Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/rules.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: the task's tests pass (`0 fail`); then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

The legacy `:*` prefix form matches both the bare command and the command followed by a space in 2.1.285 (checked in the binary). The Claude home's three read parts are also joined to the real Claude home, so a runner.json `homes.claude` outside the runner tree is still covered. Sandbox `denyRead` names each attempt through `join(paths.work, '*', '*')`, leaving the work root and project parents readable for Bun's package-script resolution. `allowRead` remains the current clone and its Claude project directory. Plain-path validation runs before the generated glob is added; caller-supplied pattern characters remain forbidden. Permission Read/Edit deny rules still do not name the work root. Claude Code 2.1.285 honours the generated `denyRead` glob through `--settings`: `bun run` succeeds, while reads of another attempt in the same project or another project fail, including reads inside an executing script.

### Task 8: Session options for query()

`buildQueryOptions` turns an `AgentLaunch` into the SDK `Options` of design 8.2; it is pure, so a test pins every security-relevant option. The binary is the one for `launch.cliVersion` (X-13), the model a full id and never an alias, `settingSources` only `project` with the base checkout as `projectConfigRoot`, the only MCP server the agflow bridge with `launch.bridge.env` (X-32), and the permission mode `auto` only for the auto profile on an account that offers it (X-29). The sandbox is a top-level option, the system prompt is Claude Code's own preset with `CLAUDE_BASH_NOTE` appended, and the SessionStart brief hook is built from the agflow command the factory gets (X-5), with an explicit 60 s timeout. The bridge and the hook start in `claudeEmptyDir(claudeHome)`, an empty runner-owned directory, instead of the base checkout the CLI would use, so a `bunfig.toml` preload or `.env` on main never loads in them outside the sandbox; that directory is also zsh's `ZDOTDIR`, and the CLI's shell is zsh, so the owner's `~/.zshenv`, `~/.zprofile`, `~/.zlogin` and `~/.bashrc` never run around agent commands (design 5, 8.2; see Decisions). Keep Claude Code's preset system prompt and append `CLAUDE_BASH_NOTE` on new and resumed queries. The note explains that the session has no approval surface, names the measured compound-command restrictions, recommends simple commands or a clone-local script for ordinary work, and preserves guard/path/network restrictions and runner-only pushes. No permission or sandbox exception accompanies the note.

- Create: `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/options.ts`

```ts
        CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL: CLAUDE_SHELL,
      });
    }
    // An owner's zsh stays the CLI's shell.
    for (const shell of ['/bin/zsh', '/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh']) {
      const env = { ...given.env, SHELL: shell };
      expect(buildQueryOptions(launch({ env }), deps()).env).toEqual({ ...env, ZDOTDIR: EMPTY });
    }
    // Whatever the launch says, ZDOTDIR and CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL are the adapter's.
    const planted = { ...given.env, ZDOTDIR: '/Users/owner', CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL: '/bin/bash' };
    const { CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL: _planted, ...unplanted } = planted;
    expect(buildQueryOptions(launch({ env: { ...planted, SHELL: '/bin/zsh' } }), deps()).env).toEqual({
      ...unplanted,
      SHELL: '/bin/zsh',
      ZDOTDIR: EMPTY,
    });
    expect(buildQueryOptions(launch({ env: { ...planted, SHELL: '/bin/bash' } }), deps()).env).toEqual({
      ...planted,
      SHELL: '/bin/bash',
      ZDOTDIR: EMPTY,
      CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL: CLAUDE_SHELL,
    });
    const wrongHome = launch({ env: { ...given.env, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: '/Users/owner/.claude' } });
    expect(() => buildQueryOptions(wrongHome, deps())).toThrow(/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/);
    const wrongTmp = launch({ env: { ...given.env, CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR: '/tmp/claude' } });
    expect(() => buildQueryOptions(wrongTmp, deps())).toThrow(/CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR/);
    const { HOME: _home, ...homeless } = given.env;
    expect(() => buildQueryOptions(launch({ env: homeless }), deps())).toThrow(/HOME/);
  });

  test("the binary is the one for launch.cliVersion, and the spawn hook is the adapter's", () => {
    const options = buildQueryOptions(launch({ cliVersion: '2.1.200' }), deps());
    expect(options.pathToClaudeCodeExecutable).toBe(join(paths.runner, 'vendor', 'claude', '2.1.200', 'claude'));
    expect(options.spawnClaudeCodeProcess).toBe(spawn);
  });

  test("new and resumed sessions retain Claude Code's prompt and explain the runner's Bash limits", () => {
    for (const profile of [standardProfile, auto]) {
      for (const resume of [null, { sessionRef: SESSION }]) {
        const options = buildQueryOptions(launch({ profile, resume }), deps({ autoOffered: true }));
        expect(options.systemPrompt).toMatchObject({
          type: 'preset',
          preset: 'claude_code',
        });
        const note = (options.systemPrompt as { append: string }).append;
        expect(note).toContain('no approval surface');
        expect(note).toContain('loops with $var');
        expect(note).toContain('$(git rev-parse');
        expect(note).toContain('brace groups with quotes');
        expect(note).toContain('sh script.sh');
        expect(note).toContain('Only the runner pushes');
        expect(options.permissionPrompts).toBe('none');
        expect(options.sandbox?.allowUnsandboxedCommands).toBe(false);
        expect(options.sandbox?.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed).toBeUndefined();
        expect(options.settings).toMatchObject({
          permissions: { allow: expect.not.arrayContaining(['Bash']) },
        });
      }
    }
  });

  test('a model alias is refused before anything is built', () => {
    for (const alias of ['opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku', 'fable', 'default', 'opusplan', 'best', 'sonnet[1m]', '']) {
      expect(() => assertFullModelId(alias)).toThrow(/full model id/);
      expect(() => buildQueryOptions(launch({ model: alias }), deps())).toThrow(/full model id/);
    }
    for (const id of ['claude-sonnet-5-5', 'claude-opus-5-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001']) {
      expect(() => assertFullModelId(id)).not.toThrow();
    }
    expect(buildQueryOptions(launch(), deps()).model).toBe('claude-sonnet-5-5');
  });
});

describe('the empty directory', () => {
  test('it lies in the Claude home; ensureClaudeEmptyDir makes it private and refuses anything but a directory', () => {
    expect(claudeEmptyDir(CLAUDE_HOME)).toBe(EMPTY);
    const home = join(scratchDir(), 'claude');
    const empty = ensureClaudeEmptyDir(home);
    expect(empty).toBe(claudeEmptyDir(home));
    expect(statSync(empty).isDirectory()).toBe(true);
    expect(statSync(empty).mode & 0o777).toBe(0o700);
    expect(ensureClaudeEmptyDir(home)).toBe(empty);
    const other = scratchDir();
    rmSync(empty, { recursive: true });
    symlinkSync(other, empty);
    expect(() => ensureClaudeEmptyDir(home)).toThrow(/not a directory/);
    rmSync(empty);
    writeFileSync(empty, '');
    expect(() => ensureClaudeEmptyDir(home)).toThrow();
  });
});
```

```ts
// The SDK options of one Claude session (design 8.2, 7.6, 8.4, X-5, X-13, X-29, X-32). Pure, so a test pins every
// security-relevant option: the tools, the permission mode, the sandbox, the deny rules, the only MCP server, the
// brief hook, the guard and the CLI's shell.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { lstatSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import type { Vendor } from '@agflow/core';
import type {
  HookCallback,
  Options,
  PermissionMode,
  SpawnedProcess,
  SpawnOptions,
} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import type { RunnerPaths } from '../../paths';
import type { PermissionProfile } from '../../profile';
import { vendorBinary } from '../../vendor/pins';
import type { AgentLaunch, AgflowCommand } from '../types';
import { createGuardHook } from './guard';
import { claudePermissionRules, claudeSandboxSettings } from './rules';

/**
 * The built-in tools an agent gets. Naming them removes the rest: SendMessage, ListAgents, the cron and wake-up
 * tools, RemoteTrigger, Workflow, EnterWorktree and ToolSearch.
 */
export const CLAUDE_BUILTIN_TOOLS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([
  'Bash',
  'Read',
  'Edit',
  'Write',
  'Glob',
  'Grep',
  'Task',
  'TaskCreate',
  'TaskGet',
  'TaskList',
  'TaskUpdate',
]);

/** Offered, and allowed, only with profile.webTools: they run in-process, outside the sandbox's network allowlist. */
const WEB_TOOLS = ['WebFetch', 'WebSearch'];

/** Measured on 2.1.285 with permissionPrompts 'none'; this note adds no permission or sandbox exception. */
export const CLAUDE_BASH_NOTE =
  'Runner Bash: this session has no approval surface. Claude Code may deny loops with $var, ' +
  'quoted command substitutions such as "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)", and brace groups with quotes ' +
  'before running them. Use simple commands; for ordinary local work that needs these shell constructs, ' +
  'write a script file in the clone and run it with sh script.sh inside the sandbox. ' +
  'The script fallback does not permit evading a guard, path, or network restriction. ' +
  'Only the runner pushes; use the agflow tools for submission.';

export interface ClaudeOptionDeps {
  /** How the runner runs agflow, from the adapter factory's input; the brief hook runs it (X-5). */
  agflow: AgflowCommand;
  /** The runner's layout; the pinned binaries lie under paths.runner. */
  paths: Pick<RunnerPaths, 'runner' | 'vaults' | 'work'>;
  /** vendorHomes(config, paths); the Claude home is the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR every launch must carry. */
  vendorHomes: Record<Vendor, string>;
  /** Whether the account offered auto mode in the adapter's last preflight. */
  autoOffered: boolean;
  /** The detached spawn hook: each claude in its own process group (design 7.4). */
  spawnClaudeCodeProcess: (options: SpawnOptions) => SpawnedProcess;
  /** The session's compaction callbacks: PreCompact warns, PostCompact captures the summary. */
  compaction: { preCompact: HookCallback; postCompact: HookCallback };
  /** A new session's id; randomUUID by default. */
  newSessionId?: () => string;
}

/**
 * An empty directory the runner owns, in its Claude home, which agents cannot write (7.6).
 *
 * The bridge and the brief hook start in it. Both run outside the sandbox with the agent token, and Bun loads the
 * bunfig.toml (with its preload) and the .env of its working directory; the CLI would start both in the base checkout,
 * so a bunfig.toml or .env committed to main would run in them.
 *
 * zsh takes it as ZDOTDIR, so none of the CLI's shells outside the sandbox (its `<shell> -c env`, the snapshot's login
 * shell and the wrapper of every Bash command) nor the agent's own reads the owner's ~/.zshenv, ~/.zprofile or
 * ~/.zlogin: only the snapshot sources ~/.zshrc, by its path, once per process (design 5, 8.2).
 */
export function claudeEmptyDir(claudeHome: string): string {
  return join(claudeHome, 'agflow-empty');
}

/** Makes the empty directory (mode 0700) before a launch; anything but a directory there, a link included, fails. */
export function ensureClaudeEmptyDir(claudeHome: string): string {
  const dir = claudeEmptyDir(claudeHome);
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  if (!lstatSync(dir).isDirectory()) throw new Error(`${dir} is not a directory`);
  return dir;
}

/**
 * The shell the CLI runs its shells with when the owner's SHELL is not a zsh (CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL): only zsh can be kept
 * from the owner's startup files by ZDOTDIR, and bash reads ~/.bashrc in each of the CLI's shells (its standard input
 * is a socket).
 */
export const CLAUDE_SHELL = '/bin/zsh';

/** The CLI's environment: the launch's, with the empty directory as ZDOTDIR and zsh as the CLI's shell. */
function claudeEnv(env: Record<string, string>, emptyDir: string): Record<string, string> {
  const { CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL: _owner, ...rest } = env;
  const zsh = env.SHELL !== undefined && basename(env.SHELL) === 'zsh';
  return { ...rest, ZDOTDIR: emptyDir, ...(zsh ? {} : { CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL: CLAUDE_SHELL }) };
}

/** A command that changes to the directory, then runs as itself: /bin/sh reads no startup file and execs it. */
export function inDirectory(dir: string, command: string, args: string[]): { command: string; args: string[] } {
  return { command: '/bin/sh', args: ['-c', 'cd -- "$1" && shift && exec "$@"', 'agflow', dir, command, ...args] };
}

/** acceptEdits, or auto for the auto profile on an account that offers it (7.6, X-29). */
export function effectivePermissionMode(profile: PermissionProfile, autoOffered: boolean): PermissionMode {
  return profile.name === 'auto' && autoOffered ? 'auto' : 'acceptEdits';
}

// A full id names a model family and a version; the CLI resolves aliases (opus, sonnet, default, opusplan, ...)
// to whatever its release maps them to, which the hub could neither record nor reproduce.
const FULL_MODEL_ID = /^claude-[a-z]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*-[0-9][a-z0-9-]*$/;

export function assertFullModelId(model: string): void {
  if (!FULL_MODEL_ID.test(model)) {
    throw new Error(`the model ${JSON.stringify(model)} is not a full model id such as claude-sonnet-5-5`);
  }
}

/**
 * The SessionStart command hook: `cd <dir> && exec <agflow> hook brief --runner`, quoted for the /bin/sh the CLI runs
 * it with.
 */
export function briefHookCommand(agflow: AgflowCommand, dir: string): string {
  const command = [agflow.command, ...agflow.args].map(shellQuote).concat('hook', 'brief', '--runner').join(' ');
  return `cd ${shellQuote(dir)} && exec ${command}`;
}

function shellQuote(word: string): string {
  return /^[A-Za-z0-9_/.:=@%+-]+$/.test(word) ? word : `'${word.replaceAll("'", `'\\''`)}'`;
}

/**
 * query()'s options for a launch. It refuses a model alias, a launch without a base checkout, and an environment
 * whose CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR differs from what the rules, the sandbox and the guard confine.
 */
export function buildQueryOptions(launch: AgentLaunch, deps: ClaudeOptionDeps): Options {
  assertFullModelId(launch.model);
  if (launch.baseCheckout === null) {
    throw new Error('a Claude launch needs a base checkout as its project config root');
  }
  const claudeHome = deps.vendorHomes.claude;
  const { CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR } = launch.env;
  if (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR !== claudeHome) {
    throw new Error(`the launch's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}, not the Claude home ${claudeHome}`);
  }
  if (CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR !== launch.tmpDir) {
    throw new Error(`the launch's CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR is ${CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR}, not its tmpDir ${launch.tmpDir}`);
  }
  // The agent's HOME is where the rules point and where the CLI expands ~; the runner's own never counts.
  const home = launch.env.HOME;
  if (!home) throw new Error("a Claude launch's environment needs HOME");
  const scope = {
    home,
    paths: deps.paths,
    vendorHomes: deps.vendorHomes,
    profile: launch.profile,
    clone: launch.clone,
    tmpDir: launch.tmpDir,
  };
  const rules = claudePermissionRules(scope);
  const emptyDir = claudeEmptyDir(claudeHome);
  const session = launch.resume
    ? { resume: launch.resume.sessionRef }
    : { sessionId: (deps.newSessionId ?? randomUUID)() };
  return {
    pathToClaudeCodeExecutable: join(deps.paths.runner, vendorBinary('claude', launch.cliVersion)),
    spawnClaudeCodeProcess: deps.spawnClaudeCodeProcess,
    cwd: launch.clone,
    // Whole: the SDK gives the child exactly this environment.
    env: claudeEnv(launch.env, emptyDir),
    ...session,
    model: launch.model,
    systemPrompt: { type: 'preset', preset: 'claude_code', append: CLAUDE_BASH_NOTE },
    settingSources: ['project'],
    projectConfigRoot: launch.baseCheckout,
    strictMcpConfig: true,
    mcpServers: {
      agflow: {
        type: 'stdio',
        ...inDirectory(emptyDir, launch.bridge.command, launch.bridge.args),
        env: launch.bridge.env,
      },
    },
    tools: [...CLAUDE_BUILTIN_TOOLS, ...(launch.profile.webTools ? WEB_TOOLS : [])],
    permissionMode: effectivePermissionMode(launch.profile, deps.autoOffered),
    // No canUseTool: a call the rules do not allow is denied at once instead of waiting for an answer.
    permissionPrompts: 'none',
    // Top-level only, so the SDK passes failIfUnavailable and Bash never runs unsandboxed.
    sandbox: claudeSandboxSettings(scope),
    settings: {
      permissions: { allow: rules.allow, deny: rules.deny },
      hooks: { SessionStart: [{ hooks: [{ type: 'command', command: briefHookCommand(deps.agflow, emptyDir) }] }] },
      autoMemoryEnabled: false,
      crossSessionInbound: 'refuse',
      cleanupPeriodDays: 30,
      syncClaudeAiSkills: false,
      syncClaudeAiPlugins: false,
    },
    hooks: {
      PreToolUse: [
        createGuardHook({
          clone: launch.clone,
          tmpDir: launch.tmpDir,
          workRoot: deps.paths.work,
          claudeHome,
          home,
        }),
      ],
      PreCompact: [{ hooks: [deps.compaction.preCompact] }],
      PostCompact: [{ hooks: [deps.compaction.postCompact] }],
    },
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run the tests and see them pass**

Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/options.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: the task's tests pass (`0 fail`); then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

2.1.285's stdio MCP config and its command hooks have no `cwd` field: the binary starts stdio servers in the project root and runs shell-form hooks with `/bin/sh -c` there. So `inDirectory` wraps the bridge as `/bin/sh -c 'cd -- "$1" && shift && exec "$@"' agflow <dir> <command> <args…>`, and the hook is `cd <dir> && exec <agflow> hook brief --runner`. A behaviour test runs both with bun from a directory holding a planted `bunfig.toml` and `.env`; Task 24 checks them with the real CLI. The CLI's environment is `launch.env` plus `ZDOTDIR`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL=/bin/zsh` unless the owner's `SHELL` is a zsh; a `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL` in the launch is dropped, and M2b's `SHELL` is left as it is. The runner makes the directory before every launch (`ensureClaudeEmptyDir`, Tasks 10, 17 and 21). Keep Claude Code's preset system prompt and append `CLAUDE_BASH_NOTE` on new and resumed queries. The note explains that the session has no approval surface, names the measured compound-command restrictions, recommends simple commands or a clone-local script for ordinary work, and preserves guard/path/network restrictions and runner-only pushes. No permission or sandbox exception accompanies the note. Literal bridge configurations include `tools: []`; their bridge environment has no `AGFLOW_ROLE`, matching `bridgeOf`. Preflight obtains its bridge through `bridgeOf`.

### Task 9: Recorded-stream fake Claude CLI

A fake `claude` that speaks 2.1.285's stream-json control protocol and replays recorded stdout frames, so the adapter runs in CI and meets signals only a subscription produces (design 15, 15.1, 8.3). A recording is JSONL: frames, plus `$`-directives for turns, waits for a user message or an interrupt, sleeps, hook callbacks, exit codes and ignoring stdin EOF mid-turn, and an `$answer` for each control request subtype; placeholders (`$SESSION`, `$UUID`, `$USER_UUID_<n>`, `$CWD`, `$MODEL`, `$PERMISSION_MODE`) are filled at replay. It reacts to interrupts (with and without `cancel_queued`), stdin EOF and SIGTERM as the real CLI does, and logs everything it receives to `FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG`. `bin/fake-claude` has no extension, so the SDK spawns it as a native binary; `fake-claude/index.ts` is the entry (`FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN`, `fakeClaudeEnv`, `claudeRecording`, `loadRecording`, `readFakeClaudeLog`).

**Files:**
- Test: `packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/fake-cli.test.ts`
- Create: `packages/testkit/bin/fake-claude`
- Create: `packages/testkit/src/fake-claude/cli.ts`
- Create: `packages/testkit/src/fake-claude/index.ts`
- Create: `packages/testkit/src/fake-claude/recording.ts`
- Test: `packages/testkit/test/fake-claude.test.ts`
- Generate:  (with `chmod +x packages/testkit/bin/fake-claude`)

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import {
  claudeRecording,
  FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN,
  fakeClaudeEnv,
  type RecordingStep,
  readFakeClaudeLog,
} from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import { query, type SDKMessage, type SDKUserMessage } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { createGuardHook } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/guard';

// macOS's first exec of a new script is slow.
const TIMEOUT = 30_000;
const SESSION = '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555';

const dirs: string[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

const frame = (value: Record<string, unknown>): RecordingStep => ({ frame: value });

const turn: RecordingStep[] = [
  frame({ type: 'command_lifecycle', command_uuid: '$LAST_USER_UUID', state: 'started', session_id: '$SESSION' }),
  frame({
    type: 'system',
    subtype: 'init',
    session_id: '$SESSION',
    cwd: '$CWD',
    model: '$MODEL',
    permissionMode: '$PERMISSION_MODE',
    tools: ['Bash'],
    mcp_servers: [],
    apiKeySource: 'none',
    claude_code_version: '2.1.285',
    uuid: '$UUID',
  }),
  {
    hook: {
      event: 'PreToolUse',
      input: {
        hook_event_name: 'PreToolUse',
        session_id: '$SESSION',
        transcript_path: '/dev/null',
        cwd: '$CWD',
        tool_name: 'Bash',
        tool_input: { command: 'git push origin HEAD' },
        tool_use_id: 'toolu_1',
      },
      toolUseId: 'toolu_1',
    },
  },
  frame({
    type: 'assistant',
    message: { role: 'assistant', model: '$MODEL', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Hello from the recording.' }] },
    parent_tool_use_id: null,
    session_id: '$SESSION',
    uuid: '$UUID',
  }),
  frame({
    type: 'result',
    subtype: 'success',
    is_error: false,
    result: 'Hello from the recording.',
    duration_ms: 1,
    duration_api_ms: 1,
    num_turns: 1,
    stop_reason: 'end_turn',
    session_id: '$SESSION',
    total_cost_usd: 0,
    usage: { input_tokens: 100, output_tokens: 10, cache_creation_input_tokens: 0, cache_read_input_tokens: 0 },
    modelUsage: {},
    permission_denials: [],
    terminal_reason: 'completed',
    uuid: '$UUID',
    user_message_uuids: ['$LAST_USER_UUID'],
  }),
];

describe('the fake claude through the Agent SDK', () => {
  test(
    'initializationResult(), one turn with a hook callback, and close() work',
    async () => {
      const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-fake-cli-'));
      dirs.push(dir);
      const env = fakeClaudeEnv({ recording: claudeRecording({ turns: [turn] }), dir });
      const scope = {
        clone: join(dir, 'clone'),
        tmpDir: join(dir, 'tmp'),
        workRoot: join(dir, 'work'),
        claudeHome: dir,
        home: dir,
      };
      const inbox: SDKUserMessage[] = [
        {
          type: 'user',
          message: { role: 'user', content: 'go' },
          parent_tool_use_id: null,
          uuid: 'aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
        },
      ];
      const q = query({
        prompt: (async function* () {
          yield* inbox;
          // A finite input would close stdin and end the session; this one stays open until close().
          await new Promise(() => {});
        })(),
        options: {
          pathToClaudeCodeExecutable: FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN,
          cwd: dir,
          env: { PATH: process.env.PATH ?? '/usr/bin:/bin', ...env },
          sessionId: SESSION,
          model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
          permissionMode: 'acceptEdits',
          hooks: { PreToolUse: [createGuardHook(scope)] },
        },
      });
      const init = await q.initializationResult();
      expect(init.account).toEqual({
        email: 'agent@example.invalid',
        organization: 'org-00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000',
        subscriptionType: 'max',
        tokenSource: 'claude.ai',
        apiProvider: 'firstParty',
      });
      const seen: SDKMessage[] = [];
      for await (const message of q) {
        seen.push(message);
        if (message.type === 'result') break;
      }
      const system = seen.find((message) => message.type === 'system' && message.subtype === 'init');
      expect(system).toMatchObject({ session_id: SESSION, model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', permissionMode: 'acceptEdits' });
      const result = seen.find((message) => message.type === 'result');
      expect(result).toMatchObject({ subtype: 'success', session_id: SESSION, result: 'Hello from the recording.' });
      expect((result as { user_message_uuids?: string[] }).user_message_uuids).toEqual([
        'aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
      ]);
      q.close();
      const log = await readFakeClaudeLog(env.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG as string);
      const argv = log.find((entry) => entry.kind === 'argv');
      expect(argv?.kind === 'argv' && argv.argv).toContain(`--session-id=${SESSION}`);
      expect(log.find((entry) => entry.kind === 'control')).toMatchObject({ request: { subtype: 'initialize' } });
      expect(log.find((entry) => entry.kind === 'user')).toMatchObject({
        message: { uuid: 'aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' },
      });
      // The SDK answered the hook with the guard's verdict.
      expect(log.find((entry) => entry.kind === 'hook_answer')).toMatchObject({
        event: 'PreToolUse',
        answer: { subtype: 'success', response: { hookSpecificOutput: { permissionDecision: 'deny' } } },
      });
      // close() ends stdin; the fake exits 0 on EOF while idle.
      for (let tries = 0; tries < 100; tries += 1) {
        if ((await readFakeClaudeLog(env.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG as string)).some((entry) => entry.kind === 'exit')) break;
        await Bun.sleep(50);
      }
      expect((await readFakeClaudeLog(env.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG as string)).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', code: 0 });
```

```ts
import { mkdtempSync, realpathSync, rmSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';

  type ClaudeRecording,
  claudeRecording,
  FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN,
  fakeClaudeEnv,
  loadRecording,
  parseRecording,
  type RecordingStep,
  readFakeClaudeLog,
  serializeRecording,
  writeRecording,

// macOS's first exec of a new script is slow; each test that runs the fake gets this long.
const TIMEOUT = 30_000;
const SESSION = '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555';

const dirs: string[] = [];
const procs: FakeProcess[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  for (const proc of procs.splice(0)) proc.kill();
  for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

function tempDir(): string {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-fake-claude-'));
  dirs.push(dir);
  return dir;
}

type Frame = Record<string, any>;

/** The fake as the SDK drives it: JSON lines in, JSON lines out. */
class FakeProcess {
  readonly frames: Frame[] = [];
  private cursor = 0;
  private waiters: (() => void)[] = [];
  readonly proc: Bun.Subprocess<'pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'>;
  readonly log: string;

  constructor(
    args: string[],
    env: Record<string, string>,
    readonly cwd: string,
  ) {
    this.log = env.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG ?? '';
    this.proc = Bun.spawn([FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, ...args], {
      cwd,
      env: { PATH: process.env.PATH ?? '/usr/bin:/bin', ...env },
      stdin: 'pipe',
      stdout: 'pipe',
      stderr: 'pipe',
    });
    void this.read();
  }

  private async read(): Promise<void> {
    let buffer = '';
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    for await (const chunk of this.proc.stdout) {
      buffer += decoder.decode(chunk, { stream: true });
      let index = buffer.indexOf('\n');
      while (index >= 0) {
        const line = buffer.slice(0, index);
        buffer = buffer.slice(index + 1);
        if (line.trim() !== '') this.frames.push(JSON.parse(line));
        index = buffer.indexOf('\n');
      }
      for (const wake of this.waiters.splice(0)) wake();
    }
    for (const wake of this.waiters.splice(0)) wake();
  }

  send(message: Frame): void {
    this.proc.stdin.write(`${JSON.stringify(message)}\n`);
    this.proc.stdin.flush();
  }

  control(requestId: string, request: Frame): void {
    this.send({ type: 'control_request', request_id: requestId, request });
  }

  user(text: string, uuid: string): void {
    this.send({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: text }, parent_tool_use_id: null, uuid });
  }

  /** The next frame after the cursor that matches, and moves the cursor past it. */
  async next(match: (frame: Frame) => boolean, timeoutMs = 10_000): Promise<Frame> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    for (;;) {
      const index = this.frames.findIndex((frame, at) => at >= this.cursor && match(frame));
      if (index >= 0) {
        this.cursor = index + 1;
        return this.frames[index] as Frame;
      }
      if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error(`no matching frame; got ${JSON.stringify(this.frames)}`);
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        this.waiters.push(resolve);
        setTimeout(resolve, 50);
      });
    }
  }

  response(requestId: string): Promise<Frame> {
    return this.next((frame) => frame.type === 'control_response' && frame.response.request_id === requestId);
  }

  async end(): Promise<number> {
    this.proc.stdin.end();
    return this.proc.exited;
  }

  kill(): void {
    this.proc.kill('SIGKILL');
  }
}

function start(recording: ClaudeRecording, args: string[] = [`--session-id=${SESSION}`]): FakeProcess {
  const dir = tempDir();
  const proc = new FakeProcess(args, fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir }), dir);
  procs.push(proc);
  return proc;
}

async function initialize(proc: FakeProcess, hooks: Frame = {}): Promise<Frame> {
  proc.control('init-1', { subtype: 'initialize', hooks });
  return proc.response('init-1');
}

const frame = (value: Frame): RecordingStep => ({ frame: value });
const result = (extra: Frame = {}): RecordingStep =>
  frame({
    type: 'result',
    subtype: 'success',
    is_error: false,
    result: 'done',
    session_id: '$SESSION',
    uuid: '$UUID',
    user_message_uuids: ['$LAST_USER_UUID'],
    ...extra,
  });
const lifecycle = (state: string, uuid = '$LAST_USER_UUID'): RecordingStep =>
  frame({ type: 'command_lifecycle', command_uuid: uuid, state, uuid: '$UUID', session_id: '$SESSION' });
const init: RecordingStep = frame({
  type: 'system',
  subtype: 'init',
  session_id: '$SESSION',
  cwd: '$CWD',
  model: '$MODEL',
  permissionMode: '$PERMISSION_MODE',
  uuid: '$UUID',
});
const say = (text: string): RecordingStep =>

    message: { role: 'assistant', content: [{ type: 'text', text }] },
    session_id: '$SESSION',
    uuid: '$UUID',
  });
```

**File:** `packages/testkit/bin/fake-claude` (new)

```
#!/bin/sh
# The recorded-stream fake claude (packages/testkit/src/fake-claude). The Agent SDK spawns this file directly, as it
# does the real binary; it runs the fake with FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN, which fakeClaudeEnv sets, or the bun on PATH.
# A symlink to this file (a test runner home's vendor/claude/<version>/claude) is followed to find the sources.
self=$0
while [ -L "$self" ]; do
  target=$(readlink "$self")
  case $target in
    /*) self=$target ;;
    *) self=$(dirname "$self")/$target ;;
  esac
done
exec "${FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN:-bun}" "$(dirname "$self")/../src/fake-claude/cli.ts" "$@"
```

```ts
// The fake claude's program (bin/fake-claude runs it). It speaks the stream-json control protocol of 2.1.285 on
// stdin and stdout: it answers control requests from the recording, replays one recorded turn per user message that
// finds it idle, and reacts to interrupts, hook answers, stdin EOF and SIGTERM as the real CLI does. Everything it
// receives goes to FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG for the tests to check.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { appendFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION } from '@agflow/runner/src/adapters/claude/pin';
import type { FakeClaudeLogRecord } from './index';
import { type ClaudeRecording, loadRecording, type RecordingStep } from './recording';

type Json = Record<string, unknown>;

interface UserMessage {
  uuid: string;
}

class Aborted extends Error {}

/** --flag value and --flag=value. */
function flag(argv: string[], name: string): string | null {
  for (let index = 0; index < argv.length; index += 1) {
    const arg = argv[index] as string;
    if (arg === name) return argv[index + 1] ?? null;
    if (arg.startsWith(`${name}=`)) return arg.slice(name.length + 1);
  }
  return null;
}

const PLACEHOLDER = /\$(SESSION|LAST_USER_UUID|USER_UUID_(\d+)|UUID|CWD|MODEL|PERMISSION_MODE)\b/g;

class FakeClaude {
  private readonly session: string;
  private readonly model: string;
  private readonly permissionMode: string;
  private readonly cwd = realpathSync(process.cwd());
  /** The callback ids the SDK registered at initialize, by hook event: the first of each event's first matcher. */
  private readonly callbacks = new Map<string, string>();
  private readonly queue: UserMessage[] = [];
  private readonly pendingHooks = new Map<string, (answer: Json) => void>();
  private nextTurn = 0;
  private running = false;
  /** The user messages the running turn has taken, in order. */
  private turnUsers: UserMessage[] = [];
  private turnAbort: AbortController | null = null;
  private userWaiter: ((message: UserMessage) => void) | null = null;
  private interruptWaiter: (() => void) | null = null;
  private ignoreEof = false;
  private eof = false;

  constructor(
    private readonly recording: ClaudeRecording,
    private readonly logPath: string | null,
    argv: string[],
  ) {
    this.session = flag(argv, '--session-id') ?? flag(argv, '--resume') ?? randomUUID();
    this.model = flag(argv, '--model') ?? recording.header.model;
    this.permissionMode = flag(argv, '--permission-mode') ?? recording.header.permissionMode;
  }

  log(entry: FakeClaudeLogRecord): void {
    if (this.logPath) appendFileSync(this.logPath, `${JSON.stringify({ at: Date.now(), ...entry })}\n`);
  }

  async exit(code: number): Promise<never> {
    this.log({ kind: 'exit', code });
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => process.stdout.write('', () => resolve()));
    process.exit(code);
  }

  private write(frame: Json): void {
    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(frame)}\n`);
  }

  private fill(value: unknown): unknown {
    if (typeof value === 'string') return this.fillText(value);
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => this.fill(item));
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
      return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [this.fillText(key), this.fill(item)]));
    }
    return value;
  }

  private fillText(text: string): string {
    return text.replace(PLACEHOLDER, (whole, name: string, nth: string | undefined) => {
      if (nth !== undefined) return this.turnUsers[Number(nth) - 1]?.uuid ?? whole;
      switch (name) {
        case 'SESSION':
          return this.session;
        case 'LAST_USER_UUID':
          return this.turnUsers.at(-1)?.uuid ?? whole;
        case 'UUID':
          return randomUUID();
        case 'CWD':
          return this.cwd;
        case 'MODEL':
          return this.model;
        default:
          return this.permissionMode;
      }
    });
  }

  async onLine(message: Json): Promise<void> {
    switch (message.type) {
      case 'control_request':
        return this.onControl(String(message.request_id), (message.request ?? {}) as Json);
      case 'control_response': {
        const response = (message.response ?? {}) as Json;
        this.pendingHooks.get(String(response.request_id))?.(response);
        return;
      }
      case 'user': {
        this.log({ kind: 'user', message });
        const user = { uuid: typeof message.uuid === 'string' ? message.uuid : randomUUID() };
        if (this.userWaiter) {
          const wake = this.userWaiter;
          this.userWaiter = null;
          wake(user);
        } else {
          this.queue.push(user);
          if (!this.running) void this.runNextTurn();
        }
        return;
      }
      default:
        // keep_alive, control_cancel_request and frames the fake has no use for.
        return;
    }
  }

  private async onControl(requestId: string, request: Json): Promise<void> {
    this.log({ kind: 'control', requestId, request });
    const subtype = String(request.subtype);
    if (subtype === 'initialize') this.registerHooks(request.hooks);
    if (subtype === 'interrupt') return this.onInterrupt(requestId, request.cancel_queued === true);
    if (subtype === 'initialize') await this.runSteps(this.recording.startup, null);
    const answer = this.recording.answers[subtype];
    if (answer === undefined) {
      this.write({
        type: 'control_response',
        response: { subtype: 'error', request_id: requestId, error: `fake-claude has no answer for ${subtype}` },
      });
    } else if ('error' in answer) {
      this.write({
        type: 'control_response',
        response: { subtype: 'error', request_id: requestId, error: answer.error },
      });
    } else {
      this.write({
        type: 'control_response',
        response: { subtype: 'success', request_id: requestId, response: this.fill(answer.response) },
      });
    }
  }

  private registerHooks(hooks: unknown): void {
    if (typeof hooks !== 'object' || hooks === null) return;
    for (const [event, matchers] of Object.entries(hooks)) {
      const id = (matchers as { hookCallbackIds?: string[] }[] | undefined)?.[0]?.hookCallbackIds?.[0];
      if (id) this.callbacks.set(event, id);
    }
  }

  private onInterrupt(requestId: string, cancelQueued: boolean): void {
    const cancelled = cancelQueued ? this.queue.splice(0).map((user) => user.uuid) : [];
    const stillQueued = this.queue.map((user) => user.uuid);
    this.write({
      type: 'control_response',
      response: { subtype: 'success', request_id: requestId, response: { still_queued: stillQueued, cancelled } },
    });
    if (!this.running) return;
    if (this.interruptWaiter) {
      // The recording holds what the CLI printed after this interrupt.
      const wake = this.interruptWaiter;
      this.interruptWaiter = null;
      wake();
    } else {
      this.turnAbort?.abort();
    }
  }

  async onEof(): Promise<void> {
    this.eof = true;
    this.log({ kind: 'eof', midTurn: this.running, ignored: this.running && this.ignoreEof });
    if (this.running && this.ignoreEof) return;
    await this.exit(0);
  }

  private async runNextTurn(): Promise<void> {
    const user = this.queue.shift();
    if (!user) return;
    this.running = true;
    this.turnUsers = [user];
    this.ignoreEof = false;
    this.turnAbort = new AbortController();
    const steps = this.recording.turns[this.nextTurn];
    this.nextTurn += 1;
    try {
      if (steps === undefined) {
        this.log({ kind: 'note', text: `the recording has no turn ${this.nextTurn}` });
        this.write(this.endFrame('error_during_execution', `fake-claude: the recording has no turn ${this.nextTurn}`));
      } else {
        await this.runSteps(steps, this.turnAbort.signal);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof Aborted)) throw error;
      this.writeAborted();
    }
    this.running = false;
    this.turnAbort = null;
    this.userWaiter = null;
    this.interruptWaiter = null;
    if (this.eof) await this.exit(0);
    if (this.queue.length > 0) void this.runNextTurn();
  }

  private async runSteps(steps: RecordingStep[], signal: AbortSignal | null): Promise<void> {
    for (const step of steps) {
      if (signal?.aborted) throw new Aborted();
      if ('frame' in step) {
        this.write(this.fill(step.frame) as Json);
      } else if ('wait' in step) {
        if (step.wait === 'user') {
          const queued = this.queue.shift();
          const user = queued ?? (await this.until<UserMessage>(signal, (wake) => (this.userWaiter = wake)));
          this.turnUsers.push(user);
        } else {
          await this.until<void>(signal, (wake) => (this.interruptWaiter = wake));
        }
      } else if ('sleep' in step) {
        await this.until<void>(signal, (wake) => setTimeout(wake, step.sleep));
      } else if ('hook' in step) {
        await this.fireHook(step.hook, signal);
      } else if ('exit' in step) {
        await this.exit(step.exit);
      } else {
        this.ignoreEof = true;
      }
    }
  }

  /** Resolves when `arm`'s callback is called, or rejects with Aborted when the turn is interrupted. */
  private until<T>(signal: AbortSignal | null, arm: (wake: (value: T) => void) => void): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      const abort = () => reject(new Aborted());
      signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
      arm((value) => {
        signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
        resolve(value);
      });
    });
  }

  private async fireHook(
    hook: { event: string; input: Record<string, unknown>; toolUseId?: string },
    signal: AbortSignal | null,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const callbackId = this.callbacks.get(hook.event);
    if (callbackId === undefined) {
      this.log({ kind: 'note', text: `no ${hook.event} callback was registered at initialize; the hook is skipped` });
      return;
    }
    const requestId = randomUUID();
    const answer = this.until<Json>(signal, (wake) => this.pendingHooks.set(requestId, wake));
    this.write({
      type: 'control_request',
      request_id: requestId,
      request: {
        subtype: 'hook_callback',
        callback_id: callbackId,
        input: this.fill(hook.input),
        ...(hook.toolUseId === undefined ? {} : { tool_use_id: this.fillText(hook.toolUseId) }),
      },
    });
    try {
      this.log({ kind: 'hook_answer', event: hook.event, callbackId, answer: await answer });
    } finally {
      this.pendingHooks.delete(requestId);
    }
  }

  /** What 2.1.285 prints when an interrupt stops a turn that was running a tool. */
  private writeAborted(): void {
    this.write({ ...this.endFrame('error_during_execution', null), terminal_reason: 'aborted_tools' });
    for (const user of this.turnUsers) {
      this.write({
        type: 'command_lifecycle',
        command_uuid: user.uuid,
        state: 'cancelled',
        uuid: randomUUID(),
        session_id: this.session,
      });
    }
  }

  private endFrame(subtype: string, error: string | null): Json {
    return {
      type: 'result',
      subtype,
      is_error: true,
      duration_ms: 0,
      duration_api_ms: 0,
      num_turns: 0,
      result: null,
      stop_reason: null,
      session_id: this.session,
      total_cost_usd: 0,
      usage: { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0, cache_creation_input_tokens: 0, cache_read_input_tokens: 0 },
      modelUsage: {},
      permission_denials: [],
      errors: error === null ? [] : [error],
      terminal_reason: null,
      uuid: randomUUID(),
      user_message_uuid: this.turnUsers[0]?.uuid ?? null,
      user_message_uuids: this.turnUsers.map((user) => user.uuid),
    };
  }
}

async function main(argv: string[]): Promise<void> {
  if (argv.includes('--version')) {
    process.stdout.write(`${process.env.FAKE_CLAUDE_VERSION || CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION} (Claude Code)\n`);
    return;
  }
  const recordingPath = process.env.FAKE_CLAUDE_RECORDING;
  if (!recordingPath) {
    process.stderr.write('fake-claude: FAKE_CLAUDE_RECORDING is not set\n');
    process.exit(2);
  }
  const fake = new FakeClaude(loadRecording(recordingPath), process.env.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG || null, argv);
  fake.log({ kind: 'argv', argv });
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => void fake.exit(143));
  // One line at a time, in order: an answer can depend on what an earlier line set up.
  let buffer = '';
  let chain = Promise.resolve();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  for await (const chunk of process.stdin) {
    buffer += decoder.decode(chunk as Uint8Array, { stream: true });
    let index = buffer.indexOf('\n');
    while (index >= 0) {
      const line = buffer.slice(0, index).trim();
      buffer = buffer.slice(index + 1);
      index = buffer.indexOf('\n');
      if (line === '') continue;
      const message = JSON.parse(line) as Json;
      chain = chain.then(() => fake.onLine(message));
    }
  }
  await chain;
  await fake.onEof();
}

await main(process.argv.slice(2));
```

```ts
// The recorded-stream fake claude (design 15, 15.1): an executable that speaks the CLI's stream-json control
// protocol and replays recorded stdout frames, so the Claude adapter runs in CI and meets signals only a subscription
// produces. It stays out of the testkit's main index; M2d's Claude tests import this entry.
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { type ClaudeRecording, writeRecording } from './recording';

export * from './recording';

/**
 * The executable. It has no file extension, so the Agent SDK spawns it as a native binary, as it does the real one.
 * It runs cli.ts with FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN, or the bun on PATH.
 */
export const FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN = join(import.meta.dir, '..', '..', 'bin', 'fake-claude');

export interface FakeClaudeEnvOptions {
  /** A recording, written into dir, or the path of one. */
  recording: ClaudeRecording | string;
  /** Where the recording and the log go. */
  dir: string;
  /** What `--version` prints instead of the pin. */
  version?: string;
}

/** The variables the fake reads; they reach it through the launch environment, which the SDK passes whole. */
export function fakeClaudeEnv(options: FakeClaudeEnvOptions): Record<string, string> {
  mkdirSync(options.dir, { recursive: true });
  let recording = options.recording;
  if (typeof recording !== 'string') {
    const path = join(options.dir, 'recording.jsonl');
    writeRecording(path, recording);
    recording = path;
  }
  return {
    FAKE_CLAUDE_RECORDING: recording,
    FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG: join(options.dir, 'fake-claude.log'),
    FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN: process.execPath,
    ...(options.version === undefined ? {} : { FAKE_CLAUDE_VERSION: options.version }),
  };
}

/** What one line of FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG records. */
export type FakeClaudeLogRecord =
  | { kind: 'argv'; argv: string[] }
  /** Every control request the SDK sent, as it came. */
  | { kind: 'control'; requestId: string; request: Record<string, unknown> }
  /** Every user message, as it came. */
  | { kind: 'user'; message: Record<string, unknown> }
  /** The SDK's answer to a $hook directive's hook_callback. */
  | { kind: 'hook_answer'; event: string; callbackId: string; answer: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { kind: 'eof'; midTurn: boolean; ignored: boolean }
  | { kind: 'exit'; code: number }
  /** Something the replay could not do as recorded: no turn left, no callback for a hook. */
  | { kind: 'note'; text: string };

/** One line of FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG; `at` is epoch ms. */
export type FakeClaudeLogEntry = { at: number } & FakeClaudeLogRecord;

export async function readFakeClaudeLog(path: string): Promise<FakeClaudeLogEntry[]> {
  const file = Bun.file(path);
  if (!(await file.exists())) return [];
  return (await file.text())
    .split('\n')
    .filter((line) => line.trim() !== '')
    .map((line) => JSON.parse(line) as FakeClaudeLogEntry);
}
```

```ts
// Recordings for the fake claude (design 15, 15.1, 8.3): what a real 2.1.285 printed on stdout in stream-json mode,
// split into turns, plus the directives that make a replay react to its input and the answers to the SDK's control
// requests. A recording is JSONL: a line holding a "type" is a frame, printed as it is after its placeholders are
// filled; every other line is one directive, an object with a single $-key.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { isAbsolute, join } from 'node:path';

/** What the recording is and where it came from. */
export interface RecordingHeader {
  /** The CLI version the frames came from. */
  cliVersion: string;
  /** captured: a real CLI printed it; synthesised: built by a test or from the typings and the binary's texts. */
  source: 'captured' | 'synthesised';
  scenario: string;
  /**
   * The account the frames show. Captures run against the scripted server with an API key, and the recorder rewrites
   * them into a synthetic subscription account; live captures keep the (redacted) real one.
   */
  account: 'synthetic-subscription' | 'live';
  /** The --model and --permission-mode the frames were recorded with; $MODEL and $PERMISSION_MODE default to them. */
  model: string;
  permissionMode: string;
}

/** The answer to one control request subtype: a success response, or an error with its message. */
export type ControlAnswer = { response: Record<string, unknown> } | { error: string };

/** One step of a turn, or of the startup that follows initialize. */
export type RecordingStep =
  /** Printed after its placeholders are filled. */
  | { frame: Record<string, unknown> }
  /** Waits for the next user message (a delivery folded into the running turn), or for an interrupt request. */
  | { wait: 'user' | 'interrupt' }
  | { sleep: number }
  /** Sends hook_callback for the callback the SDK registered for the event, and logs the SDK's answer. */
  | { hook: { event: string; input: Record<string, unknown>; toolUseId?: string } }
  /** Exits with this code. */
  | { exit: number }
  /** From here to the end of the turn, stdin EOF does not end the process. */
  | { ignoreEof: true };

export interface ClaudeRecording {
  header: RecordingHeader;
  /** Answers by control request subtype: initialize, get_settings, get_usage and any other the recording knows. */
  answers: Record<string, ControlAnswer>;
  /** Run after initialize, before its answer: the SessionStart hook frames, for one. */
  startup: RecordingStep[];
  /** Each user message that arrives while the fake is idle replays the next turn. */
  turns: RecordingStep[][];
}

/**
 * The placeholders a replay fills in any string, keys included: the session id (--session-id or --resume), a fresh
 * uuid per occurrence, the newest user message's uuid and the n-th of the running turn (1-based), the working
 * directory, and the --model and --permission-mode arguments.
 */
export const RECORDING_PLACEHOLDERS = [
  '$SESSION',
  '$UUID',
  '$LAST_USER_UUID',
  '$USER_UUID_<n>',
  '$CWD',
  '$MODEL',
  '$PERMISSION_MODE',
] as const;

/** The base recordings record:claude writes. */
export const CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR = join(import.meta.dir, '..', '..', 'fixtures', 'claude');

/** The account a synthetic subscription shows: a made-up email and organisation, and a Max plan. */
export const SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT = Object.freeze({
  email: 'agent@example.invalid',
  organization: 'org-00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000',
  subscriptionType: 'max',
  tokenSource: 'claude.ai',
  apiProvider: 'firstParty',
});

export interface ClaudeRecordingInput {
  turns: RecordingStep[][];
  startup?: RecordingStep[];
  /** Merged over the defaults: a synthetic subscription account, a sandbox that is on, and no plan usage. */
  answers?: Record<string, ControlAnswer>;
  header?: Partial<RecordingHeader>;
}

/** A synthesised recording, for cases no capture can produce (limit hits, overage) and for the fake's own tests. */
export function claudeRecording(input: ClaudeRecordingInput): ClaudeRecording {
  return {
    header: {
      cliVersion: '2.1.285',
      source: 'synthesised',
      scenario: 'synthesised',
      account: 'synthetic-subscription',
      model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
      permissionMode: 'acceptEdits',
      ...input.header,
    },
    answers: {
      initialize: {
        response: {
          commands: [],
          agents: [],
          output_style: 'default',
          available_output_styles: ['default'],
          models: [],
          account: { ...SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT },
          pid: 0,
        },
      },
      get_settings: {
        response: { effective: { sandbox: { enabled: true, failIfUnavailable: true } }, sources: [], applied: {} },
      },
      get_usage: { response: { subscription_type: 'max', rate_limits_available: false, rate_limits: null } },
      ...input.answers,
    },
    startup: input.startup ?? [],
    turns: input.turns,
  };
}

const DIRECTIVES = ['$recording', '$answer', '$turn', '$wait', '$sleep', '$hook', '$exit', '$ignoreEof'] as const;

/** The JSONL form: the header, the answers, the startup steps, then each turn after a $turn line. */
export function serializeRecording(recording: ClaudeRecording): string {
  const lines: unknown[] = [{ $recording: recording.header }];
  for (const [subtype, answer] of Object.entries(recording.answers)) lines.push({ $answer: { subtype, ...answer } });
  const steps = (list: RecordingStep[]) => lines.push(...list.map(stepLine));
  steps(recording.startup);
  recording.turns.forEach((turn, index) => {
    lines.push({ $turn: index + 1 });
    steps(turn);
  });
  return `${lines.map((line) => JSON.stringify(line)).join('\n')}\n`;
}

function stepLine(step: RecordingStep): unknown {
  if ('frame' in step) return step.frame;
  if ('wait' in step) return { $wait: step.wait };
  if ('sleep' in step) return { $sleep: step.sleep };
  if ('hook' in step) return { $hook: step.hook };
  if ('exit' in step) return { $exit: step.exit };
  return { $ignoreEof: true };
}

export function parseRecording(text: string, name = 'recording'): ClaudeRecording {
  let header: RecordingHeader | null = null;
  const answers: Record<string, ControlAnswer> = {};
  const startup: RecordingStep[] = [];
  const turns: RecordingStep[][] = [];
  const lines = text.split('\n');
  lines.forEach((line, index) => {
    if (line.trim() === '') return;
    const where = `${name}:${index + 1}`;
    let entry: Record<string, unknown>;
    try {
      entry = JSON.parse(line);
    } catch {
      throw new Error(`${where} is not JSON`);
    }
    if (typeof entry !== 'object' || entry === null || Array.isArray(entry)) throw new Error(`${where} is no object`);
    const current = turns.at(-1) ?? startup;
    if (typeof entry.type === 'string') {
      current.push({ frame: entry });
      return;
    }
    const keys = Object.keys(entry);
    const key = keys[0] as (typeof DIRECTIVES)[number];
    if (keys.length !== 1 || !DIRECTIVES.includes(key)) throw new Error(`${where} is neither a frame nor a directive`);
    const value = entry[key];
    switch (key) {
      case '$recording':
        header = value as RecordingHeader;
        return;
      case '$answer': {
        const { subtype, ...answer } = value as { subtype: string } & ControlAnswer;
        answers[subtype] = answer as ControlAnswer;
        return;
      }
      case '$turn':
        turns.push([]);
        return;
      case '$wait':
        if (value !== 'user' && value !== 'interrupt') throw new Error(`${where} waits for ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);
        current.push({ wait: value });
        return;
      case '$sleep':
        current.push({ sleep: Number(value) });
        return;
      case '$hook':
        current.push({ hook: value as { event: string; input: Record<string, unknown>; toolUseId?: string } });
        return;
      case '$exit':
        current.push({ exit: Number(value) });
        return;
      case '$ignoreEof':
        current.push({ ignoreEof: true });
        return;
    }
  });
  if (header === null) throw new Error(`${name} has no $recording header`);
  return { header, answers, startup, turns };
}

/** A recording by fixture name (packages/testkit/fixtures/claude/<name>.jsonl) or by absolute path. */
export function loadRecording(nameOrPath: string): ClaudeRecording {
  const path = isAbsolute(nameOrPath) ? nameOrPath : join(CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, `${nameOrPath}.jsonl`);
  let text: string;
  try {
    text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(`no Claude recording at ${path}: ${(error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code ?? error}`);
  }
  return parseRecording(text, path);
}

export function writeRecording(path: string, recording: ClaudeRecording): void {
  writeFileSync(path, serializeRecording(recording));
}
```

### Task 10: Stream recorder, redaction and the base recordings

`record-claude-stream.ts`, which M2b's pre-declared `record:claude` script runs, drives the real pinned claude through the SDK with `buildQueryOptions` for a scratch launch and turns what it prints into the fake's recordings (design 15, 15.1, 8.1, 8.3). By default it runs against the scripted server behind the refusing proxy, with scratch homes and a stub agflow (`claude-stub-bridge.ts`, both the bridge and the brief hook), so no model is used; it rewrites the captured API-key account into a synthetic subscription marked in the header, drops machine-specific managed policy, and redacts emails, organisation ids, session ids and home paths. This task commits the base recordings (`preflight-ok`, `turn-basic`, `turn-delivery`, `interrupt`, `compaction`) and the transcript fixture `session.jsonl`, captured from 2.1.285, and the recorder asserts that each transcript lies in the project directory Task 6 names. `--live` records from the runner's own login and uses a real model; do not use it during implementation or verification.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, realpathSync, rmSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { homedir, tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { BRIDGE_ANSWERS } from '@agflow/core';
import {
  type ClaudeRecording,
  claudeRecording,
  FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN,
  fakeClaudeEnv,
  loadRecording,
  SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT,
} from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import { STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS, STUB_UNREACHABLE_TOOL } from '../../../scripts/claude-stub-bridge';
import {
  asSubscription,
  assertTranscriptPlacement,
  CLAUDE_SCENARIOS,
  type ClaudeScenario,
  type RedactionContext,
  recordingOf,
  redactRecording,
  runScenario,
  type ScenarioRun,
  type ScratchLaunch,
  scratchLaunch,
  stripManagedPolicy,
} from '../../../scripts/record-claude-stream';
import { BRIDGE_TOOL_NAMES } from '../../../src/adapters/bridge-tools';
import { buildQueryOptions, CLAUDE_BUILTIN_TOOLS, claudeEmptyDir } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/options';
import { claudeProjectDir } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/paths';
import { CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/pin';
import { RunnerConfigSchema, saveRunnerConfig } from '../../../src/config';
import { runnerPaths } from '../../../src/paths';
import { vendorBinary } from '../../../src/vendor/pins';

// macOS's first exec of a new script is slow.
const TIMEOUT = 30_000;
const STUB = join(import.meta.dir, '..', '..', '..', 'scripts', 'claude-stub-bridge.ts');

const cleanups: (() => void)[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) cleanup();
});

beforeAll(() => {
  // Warm both scripts once.
  const env = { PATH: process.env.PATH ?? '', FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN: process.execPath };
  Bun.spawnSync([FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, '--version'], { env });
  Bun.spawnSync([process.execPath, STUB, 'hook', 'brief', '--runner'], { env });
}, TIMEOUT);

function scenario(name: string): ClaudeScenario {
  const found = CLAUDE_SCENARIOS.find((entry) => entry.name === name);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no scenario ${name}`);
  return found;
}

/** Replays a committed recording through the fake claude, driven by its scenario through buildQueryOptions. */
async function replay(name: string): Promise<{ recording: ClaudeRecording; run: ScenarioRun; launch: ScratchLaunch }> {
  const recording = loadRecording(name);
  const launch = scratchLaunch({ bin: FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, model: recording.header.model, env: {} });
  cleanups.push(launch.cleanup);
  Object.assign(launch.launch.env, fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir: join(launch.root, 'fake') }));
  const run = await runScenario(scenario(name), launch);
  return { recording, run, launch };
}

/**
 * The recorder's own path from a run to a recording gives back the recording that was replayed: what assembles,
 * templates, rewrites the account, strips the policy and redacts is the code that wrote the committed files.
 */
function expectRoundTrip(recording: ClaudeRecording, run: ScenarioRun, launch: ScratchLaunch): void {
  const again = recordingOf(run, recording.header, launch, { live: false });
  expect(again.answers).toEqual(recording.answers);
  expect(again.turns).toEqual(recording.turns);
  expect(again.startup).toEqual(recording.startup);
}

const out = (run: ScenarioRun) => run.events.filter((event) => event.dir === 'out').map((event) => event.frame);

/** The first frame the CLI printed that matches; the test fails when there is none. */
function first(run: ScenarioRun, match: (frame: Record<string, any>) => boolean): Record<string, any> {
  const found = out(run).find(match);
  if (found === undefined) throw new Error('no such frame in the replay');
  return found;
}

describe('the stub bridge', () => {

    proc.stdin.end();
    const text = await new Response(proc.stdout).text();

      .split('\n')
      .filter(Boolean)

    async () => {

        { jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'notifications/initialized' },
        { jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 2, method: 'tools/list' },

        call(4, 'declare_blocked'),
        call(5, 'write_handoff'),

        'write_handoff',
        'declare_blocked',
        'declare_impossible',
        'release_task',
        'submit',

      expect(BRIDGE_TOOL_NAMES.worker).toEqual(STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS);
      expect(answers[1]?.result.tools.map((tool: { name: string }) => tool.name)).toEqual([...STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS]);
      for (const name of ['submit', 'declare_blocked', 'declare_impossible', 'release_task', 'write_handoff']) {
        expect(STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS as readonly string[]).toContain(name);
      }
      expect(STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS as readonly string[]).not.toContain('claim_task');
      for (const answer of answers.slice(2, 5)) {
        expect(answer.result.isError).toBeUndefined();
        expect(answer.result.content[0].type).toBe('text');
      }
      expect(answers[2]?.result.content[0].text).toContain('Submission pending');
      expect(answers[5]?.result).toEqual({

      });

  test(

      const run = Bun.spawnSync([process.execPath, STUB, 'hook', 'brief', '--runner'], {

      });
      expect(run.exitCode).toBe(0);
      const output = JSON.parse(run.stdout.toString());
      expect(output.hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName).toBe('SessionStart');
      expect(output.hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext).toContain('Your working directory: /work/p/T-1-a1');
    },

});

describe('redaction', () => {
  const SESSION = '9f1c2d3e-4b5a-4c6d-8e7f-0a1b2c3d4e5f';
  const OTHER_SESSION = '1e46f8ed-76d5-4281-b1b9-d042abd4cf05';
  const context: RedactionContext = {
    sessionId: SESSION,
    sessionPlaceholder: '$SESSION',
    paths: [
      ['/private/tmp/agflow-record-x1/agflow/work/p/T-1-a1', '$CWD'],
      ['/private/tmp/agflow-record-x1', '/redacted'],
      ['/Users/owner', '/Users/redacted'],
    ],
  };

  function captured(): ClaudeRecording {
    return claudeRecording({
      header: { source: 'captured' },
      answers: {
        initialize: {
          response: {
            account: {
              email: 'owner@example.com',
              organization: 'org-3f2a9b1c-1111-4222-8333-444455556666',
              subscriptionType: 'max',
            },
          },
        },
      },
      turns: [
        [
          {
            frame: {
              type: 'system',
              subtype: 'init',
              session_id: SESSION,
              cwd: '/private/tmp/agflow-record-x1/agflow/work/p/T-1-a1',
              transcript_path:
                '/private/tmp/agflow-record-x1/agflow/runner/homes/claude/projects/' +
                `-private-tmp-agflow-record-x1-agflow-work-p-T-1-a1/${SESSION}.jsonl`,
              note: 'mail owner.name+agflow@corp.example.org or see /Users/owner/.zshrc',
              organization_uuid: '0d1e2f3a-aaaa-4bbb-8ccc-dddddddddddd',
              key: 'sk-ant-api03-agflow-test-dummy-key',
            },
          },
          { frame: { type: 'result', session_id: OTHER_SESSION, new_conversation_id: OTHER_SESSION } },
        ],
      ],
    });
  }

  test('it removes emails, organisation ids, the scratch home and session ids', () => {
    const redacted = redactRecording(captured(), context);
    const text = JSON.stringify(redacted);
    for (const secret of [
      'owner@example.com',
      'owner.name+agflow@corp.example.org',
      '3f2a9b1c',
      '0d1e2f3a',
      'agflow-record-x1',
      '/Users/owner',
      SESSION,
      OTHER_SESSION,
      'dummy-key',
    ]) {
      expect(text).not.toContain(secret);
    }
    const init = redacted.turns[0]?.[0];
    expect(init).toEqual({
      frame: {
        type: 'system',
        subtype: 'init',
        session_id: '$SESSION',
        cwd: '$CWD',
        transcript_path: '/redacted/agflow/runner/homes/claude/projects/-redacted-agflow-work-p-T-1-a1/$SESSION.jsonl',
        note: 'mail agent@example.invalid or see /Users/redacted/.zshrc',
        organization_uuid: SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT.organization,
        key: 'sk-ant-redacted',
      },
```
