    expect(redacted.answers.initialize).toEqual({
      response: {
        account: {
          email: SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT.email,
          organization: SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT.organization,
          subscriptionType: 'max',
        },
      },
    });
    // Another session's id becomes a stable synthetic one, the same wherever it appears.
    const other = redacted.turns[0]?.[1];
    expect(other).toEqual({
      frame: {
        type: 'result',
        session_id: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
        new_conversation_id: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
      },
    });
  });

  test('it is idempotent', () => {
    const once = redactRecording(captured(), context);
    expect(redactRecording(once, context)).toEqual(once);
  });
});

describe('the managed policy', () => {
  const flagSettings = {
    cleanupPeriodDays: 30,
    permissions: { allow: ['mcp__agflow'], deny: ['Bash(gh:*)'] },
    sandbox: { enabled: true, filesystem: { denyRead: ['/redacted/home/.ssh'] } },
  };
  const policySettings = {
    env: { DISABLE_TELEMETRY: '1' },
    permissions: { deny: ['Read(/etc/shadow)', 'Read(~/.gnupg/**)'], disableBypassPermissionsMode: 'disable' },
    disableRemoteControl: true,
    allowedHttpHookUrls: ['http://localhost:*'],
  };
  const userSettings = { permissions: { deny: ['Bash(gh:*)', 'Bash(curl:*)'] }, cleanupPeriodDays: 14 };

  function withSettings(response: Record<string, unknown>): ClaudeRecording {
    return claudeRecording({ answers: { get_settings: { response } }, turns: [] });
  }

  test('it drops the policy source and the lock reason, and rebuilds effective from the other sources', () => {
    const recording = withSettings({
      effective: { ...flagSettings, ...policySettings },
      sources: [
        { source: 'userSettings', settings: userSettings },
        { source: 'flagSettings', settings: flagSettings },
        { source: 'policySettings', settings: policySettings },
      ],
      remote_control_policy_lock_reason: "Remote Control is disabled by your organization's policy.",
      applied: { model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' },
    });
    const stripped = stripManagedPolicy(recording);
    expect(stripped.answers.get_settings).toEqual({
      response: {
        // Objects merge, arrays concatenate without duplicates, and the later source wins for scalars.
        effective: {
          permissions: { deny: ['Bash(gh:*)', 'Bash(curl:*)'], allow: ['mcp__agflow'] },
          cleanupPeriodDays: 30,
          sandbox: flagSettings.sandbox,
        },
        sources: [
          { source: 'userSettings', settings: userSettings },
          { source: 'flagSettings', settings: flagSettings },
        ],
        applied: { model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' },
      },
    });
    const text = JSON.stringify(stripped.answers.get_settings);
    for (const policy of ['policy', 'etc/shadow', 'gnupg', 'disableRemoteControl', 'allowedHttpHookUrls', 'env']) {
      expect(text).not.toContain(policy);
    }
    expect(stripManagedPolicy(stripped)).toEqual(stripped);
    // The input is left as it was.
    expect(JSON.stringify(recording)).toContain('policySettings');
  });

  test('an answer without a policy source keeps its effective settings', () => {
    const response = {
      effective: { ...flagSettings, model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' },
      sources: [{ source: 'flagSettings', settings: flagSettings }],
    };
    expect(stripManagedPolicy(withSettings(response)).answers.get_settings).toEqual({ response });
    const failed = claudeRecording({ answers: { get_settings: { error: 'no settings' } }, turns: [] });
    expect(stripManagedPolicy(failed)).toEqual(failed);
  });

  test('no committed recording carries a managed policy', () => {
    for (const name of ['preflight-ok', 'turn-basic', 'turn-delivery', 'interrupt', 'compaction']) {
      const text = JSON.stringify(loadRecording(name));
      for (const policy of ['policySettings', 'policy_lock', 'etc/shadow', 'disableRemoteControl']) {
        expect(text).not.toContain(policy);
      }
    }
  });
});

describe('the synthetic subscription', () => {
  test('an API-key capture becomes the synthetic subscription account', () => {
    const capture = claudeRecording({
      header: { source: 'captured', account: 'live' },
      answers: {
        initialize: {
          response: {
            account: { email: 'owner@corp.example.org', apiKeySource: 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY', apiProvider: 'firstParty' },
            models: [{ value: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' }],
          },
        },
        get_usage: { response: { subscription_type: null, rate_limits: null } },
      },
      startup: [{ frame: { type: 'system', subtype: 'hook_started', apiKeySource: 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' } }],
      turns: [
        [
          { frame: { type: 'system', subtype: 'init', apiKeySource: 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY', model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' } },
          { frame: { type: 'result', subtype: 'success' } },
        ],
      ],
    });
    const subscription = asSubscription(capture);
    expect(subscription.header.account).toBe('synthetic-subscription');
    expect(subscription.answers.initialize).toEqual({
      response: { account: { ...SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT }, models: [{ value: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' }] },
    });
    expect(subscription.answers.get_usage).toEqual({ response: { subscription_type: 'max', rate_limits: null } });
    expect(subscription.startup).toEqual([
      { frame: { type: 'system', subtype: 'hook_started', apiKeySource: 'none' } },
    ]);
    expect(subscription.turns[0]?.[0]).toEqual({
      frame: { type: 'system', subtype: 'init', apiKeySource: 'none', model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5' },
    });
    expect(JSON.stringify(subscription)).not.toContain('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY');
    expect(JSON.stringify(subscription)).not.toContain('owner@corp.example.org');
  });
});

describe('the recorder', () => {
  test("a live launch is confined by the runner's own layout and runs its pinned claude", () => {
    const runnerHome = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-live-')));
    cleanups.push(() => rmSync(runnerHome, { recursive: true, force: true }));
    const real = runnerPaths(runnerHome);
    const claudeHome = join(runnerHome, 'claude-home');
    mkdirSync(claudeHome);
    const identity = { runnerKey: 'r-1', machineId: 'machine-1', name: 'laptop' };
    saveRunnerConfig(real.config, RunnerConfigSchema.parse({ ...identity, homes: { claude: claudeHome } }));
    const live = () =>
      scratchLaunch({ bin: FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', env: {}, live: true, runnerHome });
    expect(live).toThrow(/is missing; run bun run vendor:install/);

    const pinned = join(real.runner, vendorBinary('claude', CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION));
    mkdirSync(join(pinned, '..'), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(pinned, '');
    const launch = live();
    cleanups.push(launch.cleanup);
    // runner.json's Claude home, verbatim: the CLI finds its login by that string.
    expect(launch.vendorHomes).toEqual({ claude: claudeHome, codex: real.homes.codex });
    // Its empty directory, where the bridge and the brief hook start, is there.
    expect(statSync(claudeEmptyDir(claudeHome)).isDirectory()).toBe(true);
    expect(launch.launch.env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR).toBe(claudeHome);
    expect(launch.launch.env.HOME).toBe(homedir());
    // The clone stays in the scratch directory, outside the real work root.
    expect(launch.clone.startsWith(`${launch.root}/`)).toBe(true);
    expect(launch.clone.startsWith(`${real.work}/`)).toBe(false);
    const options = buildQueryOptions(launch.launch, {
      agflow: launch.agflow,
      paths: launch.paths,
      vendorHomes: launch.vendorHomes,
      autoOffered: false,
      spawnClaudeCodeProcess: () => {
        throw new Error('not spawned');
      },
      compaction: { preCompact: async () => ({}), postCompact: async () => ({}) },
    });
    expect(options.pathToClaudeCodeExecutable).toBe(pinned);
    expect(options.sandbox?.filesystem?.denyRead).toContain(real.runner);
    expect(options.sandbox?.filesystem?.denyRead).toContain(join(real.work, '*', '*'));
    expect(options.settings).toMatchObject({
      permissions: { deny: expect.arrayContaining([`Read(/${join(real.runner, 'homes', 'codex', '**')})`]) },
    });
  });

  test("it requires the transcript under the clone's project directory", () => {
    const launch = scratchLaunch({ bin: FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', env: {} });
    cleanups.push(launch.cleanup);
    const claudeHome = launch.vendorHomes.claude;
    const session = '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555';
    expect(() => assertTranscriptPlacement(claudeHome, launch.clone, session)).toThrow(
      /not under .*projects\/.*a pin that renames project directories/,
    );
    // Where an older or newer pin might put it: under a differently formed slug.
    mkdirSync(join(claudeHome, 'projects', 'renamed'), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(join(claudeHome, 'projects', 'renamed', `${session}.jsonl`), '{}\n');
    expect(() => assertTranscriptPlacement(claudeHome, launch.clone, session)).toThrow(/projects\/renamed/);
    const expected = join(claudeProjectDir(claudeHome, launch.clone), `${session}.jsonl`);
    mkdirSync(join(expected, '..'), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(expected, '{}\n');
    expect(assertTranscriptPlacement(claudeHome, launch.clone, session)).toBe(expected);
  });
});

describe('the base recordings replay through the fake claude and the SDK', () => {
  test(
    'turn-basic: a Bash call, a refused call, bridge answers and text',
    async () => {
      const { recording, run, launch } = await replay('turn-basic');
      expect(recording.header).toMatchObject({ cliVersion: '2.1.285', account: 'synthetic-subscription' });
      expectRoundTrip(recording, run, launch);
      const frames = out(run);
      const tools = frames
        .filter((frame) => frame.type === 'assistant')
        .flatMap((frame) => frame.message.content)
        .filter((block: { type: string }) => block.type === 'tool_use');
      expect(tools.map((tool: { name: string }) => tool.name)).toEqual([
        'Bash',
        'Bash',
        'mcp__agflow__report_progress',
        'mcp__agflow__submit',
      ]);
      const results = frames
        .filter((frame) => frame.type === 'user')
        .flatMap((frame) => frame.message.content)
        .filter((block: { type: string }) => block.type === 'tool_result');
      expect(results).toHaveLength(4);
      expect(results[1].is_error).toBe(true);
      // The untyped mark of a refused call, as 2.1.285 prints it (outline Q2).
      const refused = frames.find(
        (frame) =>
          frame.type === 'user' &&
          frame.message.content.some((block: { tool_use_id?: string }) => block.tool_use_id === 'toolu_basic_2'),
      );
      expect(refused?.tool_result_meta).toEqual([{ id: 'toolu_basic_2', non_execution_kind: 'permission-rule' }]);
      expect(JSON.stringify(results[2])).toContain(BRIDGE_ANSWERS.hubUnreachable);
      expect(results[2].is_error).toBe(true);
      expect(JSON.stringify(results[3])).toContain('Submission pending');
      const result = first(run, (frame) => frame.type === 'result');
      expect(result).toMatchObject({ subtype: 'success', is_error: false, session_id: run.sessionId });
      expect(result.user_message_uuids).toEqual(run.sent);
      // The guard answered the refused call's PreToolUse hook.
      const denied = run.hookAnswers.find((answer) => JSON.stringify(answer).includes('"deny"'));
      expect(denied).toBeDefined();
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'turn-delivery: a message folded in at a tool boundary',
    async () => {
      const { recording, run, launch } = await replay('turn-delivery');
      expectRoundTrip(recording, run, launch);
      const frames = out(run);
      const [message, note] = run.sent;
      const started = frames.filter((frame) => frame.type === 'command_lifecycle' && frame.state === 'started');
      expect(started.map((frame) => frame.command_uuid)).toEqual([message, note]);
      const result = first(run, (frame) => frame.type === 'result');
      expect(result.user_message_uuids).toEqual([message, note]);
      // Folded into the first turn: one result for both messages.
      expect(frames.filter((frame) => frame.type === 'result')).toHaveLength(1);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'interrupt: the turn ends as an aborted execution',
    async () => {
      const { recording, run, launch } = await replay('interrupt');
      expectRoundTrip(recording, run, launch);
      // Only the recording holds the rejected tool result: the fake's own abort (writeAborted) has none, so this
      // proves the recorded end was replayed.
      const rejected = first(run, (frame) => frame.type === 'user' && Array.isArray(frame.tool_result_meta));
      expect(rejected.tool_result_meta).toEqual([{ id: 'toolu_interrupt_1', non_execution_kind: 'user-rejected' }]);
      const result = first(run, (frame) => frame.type === 'result');
      expect(result).toMatchObject({ subtype: 'error_during_execution', is_error: true });
      expect(['aborted_tools', 'aborted_streaming']).toContain(result.terminal_reason);
      const interrupt = run.events.find((event) => event.dir === 'in' && event.frame.request?.subtype === 'interrupt');
      expect(interrupt?.frame.request.cancel_queued).toBe(true);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'compaction: PreCompact, then PostCompact with a summary',
    async () => {
      const { recording, run, launch } = await replay('compaction');
      expectRoundTrip(recording, run, launch);
      expect(run.compactions.map((input) => input.hook_event_name)).toEqual(['PreCompact', 'PostCompact']);
      const post = run.compactions[1] as { compact_summary?: string };
      expect(post.compact_summary).toContain('Summary');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "preflight-ok: /clear only, a correct session's init, and the sandbox on",
    async () => {
      const { recording, run, launch } = await replay('preflight-ok');
      expectRoundTrip(recording, run, launch);
      const init = first(run, (frame) => frame.type === 'system' && frame.subtype === 'init');
      expect(init).toMatchObject({
        apiKeySource: 'none',
        claude_code_version: '2.1.285',
        model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
        permissionMode: 'acceptEdits',
        mcp_servers: [{ name: 'agflow', status: 'connected' }],
      });
      // Design 8.1: the requested built-ins plus the bridge's tools, and nothing else.
      const builtins = init.tools.filter((tool: string) => !tool.startsWith('mcp__agflow__'));
      expect(builtins.sort()).toEqual([...CLAUDE_BUILTIN_TOOLS].sort());
      const bridge = init.tools.filter((tool: string) => tool.startsWith('mcp__agflow__'));
      expect(bridge.sort()).toEqual(STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS.map((tool) => `mcp__agflow__${tool}`).sort());
      expect(init.plugins.every((plugin: { path: string }) => plugin.path === 'builtin')).toBe(true);
      expect(run.initialization).toMatchObject({ account: { subscriptionType: 'max' } });
      expect(run.initialization).not.toHaveProperty('account.apiKeySource');
      expect(run.settings).toMatchObject({ effective: { sandbox: { enabled: true, failIfUnavailable: true } } });
      expect(recording.turns).toHaveLength(1);
      // /clear asks the model nothing, so the recording holds no assistant frame.
      expect(out(run).some((frame) => frame.type === 'assistant')).toBe(false);
      expect(run.sentTexts).toEqual(['/clear']);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

```ts
// A stand-in for agflow while record:claude captures streams (design 15): run with `mcp ...` it is the bridge, an MCP
// server on stdio with the runner-mode worker tools of design 10 and fixed answers; run with `hook brief --runner` it
// is the SessionStart brief hook. It needs no hub, so recordings capture the CLI and nothing else.
import { BRIDGE_ANSWERS } from '@agflow/core';

/** A worker's tools in runner mode (design 10): M1's shared tools in their order, then the seven worker tools. */
export const STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS = [
  'hello',
  'get_brief',
  'get_goal',
  'list_tasks',
  'get_task',
  'check_inbox',
  'ack_messages',
  'send_message',
  'search',
  'report_progress',
  'write_handoff',
  'declare_blocked',
  'declare_impossible',
  'release_task',
  'submit',
  'prepare_dependencies',
] as const;

/** The tool that answers as if the hub were down, so recordings hold a hub-unreachable error result. */
export const STUB_UNREACHABLE_TOOL = 'report_progress';

const ANSWERS: Partial<Record<(typeof STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS)[number], string>> = {
  hello: 'Already connected.',
  submit: 'Submission pending: the runner pushes your branch and submits it when your turn ends.',
  declare_blocked: 'The task is marked blocked.',
  declare_impossible: 'The task is marked impossible.',
  write_handoff: 'Your handoff note is saved.',
  release_task: 'The task is released.',
};

/** The brief the stub hook gives; the line about the working directory is the runner brief's (design 10). */
export function stubBrief(clone: string | undefined): string {
  return `agflow stub brief for record:claude.\nYour working directory: ${clone ?? '(unknown)'}`;
}

type Json = Record<string, unknown>;

/** The answer to one JSON-RPC request, or null for a notification. */
export function answerRpc(message: Json): Json | null {
  if (message.id === undefined || message.id === null) return null;
  const result = (value: unknown): Json => ({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: message.id, result: value });
  const params = (message.params ?? {}) as Json;
  switch (message.method) {
    case 'initialize':
      return result({
        protocolVersion: params.protocolVersion ?? '2025-06-18',
        capabilities: { tools: {} },
        serverInfo: { name: 'agflow', version: 'stub' },
      });
    case 'ping':
      return result({});
    case 'tools/list':
      return result({
        tools: STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS.map((name) => ({
          name,
          description: `agflow ${name} (record:claude stub)`,
          inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: {}, additionalProperties: true },
        })),
      });
    case 'tools/call': {
      const name = String(params.name);
      if (!(STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS as readonly string[]).includes(name)) {
        return { jsonrpc: '2.0', id: message.id, error: { code: -32602, message: `Unknown tool: ${name}` } };
      }
      if (name === STUB_UNREACHABLE_TOOL) {
        return result({ content: [{ type: 'text', text: BRIDGE_ANSWERS.hubUnreachable }], isError: true });
      }
      const text = ANSWERS[name as keyof typeof ANSWERS] ?? 'OK.';
      return result({ content: [{ type: 'text', text }] });
    }
    default:
      return {
        jsonrpc: '2.0',
        id: message.id,
        error: { code: -32601, message: `Method not found: ${message.method}` },
      };
  }
}

async function serveMcp(): Promise<void> {
  let buffer = '';
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  for await (const chunk of process.stdin) {
    buffer += decoder.decode(chunk as Uint8Array, { stream: true });
    let index = buffer.indexOf('\n');
    while (index >= 0) {
      const line = buffer.slice(0, index).trim();
      buffer = buffer.slice(index + 1);
      index = buffer.indexOf('\n');
      if (line === '') continue;
      const answer = answerRpc(JSON.parse(line) as Json);
      if (answer) process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(answer)}\n`);
    }
  }
}

if (import.meta.main) {
  const [command, subcommand] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (command === 'mcp') {
    await serveMcp();
  } else if (command === 'hook' && subcommand === 'brief') {
    const additionalContext = stubBrief(process.env.AGFLOW_CLONE);
    const hookSpecificOutput = { hookEventName: 'SessionStart', additionalContext };
    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ hookSpecificOutput })}\n`);
  } else {
    process.stderr.write('usage: claude-stub-bridge.ts mcp --vendor claude --runner | hook brief --runner\n');
    process.exit(2);
  }
}
```

```ts
// record:claude (design 15, 15.1, 8.1, 8.3): drives the pinned claude through the Agent SDK with buildQueryOptions for
// a scratch launch, and turns what it printed into the fake claude's recordings. By default it runs against the
// scripted Messages API behind the refusing proxy, with a stub agflow (claude-stub-bridge.ts) as the bridge and the
// brief hook, so no model is used; it then rewrites the API-key account into a synthetic subscription. --live records
// from the runner's own Claude login instead, for what only a subscription produces. Either way it drops the Mac's
// managed policy and redacts emails, organisation ids, home paths and session ids before anything is written.
//
//   bun run record:claude [--only turn-basic,interrupt] [--live] [--model <id>] [--bin <claude>]
import { type ChildProcess, spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  existsSync,
  mkdirSync,
  mkdtempSync,
  readdirSync,
  readFileSync,
  realpathSync,
  rmSync,
  symlinkSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import { homedir, tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path';
import type { Vendor } from '@agflow/core';
import { startRefusingProxy } from '@agflow/testkit';
import {
  type AnthropicHandler,
  agflowTool,
  afterToolResult,
  bashTool,
  claudeTestEnv,
  findClaudeBinary,
  isCompaction,
  reply,
  rules,
  startScriptedAnthropic,
  text,
  userSays,
} from '@agflow/testkit/src/anthropic';
import {
  CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR,
  type ClaudeRecording,
  type ControlAnswer,
  type RecordingHeader,
  type RecordingStep,
  SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT,
  writeRecording,
} from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import {
  type HookCallback,
  query,
  type SDKUserMessage,
  type SpawnedProcess,
  type SpawnOptions,
} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { buildQueryOptions, effectivePermissionMode, ensureClaudeEmptyDir } from '../src/adapters/claude/options';
import { claudeProjectDir } from '../src/adapters/claude/paths';
import { CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, readClaudeVersion } from '../src/adapters/claude/pin';
import type { AgentLaunch, AgflowCommand } from '../src/adapters/types';
import { loadRunnerConfig, vendorHomes } from '../src/config';
import { agflowHome, makeAttemptTmpDir, type RunnerPaths, runnerPaths } from '../src/paths';
import { type PermissionProfile, standardProfile } from '../src/profile';
import { vendorBinary } from '../src/vendor/pins';
import { STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS, stubBrief } from './claude-stub-bridge';

// Frames are untyped JSON, as the CLI printed them.
type Json = Record<string, any>;

/** The stub agflow: `<bun> claude-stub-bridge.ts`, which the bridge args and the brief hook follow. */
export const STUB_AGFLOW: AgflowCommand = {
  command: process.execPath,
  args: [join(import.meta.dir, 'claude-stub-bridge.ts')],
};

/** Where record:claude writes transcripts for the runner's tests (readTranscriptTail). */
export const CLAUDE_TRANSCRIPT_FIXTURES_DIR = join(import.meta.dir, '..', 'test', 'fixtures', 'claude');

/** The session id a committed transcript carries instead of the recorded one. */
export const TRANSCRIPT_SESSION_ID = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000';

const REPO_ROOT = resolve(import.meta.dir, '..', '..', '..');
const WAIT_MS = 60_000;
const EXIT_WAIT_MS = 10_000;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The scratch launch

export interface ScratchLaunchOptions {
  /**
   * The claude to run; it is linked where vendorBinary puts the pin in the scratch layout, so buildQueryOptions
   * finds it. A live launch runs the runner's own pinned binary instead.
   */
  bin: string;
  model: string;
  /** Added to the launch environment: the test environment, or the fake's. */
  env: Record<string, string>;
  profile?: PermissionProfile;
  /**
   * The owner's HOME and the runner's own layout and Claude home, whose login --live records from. The rules, the
   * sandbox and the guard then confine the agent to the real runner tree and work root, as for the runner's agents.
   */
  live?: boolean;
  /** The runner's AGFLOW_HOME for a live launch; agflowHome() by default. */
  runnerHome?: string;
  agflow?: AgflowCommand;
}

export interface ScratchLaunch {
  /** The scratch directory that cleanup removes. */
  root: string;
  /** The layout the options are built from: the scratch one, or the runner's own for a live launch. */
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  vendorHomes: Record<Vendor, string>;
  clone: string;
  agflow: AgflowCommand;
  launch: AgentLaunch;
  cleanup(): void;
}

/**
 * A launch like the runner's: a git clone, a base checkout and a private tmpDir in a scratch directory. Its layout
 * is a scratch AGFLOW_HOME, or for a live launch the runner's own, while the clone stays outside the real work root.
 */
export function scratchLaunch(options: ScratchLaunchOptions): ScratchLaunch {
  const root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-record-')));
  const scratchPaths = runnerPaths(join(root, 'agflow'));
  const home = options.live ? homedir() : join(root, 'home');
  let paths = scratchPaths;
  let homes: Record<Vendor, string> = { claude: scratchPaths.homes.claude, codex: scratchPaths.homes.codex };
  if (options.live) {
    // The runner's Claude home as M2b gives it: the CLI finds its login by that exact CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR string.
    paths = runnerPaths(options.runnerHome ?? agflowHome());
    homes = vendorHomes(loadRunnerConfig(paths.config), paths);
    liveClaudeBinary(paths);
  }
  const clone = scratchPaths.clone('p', 'T-1-a1');
  const baseCheckout = scratchPaths.baseCheckout('p', '000000000000');
  for (const dir of [home, clone, baseCheckout, homes.claude]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  ensureClaudeEmptyDir(homes.claude);
  const git = Bun.spawnSync(['git', 'init', '-q', clone], { env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', HOME: home } });
  if (git.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`git init failed: ${git.stderr.toString()}`);
  writeFileSync(join(clone, 'README.md'), '# Scratch project\n');
  if (!options.live) {
    const link = join(paths.runner, vendorBinary('claude', CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION));
    mkdirSync(dirname(link), { recursive: true });
    symlinkSync(resolve(options.bin), link);
  }
  const claudeHome = homes.claude;
  const tmpDir = makeAttemptTmpDir();
  const agflow = options.agflow ?? STUB_AGFLOW;
  const env: Record<string, string> = {
    HOME: home,
    USER: process.env.USER ?? 'agent',
    LOGNAME: process.env.LOGNAME ?? process.env.USER ?? 'agent',
    LANG: 'en_US.UTF-8',
    SHELL: process.env.SHELL ?? '/bin/zsh',
    TERM: 'dumb',
    PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin',
    NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA: '1',
    CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: claudeHome,
    CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR: tmpDir,
    CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS: '1',
    DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER: '1',
    AGFLOW_CLONE: clone,
    ...options.env,
  };
  const launch: AgentLaunch = {
    attemptId: 'T-1-a1',
    role: 'worker',
    model: options.model,
    cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
    clone,
    baseCheckout,
    projectConfigVerified: true,
    tmpDir,
    env,
    bridge: {
      command: agflow.command,
      args: [...agflow.args, 'mcp', '--vendor', 'claude', '--runner'],
      env: { AGFLOW_CLONE: clone },
      tools: STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS,
    },
    profile: options.profile ?? standardProfile,
    brief: stubBrief(clone),
    firstPrompt: '',
    resume: null,
    logFile: join(root, 'attempt.log'),
    registerProcess: () => {},
  };
  return {
    root,
    paths,
    vendorHomes: homes,
    clone,
    agflow,
    launch,
    cleanup: () => {
      // A live run leaves its scratch project directory in the runner's real Claude home; nothing else is there.
      if (options.live) rmSync(claudeProjectDir(claudeHome, clone), { recursive: true, force: true });
      rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
      rmSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    },
  };
}

/**
 * The runner's own pinned claude, which a live launch runs: buildQueryOptions takes the binary from the layout, and
 * nothing is linked into the real runner tree.
 */
export function liveClaudeBinary(paths: Pick<RunnerPaths, 'runner'>): string {
  const bin = join(paths.runner, vendorBinary('claude', CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION));
  if (!existsSync(bin)) throw new Error(`${bin} is missing; run bun run vendor:install`);
  return bin;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Running a scenario

/** One JSON line between the SDK and the CLI: in goes to the CLI's stdin, out came from its stdout. */
export interface TeeEvent {
  dir: 'in' | 'out';
  frame: Json;
}

export interface ScenarioSession {
  /** Pushes a user message; gives its uuid. */
  send(text: string): string;
  /** The next frame from the CLI that matches, after the previous one this returned. */
  frame(match: (frame: Json) => boolean): Promise<Json>;
  /** The next session_state_changed idle: the turn and its trailing frames are done. */
  idle(): Promise<void>;
  interrupt(cancelQueued: boolean): Promise<void>;
}

export interface ClaudeScenario {
  name: string;
  /** The recording it writes under packages/testkit/fixtures/claude/. */
  fixture?: string;
  /** The transcript it writes under packages/runner/test/fixtures/claude/. */
  transcript?: string;
  /** The scripted server's answers; --live leaves them to the model, which the prompts instruct the same way. */
  handler: AnthropicHandler;
  drive(session: ScenarioSession): Promise<void>;
}

export interface ScenarioRun {
  /** The id the session was started with. */
  sessionId: string;
  /** The id the last result named: /clear starts a new conversation. */
  finalSessionId: string;
  events: TeeEvent[];
  /** The uuids and texts of the user messages, in order. */
  sent: string[];
  sentTexts: string[];
  /** What the SDK answered to the CLI's hook_callback requests. */
  hookAnswers: Json[];
  /** The inputs the PreCompact and PostCompact callbacks got. */
  compactions: Json[];
  initialization: Json;
  settings: Json | null;
  exit: { code: number | null; signal: string | null } | null;
  stderr: string;
}

/** Runs one scenario through the SDK with buildQueryOptions and records every line both ways. */
export async function runScenario(scenario: ClaudeScenario, scratch: ScratchLaunch): Promise<ScenarioRun> {
  const events: TeeEvent[] = [];
  const waiters = new Set<() => void>();
  const notify = () => {
    for (const wake of [...waiters]) wake();
  };
  let stderr = '';
  let child: ChildProcess | null = null;
  const exited = Promise.withResolvers<{ code: number | null; signal: string | null }>();

  const tee = (dir: TeeEvent['dir'], text: string) => {
    for (const line of text.split('\n')) {
      if (line.trim() === '') continue;
      try {
        events.push({ dir, frame: JSON.parse(line) });
      } catch {
        events.push({ dir, frame: { type: 'unparsed', line } });
      }
    }
    notify();
  };

  const spawnClaudeCodeProcess = (options: SpawnOptions): SpawnedProcess => {
    const proc = spawn(options.command, options.args, {
      cwd: options.cwd,
      env: options.env,
      stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
      detached: true,
    });
    child = proc;
    let pending = '';
    proc.stdout?.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {
      pending += chunk.toString('utf8');
      const end = pending.lastIndexOf('\n');
      if (end < 0) return;
      tee('out', pending.slice(0, end));
      pending = pending.slice(end + 1);
    });
    proc.stderr?.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {
      stderr = (stderr + chunk.toString('utf8')).slice(-64_000);
    });
    const stdin = proc.stdin;
    if (stdin) {
      const write = stdin.write.bind(stdin) as (chunk: unknown, ...rest: unknown[]) => boolean;
      stdin.write = ((chunk: unknown, ...rest: unknown[]) => {
        tee('in', String(chunk));
        return write(chunk, ...rest);
      }) as typeof stdin.write;
    }
    proc.on('exit', (code, signal) => exited.resolve({ code, signal }));
    options.signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => killGroup(proc, 'SIGTERM'), { once: true });
    return proc as unknown as SpawnedProcess;
  };

  const compactions: Json[] = [];
  const compactionHook: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    compactions.push(input as Json);
    return {};
  };
  const options = buildQueryOptions(scratch.launch, {
    agflow: scratch.agflow,
    paths: scratch.paths,
    vendorHomes: scratch.vendorHomes,
    autoOffered: false,
    spawnClaudeCodeProcess,
    compaction: { preCompact: compactionHook, postCompact: compactionHook },
  });
  const sessionId = options.sessionId as string;

  const queue: SDKUserMessage[] = [];
  const inboxState: { wake: (() => void) | null; ended: boolean } = { wake: null, ended: false };
  async function* inbox(): AsyncGenerator<SDKUserMessage> {
    for (;;) {
      const next = queue.shift();
      if (next) {
        yield next;
        continue;
      }
      if (inboxState.ended) return;
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        inboxState.wake = resolve;
      });
      inboxState.wake = null;
    }
  }

  const q = query({ prompt: inbox(), options });
  const pump = (async () => {
    for await (const _message of q) {
      // The frames are read from the tee; the SDK only has to keep reading.
    }
  })();

  const sent: string[] = [];
  const sentTexts: string[] = [];
  let cursor = 0;
  const frame = async (match: (frame: Json) => boolean): Promise<Json> => {
    const deadline = Date.now() + WAIT_MS;
    for (;;) {
      const index = events.findIndex((event, at) => at >= cursor && event.dir === 'out' && match(event.frame));
      if (index >= 0) {
        cursor = index + 1;
        return (events[index] as TeeEvent).frame;
      }
      if (Date.now() > deadline) {
        throw new Error(`${scenario.name}: no matching frame within ${WAIT_MS} ms; stderr: ${stderr.slice(-2000)}`);
      }
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        const wake = () => {
          waiters.delete(wake);
          resolve();
        };
        waiters.add(wake);
        setTimeout(wake, 200);
      });
    }
  };
  const session: ScenarioSession = {
    send(value) {
      const uuid = randomUUID();
      sent.push(uuid);
      sentTexts.push(value);
      queue.push({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: value }, parent_tool_use_id: null, uuid });
      inboxState.wake?.();
      return uuid;
    },
    frame,
    idle: async () => {
      await frame((f) => f.type === 'system' && f.subtype === 'session_state_changed' && f.state === 'idle');
    },
    interrupt: async (cancelQueued) => {
      // cancelQueued is untyped in sdk.d.ts 0.3.285 (design 8.3).
      const interrupt = q.interrupt as (options?: { cancelQueued?: boolean }) => Promise<unknown>;
      await interrupt.call(q, cancelQueued ? { cancelQueued: true } : undefined);
    },
  };

  let initialization: Json = {};
  let settings: Json | null = null;
  try {
    initialization = (await q.initializationResult()) as Json;
    // Untyped in sdk.d.ts, like cancelQueued; preflight reads the same answer.
    settings = await (q as unknown as { getSettings(): Promise<Json> }).getSettings().catch(() => null);
    await q.usage_EXPERIMENTAL_MAY_CHANGE_DO_NOT_RELY_ON_THIS_API_YET({ skipBehaviors: true }).catch(() => null);
    await scenario.drive(session);
  } finally {
    inboxState.ended = true;
    inboxState.wake?.();
    q.close();
    const exit = await Promise.race([exited.promise, Bun.sleep(EXIT_WAIT_MS).then(() => null)]);
    if (exit === null && child) killGroup(child, 'SIGKILL');
    await pump.catch(() => {});
  }
  const exit = await Promise.race([exited.promise, Bun.sleep(1000).then(() => null)]);
  const hookRequests = new Set(
    events
      .filter((event) => event.dir === 'out' && event.frame.type === 'control_request')
      .map((event) => event.frame.request_id),
  );
  const hookAnswers = events
    .filter((event) => event.dir === 'in' && event.frame.type === 'control_response')
    .map((event) => event.frame.response as Json)
    .filter((response) => hookRequests.has(response.request_id));
  const results = events.filter((event) => event.dir === 'out' && event.frame.type === 'result');
  return {
    sessionId,
    finalSessionId: (results.at(-1)?.frame.session_id as string | undefined) ?? sessionId,
    events,
    sent,
    sentTexts,
    hookAnswers,
    compactions,
    initialization,
    settings,
    exit,
    stderr,
  };
}

function killGroup(proc: ChildProcess, signal: NodeJS.Signals): void {
  if (proc.pid === undefined || proc.exitCode !== null) return;
  try {
    process.kill(-proc.pid, signal);
  } catch {
    proc.kill(signal);
  }
}

/**
 * The transcript of a session lies in the clone's project directory as the runner computes it (claudeProjectDir).
 * A pin that forms project directories differently would loosen the guard's transcript rule, so it fails here.
 */
export function assertTranscriptPlacement(claudeHome: string, clone: string, sessionId: string): string {
  const expected = join(claudeProjectDir(claudeHome, clone), `${sessionId}.jsonl`);
  if (existsSync(expected)) return expected;
  const projects = join(claudeHome, 'projects');
  const found = existsSync(projects)
    ? readdirSync(projects)
        .map((dir) => join(projects, dir, `${sessionId}.jsonl`))
        .filter((path) => existsSync(path))
    : [];
  throw new Error(
    `the transcript of session ${sessionId} is not under ${relative(claudeHome, expected)}` +
      `${found.length > 0 ? `; it is at ${found.map((path) => relative(claudeHome, path)).join(', ')}` : ''}. ` +
      'This looks like a pin that renames project directories: check claudeProjectSlug against the new CLI.',
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// From a run to a recording

/**
 * The recording of a run: the answers to the SDK's control requests, the frames, a $turn at each message that found
 * the CLI idle, $wait where a message or an interrupt arrived mid-turn, and $hook for each hook_callback. Each turn's
 * user message uuids become $USER_UUID_<n>, the model $MODEL and the permission mode $PERMISSION_MODE.
 */
export function assembleRecording(run: ScenarioRun, header: RecordingHeader): ClaudeRecording {
  const requests = new Map<string, string>();
  const callbacks = new Map<string, string>();
  const answers: Record<string, ControlAnswer> = {};
  const startup: RecordingStep[] = [];
  const turns: { steps: RecordingStep[]; users: string[] }[] = [];
  let current = startup;
  let idle = true;
  for (const { dir, frame } of run.events) {
    if (dir === 'in') {
      if (frame.type === 'control_request') {
        const subtype = String(frame.request?.subtype);
        requests.set(frame.request_id, subtype);
        if (subtype === 'initialize') {
          for (const [event, matchers] of Object.entries((frame.request.hooks ?? {}) as Json)) {
            for (const matcher of matchers as { hookCallbackIds: string[] }[]) {
              for (const id of matcher.hookCallbackIds) callbacks.set(id, event);
            }
          }
        }
        if (subtype === 'interrupt' && !idle) current.push({ wait: 'interrupt' });
      } else if (frame.type === 'user') {
        if (idle) {
          current = [];
          turns.push({ steps: current, users: [] });
          idle = false;
        } else {
          current.push({ wait: 'user' });
        }
        turns.at(-1)?.users.push(String(frame.uuid));
      }
      // The SDK's answers to hook callbacks are its own; the fake logs them.
      continue;
    }
    if (frame.type === 'control_response') {
      const subtype = requests.get(frame.response?.request_id);
      // The fake answers interrupts itself, from what it has queued.
      if (subtype !== undefined && subtype !== 'interrupt') {
        answers[subtype] =
          frame.response.subtype === 'success'
            ? { response: (frame.response.response ?? {}) as Json }
            : { error: String(frame.response.error) };
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (frame.type === 'control_request') {
      const request = frame.request as Json;
      const event = callbacks.get(request.callback_id);
      if (request.subtype !== 'hook_callback' || event === undefined) {
        throw new Error(`the CLI sent a ${request.subtype} control request the fake cannot replay`);
      }
      current.push({
        hook: {
          event,
          input: request.input as Json,
          ...(request.tool_use_id === undefined ? {} : { toolUseId: request.tool_use_id }),
        },
      });
      continue;
    }
    if (frame.type === 'keep_alive') continue;
    current.push({ frame });
    if (frame.type === 'system' && frame.subtype === 'session_state_changed' && frame.state === 'idle') idle = true;
  }
  const template = (steps: RecordingStep[], users: string[]) =>
    steps.map((step) => mapStrings(step, (value, key) => templated(value, key, users, header)) as RecordingStep);
  return {
    header,
    answers,
    startup: template(startup, []),
    turns: turns.map((turn) => template(turn.steps, turn.users)),
  };
}

const MODE_KEYS = new Set(['permissionMode', 'permission_mode', 'current_permission_mode']);

function templated(value: string, key: string | null, users: string[], header: RecordingHeader): string {
  const user = users.indexOf(value);
  if (user >= 0) return `$USER_UUID_${user + 1}`;
  if (value === header.model) return '$MODEL';
  if (key !== null && MODE_KEYS.has(key) && value === header.permissionMode) return '$PERMISSION_MODE';
  return value;
}

/** Applies `change` to every string value and key; a value's key is passed along. */
function mapStrings(
  value: unknown,
  change: (value: string, key: string | null) => string,
  key: string | null = null,
): unknown {
  if (typeof value === 'string') return change(value, key);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => mapStrings(item, change, key));
  if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(value).map(([name, item]) => [change(name, null), mapStrings(item, change, name)]),
    );
  }
  return value;
}

/**
 * A capture against the scripted server shows an API-key account. The fake's recordings show a subscription, as the
 * runner requires, with the synthetic account (the header says so).
 */
export function asSubscription(recording: ClaudeRecording): ClaudeRecording {
  const answers = structuredClone(recording.answers);
  const initialize = answers.initialize;
  if (initialize && 'response' in initialize) initialize.response.account = { ...SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT };
  const usage = answers.get_usage;
  if (usage && 'response' in usage) usage.response.subscription_type = SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT.subscriptionType;
  const keyless = (steps: RecordingStep[]) =>
    steps.map((step) => mapStrings(step, (value, key) => (key === 'apiKeySource' ? 'none' : value)) as RecordingStep);
  return {
    header: { ...recording.header, account: 'synthetic-subscription' },
    answers,
    startup: keyless(recording.startup),
    turns: recording.turns.map(keyless),
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The managed policy

/** The settings source a Mac's managed (MDM) Claude Code policy arrives through. */
const POLICY_SOURCE = 'policySettings';

/**
 * Drops the recording Mac's managed policy from the get_settings answer: its source, the remote-control lock reason
 * it causes, and what it merged into `effective`, which is rebuilt from the remaining sources. An organisation's
 * configuration must not reach committed recordings, and no other Mac or CI would reproduce it (8.1: managedPolicy is
 * always false). The recorder cannot avoid reading the policy without bypassing it, so it strips it afterwards.
 */
export function stripManagedPolicy(recording: ClaudeRecording): ClaudeRecording {
  const answer = recording.answers.get_settings;
  if (answer === undefined || !('response' in answer)) return recording;
  const { remote_control_policy_lock_reason: _lockReason, ...response } = answer.response as Json;
  if (Array.isArray(response.sources)) {
    const sources = response.sources as Json[];
    const kept = sources.filter((source) => source.source !== POLICY_SOURCE);
    if (kept.length < sources.length) {
      response.sources = kept;
      response.effective = kept.reduce<Json>((merged, source) => mergeSettings(merged, source.settings ?? {}), {});
    }
  }
  return { ...recording, answers: { ...recording.answers, get_settings: { response } } };
}

/**
 * One settings layer over another, as the CLI merges its sources: objects merge, arrays concatenate without
 * duplicates, and the later layer wins for anything else.
 */
function mergeSettings(base: Json, layer: Json): Json {
  const merged: Json = { ...base };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(layer)) {
    const before = merged[key];
    if (Array.isArray(before) && Array.isArray(value)) {
      const seen = new Set(before.map((item) => JSON.stringify(item)));
      merged[key] = [...before, ...value.filter((item) => !seen.has(JSON.stringify(item)))];
    } else if (isObject(before) && isObject(value)) {
      merged[key] = mergeSettings(before, value);
    } else {
      merged[key] = structuredClone(value);
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

function isObject(value: unknown): value is Json {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

/**
 * The recording the recorder writes for a run: assembled, rewritten into the synthetic subscription unless live,
 * without the managed policy, and redacted.
 */
export function recordingOf(
  run: ScenarioRun,
  header: RecordingHeader,
  scratch: ScratchLaunch,
  options: { live: boolean },
): ClaudeRecording {
  const assembled = assembleRecording(run, header);
  return redactRecording(stripManagedPolicy(options.live ? assembled : asSubscription(assembled)), {
    sessionId: run.sessionId,
    sessionPlaceholder: '$SESSION',
    paths: redactionPaths(scratch, scratch.clone),
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Redaction

export interface RedactionContext {
  /** The recorded session's id. */
  sessionId: string;
  /** What it becomes: $SESSION in recordings, a fixed id in transcripts. Other session ids get synthetic ids. */
  sessionPlaceholder: string;
  /** Path prefixes and what they become. A path target's slug form (as in project directory names) is replaced too. */
  paths: [string, string][];
}

const EMAIL = /[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g;
const API_KEY = /sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g;
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const SESSION_KEYS = new Set(['session_id', 'sessionId', 'new_conversation_id']);
const ORGANISATION_KEY = /^organi[sz]ation(?:[_-]?(?:id|uuid|name))?$/i;
const SYNTHETIC_SESSION_PREFIX = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-';

const slug = (path: string) => path.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '-');

/** Redacts any JSON value; the same input gives the same output, and redacting twice changes nothing. */
export function redactValue(value: unknown, context: RedactionContext): unknown {
  const others = new Map<string, string>();
  collectSessions(value, context, others);
  const replacements: [string, string][] = [
    [context.sessionId, context.sessionPlaceholder],
    ...others,
    ...[...context.paths].sort((a, b) => b[0].length - a[0].length),
    ...context.paths
      .filter(([, to]) => to.startsWith('/'))
      .map(([from, to]): [string, string] => [slug(from), slug(to)])
      .sort((a, b) => b[0].length - a[0].length),
  ];
  const redactText = (input: string): string => {
    let output = input;
    for (const [from, to] of replacements) output = output.split(from).join(to);
    return output.replace(EMAIL, SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT.email).replace(API_KEY, 'sk-ant-redacted');
  };
  const walk = (item: unknown, key: string | null): unknown => {
    if (typeof item === 'string') {
      return key !== null && ORGANISATION_KEY.test(key) ? SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT.organization : redactText(item);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(item)) return item.map((entry) => walk(entry, key));
    if (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null) {
      return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(item).map(([name, entry]) => [redactText(name), walk(entry, name)]));
    }
    return item;
  };
  return walk(value, null);
}

function collectSessions(value: unknown, context: RedactionContext, others: Map<string, string>): void {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    for (const item of value) collectSessions(item, context, others);
  } else if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
    for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value)) {
      if (
        SESSION_KEYS.has(key) &&
        typeof item === 'string' &&
        UUID.test(item) &&
        item !== context.sessionId &&
        !item.startsWith(SYNTHETIC_SESSION_PREFIX) &&
        !others.has(item)
      ) {
        others.set(item, `${SYNTHETIC_SESSION_PREFIX}${String(others.size + 1).padStart(12, '0')}`);
      }
      collectSessions(item, context, others);
    }
  }
}

export function redactRecording(recording: ClaudeRecording, context: RedactionContext): ClaudeRecording {
  return redactValue(recording, context) as ClaudeRecording;
}

function redactTranscript(text: string, context: RedactionContext): string {
  const lines = text
    .split('\n')
    .filter((line) => line.trim() !== '')
    .map((line) => JSON.parse(line) as unknown);
  return `${(redactValue(lines, context) as unknown[]).map((line) => JSON.stringify(line)).join('\n')}\n`;
}

/** What a scratch run's paths become: the clone $CWD, the scratch root, the repository, the owner's home. */
function redactionPaths(scratch: ScratchLaunch, clone: string | null): [string, string][] {
  const paths: [string, string][] = [
    // The runner's own layout, for a live launch; the scratch one lies under the root anyway.
    [scratch.paths.home, '/redacted/agflow'],
    [scratch.root, '/redacted'],
    [scratch.launch.tmpDir, '/tmp/agf/000000'],
    [realpathSync(scratch.launch.tmpDir), '/private/tmp/agf/000000'],
    [process.execPath, '/usr/local/bin/bun'],
    [REPO_ROOT, '/agflow'],
    [homedir(), '/Users/redacted'],
  ];
  return clone === null ? paths : [[clone, '$CWD'], ...paths];
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The scenarios. Their prompts say what to do, so --live gets the same calls from a real model.

const PROMPTS = {
  basic:
    'Run `echo hi` with Bash, then run `git push origin HEAD`, then call the agflow report_progress tool, ' +
    'then the agflow submit tool, and finish with one sentence.',
  slow: 'Run `sleep 2; echo slow` with Bash, then finish with one sentence.',
  note: 'A note for you while that runs: keep going.',
  long: 'Run `sleep 30` with Bash.',
  hello: 'Say hello in one word.',
  describe: 'Describe this repository in one sentence, without tools.',
  count: 'Count the files here with `ls | wc -l` in Bash, then say how many there are.',
  handoff: 'Write a handoff with the agflow write_handoff tool, then say that you did.',
};

const COMPACTION_SUMMARY = 'Summary: the agent said hello; nothing else happened.';

/** Answers compaction requests with a summary and leaves every other request to `main`. */
function withSummary(main: AnthropicHandler): AnthropicHandler {
  return (request) => (isCompaction(request) ? reply(COMPACTION_SUMMARY) : main(request));
}

export const CLAUDE_SCENARIOS: ClaudeScenario[] = [
  {
    name: 'preflight-ok',
    fixture: 'preflight-ok',
    // /clear is a local command: no request reaches any model.
    handler: rules(),
    drive: async (session) => {
      session.send('/clear');
      await session.idle();
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'turn-basic',
    fixture: 'turn-basic',
    handler: rules(
      { when: afterToolResult('toolu_basic_4'), reply: reply('The check printed hi, and the work is submitted.') },
      {
        when: afterToolResult('toolu_basic_3'),
        reply: reply(agflowTool({ tool: 'submit', args: { summary: 'Checked.' }, id: 'toolu_basic_4' })),
      },
      {
        when: afterToolResult('toolu_basic_2'),
        reply: reply(agflowTool({ tool: 'report_progress', args: { note: 'Checked.' }, id: 'toolu_basic_3' })),
      },
      {
        when: afterToolResult('toolu_basic_1'),
        reply: reply(bashTool({ command: 'git push origin HEAD', id: 'toolu_basic_2' })),
      },
      {
        when: userSays('Run `echo hi`'),
        reply: reply([text('Running the check.'), bashTool({ command: 'echo hi', id: 'toolu_basic_1' })]),
      },
    ),
    drive: async (session) => {
      session.send(PROMPTS.basic);
      await session.idle();
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'turn-delivery',
    fixture: 'turn-delivery',
    handler: rules(
      { when: afterToolResult('toolu_delivery_1'), reply: reply('Done, and I saw your note.') },
      {
        when: userSays('Run `sleep 2; echo slow`'),
        reply: reply([text('Running it.'), bashTool({ command: 'sleep 2; echo slow', id: 'toolu_delivery_1' })]),
      },
    ),
    drive: async (session) => {
      session.send(PROMPTS.slow);
      await session.frame(
        (f) => f.type === 'assistant' && f.message?.content?.some((block: Json) => block.type === 'tool_use'),
      );
      session.send(PROMPTS.note);
      await session.idle();
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'interrupt',
    fixture: 'interrupt',
    handler: rules({
      when: userSays('Run `sleep 30`'),
      reply: reply([text('Running it.'), bashTool({ command: 'sleep 30', id: 'toolu_interrupt_1' })]),
    }),
    drive: async (session) => {
      session.send(PROMPTS.long);
      await session.frame(
        (f) => f.type === 'assistant' && f.message?.content?.some((block: Json) => block.type === 'tool_use'),
      );
      // Past the PreToolUse hook, while the command runs.
      await Bun.sleep(1500);
      await session.interrupt(true);
      await session.idle();
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'compaction',
    fixture: 'compaction',
    handler: withSummary(rules({ when: userSays(PROMPTS.hello), reply: reply('Hello.') })),
    drive: async (session) => {
      session.send(PROMPTS.hello);
      await session.idle();
      session.send('/compact');
      await session.idle();
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'session',
    transcript: 'session',
    handler: rules(
      { when: afterToolResult('toolu_session_2'), reply: reply('The handoff is written.') },
      { when: afterToolResult('toolu_session_1'), reply: reply('There is one file.') },
      { when: userSays(PROMPTS.describe), reply: reply('The repository holds a README and nothing else.') },
      {
        when: userSays(PROMPTS.count),
        reply: reply([text('Counting.'), bashTool({ command: 'ls | wc -l', id: 'toolu_session_1' })]),
      },
      {
        when: userSays(PROMPTS.handoff),
        reply: reply(
          agflowTool({ tool: 'write_handoff', args: { note: 'The README is all there is.' }, id: 'toolu_session_2' }),
        ),
      },
      // The last turn is interrupted while its command runs, so the transcript ends with a tool-only turn.
      {
        when: userSays('Run `sleep 30`'),
        reply: reply(bashTool({ command: 'sleep 30', id: 'toolu_session_3' })),
      },
    ),
    drive: async (session) => {
      for (const prompt of [PROMPTS.describe, PROMPTS.count, PROMPTS.handoff]) {
        session.send(prompt);
        await session.idle();
      }
      session.send(PROMPTS.long);
      await session.frame(
        (f) => f.type === 'assistant' && f.message?.content?.some((block: Json) => block.type === 'tool_use'),
      );
      await Bun.sleep(1500);
      await session.interrupt(false);
      await session.idle();
    },
  },
];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The recorder

export interface RecordClaudeStreamOptions {
  /** The pinned claude; findClaudeBinary's by default. */
  bin?: string;
  /** Scenario names; all by default. */
  only?: string[];
  live?: boolean;
  model?: string;
  fixturesDir?: string;
  transcriptsDir?: string;
  log?: (line: string) => void;
}

/** Records each scenario and writes its redacted recording or transcript; gives the files written. */
export async function recordClaudeStream(options: RecordClaudeStreamOptions = {}): Promise<string[]> {
  const log = options.log ?? ((line: string) => console.log(line));
  if (options.live && options.bin) throw new Error("--live runs the runner's own pinned claude; leave out --bin");
  const bin = options.live ? liveClaudeBinary(runnerPaths(agflowHome())) : (options.bin ?? locateClaude());
  const version = await readClaudeVersion(bin, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION);
  if (!version.ok) throw new Error(`${bin}: ${version.problem}`);
  const model = options.model ?? 'claude-sonnet-5-5';
  const scenarios = CLAUDE_SCENARIOS.filter((scenario) => !options.only || options.only.includes(scenario.name));
  const unknown = (options.only ?? []).filter((name) => !CLAUDE_SCENARIOS.some((scenario) => scenario.name === name));
  if (unknown.length > 0) throw new Error(`no scenario named ${unknown.join(', ')}`);
  const written: string[] = [];
  for (const scenario of scenarios) {
    log(`recording ${scenario.name}${options.live ? ' (live)' : ''}`);
    const server = options.live ? null : await startScriptedAnthropic({ handler: scenario.handler });
    const proxy = options.live ? null : await startRefusingProxy();
    const env = server && proxy ? claudeTestEnv({ baseUrl: server.url, proxyUrl: proxy.url }) : {};
    const scratch = scratchLaunch({ bin, model, env, live: options.live });
    try {
      const run = await runScenario(scenario, scratch);
      const transcript = assertTranscriptPlacement(scratch.vendorHomes.claude, scratch.clone, run.finalSessionId);
      if (scenario.fixture) {
        const header: RecordingHeader = {
          cliVersion: version.version,
          source: 'captured',
          scenario: scenario.name,
          account: options.live ? 'live' : 'synthetic-subscription',
          model,
          permissionMode: effectivePermissionMode(scratch.launch.profile, false),
        };
        const recording = recordingOf(run, header, scratch, { live: options.live === true });
        const path = join(options.fixturesDir ?? CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, `${scenario.fixture}.jsonl`);
        mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true });
        writeRecording(path, recording);
        written.push(path);
      }
      if (scenario.transcript) {
        const path = join(options.transcriptsDir ?? CLAUDE_TRANSCRIPT_FIXTURES_DIR, `${scenario.transcript}.jsonl`);
        mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true });
        const context = {
          sessionId: run.finalSessionId,
          sessionPlaceholder: TRANSCRIPT_SESSION_ID,
          paths: redactionPaths(scratch, null),
        };
        writeFileSync(path, redactTranscript(readFileSync(transcript, 'utf8'), context));
        written.push(path);
      }
      for (const refused of proxy?.refused ?? []) {
        log(`  the refusing proxy refused ${refused.method} ${refused.target}`);
      }
      for (const request of server?.unmatched ?? []) {
        log(`  unscripted request: ${request.endpoint} ${request.userTexts.at(-1)?.slice(0, 80) ?? ''}`);
      }
    } finally {
      scratch.cleanup();
      await server?.close();
      await proxy?.close();
    }
  }
  return written;
}

function locateClaude(): string {
  const found = findClaudeBinary(CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION);
  if (found.path === null) throw new Error(found.reason);
  return found.path;
}

function flagValue(args: string[], name: string): string | undefined {
  const index = args.indexOf(name);
  return index >= 0 ? args[index + 1] : args.find((arg) => arg.startsWith(`${name}=`))?.slice(name.length + 1);
}

if (import.meta.main) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const live = args.includes('--live');
  if (live) {
    console.log(
      "--live runs real turns on the runner's own Claude login and uses its subscription quota; " +
        'the prompts ask for the same calls the scripted server makes.',
    );
  }
  const written = await recordClaudeStream({
    live,
    only: flagValue(args, '--only')?.split(','),
    model: flagValue(args, '--model'),
    bin: flagValue(args, '--bin'),
  });
  for (const path of written) console.log(`wrote ${relative(process.cwd(), path)}`);
}

When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. The recordings in this task's blocks are the committed captures; following the plan does not re-record them. To re-record after a pin change: `AGFLOW_CLAUDE_BIN=<claude 2.1.285> bun run record:claude [--only <names>]`. `turn-basic` holds a Bash call, a `git push` the guard denies (`non_execution_kind` 'permission-rule'), a `report_progress` the stub answers with the hub-unreachable text and a `submit` answered 'Submission pending', so Tasks 14 and 15 see the untyped frames 2.1.285 really prints. The scratch launch makes the Claude home's empty directory before it starts the CLI (Task 8). The scratch launch advertises `STUB_BRIDGE_TOOLS`, checked against `BRIDGE_TOOL_NAMES.worker`. Recorder confinement checks expect the generated `work/*/*` denial.

### Task 11: Transcript tail and transcript deletion

`transcript.ts` reads and deletes a session's transcript under the runner's Claude home, without a live session (design 8.3, 6.8, 7.8, X-5). `readClaudeTranscriptTail` gives the hub's handoff note the last assistant turns: up to three, the newest always kept (cut from its start behind '…' when it alone is too long), a tool-only turn as `[tools: A, B]`, reading at most the file's last 8 MiB. `deleteClaudeTranscript` removes `<ref>.jsonl` and `<ref>/` from every project directory, then the clone's project directory if it is empty. Both look in the clone's project directory first, then for the session id under any project directory, and refuse an id that is not a plain name; the SDK's session helpers are not used, because they resolve the projects directory from the runner's own environment. `json.ts` holds `isRecord`, the guard every untyped frame and file is read through.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/json.ts`
- Create: `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/transcript.ts`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/transcript.test.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

const FIXTURE = join(import.meta.dir, '..', '..', 'fixtures', 'claude', 'session.jsonl');
const SESSION = '0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4061-8728-394a5b6c7d8e';
/** Longer than the 8 MiB the tail reads from the end of a transcript. */
const OVER_READ_WINDOW = 8.5 * 1024 * 1024;

const dirs: string[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

/** A Claude home and a clone, both real directories, in a fresh temporary root. */
function setup(): { home: string; clone: string; projectDir: string } {
  const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-transcript-'));
  dirs.push(root);
  const home = join(root, 'homes', 'claude');
  const clone = join(root, 'work', 'p-1', 'T-1-a1');
  mkdirSync(join(home, 'projects'), { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(clone, { recursive: true });
  return { home, clone, projectDir: claudeProjectDir(home, clone) };
}

function writeSession(dir: string, sessionRef: string, lines: string[]): string {
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const path = join(dir, `${sessionRef}.jsonl`);
  writeFileSync(path, `${lines.join('\n')}\n`);
  return path;
}

const prompt = (text: string, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
  JSON.stringify({ type: 'user', isSidechain: false, message: { role: 'user', content: text }, ...extra });
const said = (blocks: unknown[], extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
  JSON.stringify({ type: 'assistant', isSidechain: false, message: { role: 'assistant', content: blocks }, ...extra });
const text = (value: string) => ({ type: 'text', text: value });
const toolUse = (name: string) => ({ type: 'tool_use', id: `toolu_${name}`, name, input: {} });
const toolResult = (name: string) =>
  JSON.stringify({
    type: 'user',
    isSidechain: false,
    message: { role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'tool_result', tool_use_id: `toolu_${name}`, content: 'ok' }] },
  });

describe('findClaudeTranscript', () => {
  test("finds <claudeHome>/projects/<slug>/<sessionRef>.jsonl in the clone's project directory first", async () => {
    const { home, clone, projectDir } = setup();
    writeSession(join(home, 'projects', '-elsewhere'), SESSION, [prompt('x')]);
    const own = writeSession(projectDir, SESSION, [prompt('x')]);
    expect(await findClaudeTranscript(home, { sessionRef: SESSION, clone })).toBe(own);
  });

  test('falls back to the session under any project directory, and gives null when there is none', async () => {
    const { home, clone } = setup();
    expect(await findClaudeTranscript(home, { sessionRef: SESSION, clone })).toBeNull();
    const other = writeSession(join(home, 'projects', '-somewhere-else'), SESSION, [prompt('x')]);
    expect(await findClaudeTranscript(home, { sessionRef: SESSION, clone })).toBe(other);
    expect(await findClaudeTranscript(home, { sessionRef: 'f'.repeat(8), clone })).toBeNull();
  });

  test('a Claude home without a projects directory has no transcripts', async () => {
    const { home, clone } = setup();
    rmSync(join(home, 'projects'), { recursive: true });
    expect(await findClaudeTranscript(home, { sessionRef: SESSION, clone })).toBeNull();
  });

  test('a session id containing path characters is refused', async () => {
    const { home, clone } = setup();
    for (const sessionRef of ['', '../x', 'a/b', 'a\\b', '..', 'x.jsonl', 'a\0b']) {
      await expect(findClaudeTranscript(home, { sessionRef, clone })).rejects.toThrow(/session id/);
      await expect(readClaudeTranscriptTail(home, { sessionRef, clone, maxChars: 100 })).rejects.toThrow(/session id/);
      await expect(deleteClaudeTranscript(home, { sessionRef, clone })).rejects.toThrow(/session id/);
    }
  });
});

describe('readClaudeTranscriptTail', () => {
  test("the recorded session's tail is its last 3 assistant turns; the tool-only turn is named by its tools", async () => {
    const { home, clone, projectDir } = setup();
    mkdirSync(projectDir, { recursive: true });

    expect(await readClaudeTranscriptTail(home, { sessionRef: SESSION, clone, maxChars: 10_000 })).toBe(
      ['Counting.\nThere is one file.', 'The handoff is written.', '[tools: Bash]'].join('\n\n'),
    );

  test('sidechain entries, malformed lines and thinking blocks are skipped', async () => {

      toolResult('mcp__agflow__submit'),

      'one\ntwo\n\n[tools: Grep, Edit]\n\n[tools: Read]',

  });

  test('only the last 3 turns count, a tool result does not start a turn, and prompts without replies are dropped', async () => {
    const { home, clone, projectDir } = setup();
    writeSession(projectDir, SESSION, [
      prompt('1'),
      said([text('a')]),
      prompt('2'),
      said([text('b')]),
      said([toolUse('Bash')]),
      toolResult('Bash'),
      said([text('c')]),
      prompt('3'),
      said([text('d')]),
      JSON.stringify({
        type: 'user',

    expect(await readClaudeTranscriptTail(home, { sessionRef: SESSION, clone, maxChars: 1000 })).toBe('b\nc\n\nd\n\ne');
  });

  test('maxChars cuts at a turn boundary and always keeps the newest turn, cut to its end', async () => {
    const { home, clone, projectDir } = setup();
    writeSession(projectDir, SESSION, [
      prompt('1'),
      said([text('x'.repeat(30))]),
      prompt('2'),

    expect(await tail(64)).toBe(`${'x'.repeat(30)}\n\n${'y'.repeat(20)}\n\n${'z'.repeat(10)}`);
    expect(await tail(63)).toBe(`${'y'.repeat(20)}\n\n${'z'.repeat(10)}`);
    expect(await tail(31)).toBe('z'.repeat(10));
    expect(await tail(6)).toBe(`…${'z'.repeat(5)}`);

  test('a cut never leaves half a surrogate pair', async () => {
    const { home, clone, projectDir } = setup();

    const tail = await readClaudeTranscriptTail(home, { sessionRef: SESSION, clone, maxChars: 4 });
    expect(tail).toBe('…😀');

    const { home, clone, projectDir } = setup();

// The guard for the SDK's untyped frames and files (transcripts, settings, rate-limit and lifecycle fields): every
// field is read off a plain object, never off an array or null.
export function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}
```

```ts
// A Claude session's transcript under the runner's Claude home (design 8.3, 6.8, 7.8): the tail the hub's handoff
// note quotes, read without a live session, and the deletion cleanup_attempt and retention run. Both look in the
// clone's project directory first, then for the session id under any project directory. The SDK's own session helpers
// are not used: they resolve the projects directory from the runner's environment, not from the Claude home.
import { open, readdir, rm, rmdir, stat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { isRecord } from './json';
import { claudeProjectDir } from './paths';

export interface ClaudeTranscriptRef {
  sessionRef: string;
  /** The attempt's clone; its project directory is searched first. */
  clone: string;
}

/** The assistant turns the tail keeps (design 6.8). */
const TAIL_TURNS = 3;
/** Only the end of a long transcript is read: three turns of text never need more, tool results included. */
const TAIL_READ_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
const TURN_SEPARATOR = '\n\n';
const CUT_MARK = '…';

// Session ids are UUIDs; anything that could leave the projects directory, or name another file, is refused.
const SESSION_REF = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/;

function checkSessionRef(sessionRef: string): void {
  if (!SESSION_REF.test(sessionRef)) throw new Error(`the session id ${JSON.stringify(sessionRef)} is not valid`);
}

/** The session's transcript file, or null when no project directory holds one. */
export async function findClaudeTranscript(claudeHome: string, ref: ClaudeTranscriptRef): Promise<string | null> {
  checkSessionRef(ref.sessionRef);
  const file = `${ref.sessionRef}.jsonl`;
  const own = ownProjectDir(claudeHome, ref.clone);
  if (own !== null && (await isFile(join(own, file)))) return join(own, file);
  for (const dir of await projectDirs(claudeHome)) {
    if (dir !== own && (await isFile(join(dir, file)))) return join(dir, file);
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * The last three main-thread assistant turns, oldest first, a blank line between turns: a turn's text, or the names of
 * the tools it called when it wrote none. Older turns are left out whole once they would pass maxChars; the newest is
 * always kept, cut to its end when it alone is longer. Null without a transcript or any assistant turn.
 */
export async function readClaudeTranscriptTail(
  claudeHome: string,
  input: ClaudeTranscriptRef & { maxChars: number },
): Promise<string | null> {
  const path = await findClaudeTranscript(claudeHome, input);
  if (path === null) return null;
  const turns = assistantTurns(await readEnd(path, TAIL_READ_BYTES)).slice(-TAIL_TURNS);
  const newest = turns.pop();
  if (newest === undefined) return null;
  const kept = [cutToEnd(newest, input.maxChars)];
  let length = kept[0]?.length ?? 0;
  for (const turn of turns.reverse()) {
    length += TURN_SEPARATOR.length + turn.length;
    if (length > input.maxChars) break;
    kept.unshift(turn);
  }
  return kept.join(TURN_SEPARATOR);
}

/**
 * Removes the session's transcript and its directory of persisted tool output from every project directory, then the
 * clone's project directory if nothing else is left in it. Idempotent.
 */
export async function deleteClaudeTranscript(claudeHome: string, ref: ClaudeTranscriptRef): Promise<void> {
  checkSessionRef(ref.sessionRef);
  const own = ownProjectDir(claudeHome, ref.clone);
  const dirs = new Set(await projectDirs(claudeHome));
  if (own !== null) dirs.add(own);
  for (const dir of dirs) {
    await rm(join(dir, `${ref.sessionRef}.jsonl`), { force: true });
    await rm(join(dir, ref.sessionRef), { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
  if (own === null) return;
  try {
    await rmdir(own);
  } catch {
    // Missing, or it still holds another session's files.
  }
}

/** The clone's project directory, or null for a clone whose slug the CLI would hash (no transcript can be there). */
function ownProjectDir(claudeHome: string, clone: string): string | null {
  try {
    return claudeProjectDir(claudeHome, clone);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function projectDirs(claudeHome: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const projects = join(claudeHome, 'projects');
  try {
    const entries = await readdir(projects, { withFileTypes: true });
    return entries.filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory()).map((entry) => join(projects, entry.name));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

async function isFile(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    return (await stat(path)).isFile();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** The last maxBytes of a file, from its first whole line. */
async function readEnd(path: string, maxBytes: number): Promise<string> {
  const handle = await open(path, 'r');
  try {
    const { size } = await handle.stat();
    const start = Math.max(0, size - maxBytes);
    const buffer = Buffer.alloc(size - start);
    const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(buffer, 0, buffer.length, start);
    const text = buffer.subarray(0, bytesRead).toString('utf8');
    return start === 0 ? text : text.slice(text.indexOf('\n') + 1);
  } finally {
    await handle.close();
  }
}

interface Turn {
  texts: string[];
  tools: string[];
}

/**
 * The rendered main-thread assistant turns of a transcript, oldest first. A user prompt starts a turn; a tool result is
 * a user entry too, but continues the turn. Sidechain entries, malformed lines and empty turns are skipped.
 */
function assistantTurns(transcript: string): string[] {
  const turns: Turn[] = [];
  let current: Turn | null = null;
  for (const line of transcript.split('\n')) {
    const entry = parseEntry(line);
    if (entry === null || entry.isSidechain === true) continue;
    const content = isRecord(entry.message) ? entry.message.content : undefined;
    if (entry.type === 'user') {
      if (!isToolResults(content)) {
        current = { texts: [], tools: [] };
        turns.push(current);
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (entry.type !== 'assistant' || !Array.isArray(content)) continue;
    if (current === null) {
      // The read began inside a turn.
      current = { texts: [], tools: [] };
      turns.push(current);
    }
    for (const block of content) {
      if (!isRecord(block)) continue;
      if (block.type === 'text' && typeof block.text === 'string' && block.text.trim() !== '') {
        current.texts.push(block.text.trim());
      } else if (block.type === 'tool_use' && typeof block.name === 'string' && !current.tools.includes(block.name)) {
        current.tools.push(block.name);
      }
    }
  }
  return turns.flatMap((turn) => {
    if (turn.texts.length > 0) return [turn.texts.join('\n')];
    if (turn.tools.length > 0) return [`[tools: ${turn.tools.join(', ')}]`];
    return [];
  });
}

function parseEntry(line: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  if (line.trim() === '') return null;
  try {
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(line);
    return isRecord(value) ? value : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function isToolResults(content: unknown): boolean {
  return Array.isArray(content) && content.some((block) => isRecord(block) && block.type === 'tool_result');
}

/** The end of text in at most maxChars, marked as cut, without half a surrogate pair at the cut. */
function cutToEnd(text: string, maxChars: number): string {
  if (text.length <= maxChars) return text;
  let end = text.slice(text.length - Math.max(0, maxChars - CUT_MARK.length));
  const first = end.charCodeAt(0);
  if (first >= 0xdc00 && first <= 0xdfff) end = end.slice(1);
  return `${CUT_MARK}${end}`;
}
```

const preflight = loadRecording('preflight-ok');

/** preflight-ok's system/init, with the placeholders the replay fills set to the recording's own values. */
function recordedInit(): SDKSystemMessage {
  const step = preflight.turns
    .flat()
    .find((s) => 'frame' in s && s.frame.type === 'system' && s.frame.subtype === 'init');
  if (step === undefined || !('frame' in step)) throw new Error('preflight-ok has no system/init');
  return {
    ...structuredClone(step.frame),
    cwd: '/work/p/T-1-a1',
    model: preflight.header.model,
    permissionMode: preflight.header.permissionMode,
  } as unknown as SDKSystemMessage;
}

function recordedAnswer(subtype: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  const answer = preflight.answers[subtype];
  if (answer === undefined || !('response' in answer)) throw new Error(`preflight-ok has no ${subtype} answer`);
  return structuredClone(answer.response);
}
