```ts
    const init = recordedInit();
    const agflow = { name: 'agflow', status: 'connected' };
    const github = { name: 'github', status: 'connected' };
    expect(checkSystemInit({ ...init, mcp_servers: [agflow, github] }, expected)).toEqual([
      'unexpected MCP servers: github',
    ]);
    expect(checkSystemInit({ ...init, mcp_servers: [{ name: 'agflow', status: 'failed' }] }, expected)).toEqual([
      'the agflow MCP server is failed',
    ]);
    expect(checkSystemInit({ ...init, mcp_servers: [] }, expected)).toEqual(['the agflow MCP server is missing']);
  });

  test('plugins must be only CLAUDE_BUILTIN_PLUGINS, the built-in plugins the pinned CLI registers', () => {
    const init = recordedInit();
    expect(init.plugins.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const { name, path } of init.plugins) expect(CLAUDE_BUILTIN_PLUGINS).toContainEqual({ name, path });
    expect(checkSystemInit({ ...init, plugins: [] }, expected)).toEqual([]);
    // Which built-ins a session lists depends on the account's feature flags; any of them is accepted.
    const builtins = CLAUDE_BUILTIN_PLUGINS.map(({ name, path }) => ({ name, path, source: `${name}@builtin` }));
    expect(builtins.map(({ name }) => name)).toContain('cc-plugin-tips');
    expect(checkSystemInit({ ...init, plugins: builtins }, expected)).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      checkSystemInit(
        {
          ...init,
          plugins: [
            ...init.plugins,
            { name: 'superpowers', path: '/Users/owner/.claude/plugins/superpowers' },
            { name: 'cc-plugin-agents-md', path: '/tmp/look-alike' },
          ],
        },
        expected,
      ),
    ).toEqual([
      'unexpected plugins: superpowers (/Users/owner/.claude/plugins/superpowers), ' +
        'cc-plugin-agents-md (/tmp/look-alike)',
    ]);
  });

  test('skipAuthChecks waives the apiKeySource check and nothing else', () => {
    const init = { ...recordedInit(), apiKeySource: 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' as const };
    expect(checkSystemInit(init, { ...expected, skipAuthChecks: true })).toEqual([]);
    const older = { ...init, claude_code_version: '2.1.200' };
    expect(checkSystemInit(older, { ...expected, skipAuthChecks: true })).toEqual([
      `claude 2.1.200, expected ${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}`,
    ]);
  });
});

describe('checkAccount', () => {

  test("preflight-ok's account is ready, with the account id and the plan", () => {
```

**File:** `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/checks.ts` (new)

```ts
// The checks behind preflight's handshake and every session's first turn (design 8.1, 5, 15.1): what system/init,
// initializationResult().account and the untyped getSettings().effective must hold, as the problem strings the Runners
// card shows, and the account facts (accountId, plan) the hub keys quota by. Pure, so the recordings pin them.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { type RunnerVendor, TEST_ACCOUNT_ID } from '@agflow/core';
import type { AccountInfo, SDKSystemMessage } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { isRecord } from './json';

/**
 * The built-in plugins 2.1.285 registers, copied from the binary, so they change with the pin. Each is reported with
 * path 'builtin' when its gate turns it on; most gates are account feature flags, so which ones a session lists
 * depends on the account (the preflight-ok capture, made without fetching flags, lists cc-plugin-agents-md only).
 * Anything else came from a marketplace or a plugin directory, and so from outside the runner's control.
 */
export const CLAUDE_BUILTIN_PLUGINS: readonly { name: string; path: string }[] = Object.freeze(
  [
    'cc-plugin-sec-default',
    'cc-plugin-agents-md',
    'cc-plugin-telemetry',
    'cc-plugin-plugin-authoring',
    'cc-plugin-mods-guide',
    'cc-plugin-tips',
    'cc-plugin-mermaid',
    'cc-plugin-responsive-mode',
    'cc-plugin-diff',
    'cc-plugin-claude-test',
  ].map((name) => Object.freeze({ name, path: 'builtin' })),
);

/** The prefix of every agflow bridge tool: the only MCP server a session has. */
const BRIDGE_TOOL_PREFIX = 'mcp__agflow__';
const BRIDGE_SERVER = 'agflow';

/** The problem preflight shows, with a ready vendor, under skipAuthChecks (design 15.1). */
const TEST_MODE = 'test mode';

const PLANS: Record<string, string> = {
  max: 'Claude Max',
  pro: 'Claude Pro',
  team: 'Claude Team',
  enterprise: 'Claude Enterprise',
};

export interface SystemInitExpectation {
  /** The attempt's CLI version, or the pin for preflight. */
  cliVersion: string;
  /** effectivePermissionMode(profile, autoOffered). */
  permissionMode: string;
  /** The built-in tools the session asked for. */
  tools: readonly string[];
  /** Test mode: the scripted server's API key is expected, so apiKeySource is not checked. */
  skipAuthChecks?: boolean;
}

/** What a session's system/init gets wrong; empty when it is the session the options asked for. */
export function checkSystemInit(init: SDKSystemMessage, expected: SystemInitExpectation): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  if (!expected.skipAuthChecks && init.apiKeySource !== 'none') problems.push(apiKeyProblem(init.apiKeySource));
  if (init.claude_code_version !== expected.cliVersion) {
    problems.push(`claude ${init.claude_code_version}, expected ${expected.cliVersion}`);
  }
  if (init.permissionMode !== expected.permissionMode) {
    problems.push(`permission mode ${init.permissionMode}, expected ${expected.permissionMode}`);
  }

  const tools = init.tools ?? [];
  const missing = expected.tools.filter((tool) => !tools.includes(tool));
  const extra = tools.filter((tool) => !expected.tools.includes(tool) && !tool.startsWith(BRIDGE_TOOL_PREFIX));
  if (missing.length > 0) problems.push(`missing tools: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
  if (extra.length > 0) problems.push(`unexpected tools: ${extra.join(', ')}`);
  if (!tools.some((tool) => tool.startsWith(BRIDGE_TOOL_PREFIX))) problems.push('no agflow bridge tools');

  const servers = init.mcp_servers ?? [];
  const others = servers.filter((server) => server.name !== BRIDGE_SERVER);
  if (others.length > 0) problems.push(`unexpected MCP servers: ${others.map((server) => server.name).join(', ')}`);
  const bridge = servers.find((server) => server.name === BRIDGE_SERVER);
  if (bridge === undefined) problems.push('the agflow MCP server is missing');
  else if (bridge.status !== 'connected') problems.push(`the agflow MCP server is ${bridge.status}`);

  const plugins = (init.plugins ?? []).filter(
    (plugin) => !CLAUDE_BUILTIN_PLUGINS.some((builtin) => builtin.name === plugin.name && builtin.path === plugin.path),
  );
  if (plugins.length > 0) {
    problems.push(`unexpected plugins: ${plugins.map((plugin) => `${plugin.name} (${plugin.path})`).join(', ')}`);
  }
  return problems;
}

export type ClaudeAccountFacts = Pick<RunnerVendor, 'ready' | 'problem' | 'accountId' | 'plan'>;

/**
 * The account initializationResult() reports: ready with a subscription and no API key. Under skipAuthChecks it is
 * test mode's identity instead (X-21), whatever the scripted server's key looks like.
 */
export function checkAccount(
  account: AccountInfo | null | undefined,
  options: { skipAuthChecks?: boolean } = {},
): ClaudeAccountFacts {
  if (options.skipAuthChecks) return { ready: true, problem: TEST_MODE, accountId: TEST_ACCOUNT_ID, plan: TEST_MODE };
  const accountId = account ? claudeAccountId(account) : null;
  const type = account?.subscriptionType;
  const plan = type ? (PLANS[type] ?? `Claude ${type}`) : null;
  let problem: string | null = null;
  if (account?.apiKeySource) problem = apiKeyProblem(account.apiKeySource);
  else if (!type) problem = 'not logged in';
  return { ready: problem === null, problem, accountId, plan };
}

/** The first 16 hex of sha256 of the account's email, or of its organisation without one; null without either. */
export function claudeAccountId(account: Pick<AccountInfo, 'email' | 'organization'>): string | null {
  const identity = account.email || account.organization;
  if (!identity) return null;
  return createHash('sha256').update(identity).digest('hex').slice(0, 16);
}

/**
 * What getSettings().effective gets wrong about the sandbox; the SDK leaves it untyped, so any shape is read. The
 * sandbox must be on and must fail closed: a CLI that cannot start it then runs no command instead of running it bare.
 */
export function checkEffectiveSettings(effective: unknown): string[] {
  const sandbox = isRecord(effective) && isRecord(effective.sandbox) ? effective.sandbox : {};
  const problems: string[] = [];
  if (sandbox.enabled !== true) problems.push('the sandbox is not enabled');
  if (sandbox.failIfUnavailable !== true) {
    problems.push('the sandbox would let commands run unsandboxed when it is unavailable');
  }
  return problems;
}

function apiKeyProblem(source: string): string {
  const problem = 'an API key would replace the subscription';
  return source === 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' ? problem : `${problem} (${source})`;
}
```

### Task 13: Quota, paid usage and turn outcomes

Claude's quota signals as one `VendorQuota` per account, and every result as `turn_ended`'s outcome and `errorKind` (design 8.3, 8.1, 6.10). `toVendorQuota` and `QuotaBook` merge `rate_limit_event`s per account: a rejected plan window with overage in use reads `ok` with `paidUsage` `in_use`, so `allowPaidUsage` can take effect in M2b's controller, which applies it (X-14). `quotaFromUsage` turns preflight's usage call into a quota, or null for any other shape (X-29). `classifyResult` decides from the result, the turn's last assistant error and the runner's pending-interrupt flag: an interrupt, a completed turn, or a failure whose kind is `policy` for a refusal, `quota` for a usage-limit text, `context` for a full context window, `auth` for a 401 or a login text, `policy` for a policy API error and `vendor` for any other API error, in that order. The CLI's usage-limit, usage-disabled and usage-transition texts are copied from the 2.1.285 binary as per-pin lists.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/outcome.ts`
- Create: `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/quota.ts`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/outcome.test.ts`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/quota.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { loadRecording } from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import type { SDKResultError, SDKResultMessage, SDKResultSuccess } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { classifyResult } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/outcome';
import { USAGE_DISABLED_PREFIXES, USAGE_LIMIT_PREFIXES } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/quota';

/** The result frames a recording printed, by subtype. */
function recordedResult(scenario: string, subtype: SDKResultMessage['subtype']): SDKResultMessage {
  for (const step of loadRecording(scenario).turns.flat()) {
    if ('frame' in step && step.frame.type === 'result' && step.frame.subtype === subtype) {
      return structuredClone(step.frame) as unknown as SDKResultMessage;
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`${scenario} has no ${subtype} result`);
}

const success = recordedResult('turn-basic', 'success') as SDKResultSuccess;
const aborted = recordedResult('interrupt', 'error_during_execution') as SDKResultError;

/** A turn that ended on an API error: success with is_error, the error text as the result. */
function apiError(result: string, fields: Partial<SDKResultSuccess> & Record<string, unknown> = {}): SDKResultSuccess {
  return {
    ...success,
    is_error: true,
    result,
    stop_reason: 'stop_sequence',
    terminal_reason: 'api_error',
    ...fields,
  } as SDKResultSuccess;
}

const idle = { interruptPending: false };

describe('classifyResult', () => {
  test('success gives completed and is_error gives failed', () => {
    expect(success.is_error).toBe(false);
    expect(classifyResult(success, idle)).toEqual({ outcome: 'completed', errorKind: null, error: null });
    expect(classifyResult({ ...success, is_error: true, result: 'boom', terminal_reason: undefined }, idle)).toEqual({
      outcome: 'failed',
      errorKind: null,
      error: 'boom',
    });
  });

  test('with the pending-interrupt flag set, error_during_execution gives interrupted, whatever its terminal_reason', () => {
    expect(aborted.terminal_reason).toBe('aborted_tools');
    const pending = { interruptPending: true };
    for (const terminal_reason of ['aborted_tools', 'aborted_streaming', 'api_error', undefined] as const) {
      expect(classifyResult({ ...aborted, terminal_reason }, pending)).toEqual({
        outcome: 'interrupted',
        errorKind: null,
        error: null,
      });
    }
    // A turn that finished before the interrupt landed is still a completed turn.
    expect(classifyResult(success, pending).outcome).toBe('completed');
  });

  test('without the flag, error_during_execution is a failure with its errors', () => {
    expect(classifyResult(aborted, idle)).toEqual({
      outcome: 'failed',
      errorKind: null,
      error: aborted.errors.join('\n'),
    });
    expect(classifyResult({ ...aborted, errors: [] }, idle)).toEqual({
      outcome: 'failed',
      errorKind: null,
      error: null,
    });
  });

  test('terminal_reason blocking_limit or rapid_refill_breaker is a full context, never quota', () => {
    const tooLong = 'Prompt is too long';
    const blocked = apiError(tooLong, { terminal_reason: 'blocking_limit', api_error: 'invalid_request' });
    expect(classifyResult(blocked, idle)).toEqual({ outcome: 'failed', errorKind: 'context', error: tooLong });
    const thrashing = 'Autocompact is thrashing: the context refilled to the limit right after compacting';
    const refilled = { terminal_reason: 'rapid_refill_breaker', api_error: 'autocompact_thrashing' } as const;
    expect(classifyResult(apiError(thrashing, refilled), idle).errorKind).toBe('context');
    // Each signal on its own.
    for (const fields of [
      { terminal_reason: 'blocking_limit' },
      { terminal_reason: 'rapid_refill_breaker' },
      { terminal_reason: undefined, api_error: 'autocompact_thrashing' },
    ] as const) {
      expect(classifyResult(apiError('API Error: stopped', fields), idle).errorKind).toBe('context');
    }
    expect(classifyResult(apiError(thrashing, { terminal_reason: undefined }), idle).errorKind).toBe('context');
  });

  test('result text that starts with one of USAGE_LIMIT_PREFIXES gives errorKind quota', () => {
    const text = "You've hit your session limit · resets 3pm (Europe/Moscow)";
    const limited = apiError(text, { api_error_status: 429 });
    expect(classifyResult(limited, { interruptPending: false, assistantError: 'rate_limit' })).toEqual({
      outcome: 'failed',
      errorKind: 'quota',
      error: text,
    });
    for (const prefix of [...USAGE_LIMIT_PREFIXES, ...USAGE_DISABLED_PREFIXES]) {
      expect(classifyResult(apiError(`${prefix} …`), idle).errorKind).toBe('quota');
    }
    // The text of a rejected status whose overage the organisation's service level disables.
    expect(classifyResult(apiError('This service is disabled for your org'), idle).errorKind).toBe('quota');
  });

  test('prompt_too_long gives context', () => {
    expect(classifyResult(apiError('Prompt is too long', { terminal_reason: 'prompt_too_long' }), idle).errorKind).toBe(
      'context',
    );
    const overflow = apiError('Prompt is too long: 210000 tokens > 200000 maximum');
    expect(classifyResult(overflow, idle).errorKind).toBe('context');
  });

  test('an expired or invalid login gives auth', () => {
    for (const text of [
      'Not logged in · Please run /login',
      'Login expired · Please run /login',
      'OAuth token revoked · Please run /login',
      'Invalid API key · Fix external API key',
      'Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed',
      'Authentication required · Sign in again to continue',
    ]) {
      expect(classifyResult(apiError(text), idle)).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'failed', errorKind: 'auth', error: text });
    }
    expect(classifyResult(apiError('API Error: 401', { api_error_status: 401 }), idle).errorKind).toBe('auth');
    const login = { interruptPending: false, assistantError: 'authentication_failed' as const };
    expect(classifyResult(apiError('something new'), login).errorKind).toBe('auth');
  });

  test('a policy refusal gives policy', () => {
    const refused = { ...success, stop_reason: 'refusal', result: '', terminal_reason: 'completed' as const };
    expect(classifyResult(refused, idle)).toEqual({
      outcome: 'failed',
      errorKind: 'policy',
      error: 'the model declined the request (stop_reason refusal)',
    });
    const blocked = apiError('API Error: blocked', { api_error: 'safety_monitor_blocked' });
    expect(classifyResult(blocked, idle).errorKind).toBe('policy');
  });

  test("a refusal's own text never decides its kind", () => {
    for (const text of [`${USAGE_LIMIT_PREFIXES[0]} limit · resets 3pm`, 'Not logged in', 'Prompt is too long']) {
      const refused = { ...success, stop_reason: 'refusal', result: text, terminal_reason: 'completed' as const };
      expect(classifyResult(refused, idle)).toEqual({ outcome: 'failed', errorKind: 'policy', error: text });
    }
  });

  test('api_error, model_error, and 429 or 529 after retries give vendor, never quota', () => {
    expect(classifyResult(apiError('API Error: 500 Internal server error'), idle)).toMatchObject({
      outcome: 'failed',
      errorKind: 'vendor',
    });
    const modelError = apiError('API Error: bad model output', { terminal_reason: 'model_error' });
    expect(classifyResult(modelError, idle).errorKind).toBe('vendor');
    // Each vendor signal on its own, without any other.
    for (const terminal_reason of ['api_error', 'model_error'] as const) {
      expect(classifyResult(apiError('Something went wrong', { terminal_reason }), idle).errorKind).toBe('vendor');
    }
    const textOnly = apiError('API Error: Connection error.', { terminal_reason: undefined });
    expect(classifyResult(textOnly, idle).errorKind).toBe('vendor');
    expect(classifyResult(apiError('Something went wrong', { terminal_reason: undefined }), idle).errorKind).toBeNull();
    for (const [status, assistantError] of [
      [429, 'rate_limit'],
      [529, 'overloaded'],
    ] as const) {
      const result = apiError(`API Error: ${status} {"type":"error","error":{"type":"${assistantError}_error"}}`, {
        api_error_status: status,
        terminal_reason: undefined,
      });
      expect(classifyResult(result, { interruptPending: false, assistantError }).errorKind).toBe('vendor');
      expect(classifyResult(result, idle).errorKind).toBe('vendor');
    }
    expect(
      classifyResult(apiError('Request timed out', { terminal_reason: undefined }), {
        interruptPending: false,
        assistantError: 'server_error',
      }).errorKind,
    ).toBe('vendor');
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { VendorQuotaSchema } from '@agflow/core';
import { loadRecording } from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import type { SDKControlGetUsageResponse, SDKRateLimitInfo } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import {
  isLimitHitText,
  isPaidUsageNotice,
  QuotaBook,
  quotaFromUsage,
  toVendorQuota,
  USAGE_LIMIT_PREFIXES,
  USAGE_TRANSITION_PREFIXES,
} from '../../../src/adapters/claude/quota';
import { isLimitHit } from '../../../src/attempt/turns';

const NOW = 1_800_000_000_000;
const RESET_S = 1_800_003_600;
const RESET_MS = RESET_S * 1000;

const info = (fields: Partial<SDKRateLimitInfo> & Record<string, unknown>): SDKRateLimitInfo =>
  ({ status: 'allowed', ...fields }) as SDKRateLimitInfo;

describe('toVendorQuota', () => {
  test('status rejected gives exhausted, with resetsAt in epoch ms (seconds are converted)', () => {
    const quota = toVendorQuota(info({ status: 'rejected', resetsAt: RESET_S, rateLimitType: 'five_hour' }), NOW);
    expect(quota).toEqual({
      state: 'exhausted',
      resetsAt: RESET_MS,
      windows: { fiveHour: null, weekly: null },
      paidUsage: 'unknown',
      updatedAt: NOW,
    });
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ status: 'rejected', resetsAt: RESET_MS }), NOW).resetsAt).toBe(RESET_MS);
    expect(VendorQuotaSchema.parse(quota)).toEqual(quota);
  });

  test('a limit hit without a reset time gives exhausted with resetsAt null', () => {
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ status: 'rejected' }), NOW)).toMatchObject({ state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: null });
  });

  test('allowed and allowed_warning stay ok; utilization lands in fiveHour or weekly by rateLimitType', () => {
    const five = toVendorQuota(info({ status: 'allowed', rateLimitType: 'five_hour', utilization: 0.4 }), NOW);
    expect(five).toMatchObject({ state: 'ok', windows: { fiveHour: 0.4, weekly: null } });
    const weeklyTypes = ['seven_day', 'seven_day_opus', 'seven_day_sonnet', 'seven_day_overage_included'] as const;
    for (const rateLimitType of weeklyTypes) {
      const weekly = toVendorQuota(info({ status: 'allowed_warning', rateLimitType, utilization: 0.9 }), NOW);
      expect(weekly).toMatchObject({ state: 'ok', windows: { fiveHour: null, weekly: 0.9 } });
    }
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ rateLimitType: 'five_hour', utilization: 1.7 }), NOW).windows.fiveHour).toBe(1);
  });

  test('without utilization the unifiedWindows give the windows, the largest weekly one for weekly', () => {
    const unifiedWindows = {
      five_hour: { utilization: 0.25, resetsAt: RESET_S },
      seven_day: { utilization: 0.5, resetsAt: RESET_S },
      seven_day_overage_included: { utilization: 0.75, resetsAt: RESET_S },
    };
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ rateLimitType: 'five_hour', unifiedWindows }), NOW).windows).toEqual({
      fiveHour: 0.25,
      weekly: 0.75,
    });
    // The event's own utilization wins for its window.
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ rateLimitType: 'five_hour', utilization: 0.3, unifiedWindows }), NOW).windows).toEqual({
      fiveHour: 0.3,
      weekly: 0.75,
    });
    for (const odd of [null, 'x', { five_hour: 'x', seven_day: { utilization: 'high' } }]) {
      expect(toVendorQuota(info({ unifiedWindows: odd }), NOW).windows).toEqual({ fiveHour: null, weekly: null });
    }
  });

  test('isUsingOverage, overageInUse or rateLimitType overage gives paidUsage in_use; using it is not exhaustion', () => {
    // The CLI sets isUsingOverage exactly when the plan window is rejected and overage allowed.
    const overage = toVendorQuota(
      info({ status: 'rejected', resetsAt: RESET_S, overageStatus: 'allowed', isUsingOverage: true }),
      NOW,
    );
    expect(overage).toMatchObject({ state: 'ok', paidUsage: 'in_use', resetsAt: RESET_MS });
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ overageInUse: true }), NOW).paidUsage).toBe('in_use');
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ rateLimitType: 'overage', utilization: 0.2 }), NOW)).toMatchObject({
      paidUsage: 'in_use',
      windows: { fiveHour: null, weekly: null },
    });
    // The overage limit itself hit: exhausted.
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ status: 'rejected', rateLimitType: 'overage' }), NOW)).toMatchObject({
      state: 'exhausted',
      paidUsage: 'in_use',
    });
  });

  test('overageStatus allowed gives enabled; an overageDisabledReason gives disabled; neither gives unknown', () => {
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ overageStatus: 'allowed' }), NOW).paidUsage).toBe('enabled');
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ overageStatus: 'allowed_warning' }), NOW).paidUsage).toBe('enabled');
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ overageDisabledReason: 'out_of_credits' }), NOW).paidUsage).toBe('disabled');
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({ overageStatus: 'rejected' }), NOW).paidUsage).toBe('disabled');
    expect(toVendorQuota(info({}), NOW).paidUsage).toBe('unknown');
  });
});

describe('QuotaBook', () => {
  test('keeps the last value per account between sparse rate_limit_events, and merges windows', () => {
    let now = NOW;
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => now);
    expect(book.last('a')).toBeNull();
    book.rateLimit(
      'a',
      info({ rateLimitType: 'five_hour', utilization: 0.5, resetsAt: RESET_S, overageStatus: 'allowed' }),
    );
    now += 1000;
    const merged = book.rateLimit('a', info({ rateLimitType: 'seven_day', utilization: 0.2 }));
    expect(merged).toEqual({
      state: 'ok',
      resetsAt: RESET_MS,
      windows: { fiveHour: 0.5, weekly: 0.2 },
      paidUsage: 'enabled',
      updatedAt: NOW + 1000,
    });
    expect(book.last('a')).toEqual(merged);
    expect(book.last('b')).toBeNull();
    book.rateLimit('b', info({ status: 'rejected' }));
    expect(book.last('b')?.state).toBe('exhausted');
    expect(book.last('a')?.state).toBe('ok');
  });

  test('a new state replaces the old one, and its reset time with it', () => {
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => NOW);
    book.rateLimit('a', info({ status: 'rejected', resetsAt: RESET_S }));
    expect(book.rateLimit('a', info({ status: 'allowed' }))).toMatchObject({ state: 'ok', resetsAt: null });
  });

  test('a rejected report without a reset time is exhausted with resetsAt null, whatever came before', () => {
    let now = NOW;
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => now);
    book.rateLimit('a', info({ status: 'rejected', resetsAt: RESET_S }));
    now = RESET_MS + 1000;
    expect(book.rateLimit('a', info({ status: 'rejected' }))).toMatchObject({ state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: null });
    now = NOW;
    book.rateLimit('b', info({ status: 'rejected', resetsAt: RESET_S }));
    expect(book.rateLimit('b', info({ status: 'rejected' }))).toMatchObject({ state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: null });
  });

  test('a reset time that has passed is never carried into a report without one', () => {
    let now = NOW;
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => now);
    book.rateLimit('a', info({ rateLimitType: 'five_hour', utilization: 0.5, resetsAt: RESET_S }));
    now = RESET_MS + 1000;
    expect(book.rateLimit('a', info({ rateLimitType: 'seven_day', utilization: 0.2 }))).toMatchObject({
      state: 'ok',
      resetsAt: null,
    });
    book.rateLimit('b', info({ status: 'rejected', resetsAt: RESET_S }));
    expect(book.paidUsageInUse('b')).toMatchObject({ state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: null });
    now = NOW;
    book.rateLimit('c', info({ status: 'rejected', resetsAt: RESET_S }));
    expect(book.paidUsageInUse('c')).toMatchObject({ state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: RESET_MS });
  });

  test('a report that paid usage is not in use ends an in_use the book held', () => {
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => NOW);
    const warning = info({
      status: 'allowed_warning',
      rateLimitType: 'five_hour',
      utilization: 0.9,
      isUsingOverage: false,
      resetsAt: RESET_S,
    });
    book.rateLimit('a', info({ status: 'rejected', rateLimitType: 'five_hour', isUsingOverage: true }));
    expect(book.last('a')).toMatchObject({ state: 'ok', paidUsage: 'in_use' });
    const after = book.rateLimit('a', warning);
    expect(after).toMatchObject({ state: 'ok', paidUsage: 'enabled', resetsAt: RESET_MS });
    expect(isLimitHit(after, false)).toBe(false);

    book.paidUsageInUse('b');
    const notice = book.rateLimit('b', warning);
    expect(notice.paidUsage).toBe('enabled');
    expect(isLimitHit(notice, false)).toBe(false);

    // The report's own overage facts win, and without a held in_use nothing is made up.
    book.paidUsageInUse('c');
    expect(book.rateLimit('c', { ...warning, overageDisabledReason: 'out_of_credits' }).paidUsage).toBe('disabled');
    expect(book.rateLimit('d', warning).paidUsage).toBe('unknown');
  });

  test('a usage-transition notice sets paidUsage in_use and keeps the rest', () => {
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => NOW);
    expect(book.paidUsageInUse('a')).toEqual({
      state: 'unknown',
      resetsAt: null,
      windows: { fiveHour: null, weekly: null },
      paidUsage: 'in_use',
      updatedAt: NOW,
    });
    book.rateLimit('b', info({ rateLimitType: 'five_hour', utilization: 0.9 }));
    expect(book.paidUsageInUse('b')).toMatchObject({ state: 'ok', paidUsage: 'in_use', windows: { fiveHour: 0.9 } });
  });

  test('update stores a quota from elsewhere, such as the usage call', () => {
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => NOW);
    const quota = quotaFromUsage(usage({ five_hour: window(10, '2027-01-15T10:00:00.000Z') }), NOW);
    if (quota === null) throw new Error('no quota');
    expect(book.update('a', quota)).toEqual(quota);
    expect(book.last('a')).toEqual(quota);
  });
});

type RateLimits = NonNullable<SDKControlGetUsageResponse['rate_limits']>;
const window = (utilization: number | null, resets_at: string | null) => ({ utilization, resets_at });
const usage = (rate_limits: RateLimits | null | Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> => ({
  subscription_type: 'max',
  rate_limits_available: rate_limits !== null,
  rate_limits,
});

describe('quotaFromUsage', () => {
  test('maps five_hour and seven_day (percent / 100; ISO resets to epoch ms; the limiting window reset)', () => {
    const quota = quotaFromUsage(
      usage({
        five_hour: window(42, '2027-01-15T10:00:00.000Z'),
        seven_day: window(64, '2027-01-20T00:00:00Z'),
        extra_usage: { is_enabled: false, monthly_limit: null, used_credits: null, utilization: null },
      }),
      NOW,
    );
    expect(quota).toEqual({
      state: 'ok',
      resetsAt: Date.parse('2027-01-20T00:00:00Z'),
      windows: { fiveHour: 0.42, weekly: 0.64 },
      paidUsage: 'disabled',
      updatedAt: NOW,
    });
    expect(VendorQuotaSchema.parse(quota)).toEqual(quota as NonNullable<typeof quota>);
  });

  test('extra_usage.is_enabled gives enabled or disabled, and its absence unknown', () => {
    const base = { five_hour: window(10, null) };
    expect(quotaFromUsage(usage({ ...base, extra_usage: { is_enabled: true } }), NOW)?.paidUsage).toBe('enabled');
    expect(quotaFromUsage(usage({ ...base, extra_usage: null }), NOW)?.paidUsage).toBe('unknown');
    expect(quotaFromUsage(usage(base), NOW)).toMatchObject({
      resetsAt: null,
      windows: { fiveHour: 0.1, weekly: null },
      paidUsage: 'unknown',
    });
  });

  test('a full window is exhausted until its reset, unless extra usage would carry the work', () => {
    const full = { five_hour: window(100, '2027-01-15T10:00:00.000Z'), seven_day: window(80, null) };
    expect(quotaFromUsage(usage(full), NOW)).toMatchObject({
      state: 'exhausted',
      resetsAt: Date.parse('2027-01-15T10:00:00.000Z'),
      windows: { fiveHour: 1, weekly: 0.8 },
    });
    expect(quotaFromUsage(usage({ ...full, extra_usage: { is_enabled: true } }), NOW)).toMatchObject({
      state: 'ok',
      paidUsage: 'enabled',

  test("the preflight-ok capture's usage answer (rate_limits null) gives null", () => {
    const answer = loadRecording('preflight-ok').answers.get_usage;
    if (answer === undefined || !('response' in answer)) throw new Error('preflight-ok has no get_usage answer');
    expect(quotaFromUsage(answer.response, NOW)).toBeNull();
  });

  test('rate_limits null or another shape gives null', () => {
    for (const odd of [
      null,
      undefined,
      'x',
      { rate_limits: 'x' },
      usage(null),
      usage({}),
      usage({ five_hour: null, seven_day: null }),
      usage({ five_hour: 'x' }),
      usage({ five_hour: { utilization: '42%', resets_at: null } }),
      usage({ five_hour: window(10, 'not a date') }),
      usage({ five_hour: { utilization: 10, resets_at: 1_800_000_000 } }),
      usage({ five_hour: window(10, null), extra_usage: { is_enabled: 'yes' } }),
    ]) {
      expect(quotaFromUsage(odd, NOW)).toBeNull();
    }
  });
});

describe('the CLI texts', () => {

    for (const text of [
      "You've hit your session limit · resets 3pm",

    expect(isPaidUsageNotice("You're now using extra usage")).toBe(true);
    expect(isPaidUsageNotice("You've hit your session limit")).toBe(false);
    expect(isPaidUsageNotice('We are now using extra usage')).toBe(false);

});
```

```ts
// A Claude turn's result as turn_ended's outcome and errorKind (design 8.3, 6.10): limit hits, vendor errors, auth,
// context and policy kept apart, so the controller waits for quota, retries the vendor, or reports a vendor outcome.
// The CLI's texts are 2.1.285's, copied from the binary.
import type { SDKAssistantMessageError, SDKResultMessage } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import type { AgentEvent } from '../types';
import { isLimitHitText } from './quota';

type TurnEnded = Extract<AgentEvent, { type: 'turn_ended' }>;

export type ResultClassification = Pick<TurnEnded, 'outcome' | 'errorKind' | 'error'>;

export interface ResultContext {
  /** The runner interrupted the turn and its result has not arrived yet: the runner's flag decides (design 8.3). */
  interruptPending: boolean;
  /** The error of the turn's last main-thread assistant message, when that message wrapped an API error. */
  assistantError?: SDKAssistantMessageError | null;
}

/** 2.1.285's messages for a login that is missing, expired, revoked or refused. */
const AUTH_TEXTS = [
  'Not logged in',
  'Login expired',
  'OAuth token revoked',
  'Authentication required',
  'Invalid API key',
  'Invalid auth token',
  'Failed to authenticate',
  'Your organization has disabled',
  'Your ANTHROPIC_API_KEY belongs to a disabled organization',
  'Your account does not have access to Claude',
];
const AUTH_ERRORS: readonly SDKAssistantMessageError[] = [
  'authentication_failed',
  'oauth_org_not_allowed',
  'account_on_hold',
];
const CONTEXT_TEXTS = ['Prompt is too long', 'Autocompact is thrashing'];
/**
 * The terminal reasons of a full context window: blocking_limit is the context estimate at its limit before any API
 * call, rapid_refill_breaker automatic compaction refilling it each time. 2.1.285 groups them as context_limit; none
 * is a usage limit, which ends as an API error with a usage-limit text instead.
 */
const CONTEXT_REASONS: readonly string[] = ['blocking_limit', 'rapid_refill_breaker', 'prompt_too_long'];
const CONTEXT_API_ERRORS = ['autocompact_thrashing'];
/** The untyped result.api_error values for a request the API's safety checks blocked. */
const POLICY_API_ERRORS = ['dlp_request_denied', 'safety_monitor_blocked'];

/**
 * outcome: completed for a normal end, interrupted for an error_during_execution while the runner's interrupt is
 * pending, failed otherwise (any is_error, and a refusal). A failure's errorKind is policy for a refusal, quota for a
 * limit hit, context for a full context window, auth or policy for those vendor outcomes, vendor for any other API
 * error (429 and 529 after retries included), and null for a failure the CLI gives no cause for.
 */
export function classifyResult(result: SDKResultMessage, context: ResultContext): ResultClassification {
  if (context.interruptPending && result.subtype === 'error_during_execution') {
    return { outcome: 'interrupted', errorKind: null, error: null };
  }
  const refused = result.stop_reason === 'refusal';
  if (result.subtype === 'success' && !result.is_error && !refused) {
    return { outcome: 'completed', errorKind: null, error: null };
  }
  const text = (result.subtype === 'success' ? result.result : result.errors.join('\n')).trim();
  const error = text !== '' ? text : refused ? 'the model declined the request (stop_reason refusal)' : null;
  return { outcome: 'failed', errorKind: errorKind(result, text, refused, context), error };
}

/** Text tests apply to CLI-written error text only: an is_error result's, or an error subtype's errors. */
function errorKind(
  result: SDKResultMessage,
  text: string,
  refused: boolean,
  context: ResultContext,
): TurnEnded['errorKind'] {
  const reason = result.terminal_reason;
  // Untyped in sdk.d.ts on error subtypes (api_error_status) or everywhere (api_error).
  const { api_error_status: status, api_error: apiError } = result as {
    api_error_status?: unknown;
    api_error?: unknown;
  };
  const assistantError = context.assistantError ?? null;
  // A refusal's text is the model's own partial answer, not the CLI's: no text decides its kind.
  if (refused) return 'policy';
  if (isLimitHitText(text)) return 'quota';
  if (
    (reason !== undefined && CONTEXT_REASONS.includes(reason)) ||
    (typeof apiError === 'string' && CONTEXT_API_ERRORS.includes(apiError)) ||
    startsWithAny(text, CONTEXT_TEXTS)
  ) {
    return 'context';
  }
  if (
    status === 401 ||
    (assistantError !== null && AUTH_ERRORS.includes(assistantError)) ||
    startsWithAny(text, AUTH_TEXTS)
  ) {
    return 'auth';
  }
  if (typeof apiError === 'string' && POLICY_API_ERRORS.includes(apiError)) return 'policy';
  if (
    reason === 'api_error' ||
    reason === 'model_error' ||
    typeof status === 'number' ||
    assistantError !== null ||
    text.startsWith('API Error')
  ) {
    return 'vendor';
  }
  return null;
}

function startsWithAny(text: string, prefixes: readonly string[]): boolean {
  return prefixes.some((prefix) => text.startsWith(prefix));
}
```

```ts
// Claude's quota signals as one VendorQuota per account (design 8.3, 8.1, 6.10): rate_limit_event, the CLI's
// usage-limit and usage-transition texts, and preflight's usage call (X-29). The adapter reports facts only, such as
// paidUsage 'in_use'; the attempt controller applies allowPaidUsage (X-14).
import type { VendorQuota } from '@agflow/core';
import type { SDKRateLimitInfo } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { isRecord } from './json';

/** The texts 2.1.285 starts a usage-limit message with; copied from the binary, so they change with the pin. */
export const USAGE_LIMIT_PREFIXES: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([
  "You've hit your",
  "You've reached your",
  "You're out of usage credits",
  'Your org is out of usage · add funds to continue',
  'Your org is out of usage · contact your admin',
  "Your seat type doesn't include usage credits",
  "Your seat type doesn't include usage",
  'Your usage allocation has been disabled by your admin',
  "Your group's usage limit is set to $0",
  'Fable 5 requires usage credits',
  "You're out of extra usage",
  "Your seat type doesn't include extra usage",
]);

/**
 * The text 2.1.285 gives a rejected status whose overage the organisation's service level disables; the binary keeps
 * it in a list of its own, but it is a limit hit like the texts above.
 */
export const USAGE_DISABLED_PREFIXES: readonly string[] = Object.freeze(['This service is disabled for your org']);

/** The usage-limit messages 2.1.285 matches by pattern rather than prefix. */
const USAGE_LIMIT_PATTERNS: readonly RegExp[] = [/^Fable(?: [^·\n]{1,40})? requires usage credits\./];

/** The texts 2.1.285 starts a usage-transition notice with: from here on the work draws on paid usage. */
export const USAGE_TRANSITION_PREFIXES: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([
  "You're now using usage credits",
  "You're now using your usage allocation",
  'Now using your usage allocation',
  'Now using usage credits',
  "You're now using extra usage",
  'Now using extra usage',
]);

/** Whether a message, such as a failed turn's result, is the CLI saying a usage limit was hit. */
export function isLimitHitText(text: string): boolean {
  const start = text.trimStart();
  return (
    USAGE_LIMIT_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => start.startsWith(prefix)) ||
    USAGE_DISABLED_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => start.startsWith(prefix)) ||
    USAGE_LIMIT_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(start))
  );
}

/** Whether a message is the CLI's notice that the work now draws on paid usage. */
export function isPaidUsageNotice(text: string): boolean {
  const start = text.trimStart();
  return USAGE_TRANSITION_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => start.startsWith(prefix));
}

/**
 * One rate_limit_event's info as a quota. A rejected status is exhausted unless the CLI goes on with paid usage
 * (isUsingOverage or overageInUse): the controller then decides by allowPaidUsage. The event's utilization fills the
 * window its rateLimitType names; the untyped unifiedWindows, when present, fill the others.
 */
export function toVendorQuota(info: SDKRateLimitInfo, now: number): VendorQuota {
  const unified = unifiedWindows((info as { unifiedWindows?: unknown }).unifiedWindows);
  const own = fraction(info.utilization);
  const type = info.rateLimitType;
  const usingPaid = info.isUsingOverage === true || info.overageInUse === true;
  let paidUsage: VendorQuota['paidUsage'] = 'unknown';
  if (usingPaid || type === 'overage') paidUsage = 'in_use';
  else if (info.overageDisabledReason !== undefined || info.overageStatus === 'rejected') paidUsage = 'disabled';
  else if (info.overageStatus === 'allowed' || info.overageStatus === 'allowed_warning') paidUsage = 'enabled';
  return {
    state: info.status === 'rejected' && !usingPaid ? 'exhausted' : 'ok',
    resetsAt: epochMs(info.resetsAt),
    windows: {
      fiveHour: type === 'five_hour' && own !== null ? own : unified.fiveHour,
      weekly: type?.startsWith('seven_day') && own !== null ? own : unified.weekly,
    },
    paidUsage,
    updatedAt: now,
  };
}

/**
 * The quota preflight's usage call gives (X-29): rate_limits.five_hour and seven_day in percent with ISO reset times,
 * and extra_usage.is_enabled. A window at 100% is exhausted until the limiting window's reset, unless extra usage is
 * enabled. Null for rate_limits null, no window, or any shape this pin does not produce.
 */
export function quotaFromUsage(usage: unknown, now: number): VendorQuota | null {
  if (!isRecord(usage) || !isRecord(usage.rate_limits)) return null;
  const limits = usage.rate_limits;
  const fiveHour = usageWindow(limits.five_hour);
  const weekly = usageWindow(limits.seven_day);
  if (fiveHour === undefined || weekly === undefined) return null;
  let paidUsage: VendorQuota['paidUsage'] = 'unknown';
  if (isRecord(limits.extra_usage)) {
    if (typeof limits.extra_usage.is_enabled !== 'boolean') return null;
    paidUsage = limits.extra_usage.is_enabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled';
  } else if (limits.extra_usage !== undefined && limits.extra_usage !== null) {
    return null;
  }
  const known = [fiveHour, weekly].filter(
    (window): window is UsageWindow => window !== null && window.utilization !== null,
  );
  if (known.length === 0) return null;
  const limiting = known.reduce((a, b) => ((b.utilization ?? 0) > (a.utilization ?? 0) ? b : a));
  const full = (limiting.utilization ?? 0) >= 1;
  return {
    state: full && paidUsage !== 'enabled' ? 'exhausted' : 'ok',
    resetsAt: limiting.resetsAt,
    windows: { fiveHour: fiveHour?.utilization ?? null, weekly: weekly?.utilization ?? null },
    paidUsage,
    updatedAt: now,
  };
}

/**
 * The last quota per account. rate_limit_event fires only when something changes, so each report is merged into the
 * last: a window or paid-usage fact the report leaves unknown keeps its last value.
 */
export class QuotaBook {
  private readonly quotas = new Map<string | null, VendorQuota>();

  constructor(private readonly now: () => number = Date.now) {}

  last(accountId: string | null): VendorQuota | null {
    return this.quotas.get(accountId) ?? null;
  }

  /** Merges a report into the account's last quota, and gives the result. */
  update(accountId: string | null, quota: VendorQuota): VendorQuota {
    const previous = this.quotas.get(accountId);
    const merged: VendorQuota =
      previous === undefined
        ? quota
        : {
            state: quota.state === 'unknown' ? previous.state : quota.state,
            resetsAt: quota.resetsAt ?? carriedReset(previous, quota),
            windows: {
              fiveHour: quota.windows.fiveHour ?? previous.windows.fiveHour,
              weekly: quota.windows.weekly ?? previous.windows.weekly,
            },
            paidUsage: quota.paidUsage === 'unknown' ? previous.paidUsage : quota.paidUsage,
            updatedAt: quota.updatedAt,
          };
    this.quotas.set(accountId, merged);
    return merged;
  }

  rateLimit(accountId: string | null, info: SDKRateLimitInfo): VendorQuota {
    let quota = toVendorQuota(info, this.now());
    // isUsingOverage false is a fact even without overage fields: paid usage the book holds as in use has ended, and
    // since it was in use, extra usage is on.
    const notInUse = info.isUsingOverage === false && info.overageInUse !== true && info.rateLimitType !== 'overage';
    if (quota.paidUsage === 'unknown' && notInUse && this.last(accountId)?.paidUsage === 'in_use') {
      quota = { ...quota, paidUsage: 'enabled' };
    }
    return this.update(accountId, quota);
  }

  /** A usage-transition notice: the work draws on paid usage now. */
  paidUsageInUse(accountId: string | null): VendorQuota {
    return this.update(accountId, {
      state: 'unknown',
      resetsAt: null,
      windows: { fiveHour: null, weekly: null },
      paidUsage: 'in_use',
      updatedAt: this.now(),
    });
  }
}

/**
 * The reset time a report without one keeps from the last quota. A reset time belongs to its state: an exhausted report
 * without one is exhausted with resetsAt null (8.3), and a state change leaves it unknown. Only an unknown report, or
 * an ok one after ok, keeps the last reset, and only while it is still ahead.
 */
function carriedReset(previous: VendorQuota, quota: VendorQuota): number | null {
  const keeps = quota.state === 'unknown' || (quota.state === 'ok' && previous.state === 'ok');
  return keeps && previous.resetsAt !== null && previous.resetsAt > quota.updatedAt ? previous.resetsAt : null;
}

/** The untyped unifiedWindows of 2.1.285: five_hour, seven_day and seven_day_overage_included, each 0..1. */
function unifiedWindows(value: unknown): VendorQuota['windows'] {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return { fiveHour: null, weekly: null };
  const utilization = (key: string) => {
    const window = value[key];
    return isRecord(window) ? fraction(window.utilization) : null;
  };
  const weekly = [utilization('seven_day'), utilization('seven_day_overage_included')].filter((u) => u !== null);
  return { fiveHour: utilization('five_hour'), weekly: weekly.length > 0 ? Math.max(...weekly) : null };
}

interface UsageWindow {
  utilization: number | null;
  resetsAt: number | null;
}

/** A usage-call window: null when absent, undefined when its shape is not the pinned one. */
function usageWindow(value: unknown): UsageWindow | null | undefined {
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return null;
  if (!isRecord(value)) return undefined;
  const { utilization, resets_at } = value;
  if (utilization !== null && utilization !== undefined && typeof utilization !== 'number') return undefined;
  if (resets_at !== null && resets_at !== undefined && typeof resets_at !== 'string') return undefined;
  const resetsAt = typeof resets_at === 'string' ? Date.parse(resets_at) : null;
  if (Number.isNaN(resetsAt)) return undefined;
  return { utilization: typeof utilization === 'number' ? fraction(utilization / 100) : null, resetsAt };
}

/** 0..1, or null for anything that is not a finite number. */
function fraction(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) return null;
  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value));
}

// Below this an epoch value is in seconds: 1e11 seconds is the year 5138, 1e11 ms early 1973.
const SECONDS_BELOW = 1e11;

/** Epoch ms from the CLI's epoch seconds (or ms), or null. */
function epochMs(value: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return null;
  return Math.round(value < SECONDS_BELOW ? value * 1000 : value);
}
```

`terminal_reason` `blocking_limit` and `rapid_refill_breaker` are context-window stops in 2.1.285, not limit hits, so they give `context` (see Decisions). A refusal counts as failed even when `is_error` is false, so `policy` reaches the controller.

### Task 14: Event mapping: session, turns, tools and terminal bridge tools

`ClaudeEventMapper`, the first half of section 8.3's table: `started` from the first `system/init`, turns (a content frame while idle starts one, the result ends it), main-thread tool calls with their clipped input and Bash command for the stall facts (6.8), text, and terminal bridge tools. A call counts as denied from `non_execution_kind` (except the runner's own interrupt, `user-rejected`), a `permission_denied` frame or `result.permission_denials`, and calls still in flight end with the result. A terminal tool counts only on a normal result, and an `mcp__agflow__*` error result that carries `BRIDGE_ANSWERS.hubUnreachable` sets `hubUnreachable` (X-19). Sub-agent frames give neither tools nor text.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/events.ts`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/events.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { BRIDGE_ANSWERS } from '@agflow/core';
import { loadRecording } from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import { CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_MAX, ClaudeEventMapper } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/events';
import type { AgentEvent } from '../../../src/adapters/types';

type Frame = Record<string, unknown>;

/** The frames a recording printed in its turns, placeholders left as they are. */
function recordedFrames(scenario: string): Frame[] {
  return loadRecording(scenario)
    .turns.flat()
    .flatMap((step) => ('frame' in step ? [structuredClone(step.frame)] : []));
}

function mapAll(mapper: ClaudeEventMapper, frames: unknown[]): AgentEvent[] {
  return frames.flatMap((frame) => mapper.map(frame));
}

const init = (fields: Frame = {}): Frame => ({
  type: 'system',
  subtype: 'init',
  session_id: 'session-1',
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
  claude_code_version: '2.1.285',
  permissionMode: 'acceptEdits',
  tools: ['Bash'],
  ...fields,
});

const assistant = (content: Frame[], fields: Frame = {}): Frame => ({
  type: 'assistant',
  message: { role: 'assistant', content },
  parent_tool_use_id: null,
  session_id: 'session-1',
  ...fields,
});

const toolUse = (id: string, name: string, input: Frame = {}): Frame => ({ type: 'tool_use', id, name, input });

const toolResult = (id: string, content: unknown, isError = false, fields: Frame = {}): Frame => ({
  type: 'user',
  message: { role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'tool_result', tool_use_id: id, content, is_error: isError }] },
  parent_tool_use_id: null,
  session_id: 'session-1',
  ...fields,
});

const result = (fields: Frame = {}): Frame => ({
  type: 'result',
  subtype: 'success',
  is_error: false,
  result: 'Done.',
  stop_reason: 'end_turn',
  terminal_reason: 'completed',
  session_id: 'session-1',
  num_turns: 1,
  duration_ms: 1,
  duration_api_ms: 1,
  total_cost_usd: 0,
  usage: { input_tokens: 10, output_tokens: 1, cache_creation_input_tokens: 0, cache_read_input_tokens: 0 },
  modelUsage: {},
  permission_denials: [],
  ...fields,
});

type ToolEnded = Extract<AgentEvent, { type: 'tool_ended' }>;

/** A tool_ended: by default ok, not denied, not terminal, the hub reachable. */
const ended = (toolId: string, fields: Partial<ToolEnded> = {}): ToolEnded => ({
  type: 'tool_ended',
  toolId,
  ok: true,
  denied: false,
  terminal: null,
  hubUnreachable: false,
  ...fields,
});

const toolEnded = (events: AgentEvent[]) =>
  events.filter((event): event is ToolEnded => event.type === 'tool_ended');

describe('ClaudeEventMapper: session and turns', () => {

    expect(events.filter((event) => event.type === 'turn_started')).toHaveLength(1);
    // The next turn's init repeats the session facts; only the first one gives started.

    const next = mapAll(mapper, [init({ session_id: '$SESSION' }), hello, result()]);
    expect(next).toEqual([

  test("an aborted turn is interrupted only while the runner's interrupt is pending", () => {
    const frames = recordedFrames('interrupt');
    const plain = mapAll(new ClaudeEventMapper(), frames).at(-1);
    expect(plain).toMatchObject({ type: 'turn_ended', outcome: 'failed', toolCalls: 1 });

    const mapper = new ClaudeEventMapper();
    const events: AgentEvent[] = [];
    for (const frame of frames) {

    idle.interruptRequested();
    expect(mapAll(idle, [init(), aborted]).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ type: 'turn_ended', outcome: 'failed' });

    // Input the caller says it sent is a turn about to run.
    const starting = new ClaudeEventMapper();
    starting.interruptRequested({ starting: true });
    expect(mapAll(starting, [init(), aborted]).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ type: 'turn_ended', outcome: 'interrupted' });

    expect(events.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ type: 'turn_ended', outcome: 'failed', errorKind: 'vendor' });
  });

        toolUse('toolu_b', 'Bash', { command: 42 }),

    expect(write.input.startsWith('{"file_path":"/clone/a.txt","content":"xxx')).toBe(true);
    expect(write.input.endsWith('…')).toBe(true);
    expect(write.command).toBeNull();

      }),

      ended('toolu_1', { ok: false, denied: true }),
      ended('toolu_2', { ok: false, denied: true }),

    expect(events.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ type: 'turn_ended', toolCalls: 2 });

    const events = mapAll(new ClaudeEventMapper(), [

    ]);
  });

    for (const name of ['mcp__agflow__report_progress', 'submit', 'mcp__other__submit', 'mcp__agflow__submit_x']) {
      const events = mapAll(new ClaudeEventMapper(), [

  test("an agflow error result with the hub-unreachable text sets hubUnreachable; nothing else does", () => {
    const cases: [string, unknown, boolean, boolean][] = [
      ['mcp__agflow__get_task', [{ type: 'text', text: BRIDGE_ANSWERS.hubUnreachable }], true, true],
      ['mcp__agflow__submit', BRIDGE_ANSWERS.hubUnreachable, true, true],
      // A normal result, another server or another refusal is not the bridge saying the hub is unreachable.
      ['mcp__agflow__get_task', BRIDGE_ANSWERS.hubUnreachable, false, false],
      ['mcp__other__get_task', BRIDGE_ANSWERS.hubUnreachable, true, false],
      ['Bash', BRIDGE_ANSWERS.hubUnreachable, true, false],
      ['mcp__agflow__submit', BRIDGE_ANSWERS.attemptEnded('stopped'), true, false],

    for (const [name, content, isError, hubUnreachable] of cases) {

        toolResult('toolu_t', content, isError),

      expect(toolEnded(events)[0]).toMatchObject({ terminal: null, hubUnreachable });

  });
});
```

```ts
// A Claude session's stream as AgentEvents (design 8.3, 6.8, 10, 13): session facts, turns, the main thread's tools
// with what stall detection needs, text, and the bridge's terminal tools and hub-unreachable answers. Frames arrive
// as the SDK yields them, some untyped (non_execution_kind), so every field is read defensively and anything
// unknown is ignored.
import { BRIDGE_ANSWERS } from '@agflow/core';
import type { SDKAssistantMessageError, SDKResultMessage } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { clip } from '../../attempt/pump';
import type { AgentEvent, TerminalTool } from '../types';
import { isRecord } from './json';
import { classifyResult } from './outcome';

/** The longest tool input a tool_started carries, as JSON: enough to tell repeated calls apart (6.8). */
export const CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_MAX = 4_000;

const BRIDGE_TOOL_PREFIX = 'mcp__agflow__';

/** The bridge tools whose normal result ends or hands over the work (design 10). */
const TERMINAL_TOOLS: Readonly<Record<string, TerminalTool>> = Object.freeze({
  submit: 'submit',
  declare_blocked: 'blocked',
  declare_impossible: 'impossible',
  release_task: 'released',
  write_handoff: 'handoff',
});

type Json = Record<string, unknown>;

/** Maps one session's frames, in order, to the events they give. */
export class ClaudeEventMapper {
  private started = false;
  private inTurn = false;
  private toolCalls = 0;
  private interruptPending = false;
  private assistantError: SDKAssistantMessageError | null = null;
  /** The main thread's calls without a tool_result yet, by tool_use id. */
  private readonly tools = new Map<string, string>();
  /** Calls a system/permission_denied frame named before their tool_result. */
  private readonly deniedCalls = new Set<string>();

  /**
   * The runner interrupted the running turn: the error_during_execution result that follows is an interrupt, not a
   * crash (8.3). The flag ends with the next result. The CLI ignores an interrupt while idle, so one counts only while
   * a turn runs or is about to: `starting` when the caller sent input no frame has answered yet.
   */
  interruptRequested(options: { starting?: boolean } = {}): void {
    if (this.inTurn || options.starting === true) this.interruptPending = true;
  }

  /** The events one frame gives; none for a frame of an unknown type or shape. */
  map(frame: unknown): AgentEvent[] {
    if (!isRecord(frame)) return [];
    const events: AgentEvent[] = [];
    switch (frame.type) {
      case 'system':
        if (frame.subtype === 'init') this.init(frame, events);
        else if (frame.subtype === 'permission_denied' && typeof frame.tool_use_id === 'string') {
          this.deniedCalls.add(frame.tool_use_id);
        }
        break;
      case 'assistant':
        this.assistant(frame, events);
        break;
      case 'user':
        this.user(frame, events);
        break;
      case 'result':
        this.result(frame, events);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
    return events;
  }

  private turnStarts(events: AgentEvent[]): void {
    if (this.inTurn) return;
    this.inTurn = true;
    this.toolCalls = 0;
    this.assistantError = null;
    events.push({ type: 'turn_started' });
  }

  /** system/init comes again for every user message; the first one names the session. */
  private init(frame: Json, events: AgentEvent[]): void {
    if (!this.started) {
      this.started = true;
      events.push({
        type: 'started',
        sessionRef: text(frame.session_id),
        model: text(frame.model),
        cliVersion: text(frame.claude_code_version),
        permissionMode: typeof frame.permissionMode === 'string' ? frame.permissionMode : null,
      });
    }
    this.turnStarts(events);
  }

  private assistant(frame: Json, events: AgentEvent[]): void {
    this.turnStarts(events);
    // A sub-agent's frames: its calls are its own, inside the Task call in flight.
    if (frame.parent_tool_use_id !== null && frame.parent_tool_use_id !== undefined) return;
    const message = frame.message;
    if (!isRecord(message) || !Array.isArray(message.content)) return;
    this.assistantError = typeof frame.error === 'string' ? (frame.error as SDKAssistantMessageError) : null;
    for (const block of message.content) {
      if (!isRecord(block)) continue;
      if (block.type === 'text' && typeof block.text === 'string' && block.text !== '') {
        events.push({ type: 'text', text: block.text });
      } else if (block.type === 'tool_use' && typeof block.id === 'string' && typeof block.name === 'string') {
        this.toolCalls += 1;
        this.tools.set(block.id, block.name);
        const input = isRecord(block.input) ? block.input : {};
        events.push({
          type: 'tool_started',
          toolId: block.id,
          name: block.name,
          input: clip(JSON.stringify(input), CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_MAX),
          command: block.name === 'Bash' && typeof input.command === 'string' ? input.command : null,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  private user(frame: Json, events: AgentEvent[]): void {
    this.turnStarts(events);
    if (frame.parent_tool_use_id !== null && frame.parent_tool_use_id !== undefined) return;
    const message = frame.message;
    if (!isRecord(message) || !Array.isArray(message.content)) return;
    const marked = refusedCalls(frame.tool_result_meta);
    for (const block of message.content) {
      if (!isRecord(block) || block.type !== 'tool_result' || typeof block.tool_use_id !== 'string') continue;
      const id = block.tool_use_id;
      const name = this.tools.get(id);
      if (name === undefined) continue;
      this.tools.delete(id);
      const failed = block.is_error === true;
      const announced = this.deniedCalls.delete(id);
      const bridge = name.startsWith(BRIDGE_TOOL_PREFIX) ? name.slice(BRIDGE_TOOL_PREFIX.length) : null;
      events.push({
        type: 'tool_ended',
        toolId: id,
        ok: !failed,
        denied: marked.has(id) || announced,
        // Refusals are error results; only a normal result ends the work (design 10, X-19).
        terminal: bridge !== null && !failed ? (TERMINAL_TOOLS[bridge] ?? null) : null,
        hubUnreachable: bridge !== null && failed && resultText(block.content).includes(BRIDGE_ANSWERS.hubUnreachable),
      });
    }
  }

  private result(frame: Json, events: AgentEvent[]): void {
    this.turnStarts(events);
    // Calls the turn left unanswered (an interrupt, a denial without a tool_result) end with it.
    const denials = new Set(
      (Array.isArray(frame.permission_denials) ? frame.permission_denials : []).flatMap((denial) =>
        isRecord(denial) && typeof denial.tool_use_id === 'string' ? [denial.tool_use_id] : [],
      ),
    );
    for (const id of this.tools.keys()) {
      events.push({
        type: 'tool_ended',
        toolId: id,
        ok: false,
        denied: denials.has(id) || this.deniedCalls.has(id),
        terminal: null,
        hubUnreachable: false,
      });
    }
    this.tools.clear();
    this.deniedCalls.clear();
    const classified = classifyResult(asResult(frame), {
      interruptPending: this.interruptPending,
      assistantError: this.assistantError,
    });
    events.push({ type: 'turn_ended', ...classified, toolCalls: this.toolCalls });
    this.inTurn = false;
    this.interruptPending = false;
  }
}

/** A result frame with the fields classifyResult reads made safe: errors a list, result a string. */
function asResult(frame: Json): SDKResultMessage {
  return {
    ...frame,
    result: typeof frame.result === 'string' ? frame.result : '',
    errors: Array.isArray(frame.errors) ? frame.errors.filter((error) => typeof error === 'string') : [],
  } as unknown as SDKResultMessage;
}

// The runner's own interrupt rejects the call in flight; that is no denial.
const NOT_DENIALS = new Set(['user-rejected']);

/** The ids 2.1.285's untyped tool_result_meta marks as refused: never executed, for any reason but an interrupt. */
function refusedCalls(meta: unknown): Set<string> {
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  if (!Array.isArray(meta)) return ids;
  for (const entry of meta) {
    const kind = isRecord(entry) ? entry.non_execution_kind : undefined;
    if (isRecord(entry) && typeof entry.id === 'string' && typeof kind === 'string' && !NOT_DENIALS.has(kind)) {
      ids.add(entry.id);
    }
  }
  return ids;
}

/** A tool_result's text: a string, or its text blocks joined. */
function resultText(content: unknown): string {
  if (typeof content === 'string') return content;
  if (!Array.isArray(content)) return '';
  return content
    .flatMap((block) => (isRecord(block) && block.type === 'text' && typeof block.text === 'string' ? block.text : []))
    .join('\n');
}

function text(value: unknown): string {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : '';
}
```

### Task 15: Event mapping: deliveries, quota, retries, sub-agents and context

The second half of the mapper (design 8.3, 6.7, 6.10). A registered message is `delivered` when its `command_lifecycle` reaches `started` and `acknowledged` once per uuid in `result.user_message_uuids`. Quota comes from `rate_limit_event` and from the CLI's usage-transition notices, accepted only from system notifications or `<synthetic>` assistant text, never from text the model wrote. `system/api_retry` is a warning, and with a 429 it re-reports the last quota with `exhausted` as `unknown`, never a limit hit. Sub-agent tasks are tools in flight (`task:<id>`), and `contextUsed` is the last main-thread request's prompt tokens over the model's window; the untyped frames are parsed defensively in the shapes the recorder captured.

- Modify: `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/events.ts`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/events-signals.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import type { VendorQuota } from '@agflow/core';
import { loadRecording } from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import { ClaudeEventMapper } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/events';
import { QuotaBook } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/quota';
import type { AgentEvent } from '../../../src/adapters/types';

type Frame = Record<string, unknown>;

const NOW = 1_800_000_000_000;
const ACCOUNT = 'acct-1';

function recordedFrames(scenario: string): Frame[] {
  return loadRecording(scenario)
    .turns.flat()
    .flatMap((step) => ('frame' in step ? [structuredClone(step.frame)] : []));
}

function mapper(options: { quota?: QuotaBook; accountId?: string | null } = {}): ClaudeEventMapper {
  return new ClaudeEventMapper({ accountId: ACCOUNT, quota: new QuotaBook(() => NOW), ...options });
}

const mapAll = (events: ClaudeEventMapper, frames: unknown[]): AgentEvent[] =>
  frames.flatMap((frame) => events.map(frame));

const of = <T extends AgentEvent['type']>(events: AgentEvent[], type: T) =>
  events.filter((event): event is Extract<AgentEvent, { type: T }> => event.type === type);

const init = (fields: Frame = {}): Frame => ({
  type: 'system',
  subtype: 'init',
  session_id: 'session-1',
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
  claude_code_version: '2.1.285',
  permissionMode: 'acceptEdits',
  ...fields,
});

const result = (fields: Frame = {}): Frame => ({
  type: 'result',
  subtype: 'success',
  is_error: false,
  result: 'Done.',
  stop_reason: 'end_turn',
  terminal_reason: 'completed',
  session_id: 'session-1',
  usage: { input_tokens: 10, output_tokens: 1, cache_creation_input_tokens: 0, cache_read_input_tokens: 0 },
  modelUsage: {},
  permission_denials: [],
  ...fields,
});

const assistant = (content: Frame[], fields: Frame = {}, message: Frame = {}): Frame => ({
  type: 'assistant',
  message: { role: 'assistant', model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', content, ...message },
  parent_tool_use_id: null,
  session_id: 'session-1',
  ...fields,
});

const lifecycle = (uuid: unknown, state: unknown): Frame => ({
  type: 'command_lifecycle',
  command_uuid: uuid,
  state,
  uuid: 'frame-uuid',
  session_id: 'session-1',
});

describe('ClaudeEventMapper: deliveries and acknowledgements', () => {
  test('a message folded in at a tool boundary is delivered when it starts and acknowledged by the result', () => {
    const events = mapper();
    // The recording's message uuids, as the session would have sent them.
    events.messageSent('$USER_UUID_1', 'runner-1');
    events.messageSent('$USER_UUID_2', 'runner-2');
    const mapped = mapAll(events, recordedFrames('turn-delivery'));
    const messages = mapped.filter((event) => event.type === 'delivered' || event.type === 'acknowledged');
    expect(messages).toEqual([
      { type: 'delivered', id: 'runner-1' },
      { type: 'delivered', id: 'runner-2' },
      { type: 'acknowledged', id: 'runner-1' },
      { type: 'acknowledged', id: 'runner-2' },
    ]);
    // The second delivery came mid-turn, between the tool call and its end.
    const types = mapped.map((event) => event.type);
    expect(types.indexOf('tool_started')).toBeLessThan(types.lastIndexOf('delivered'));
    expect(types.at(-1)).toBe('turn_ended');
  });

  test('each message is delivered and acknowledged once; an acknowledgement implies the delivery', () => {
    const events = mapper();
    events.messageSent('u-1', 'm-1');
    events.messageSent('u-2', 'm-2');
    const mapped = mapAll(events, [
      lifecycle('u-1', 'queued'),
      lifecycle('u-1', 'started'),
      lifecycle('u-1', 'started'),
      init(),
      result({ user_message_uuids: ['u-1', 'u-2', 'u-1'] }),
      init(),
      result({ user_message_uuids: ['u-1', 'u-2'] }),
    ]);
    expect(mapped.filter((event) => event.type === 'delivered' || event.type === 'acknowledged')).toEqual([
      { type: 'delivered', id: 'm-1' },
      { type: 'acknowledged', id: 'm-1' },
      { type: 'delivered', id: 'm-2' },
      { type: 'acknowledged', id: 'm-2' },
    ]);
  });

  test('unknown uuids, cancelled messages and malformed lifecycle frames give nothing', () => {
    const events = mapper();
    events.messageSent('u-1', 'm-1');
    events.messageSent('u-2', 'm-2');
    const mapped = mapAll(events, [
      lifecycle('someone-else', 'started'),
      lifecycle(42, 'started'),
      lifecycle('u-1', 7),
      lifecycle('u-1', 'something_new'),
      { type: 'command_lifecycle' },
      // A stop's interrupt cancels a queued message; it never runs.
      lifecycle('u-2', 'queued'),
      lifecycle('u-2', 'cancelled'),
      init(),
      result({ user_message_uuids: ['someone-else', 'u-2', 3] }),
      result({ user_message_uuids: 'u-1' }),
    ]);
    expect(mapped.filter((event) => event.type === 'delivered' || event.type === 'acknowledged')).toEqual([]);
    // Lifecycle frames start no turn.
    expect(mapAll(mapper(), [lifecycle('u-1', 'started')])).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('ClaudeEventMapper: interrupts before a sent message starts', () => {
  test('a message sent and not yet delivered is a turn about to run; once delivered it is not', () => {
    const aborted = result({ subtype: 'error_during_execution', is_error: true, errors: [], terminal_reason: null });
    const queued = mapper();
    queued.messageSent('u-1', 'm-1');
    queued.interruptRequested();
    expect(mapAll(queued, [init(), aborted]).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ type: 'turn_ended', outcome: 'interrupted' });

    const delivered = mapper();
    delivered.messageSent('u-1', 'm-1');
    mapAll(delivered, [lifecycle('u-1', 'started'), init(), result({ user_message_uuids: ['u-1'] })]);
    delivered.interruptRequested();
    expect(mapAll(delivered, [init(), aborted]).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ type: 'turn_ended', outcome: 'failed' });
  });
});

describe('ClaudeEventMapper: quota', () => {
  const info = {
    status: 'allowed_warning',
    resetsAt: 1_800_003_600,
    rateLimitType: 'five_hour',
    utilization: 0.8,
    overageStatus: 'allowed',
  };

  test("rate_limit_event gives quota with the session's accountId, merged with the last one", () => {
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => NOW);
    const events = mapper({ quota: book });
    const [first] = events.map({ type: 'rate_limit_event', rate_limit_info: info, uuid: 'u', session_id: 's' });
    expect(first).toEqual({
      type: 'quota',
      accountId: ACCOUNT,
      quota: {
        state: 'ok',
        resetsAt: 1_800_003_600_000,
        windows: { fiveHour: 0.8, weekly: null },
        paidUsage: 'enabled',
        updatedAt: NOW,
      },
    });
    const weekly = { status: 'allowed', rateLimitType: 'seven_day', utilization: 0.3 };
    const [second] = events.map({ type: 'rate_limit_event', rate_limit_info: weekly });
    expect(second).toMatchObject({ quota: { windows: { fiveHour: 0.8, weekly: 0.3 }, paidUsage: 'enabled' } });
    expect(book.last(ACCOUNT)).toEqual((second as Extract<AgentEvent, { type: 'quota' }>).quota);
    // A malformed event gives nothing.
    expect(mapAll(events, [{ type: 'rate_limit_event' }, { type: 'rate_limit_event', rate_limit_info: {} }])).toEqual(
      [],
    );
  });

  test('fields of an unexpected type are unknown, not an error', () => {
    const events = mapper();
    const odd = { status: 'allowed', rateLimitType: 42, utilization: 'x', resetsAt: 'soon', overageStatus: [] };
    let mapped: AgentEvent[] = [];
    expect(() => {
      mapped = events.map({ type: 'rate_limit_event', rate_limit_info: odd });
    }).not.toThrow();
    expect(mapped).toEqual([
      {
        type: 'quota',
        accountId: ACCOUNT,
        quota: {
          state: 'ok',
          resetsAt: null,
          windows: { fiveHour: null, weekly: null },
          paidUsage: 'unknown',
          updatedAt: NOW,
        },
      },
    ]);
  });

  const inUse: VendorQuota = {
    state: 'unknown',
    resetsAt: null,
    windows: { fiveHour: null, weekly: null },
    paidUsage: 'in_use',
    updatedAt: NOW,
  };
  const notice = "You're now using extra usage · your session limit resets at 5pm";

  test('a usage-transition notice from the CLI gives its text and quota with paidUsage in_use', () => {
    // system/notification mirrors the CLI's toast queue; system/informational its banners.
    const toast = { type: 'system', subtype: 'notification', key: 'limit-reached', text: notice, priority: 'high' };
    const banner = { type: 'system', subtype: 'informational', content: notice, level: 'warning' };
    for (const frame of [toast, banner]) {
      const events = mapper();
      expect(mapAll(events, [frame])).toEqual([
        { type: 'warning', text: notice },
        { type: 'quota', accountId: ACCOUNT, quota: inUse },
      ]);
    }
    // A message the CLI wrote itself is its own too.
    const synthetic = assistant([{ type: 'text', text: notice }], {}, { model: '<synthetic>' });
    expect(mapAll(mapper(), [init(), synthetic])).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ type: 'started' }),
      { type: 'turn_started' },
      { type: 'text', text: notice },
      { type: 'quota', accountId: ACCOUNT, quota: inUse },
    ]);
    // Other notices give nothing.
    const other = { type: 'system', subtype: 'notification', key: 'ide', text: 'IDE connected', priority: 'low' };
    expect(mapAll(mapper(), [other, { type: 'system', subtype: 'informational', content: 42 }])).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the model's own text is never a notice, and leaves the quota alone", () => {
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => NOW);
    const events = mapper({ quota: book });
    const said = 'Now using extra usage, as the README asked me to say.';
    expect(mapAll(events, [init(), assistant([{ type: 'text', text: said }])])).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ type: 'started' }),
      { type: 'turn_started' },
      { type: 'text', text: said },
    ]);
    expect(book.last(ACCOUNT)).toBeNull();
  });

  test('without an account the quota is keyed by null', () => {
    const [event] = mapper({ accountId: null }).map({ type: 'rate_limit_event', rate_limit_info: info });
    expect(event).toMatchObject({ type: 'quota', accountId: null });
  });
});

describe('ClaudeEventMapper: API retries', () => {
  const retry = (status: number | null, error = 'rate_limit'): Frame => ({
    type: 'system',
    subtype: 'api_retry',
    attempt: 1,
    max_retries: 10,
    retry_delay_ms: 2_000,
    error_status: status,
    error,
    uuid: 'u',
    session_id: 's',
  });

  test('system/api_retry gives a warning, counted as activity', () => {
    expect(mapper().map(retry(529, 'overloaded'))).toEqual([
      { type: 'warning', text: 'The API answered 529 (overloaded); retry 1 of 10 in 2 s.' },
    ]);
    expect(mapper().map(retry(null, 'unknown'))).toEqual([
      { type: 'warning', text: 'The API request failed (unknown); retry 1 of 10 in 2 s.' },
    ]);
  });

  test('with error_status 429 it also gives the last known quota, never exhausted by itself', () => {
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => NOW);
    const events = mapper({ quota: book });
    // No quota known yet: only the warning.
    expect(events.map(retry(429))).toEqual([
      { type: 'warning', text: 'The API answered 429 (rate_limit); retry 1 of 10 in 2 s.' },
    ]);
    const known: VendorQuota = {
      state: 'ok',
      resetsAt: null,
      windows: { fiveHour: 0.95, weekly: 0.4 },
      paidUsage: 'disabled',
      updatedAt: NOW - 60_000,
    };
    book.update(ACCOUNT, known);
    const mapped = events.map(retry(429));
    expect(mapped).toEqual([
      { type: 'warning', text: 'The API answered 429 (rate_limit); retry 1 of 10 in 2 s.' },
      { type: 'quota', accountId: ACCOUNT, quota: known },
    ]);
    expect(book.last(ACCOUNT)?.state).toBe('ok');
    expect(of(mapAll(events, [retry(500), retry(529)]), 'quota')).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('an exhaustion or paid usage the book still holds is reported as unknown, never as a limit hit', () => {
    const book = new QuotaBook(() => NOW);
    const events = mapper({ quota: book });
    const windows = { fiveHour: 1, weekly: 0.5 };
    book.update(ACCOUNT, { state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: NOW - 1, windows, paidUsage: 'disabled', updatedAt: NOW });
    expect(of(events.map(retry(429)), 'quota')).toEqual([
      {
        type: 'quota',
        accountId: ACCOUNT,
        quota: { state: 'unknown', resetsAt: NOW - 1, windows, paidUsage: 'disabled', updatedAt: NOW },
      },
    ]);
    book.update(ACCOUNT, { state: 'ok', resetsAt: null, windows, paidUsage: 'in_use', updatedAt: NOW });
    const [quota] = of(events.map(retry(429)), 'quota');
    expect(quota?.quota).toMatchObject({ state: 'ok', windows, paidUsage: 'unknown' });
    // The book keeps what it knew.
    expect(book.last(ACCOUNT)?.paidUsage).toBe('in_use');
  });
});

describe('ClaudeEventMapper: sub-agents', () => {
  test('system/task_started and task_notification give a tool in flight that starts and ends', () => {
    const events = mapper();
    const mapped = mapAll(events, [
      init(),
      {
        type: 'system',
        subtype: 'task_started',
        task_id: 'task-1',
        tool_use_id: 'toolu_task',
        description: 'Survey the tests',
        subagent_type: 'general-purpose',
        task_type: 'local_agent',
      },
      result(),
      // A backgrounded task outlives the turn that started it.
      { type: 'system', subtype: 'task_notification', task_id: 'task-1', status: 'completed', summary: 'done' },
      { type: 'system', subtype: 'task_started', task_id: 'task-2', description: 'Watch the build' },
      { type: 'system', subtype: 'task_notification', task_id: 'task-2', status: 'failed', summary: 'broke' },
    ]);
    expect(mapped.filter((event) => event.type === 'tool_started' || event.type === 'tool_ended')).toEqual([
      { type: 'tool_started', toolId: 'task:task-1', name: 'Task', input: 'Survey the tests', command: null },
      { type: 'tool_ended', toolId: 'task:task-1', ok: true, denied: false, terminal: null, hubUnreachable: false },
      { type: 'tool_started', toolId: 'task:task-2', name: 'Task', input: 'Watch the build', command: null },
      { type: 'tool_ended', toolId: 'task:task-2', ok: false, denied: false, terminal: null, hubUnreachable: false },
    ]);
  });

  test('a foreground task runs inside its Task call: one tool in flight, not two', () => {
    const events = mapper();
    const task = (status: string): Frame[] => [
      assistant([{ type: 'tool_use', id: 'toolu_t', name: 'Task', input: { description: 'Survey', prompt: 'Go' } }]),
      {
        type: 'system',
        subtype: 'task_started',
        task_id: `task-${status}`,
        tool_use_id: 'toolu_t',
        description: 'Survey',
        is_backgrounded: false,
      },
      { type: 'system', subtype: 'task_notification', task_id: `task-${status}`, status },
      {
        type: 'user',
        message: { role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'tool_result', tool_use_id: 'toolu_t', content: 'done' }] },
        parent_tool_use_id: null,
      },
    ];
    const mapped = mapAll(events, [init(), ...task('completed'), ...task('failed')]);
    expect(mapped.filter((event) => event.type === 'tool_started' || event.type === 'tool_ended')).toEqual([
      { type: 'tool_started', toolId: 'toolu_t', name: 'Task', input: expect.any(String), command: null },
      { type: 'tool_ended', toolId: 'toolu_t', ok: true, denied: false, terminal: null, hubUnreachable: false },
      { type: 'tool_started', toolId: 'toolu_t', name: 'Task', input: expect.any(String), command: null },

    ]);
  });
```
