```ts
      { type: 'tool_started', toolId: 'toolu_t', name: 'Task', input: '{}', command: null },
      { type: 'tool_started', toolId: 'task:task-1', name: 'Task', input: '', command: null },

      { type: 'tool_ended', toolId: 'task:task-1', ok: true, denied: false, terminal: null, hubUnreachable: false },

  });

    const mapped = mapAll(mapper(), [

      { type: 'system', subtype: 'task_notification', task_id: 'quiet', status: 'completed' },

      { type: 'system', subtype: 'task_started', description: 'no id' },
      { type: 'system', subtype: 'task_notification', task_id: 'task-1' },

  });
});

describe('ClaudeEventMapper: context', () => {
  const usage = (input: number, creation = 0, read = 0): Frame => ({
    input_tokens: input,
    output_tokens: 5,
    cache_creation_input_tokens: creation,
    cache_read_input_tokens: read,
  });
  const window = { 'claude-sonnet-5-5': { contextWindow: 1_000_000 } };
  const said = (tokens: Frame, fields: Frame = {}, message: Frame = {}) =>
    assistant([{ type: 'text', text: 'Working.' }], fields, { usage: tokens, ...message });

  test("the turn's last request over the model's context window gives context, before turn_ended", () => {
    const mapped = mapAll(mapper(), [
      init(),
      said(usage(20_000, 30_000, 50_000)),
      result({
        usage: usage(20_000, 30_000, 50_000),
        modelUsage: {
          'claude-haiku-4-5': { contextWindow: 10 },
          'claude-sonnet-5-5': { inputTokens: 20_000, contextWindow: 1_000_000 },
        },
      }),
    ]);
    expect(of(mapped, 'context')).toEqual([{ type: 'context', used: 0.1 }]);
    expect(mapped.at(-2)).toEqual({ type: 'context', used: 0.1 });
    expect(mapped.at(-1)?.type).toBe('turn_ended');
  });

  test("the result's usage sums every request of the turn, so only the last one counts", () => {
    const requests = [100_000, 200_000, 250_000, 300_000].map((read) => said(usage(1_000, 0, read - 1_000)));
    const mapped = mapAll(mapper(), [
      init(),
      ...requests,
      // A sub-agent's request and a synthetic error message (no request) change nothing.
      said(usage(900_000), { parent_tool_use_id: 'toolu_task' }),
      said(usage(0), {}, { model: '<synthetic>' }),
      result({ usage: usage(4_000, 0, 846_000), modelUsage: window }),
    ]);
    expect(of(mapped, 'context')).toEqual([{ type: 'context', used: 0.3 }]);
  });

  test('the recorded turn gives its share; a turn without a request or the window gives none', () => {
    const recorded = mapAll(mapper(), recordedFrames('turn-basic'));
    // Each of the five requests had 100 input tokens (the result sums them to 500), over the recorded
    // 1,000,000-token window; the frames name the model $MODEL.
    expect(of(recorded, 'context')).toEqual([{ type: 'context', used: 0.0001 }]);
    for (const modelUsage of [{}, { 'claude-sonnet-5-5': {} }, { 'claude-sonnet-5-5': { contextWindow: 0 } }, null]) {
      expect(of(mapAll(mapper(), [init(), said(usage(10)), result({ modelUsage })]), 'context')).toEqual([]);
    }
    // No request in the turn, or one without usage: unknown.
    expect(of(mapAll(mapper(), [init(), result({ modelUsage: window })]), 'context')).toEqual([]);
    const noUsage = assistant([{ type: 'text', text: 'Hi.' }]);
    expect(of(mapAll(mapper(), [init(), noUsage, result({ modelUsage: window })]), 'context')).toEqual([]);
    // The next turn starts counting again.
    const events = mapper();
    mapAll(events, [init(), said(usage(500_000)), result({ modelUsage: window })]);
    expect(of(mapAll(events, [init(), result({ modelUsage: window })]), 'context')).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

### Task 16: The detached spawn hook

`createDetachedSpawn` is the SDK's `spawnClaudeCodeProcess` hook (design 7.4, 8.2): `node:child_process.spawn` with `detached`, because the SDK needs a Node `ChildProcess`, so each claude leads its own session and process group. The process is registered (pid, pgid, lstart) before the hook returns, and a failed registration SIGKILLs the group. stderr goes into the attempt's log through M2b's `drainToLog` up to 10 MiB, with a 64 KiB tail kept for errors. The SDK's forwarded abort and its `kill()` after close()'s grace both reach the whole group through M2b's identity-checked `killGroup`. A real SDK `query()` through the fake CLI shows that Bun's `node:child_process` satisfies the SDK before the session is built on it.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/spawn.ts`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/spawn.test.ts`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/fixtures/claude/child.ts`

```ts
import {
  CLAUDE_STDERR_TAIL_CHARS,
  createDetachedSpawn,
  type DetachedSpawnInput,
  type SpawnedClaude,
} from '../../../src/adapters/claude/spawn';
import { listProcesses, processIdentity } from '../../../src/processes';

// macOS's first exec of a new script is slow.
const TIMEOUT = 30_000;
const CHILD = join(import.meta.dir, '..', '..', 'fixtures', 'claude', 'child.ts');

const dirs: string[] = [];
const groups = new Set<number>();
const children: SpawnedClaude[] = [];

afterEach(async () => {
  for (const pgid of groups) {
    try {
      process.kill(-pgid, 'SIGKILL');
    } catch {
      // Already gone.
    }
  }
  groups.clear();
  await Promise.all(children.splice(0).map((proc) => proc.exited));
  for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

function tempDir(): string {
  const dir = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-claude-spawn-')));
  dirs.push(dir);
  return dir;
}

/** Runs the child fixture in a mode through the hook, as the SDK would. */
function launch(mode: string, input: Partial<DetachedSpawnInput> = {}, options: Partial<SpawnOptions> = {}) {
  const dir = tempDir();
  const logFile = join(dir, 'attempt.log');
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const hook = createDetachedSpawn({
    logFile,
    ...input,
    registerProcess(pid) {
      groups.add(pid);
      input.registerProcess?.(pid);
    },
  });
  const proc = hook({
    command: process.execPath,
    args: [CHILD, mode],
    cwd: dir,
    env: {},
    signal: controller.signal,
    ...options,
  });
  children.push(proc);
  return { proc, controller, logFile };
}

function pidOf(proc: SpawnedClaude): number {
  if (proc.pid === undefined) throw new Error('the child did not start');
  return proc.pid;
}

async function readAll(stream: Readable): Promise<string> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  for await (const chunk of stream) chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
  return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
}

async function until(check: () => boolean | Promise<boolean>): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + 4_000;
  while (!(await check())) {
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error('timed out waiting for the child');
    await Bun.sleep(10);
  }
}

/** Resolves once the process is gone, or a zombie its parent has not reaped yet. */
async function gone(pid: number): Promise<void> {
  await until(async () => {
    const [row] = await listProcesses([pid]);
    return row === undefined || row.stat.startsWith('Z');
  });
}

/** Collects stdout as it comes; firstLine resolves once a whole line is there. */
function watchStdout(proc: SpawnedClaude): { firstLine(): Promise<string> } {
  let text = '';
  proc.stdout.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {
    text += chunk.toString('utf8');
  });
  return {
    firstLine: async () => {
      await until(() => text.includes('\n'));
      return text.slice(0, text.indexOf('\n'));
    },
  };
}

describe('the detached spawn hook', () => {
  test(
    'the child leads its own session and process group',
    async () => {
      const { proc } = launch('wait');
      expect(await watchStdout(proc).firstLine()).toBe('ready');
      expect((await processIdentity(pidOf(proc)))?.pgid).toBe(pidOf(proc));
      // ps marks a session leader with s.
      const [row] = await listProcesses([pidOf(proc)]);
      expect(row?.stat).toContain('s');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'registerProcess(pid) and onSpawn are called before the hook returns',
    async () => {
      const order: string[] = [];
      let registered: number | undefined;
      let watched: SpawnedClaude | undefined;
      const { proc } = launch('wait', {
        registerProcess(pid) {
          registered = pid;
          order.push('register');
        },
        onSpawn(child) {
          watched = child;
          order.push('onSpawn');
        },
      });
      order.push('returned');
      expect(order).toEqual(['register', 'onSpawn', 'returned']);
      expect(registered).toBe(pidOf(proc));
      expect(watched).toBe(proc);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'command, args, cwd and env are passed exactly',
    async () => {
      const cwd = tempDir();
      const args = [CHILD, 'inspect', 'two words', '$HOME', '', '雪'];
      const { proc } = launch(
        'inspect',
        {},
        { args, cwd, env: { AGFLOW_VALUE: 'two words', AGFLOW_EMPTY: '', AGFLOW_UNSET: undefined } },
      );
      expect(JSON.parse(await readAll(proc.stdout))).toEqual({
        executable: process.execPath,
        args: args.slice(1),
        cwd,
        // Nothing from the runner's own environment; an undefined value is left out.
        env: { AGFLOW_VALUE: 'two words', AGFLOW_EMPTY: '' },
      });
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: 0, signal: null });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'stderr goes to the log up to the bound and is then dropped with a marker; the last lines stay in memory',
    async () => {
      const { proc, logFile } = launch('stderr', { maxLogBytes: 1_000, tailLines: 3 });
      // Two megabytes of stderr do not block the child: it finishes.
      expect(await readAll(proc.stdout)).toBe('done\n');
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: 0, signal: null });
      await until(() => proc.stderrTail() === 'last α\nlast β\nlast γ');
      const expected = `${'x'.repeat(1_000)}\n[agflow: output truncated after 1000 bytes]\n`;
      await until(() => {
        try {
          return readFileSync(logFile, 'utf8') === expected;
        } catch {
          return false;
        }
      });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a stderr line that never ends keeps the tail within its budget of characters',
    async () => {
      const { proc } = launch('longline', { maxLogBytes: 1_000 });
      expect(await readAll(proc.stdout)).toBe('done\n');
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: 0, signal: null });
      await until(() => proc.stderrTail().endsWith('the end'));
      const tail = proc.stderrTail();
      expect(tail.length).toBe(CLAUDE_STDERR_TAIL_CHARS);
      expect(tail.endsWith('yyythe end')).toBe(true);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'without a log, stderr is still read to its end and the tail kept',
    async () => {
      const file = join(tempDir(), 'not-a-directory');
      writeFileSync(file, '');
      // Creating the log's directory fails with ENOTDIR.
      const { proc } = launch('stderr', { logFile: join(file, 'attempt.log'), tailLines: 3 });
      expect(await readAll(proc.stdout)).toBe('done\n');
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: 0, signal: null });
      await until(() => proc.stderrTail() === 'last α\nlast β\nlast γ');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'exited resolves while an escaped process still holds the inherited pipes',
    async () => {
      const { proc } = launch('heir');
      // Only the first line: the heir keeps stdout open.
      const heir = Number(await watchStdout(proc).firstLine());
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: 0, signal: null });
      expect(await processIdentity(heir)).not.toBeNull();
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'aborting the forwarded signal sends SIGTERM to the group, a grandchild included',
    async () => {
      const { proc, controller } = launch('group');
      const grandchild = Number(await watchStdout(proc).firstLine());
      expect((await processIdentity(grandchild))?.pgid).toBe(pidOf(proc));
      controller.abort();
      // A SIGTERMed claude exits 143, not by the signal (design 7.4).
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: 143, signal: null });
      await until(async () => {
        const [member] = await listProcesses([grandchild]);
        return member === undefined || member.stat.startsWith('Z');
      });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a signal that was aborted before the spawn ends the group too',
    async () => {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      controller.abort();
      const { proc } = launch('wait', {}, { signal: controller.signal });
      proc.stdout.resume();
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: null, signal: 'SIGTERM' });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'once the leader is gone, an abort or kill signals nothing, though its group lives on',
    async () => {
      const { proc, controller } = launch('orphan');
      const grandchild = Number((await readAll(proc.stdout)).trim());
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: 0, signal: null });
      const before = await processIdentity(grandchild);
      expect(before?.pgid).toBe(pidOf(proc));
      expect(() => controller.abort()).not.toThrow();
      proc.kill('SIGTERM');
      await Bun.sleep(200);
      expect(await processIdentity(grandchild)).toEqual(before);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "the returned object is the SDK's SpawnedProcess: stdin to EOF, stdout, exit events and exitCode",
    async () => {
      const { proc } = launch('echo');
      const sdk: SpawnedProcess = proc;
      const events: unknown[] = [];
      const removed = () => {
        throw new Error('a removed exit listener fired');
      };
      sdk.on('exit', removed);
      sdk.off('exit', removed);
      sdk.on('exit', (code, signal) => events.push(['on', code, signal]));
      sdk.once('exit', (code, signal) => events.push(['once', code, signal]));
      expect(sdk.killed).toBe(false);
      expect(sdk.exitCode).toBeNull();
      expect(sdk.signalCode).toBeNull();
      const text = readAll(sdk.stdout);
      sdk.stdin.write('input from the SDK\n');
      sdk.stdin.end('EOF');
      expect(await text).toBe('input from the SDK\nEOF');
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: 23, signal: null });
      expect(sdk.exitCode).toBe(23);
      expect(sdk.signalCode).toBeNull();
      expect(events).toEqual([
        ['on', 23, null],
        ['once', 23, null],
      ]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'kill signals the whole group while the leader runs',
    async () => {
      const { proc } = launch('group');
      const grandchild = Number(await watchStdout(proc).firstLine());
      expect(proc.kill('SIGTERM')).toBe(true);
      expect(proc.killed).toBe(true);
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: 143, signal: null });
      await gone(grandchild);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a registration that throws ends the new process and rethrows',
    async () => {
      let spawned: number | undefined;
      const hook = createDetachedSpawn({
        logFile: join(tempDir(), 'attempt.log'),
        registerProcess(pid) {
          spawned = pid;
          groups.add(pid);
          throw new Error('the agent of T-1-a1 was already registered');
        },
      });
      expect(() =>
        hook({
          command: process.execPath,
          args: [CHILD, 'wait'],
          cwd: tempDir(),
          env: {},
          signal: new AbortController().signal,
        }),
      ).toThrow('already registered');
      if (spawned === undefined) throw new Error('nothing was spawned');
      await gone(spawned);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'kill signals the leader, and signalCode reports it',
    async () => {
      const { proc } = launch('wait');
      expect(await watchStdout(proc).firstLine()).toBe('ready');
      expect(proc.kill('SIGKILL')).toBe(true);
      expect(proc.killed).toBe(true);
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: null, signal: 'SIGKILL' });
      expect(proc.exitCode).toBeNull();
      expect(proc.signalCode).toBe('SIGKILL');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a missing command emits error, registers nothing and does not throw',
    async () => {
      const registered: number[] = [];
      const { proc } = launch(
        'wait',
        { registerProcess: (pid) => registered.push(pid) },
        { command: join(tempDir(), 'missing-command') },
      );
      const error = await new Promise<Error>((resolve) => proc.once('error', resolve));
      expect((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code).toBe('ENOENT');
      expect(proc.pid).toBeUndefined();
      expect(registered).toEqual([]);
      expect(await proc.exited).toEqual({ code: null, signal: null });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'through the real SDK, a session starts, runs a turn and ends on close() with the hook',
    async () => {
      const dir = tempDir();
      const recording = claudeRecording({
        turns: [
          [
            { frame: { type: 'system', subtype: 'init', session_id: '$SESSION', cwd: '$CWD', model: '$MODEL' } },
            { frame: { type: 'result', subtype: 'success', is_error: false, result: 'ok', session_id: '$SESSION' } },
          ],
        ],
      });
      const registered: number[] = [];
      let spawned: SpawnedClaude | undefined;
      const hook = createDetachedSpawn({
        logFile: join(dir, 'attempt.log'),
        registerProcess: (pid) => {
          groups.add(pid);
          registered.push(pid);
        },
        onSpawn: (proc) => {
          spawned = proc;
        },
      });
      const message: SDKUserMessage = {
        type: 'user',
        message: { role: 'user', content: 'go' },
        parent_tool_use_id: null,
        uuid: 'aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
      };
      const q = query({
        prompt: (async function* () {
          yield message;
          // A finite input would close stdin and end the session; this one stays open until close().
          await new Promise(() => {});
        })(),
        options: {
          pathToClaudeCodeExecutable: FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN,
          spawnClaudeCodeProcess: hook,
          cwd: dir,
          env: { PATH: process.env.PATH ?? '/usr/bin:/bin', ...fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir }) },
          model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
        },
      });
      await q.initializationResult();
      const seen: SDKMessage[] = [];
      for await (const frame of q) {
        seen.push(frame);
        if (frame.type === 'result') break;
      }
      expect(seen.find((frame) => frame.type === 'result')).toMatchObject({ subtype: 'success', result: 'ok' });
      if (spawned === undefined) throw new Error('the SDK did not use the hook');
      children.push(spawned);
      expect(registered).toEqual([pidOf(spawned)]);
      q.close();
      // close() ends stdin; the fake exits 0 on EOF while idle.
      expect(await spawned.exited).toEqual({ code: 0, signal: null });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "through the real SDK, close() on a claude that ignores stdin EOF SIGTERMs its group after the SDK's grace",
    async () => {
      const dir = tempDir();
      const pidFile = join(dir, 'grandchild.pid');
      let spawned: SpawnedClaude | undefined;
      const hook = createDetachedSpawn({
        logFile: join(dir, 'attempt.log'),
        registerProcess: (pid) => groups.add(pid),
        onSpawn: (proc) => {
          spawned = proc;
          children.push(proc);
        },
      });
      const q = query({
        prompt: (async function* (): AsyncGenerator<SDKUserMessage> {
          await new Promise(() => {});
        })(),
        options: {
          pathToClaudeCodeExecutable: FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN,
          // The SDK's command is replaced by the stand-in, which never answers it.
          spawnClaudeCodeProcess: (options) =>
            hook({ ...options, command: process.execPath, args: [CHILD, 'stubborn', pidFile] }),
          cwd: dir,
          env: { PATH: process.env.PATH ?? '/usr/bin:/bin' },
        },
      });
      q.initializationResult().catch(() => {});
      await until(() => existsSync(pidFile) && readFileSync(pidFile, 'utf8') !== '');
      const grandchild = Number(readFileSync(pidFile, 'utf8'));
      if (spawned === undefined) throw new Error('the SDK did not use the hook');
      q.close();
      expect(await spawned.exited).toEqual({ code: 143, signal: null });
      await gone(grandchild);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});
```

```ts
// A stand-in for claude in the spawn hook's tests: `bun child.ts <mode>`.
import { writeFileSync, writeSync } from 'node:fs';

const mode = process.argv[2];
switch (mode) {
  case 'inspect':
    // What the hook gave it: the executable, argv, cwd and the whole environment.
    console.log(
      JSON.stringify({
        executable: process.execPath,
        args: process.argv.slice(2),
        cwd: process.cwd(),
        env: process.env,
      }),
    );
    break;
  case 'stderr': {
    // Two megabytes, far past the log's bound, then three lines with a UTF-8 character split across writes and
    // no final newline.
    for (let index = 0; index < 256; index += 1) writeSync(2, `${'x'.repeat(8_191)}\n`);
    const last = Buffer.from('last α\nlast β\nlast γ');
    writeSync(2, last.subarray(0, 6));
    await Bun.sleep(10);
    writeSync(2, last.subarray(6));
    console.log('done');
    break;
  }
  case 'echo':
    for await (const chunk of process.stdin) writeSync(1, chunk);
    process.exitCode = 23;
    break;
  case 'group':
  case 'orphan': {
    // Claude exits 143 on SIGTERM rather than by the signal.
    process.on('SIGTERM', () => process.exit(143));
    // A grandchild in the same process group.
    const member = Bun.spawn(['/bin/sleep', '60'], { stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'ignore', stderr: 'ignore' });
    console.log(member.pid);
    if (mode === 'orphan') process.exit(0);
    setInterval(() => {}, 1_000);
    break;
  }
  case 'heir': {
    // A grandchild that inherits stdout and stderr, so the pipes outlive the leader's exit.
    const heir = Bun.spawn(['/bin/sleep', '60'], { stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' });
    console.log(heir.pid);
    process.exit(0);
    break;
  }
  case 'stubborn': {
    // Like a claude in a turn: stdin EOF does not end it, SIGTERM does (exit 143). Its grandchild's pid goes to the
    // file argv[3], because the SDK reads stdout as JSON.
    process.on('SIGTERM', () => process.exit(143));
    const member = Bun.spawn(['/bin/sleep', '60'], { stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'ignore', stderr: 'ignore' });
    writeFileSync(process.argv[3] as string, String(member.pid));
    process.stdin.resume();
    setInterval(() => {}, 1_000);
    break;
  }
  case 'longline':
    // A megabyte of stderr without a newline.
    for (let index = 0; index < 128; index += 1) writeSync(2, 'y'.repeat(8_192));
    writeSync(2, 'the end');
    console.log('done');
    break;
  case 'wait':
    console.log('ready');
    setInterval(() => {}, 1_000);
    break;
  default:
    throw new Error(`unknown child mode: ${mode}`);
}
```

```ts
// The SDK's spawnClaudeCodeProcess hook (design 7.4, 8.2): node:child_process.spawn, because the SDK needs a Node
// ChildProcess, with detached set, so each claude leads its own session and process group, and piped stdio. The SDK
// alone reads stdout; stderr is drained into the attempt's log up to a bound, and its last lines stay in memory for
// error classification. The process is registered before the hook returns, so before the SDK reads any output.
// Whichever way the SDK ends the process (its forwarded abort, or kill() after close()'s stdin-EOF grace), the
// signal reaches the whole group, so a tool the claude started ends with it (7.4).
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { StringDecoder } from 'node:string_decoder';
import type { SpawnedProcess, SpawnOptions } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { drainToLog, killGroup, type ProcessIdentity, processIdentity } from '../../processes';
import type { ExitInfo } from '../types';

/** The bytes of a claude's stderr that reach the attempt log; the rest is read and dropped after a marker. */
export const CLAUDE_STDERR_LOG_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024;

/** The stderr lines kept in memory for classifying a crash. */
export const CLAUDE_STDERR_TAIL_LINES = 100;

/** The characters of those lines kept at most, an unfinished last line included: a line may never end. */
export const CLAUDE_STDERR_TAIL_CHARS = 64 * 1024;

/** The spawned claude as the SDK and the session see it: a ChildProcess with its stderr tail and its exit. */
export interface SpawnedClaude extends SpawnedProcess {
  /** undefined only when the spawn itself failed; an 'error' event follows. */
  readonly pid: number | undefined;
  /** The last stderr lines, joined with newlines; an unfinished last line included. */
  stderrTail(): string;
  /** Resolves when the process exits, or with nulls when it never started; inherited pipes never hold it. */
  readonly exited: Promise<ExitInfo>;
}

export interface DetachedSpawnInput {
  /** AgentLaunch.registerProcess. */
  registerProcess(pid: number): void;
  /** AgentLaunch.logFile. */
  logFile: string;
  /** CLAUDE_STDERR_LOG_BYTES by default. */
  maxLogBytes?: number;
  /** CLAUDE_STDERR_TAIL_LINES by default. */
  tailLines?: number;
  /** CLAUDE_STDERR_TAIL_CHARS by default. */
  tailChars?: number;
  /** Called with each process before the hook returns it, so the session can watch it. */
  onSpawn?(proc: SpawnedClaude): void;
}

export function createDetachedSpawn(input: DetachedSpawnInput): (options: SpawnOptions) => SpawnedClaude {
  const maxLogBytes = input.maxLogBytes ?? CLAUDE_STDERR_LOG_BYTES;
  const tailLines = input.tailLines ?? CLAUDE_STDERR_TAIL_LINES;
  const tailChars = input.tailChars ?? CLAUDE_STDERR_TAIL_CHARS;
  for (const [name, value] of [
    ['maxLogBytes', maxLogBytes],
    ['tailLines', tailLines],
    ['tailChars', tailChars],
  ] as const) {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) throw new RangeError(`${name} must be a whole number, not ${value}`);
  }

  return (options) => {
    const env: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(options.env)) if (value !== undefined) env[name] = value;
    // options.signal is not passed on: spawn() would then kill only the leader, at once.
    const child = spawn(options.command, options.args, {
      cwd: options.cwd,
      env,
      detached: true,
      stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
    });
    // The leader's start time, read while it surely runs; killGroup compares it again before signalling, since a
    // macOS pid can be reused by then.
    const identity: Promise<ProcessIdentity | null> =
      child.pid === undefined ? Promise.resolve(null) : processIdentity(child.pid).catch(() => null);
    let ended = false;
    const abort = () => {
      void (async () => {
        const leader = await identity;
        if (!ended && leader) await killGroup(leader, 'SIGTERM');
      })().catch(() => {
        // A failed ps or kill leaves the stop ladder's later steps to end the group.
      });
    };
    const exited = new Promise<ExitInfo>((resolve) => {
      const finish = (code: number | null, signal: NodeJS.Signals | null) => {
        ended = true;
        options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
        resolve({ code, signal });
      };
      child.once('exit', finish);
      // A spawn that fails emits error and never exit.
      child.on('error', () => {
        if (child.pid === undefined) finish(null, null);
      });
    });

    const tail = new StderrTail(tailLines, tailChars);
    const leaderKill = child.kill.bind(child);
    const proc = Object.assign(child, {
      exited,
      stderrTail: () => tail.text(),
      // close() ends stdin and, after its grace, calls kill('SIGTERM'), which would reach the leader alone. While the
      // leader is not reaped, its pid and so its group id cannot have been reused, which is 7.4's identity check.
      kill: (signal: NodeJS.Signals | number = 'SIGTERM'): boolean => {
        if (child.pid !== undefined && child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) {
          try {
            process.kill(-child.pid, signal);
            // The SDK reads it to tell whether the process was already ended.
            (child as { killed: boolean }).killed = true;
            return true;
          } catch {
            // No group to signal: the leader alone.
          }
        }
        return leaderKill(signal);
      },
    }) as SpawnedClaude;

    try {
      if (child.pid !== undefined) input.registerProcess(child.pid);
      // The log gets the bytes as they came; the tail decodes them, characters split across chunks included.
      const stderr = (async function* () {
        for await (const chunk of child.stderr) {
          tail.add(chunk as Buffer);
          yield chunk as Buffer;
        }
        tail.end();
      })();
      void drainToLog(stderr, input.logFile, { maxBytes: maxLogBytes }).catch(async () => {
        // Without a log the pipe is still read to its end, so the child never blocks and Bun buffers nothing.
        try {
          for await (const _chunk of stderr) {
            // Only the tail keeps anything.
          }
        } catch {
          // A process killed mid-write may close its pipe with an error.
        }
      });
      options.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
      if (options.signal.aborted) abort();
      input.onSpawn?.(proc);
    } catch (error) {
      // A claude nobody registered or watches must not run on: its group ends at once. The pid is a child of ours
      // that has not been reaped, so it is still that group's.
      if (child.pid !== undefined) {
        try {
          process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL');
        } catch {
          // Already gone.
        }
      }
      throw error;
    }
    return proc;
  };
}

/** The last lines of a stream of bytes, within a budget of characters. */
class StderrTail {
  private readonly decoder = new StringDecoder('utf8');
  private lines: string[] = [];
  private partial = '';

  constructor(
    private readonly max: number,
    private readonly maxChars: number,
  ) {}

  add(chunk: Buffer): void {
    this.push(this.decoder.write(chunk));
  }

  end(): void {
    this.push(this.decoder.end());
  }

  text(): string {
    const lines = this.partial === '' ? this.lines : [...this.lines, this.partial];
    return lines.slice(-this.max).join('\n').slice(-this.maxChars);
  }

  private push(text: string): void {
    if (this.max === 0 || this.maxChars === 0 || text === '') return;
    // Only the last maxChars can be kept, so a line that never ends stays within the budget too.
    const parts = (this.partial + text).slice(-this.maxChars).split('\n');
    this.partial = parts.pop() as string;
    this.lines = this.lines.concat(parts).slice(-this.max);
    let size = this.partial.length + this.lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.length + 1, 0);
    while (size > this.maxChars && this.lines.length > 0) size -= (this.lines.shift() as string).length + 1;
  }
}
```

### Task 17: ClaudeInbox and ClaudeSession

`ClaudeSession`, the `AgentSession` for Claude (design 8.2, 8.3, 8.4, 13), and `ClaudeInbox`, the single-consumer queue behind it. One `query()` reads one long-lived inbox, because a finite input would close the CLI's stdin and end the session (design 3), and its frames go through the mapper. `send` pushes a user message with a fresh uuid, `interrupt` is plain or `{ cancelQueued: true }` (untyped, cast), `close` ends the inbox, `terminate` and `kill` signal the CLI's group at once, and a crash ends the running turn as failed with the stderr tail and the exit code. PreCompact only warns; the summary comes from PostCompact, and `answerApproval` always answers false. The constructor makes the Claude home's empty directory before it spawns (Task 8), and the task extends Task 14's mapper (`ended`), Task 16's hook (`signalGroup`, `stderrRead`) and the fake CLI (a `$stderr` step, and an aborted turn that ends with `session_state_changed` idle, as 2.1.285's does).

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { ClaudeInbox } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/inbox';

describe('ClaudeInbox', () => {
  test('it yields pushed items in order, and waits while empty', async () => {
    const inbox = new ClaudeInbox<string>();
    inbox.push('a');
    inbox.push('b');
    const reader = inbox[Symbol.asyncIterator]();
    expect(await reader.next()).toEqual({ value: 'a', done: false });
    expect(await reader.next()).toEqual({ value: 'b', done: false });
    let taken: IteratorResult<string> | null = null;
    const waiting = reader.next().then((result) => {
      taken = result;
    });
    await Bun.sleep(10);
    expect(taken).toBeNull();
    inbox.push('c');
    await waiting;
    expect(taken as unknown as IteratorResult<string>).toEqual({ value: 'c', done: false });
  });

  test('it ends on end(): queued items first, then done; pushes after the end are refused', async () => {
    const inbox = new ClaudeInbox<string>();
    const reader = inbox[Symbol.asyncIterator]();
    const waiting = reader.next();
    inbox.end();
    expect(await waiting).toEqual({ value: undefined, done: true });

    const other = new ClaudeInbox<string>();
    other.push('last');
    other.end();
    other.end();
    expect(other.ended).toBe(true);
    expect(() => other.push('late')).toThrow(/the inbox has ended/);
    const seen: string[] = [];
    for await (const item of other) seen.push(item);
    expect(seen).toEqual(['last']);
  });

  test('it allows a single iterator', () => {
    const inbox = new ClaudeInbox<string>();
    inbox[Symbol.asyncIterator]();
    expect(() => inbox[Symbol.asyncIterator]()).toThrow(/a single iterator/);
  });

  test('a reader that stops ends the inbox', async () => {
    const inbox = new ClaudeInbox<string>();
    inbox.push('a');
    inbox.push('b');
    for await (const item of inbox) {
      expect(item).toBe('a');
      break;
    }
    expect(inbox.ended).toBe(true);
    expect(() => inbox.push('c')).toThrow(/the inbox has ended/);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, realpathSync, rmSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';

import { linkClaudeBinary } from '@agflow/testkit/src/anthropic';
import {

// macOS's first exec of a new script is slow, more so under load.

const SESSION = '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555';
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

const dirs: string[] = [];
const groups = new Set<number>();
const sessions: ClaudeSession[] = [];

afterEach(async () => {
  for (const session of sessions.splice(0)) session.terminate();
  for (const pgid of groups) {
    try {
      process.kill(-pgid, 'SIGKILL');
    } catch {
      // Already gone.
    }
  }
  groups.clear();
  for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

beforeAll(() => {
  // Warm the script and Bun's transpile cache once, so the first test does not pay for it.
  Bun.spawnSync([FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, '--version'], { env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN: process.execPath } });
}, TIMEOUT);

/** A runner layout whose pinned claude is the fake, an attempt clone in it, and a launch for that clone. */
function setup(recording: ClaudeRecording) {
  const root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-claude-session-')));
  dirs.push(root);
  const paths = runnerPaths(join(root, '.agflow'));
  linkClaudeBinary(paths.home, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN);
  const clone = join(paths.work, 'p-1', 'T-1-a1');
  const tmpDir = join(root, 'tmp');
  const home = join(root, 'home');
  for (const dir of [clone, tmpDir, home, paths.homes.claude]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const fake = fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir: join(root, 'fake') });
  const launch: AgentLaunch = {
    attemptId: 'T-1-a1',
    role: 'worker',
    model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
    cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
    clone,
    baseCheckout: paths.baseCheckout('p-1', '0123456789abcdef'),
    projectConfigVerified: true,
    tmpDir,
    env: {
      HOME: home,
      PATH: `${dirname(process.execPath)}:/usr/bin:/bin`,
      CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: paths.homes.claude,
      CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR: tmpDir,
      ...fake,
    },
    bridge: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: ['mcp', '--vendor', 'claude', '--runner'], env: {}, tools: [] },
    profile: standardProfile,
    brief: 'brief',
    firstPrompt: 'go',
    resume: null,
    logFile: join(root, 'attempt.log'),
    registerProcess: (pid) => {
      groups.add(pid);
    },
  };
  const deps: ClaudeSessionInput['deps'] = {
    agflow: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: [] },
    paths,
    vendorHomes: { claude: paths.homes.claude, codex: paths.homes.codex },
    autoOffered: false,
    newSessionId: () => SESSION,
  } satisfies Omit<ClaudeOptionDeps, 'spawnClaudeCodeProcess' | 'compaction'>;
  return { launch, deps, log: fake.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG as string };
}

/** Reads a session's events as they come, so a test can wait for one. */
class Events {
  readonly seen: AgentEvent[] = [];
  ended = false;
  readonly done: Promise<void>;
  private wakers: (() => void)[] = [];

  constructor(session: ClaudeSession) {
    this.done = (async () => {
      for await (const event of session.events) {
        this.seen.push(event);
        this.wake();
      }
      this.ended = true;
      this.wake();
    })();
  }

  /** The n-th event (1-based) that matches, once it came. */
  async until(match: (event: AgentEvent) => boolean, nth = 1, timeoutMs = 20_000): Promise<AgentEvent> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    for (;;) {
      const found = this.seen.filter(match);
      if (found.length >= nth) return found[nth - 1] as AgentEvent;
      if (this.ended || Date.now() > deadline) {
        throw new Error(`no such event; saw ${JSON.stringify(this.seen.map((event) => event.type))}`);
      }
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        this.wakers.push(resolve);
        setTimeout(resolve, 100);
      });
    }
  }

  types(): string[] {
    return this.seen.map((event) => event.type);
  }

  private wake(): void {
    for (const wake of this.wakers.splice(0)) wake();
  }
}

function open(recording: ClaudeRecording, input: Partial<ClaudeSessionInput> = {}) {
  const { launch, deps, log } = setup(recording);
  const session = new ClaudeSession({ launch, deps, firstPrompt: launch.firstPrompt, ...input });
  sessions.push(session);
  return { session, events: new Events(session), log, launch };
}

/** Matches events of a type whose fields hold these values. */
function is<T extends AgentEvent['type']>(type: T, fields: Partial<Extract<AgentEvent, { type: T }>> = {}) {
  return (event: AgentEvent) =>
    event.type === type &&
    Object.entries(fields).every(([key, value]) => (event as Record<string, unknown>)[key] === value);
}

async function logOf(path: string, kind: FakeClaudeLogEntry['kind']): Promise<FakeClaudeLogEntry[]> {
  return (await readFakeClaudeLog(path)).filter((entry) => entry.kind === kind);
}

/** The recording with its first turn held after its system/init, where stdin EOF does not end the CLI (design 3). */
function stalledAfterInit(recording: ClaudeRecording): ClaudeRecording {
  const [turn = [], ...rest] = recording.turns;
  const init = turn.findIndex(
    (step) => 'frame' in step && step.frame.type === 'system' && step.frame.subtype === 'init',
  );
  const held: RecordingStep[] = [...turn.slice(0, init + 1), { ignoreEof: true }, { sleep: 60_000 }];
  return { ...recording, turns: [held, ...rest] };
}

/** A turn that fails by itself: only an error_during_execution result for the newest message. */
const failingTurn: RecordingStep[] = [
  {
    frame: {
      type: 'result',
      subtype: 'error_during_execution',
      is_error: true,
      duration_ms: 0,
      duration_api_ms: 0,
      num_turns: 1,
      result: null,
      stop_reason: null,
      session_id: '$SESSION',
      total_cost_usd: 0,
      usage: { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0, cache_creation_input_tokens: 0, cache_read_input_tokens: 0 },
      modelUsage: {},
      permission_denials: [],
      errors: ['the session store is corrupt'],
      uuid: '$UUID',
      user_message_uuids: ['$LAST_USER_UUID'],
    },
  },
];

/** Waits until the fake logged n entries of a kind: the interrupt recording waits for one only after its hook. */
async function logged(path: string, kind: FakeClaudeLogEntry['kind'], n = 1): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + 20_000;
  while ((await logOf(path, kind)).length < n) {
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error(`the fake logged no ${kind}`);
    await Bun.sleep(20);
  }
}

describe('ClaudeSession', () => {
  test(

    async () => {
      const { launch, deps } = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));

      sessions.push(session);
      expect(statSync(empty).isDirectory()).toBe(true);
      await new Events(session).until(is('turn_ended'));
    },

  );

    'send() pushes a message with a fresh uuid and the default priority; delivered and acknowledged carry its id',
    async () => {

      expect(session.pid).toBeGreaterThan(0);

      await events.until(is('turn_ended'));
      const delivered = events.seen.findIndex(is('delivered', { id: 'm-1' }));
      const acknowledged = events.seen.findIndex(is('acknowledged', { id: 'm-1' }));
      expect(delivered).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
      expect(acknowledged).toBeGreaterThan(delivered);
      expect(events.seen.find(is('turn_ended'))).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed', errorKind: null });

      const users = await logOf(log, 'user');
      expect(users).toHaveLength(2);
      const [first, note] = users.map((entry) => (entry.kind === 'user' ? entry.message : {}));
      expect(first).toMatchObject({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: 'go' }, parent_tool_use_id: null });
      expect(note).toMatchObject({ message: { content: 'a note' }, parent_tool_use_id: null });
      expect(note?.uuid).toMatch(UUID);
      expect(note?.uuid).not.toBe(first?.uuid);
      expect(note).not.toHaveProperty('priority');

  test(

    async () => {

      expect(await events.until(is('turn_ended'), 2)).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed' });

  test(

        summary: 'Summary: the agent said hello; nothing else happened.',
      });
      const warning = events.seen.findIndex(is('warning', { text: 'Claude is compacting its context (manual)' }));
      expect(warning).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
      expect(warning).toBeLessThan(events.seen.indexOf(compacted));
      expect(await events.until(is('turn_ended'), 2)).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed' });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'close() ends the input and the process: exited resolves, and the events end after the exit',
    async () => {
      const { session, events, log } = open(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
      await events.until(is('turn_ended'));
      let exitedFirst = false;
      void session.exited.then(() => {
        exitedFirst = !events.ended;
      });
      await session.close();
      await events.done;
      expect(exitedFirst).toBe(true);
      expect(await session.exited).toEqual({ code: 0, signal: null });
      expect(events.types()[0]).toBe('started');
      expect((await readFakeClaudeLog(log)).at(-1)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', code: 0 });
      await expect(session.send({ id: 'm-2', text: 'late', authority: 'person' })).rejects.toThrow(/closed/);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a crash mid-turn gives turn_ended failed with the stderr tail, then the exit code',
    async () => {
      const { session, events } = open(loadRecording('crash-mid-turn'));
      await events.done;
      expect(events.types()).toEqual([
        'started',
        'turn_started',
        'text',
        'tool_started',
        'tool_ended',
        'turn_ended',
      ]);
      expect(events.seen.find(is('tool_ended'))).toMatchObject({ toolId: 'toolu_basic_1', ok: false });
      expect(events.seen.at(-1)).toEqual({
        type: 'turn_ended',
        outcome: 'failed',
        toolCalls: 1,
        error: 'Error: the session store is corrupt\n    at loadSession (cli.js:1:1)\nclaude exited with code 3',
        errorKind: null,
      });
      expect(await session.exited).toEqual({ code: 3, signal: null });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a first system/init that fails the check ends the session before any work, and is reported',
    async () => {
      const { session, events } = open(loadRecording('turn-basic'), { checkInit: () => ['claude 2.1.200, expected'] });
      expect(await session.firstInit).toMatchObject({
        init: { type: 'system', subtype: 'init', session_id: SESSION },
        problems: ['claude 2.1.200, expected'],
      });
      await events.done;
      expect(events.seen).toEqual([
        { type: 'warning', text: 'the session does not match its options: claude 2.1.200, expected' },
      ]);
      // Ended, by stdin EOF (0) or SIGTERM (the fake exits 143 on it), whichever reaches the CLI first.
      const exit = await session.exited;
      expect(exit.signal).toBeNull();
      expect([0, 143]).toContain(exit.code as number);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "terminate() ends the CLI's group at once, also mid-turn, where stdin EOF does not end it",
    async () => {
      const { session, events } = open(stalledAfterInit(loadRecording('turn-basic')));
      await events.until(is('turn_started'));
      const before = Date.now();
      session.terminate();
      expect(await session.exited).toEqual({ code: 143, signal: null });
      // The SDK's close() alone would wait 2 s before it signals the leader.
      expect(Date.now() - before).toBeLessThan(1_500);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'answerApproval resolves false: Claude raises no approvals',
    async () => {
      const { session } = open(claudeRecording({ turns: [] }), { firstPrompt: null });
      expect(await session.answerApproval('a-1', 'approve', null)).toBe(false);
      await session.close();
      expect(await session.exited).toEqual({ code: 0, signal: null });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});
```

```ts
// A single-consumer queue that an async iterator drains (design 8.2, 3): a session's input, which query() reads as
// its prompt, and the session's events. The input must stay open for the whole session, because a finite one would
// close the CLI's stdin and end the session; it ends only when the session closes.
import type { SDKUserMessage } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';

export class ClaudeInbox<T = SDKUserMessage> implements AsyncIterable<T> {
  private readonly items: T[] = [];
  private waiting: ((result: IteratorResult<T>) => void) | null = null;
  private done = false;
  private iterated = false;

  get ended(): boolean {
    return this.done;
  }

  /** Queues an item, or hands it to the waiting reader; refused once the inbox has ended. */
  push(item: T): void {
    if (this.done) throw new Error('the inbox has ended');
    const waiting = this.waiting;
    this.waiting = null;
    if (waiting) waiting({ value: item, done: false });
    else this.items.push(item);
  }

  /** No more items: the reader gets what is queued, then the end. Idempotent. */
  end(): void {
    this.done = true;
    const waiting = this.waiting;
    this.waiting = null;
    waiting?.({ value: undefined, done: true });
  }

  [Symbol.asyncIterator](): AsyncIterator<T> {
    // A second reader would take items the first one expects.
    if (this.iterated) throw new Error('the inbox allows a single iterator');
    this.iterated = true;
    return {
      next: () => {
        if (this.items.length > 0) return Promise.resolve({ value: this.items.shift() as T, done: false });
        if (this.done) return Promise.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true });
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
          this.waiting = resolve;
        });
      },
      return: () => {
        // The reader stopped: what it left is dropped, and nothing more is taken.
        this.items.length = 0;
        this.end();
        return Promise.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true });
      },
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
// A live Claude session, the AgentSession of the Claude adapter (design 8.2, 8.3, 8.4, 13). One query() reads one
// long-lived inbox, so the CLI's stdin stays open between turns; its frames go through the event mapper, and the
// compaction hooks add theirs. Sending pushes a user message with a fresh uuid, interrupting is the SDK's control
// request, and closing ends the inbox, after which the CLI exits once its turn is over. The guard is a PreToolUse
// hook of the options. Claude raises no approvals: a call the rules do not allow is denied at once.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  type HookCallback,
  type Query,
  query,
  type SDKControlInitializeResponse,
  type SDKSystemMessage,
  type SDKUserMessage,
} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { boundedWait } from '../../processes';
import type { AgentEvent, AgentLaunch, AgentSession, ExitInfo } from '../types';
import { ClaudeEventMapper } from './events';
import { ClaudeInbox } from './inbox';
import { isRecord } from './json';
import { buildQueryOptions, type ClaudeOptionDeps, ensureClaudeEmptyDir } from './options';
import type { QuotaBook } from './quota';
import { createDetachedSpawn, type SpawnedClaude } from './spawn';

/** The characters of stderr a crashed turn's error keeps, from the end. */
export const CLAUDE_CRASH_TAIL_CHARS = 4_000;

/** How long the rest of stderr is waited for after the exit: an escaped child that inherited it may hold it open. */
const STDERR_AFTER_EXIT_MS = 1_000;

export interface ClaudeSessionInput {
  launch: AgentLaunch;
  /** Everything buildQueryOptions needs except the session's own spawn hook and compaction callbacks. */
  deps: Omit<ClaudeOptionDeps, 'spawnClaudeCodeProcess' | 'compaction'>;
  /** Pushed before anything else: a new session's first prompt. A resumed session gets none. */
  firstPrompt: string | null;
  /** The account the session's quota events name. */
  accountId?: string | null;
  /** The adapter's last quota per account, shared by its sessions. */
  quota?: QuotaBook;
  /** The first-turn check (8.1): the problems of the session's first system/init, none when it matches. */
  checkInit?(init: SDKSystemMessage): string[];
}

/** The session's first system/init and what the first-turn check found in it. */
export interface FirstInit {
  init: SDKSystemMessage;
  problems: string[];
}

export class ClaudeSession implements AgentSession {
  readonly sessionRef: string;
  readonly events: AsyncIterable<AgentEvent>;
  readonly exited: Promise<ExitInfo>;
  /** Resolves with the first system/init, or with null when the session ends before one. */
  readonly firstInit: Promise<FirstInit | null>;

  private readonly inbox = new ClaudeInbox<SDKUserMessage>();
  private readonly queue = new ClaudeInbox<AgentEvent>();
  private readonly mapper: ClaudeEventMapper;
  private readonly query: Query;
  private readonly checkInit: (init: SDKSystemMessage) => string[];
  private readonly exit = Promise.withResolvers<ExitInfo>();
  private readonly first = Promise.withResolvers<FirstInit | null>();
  private proc: SpawnedClaude | null = null;
  private initSeen = false;
  /** The first-turn check failed: the session is being ended, and its frames are not mapped. */
  private refused = false;
  /**
   * The first prompt was pushed and no turn has started yet: the CLI may be starting one. A message sent later is
   * the mapper's to track, until the CLI starts or cancels it.
   */
  private firstTurnPending = false;

  /** Starts the CLI: the process is spawned, and registered, before this returns. */
  constructor(input: ClaudeSessionInput) {
    this.mapper = new ClaudeEventMapper({ accountId: input.accountId ?? null, quota: input.quota });
    this.checkInit = input.checkInit ?? (() => []);
    this.events = this.queue;
    this.exited = this.exit.promise;
    this.firstInit = this.first.promise;
    // Where the bridge and the brief hook start, and zsh's ZDOTDIR: it must be there before the CLI is.
    ensureClaudeEmptyDir(input.deps.vendorHomes.claude);
    const spawn = createDetachedSpawn({
      registerProcess: (pid) => input.launch.registerProcess(pid),
      logFile: input.launch.logFile,
      onSpawn: (proc) => {
        this.proc = proc;
        void proc.exited.then((exit) => this.exit.resolve(exit));
      },
    });
    const options = buildQueryOptions(input.launch, {
      ...input.deps,
      spawnClaudeCodeProcess: spawn,
      compaction: { preCompact: this.preCompact, postCompact: this.postCompact },
    });
    const sessionRef = options.resume ?? options.sessionId;
    if (sessionRef === undefined) throw new Error('the session options name no session');
    this.sessionRef = sessionRef;
    if (input.firstPrompt !== null) {
      this.pushUser(input.firstPrompt, randomUUID());
      this.firstTurnPending = true;
    }
    this.query = query({ prompt: this.inbox, options });
    void this.pump();
  }

  /** The CLI's pid; 0 when it could not be spawned (the session then ends at once). */
  get pid(): number {
    return this.proc?.pid ?? 0;
  }

  /** The CLI's answer to initialize: the account among others. Rejects when the CLI ends before it answers. */
  initialization(): Promise<SDKControlInitializeResponse> {
    return this.query.initializationResult();
  }

  /** The last lines the CLI wrote to stderr. */
  stderrTail(): string {
    return this.proc?.stderrTail() ?? '';
  }

  /** Resolves once stderr is read to its end, so stderrTail() holds all of it; bounded, as a child may hold it. */
  async stderrRead(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.proc !== null) await boundedWait(this.proc.stderrRead, STDERR_AFTER_EXIT_MS);
  }

  async send(message: { id: string; text: string; authority: 'person' | 'agent' | 'system' }): Promise<void> {
    if (this.inbox.ended) throw new Error('the Claude session is closed');
    const uuid = randomUUID();
    this.mapper.messageSent(uuid, message.id);
    this.pushUser(message.text, uuid);
  }

  /**
   * Plain, queued messages survive and run next (the hub's interrupt); with cancelQueued they are dropped too (a
   * stop). The SDK leaves that parameter untyped, so it is cast (8.3).
   */
  async interrupt(options: { cancelQueued?: boolean } = {}): Promise<void> {
    // Only a turn that runs, or is starting, gives the result an interrupt classifies: the mapper knows the turns and
    // the sent messages still queued, the session the first prompt.
    this.mapper.interruptRequested({ starting: this.firstTurnPending });
    const interrupt = this.query.interrupt as (options?: { cancelQueued?: boolean }) => Promise<unknown>;
    if (options.cancelQueued) await interrupt.call(this.query, { cancelQueued: true });
    else await interrupt.call(this.query);
  }

  /** Claude raises no approvals (permissionPrompts 'none'), so no request ever takes an answer. */
  async answerApproval(_id: string, _decision: 'approve' | 'decline', _reason: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
    return false;
  }

  /** Ends the input: the SDK closes the CLI's stdin once the running turn is over, and the CLI exits. */
  async close(): Promise<void> {
    this.inbox.end();
  }

  /**
   * Ends the session at once: the input, the SDK's side, and the CLI's process group with SIGTERM now. close() alone
   * would leave a running turn to go on until its stdin-EOF grace is over, and then signal the leader only.
   */
  terminate(): void {
    this.inbox.end();
    this.query.close();
    void this.proc?.signalGroup('SIGTERM');
  }

  private pushUser(text: string, uuid: ReturnType<typeof randomUUID>): void {
    // No priority: the default folds it into a running turn at the next tool boundary (8.3).
    this.inbox.push({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: text }, parent_tool_use_id: null, uuid });
  }

  private emit(event: AgentEvent): void {
    if (this.queue.ended) return;
    if (event.type === 'turn_started') this.firstTurnPending = false;
    this.queue.push(event);
  }

  private readonly preCompact: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const trigger = input.hook_event_name === 'PreCompact' ? input.trigger : 'auto';
    this.emit({ type: 'warning', text: `Claude is compacting its context (${trigger})` });
    return {};
  };

  private readonly postCompact: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    if (input.hook_event_name === 'PostCompact') {
      this.emit({ type: 'compacted', summary: input.compact_summary || null });
    }
    return {};
  };

  /** Maps every frame until the SDK's stream ends, then waits for the exit and ends the events after it. */
  private async pump(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      for await (const frame of this.query) this.take(frame);
    } catch {
      // A crash or a kill ends the stream with an error; the exit and stderr say what happened.
    }
    if (this.proc === null) this.exit.resolve({ code: null, signal: null });
    const exit = await this.exited;
    await this.stderrRead();
    this.first.resolve(null);
    for (const event of this.mapper.ended(crashError(this.stderrTail(), exit))) this.emit(event);
    this.queue.end();
  }

  private take(frame: unknown): void {
    if (this.refused) return;
    if (!this.initSeen && isRecord(frame) && frame.type === 'system' && frame.subtype === 'init') {
      this.initSeen = true;
      const init = frame as unknown as SDKSystemMessage;
      const problems = this.checkInit(init);
      this.first.resolve({ init, problems });
      if (problems.length > 0) {
        // A session that is not the one the options asked for does no work (X-29).
        this.refused = true;
        this.emit({ type: 'warning', text: `the session does not match its options: ${problems.join('; ')}` });
        this.terminate();
        return;
      }
    }
    for (const event of this.mapper.map(frame)) this.emit(event);
  }
}

/** A turn's error when the CLI ends inside it: the end of its stderr, then how it exited. */
function crashError(stderrTail: string, exit: ExitInfo): string {
  const tail = stderrTail.trim();
  const kept = tail.length > CLAUDE_CRASH_TAIL_CHARS ? `…${tail.slice(-(CLAUDE_CRASH_TAIL_CHARS - 1))}` : tail;
  const how =
    exit.signal !== null
      ? `claude was ended by ${exit.signal}`
      : exit.code !== null
        ? `claude exited with code ${exit.code}`
        : 'claude could not be started';
  return kept === '' ? how : `${kept}\n${how}`;
}
```

### Task 18: ClaudeAdapter.start and the first-turn check

`ClaudeAdapter.start` (design 8.1, 8.2, 7.4, 13). It checks the binary of `launch.cliVersion` with only the launch's `PATH` (X-13), builds the options with the effective permission mode (acceptEdits unless the last preflight saw auto offered, 7.6), pushes the first prompt and resolves once the first `system/init` passes the first-turn check. A mismatch fails the start with the problems and does nothing else (X-29): the CLI's group is SIGTERMed at once and SIGKILLed after 5 s. A start that sees no first turn within `CLAUDE_START_TIMEOUT_MS` (the brief hook's 60 s plus 60 s) fails the same way. A resume pushes no prompt and resolves once the CLI answers initialize; its first turn is checked when the controller's message starts it, and a mismatch then ends the session (X-50). `started` stays the first event, and `readTranscriptTail` and `deleteTranscript` are bound to the adapter's Claude home.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import {
  chmodSync,
  existsSync,
  mkdirSync,
  mkdtempSync,
  readFileSync,
  realpathSync,
  rmSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { linkClaudeBinary } from '@agflow/testkit/src/anthropic';
import {
  CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR,
  type ClaudeRecording,
  claudeRecording,
  FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN,
  type FakeClaudeLogEntry,
  fakeClaudeEnv,
  loadRecording,
  parseRecording,
  type RecordingStep,
  readFakeClaudeLog,
} from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import { ClaudeAdapter, type ClaudeAdapterOptions } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/adapter';
import { claudeBinary } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/options';
import { claudeProjectDir } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/paths';
import { CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/pin';
import type { AgentEvent, AgentLaunch, AgentSession, VendorAdapter } from '../../../src/adapters/types';
import { runnerPaths } from '../../../src/paths';
import { standardProfile } from '../../../src/profile';

// macOS's first exec of a new script is slow, more so under load.
const TIMEOUT = 30_000;
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

const dirs: string[] = [];
const groups = new Set<number>();
const sessions: AgentSession[] = [];

afterEach(async () => {
  for (const session of sessions.splice(0)) await session.close();
  for (const pgid of groups) {
    try {
      process.kill(-pgid, 'SIGKILL');
    } catch {
      // Already gone.
    }
  }
  groups.clear();
  for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

beforeAll(() => {
  // Warm the script and Bun's transpile cache once, so the first test does not pay for it.
  Bun.spawnSync([FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, '--version'], { env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN: process.execPath } });
}, TIMEOUT);

interface Setup {
  adapter: ClaudeAdapter;
  launch: AgentLaunch;
  /** The fake's log. */
  log: string;
  /** The pids registerProcess got, in order. */
  registered: number[];
  paths: ReturnType<typeof runnerPaths>;
}

/** A runner layout, its adapter, and a launch of the given recording; the fake is the pinned claude unless told. */
function setup(
  recording: ClaudeRecording,
  options: { binary?: 'fake' | 'none'; adapter?: Partial<ClaudeAdapterOptions> } = {},
): Setup {
  const root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-claude-adapter-')));
  dirs.push(root);
  const paths = runnerPaths(join(root, '.agflow'));
  if (options.binary !== 'none') linkClaudeBinary(paths.home, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN);
  const clone = join(paths.work, 'p-1', 'T-1-a1');
  const tmpDir = join(root, 'tmp');
  const home = join(root, 'home');
  for (const dir of [clone, tmpDir, home, paths.homes.claude]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const fake = fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir: join(root, 'fake') });
  const registered: number[] = [];
  const launch: AgentLaunch = {
    attemptId: 'T-1-a1',
    role: 'worker',
    model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
    cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
    clone,
    baseCheckout: paths.baseCheckout('p-1', '0123456789abcdef'),
    projectConfigVerified: true,
    tmpDir,
    env: {
      HOME: home,
      PATH: `${dirname(process.execPath)}:/usr/bin:/bin`,
      CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: paths.homes.claude,
      CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR: tmpDir,
      ...fake,
    },
    bridge: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: ['mcp', '--vendor', 'claude', '--runner'], env: {}, tools: [] },
    profile: standardProfile,
    brief: 'brief',
    firstPrompt: 'Start with the task.',
    resume: null,
    logFile: join(root, 'attempt.log'),
    registerProcess: (pid) => {
      registered.push(pid);
      groups.add(pid);
    },
  };
  const adapter = new ClaudeAdapter({
    agflow: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: [] },
    paths,
    vendorHomes: { claude: paths.homes.claude, codex: paths.homes.codex },
    ...options.adapter,
  });
  return { adapter, launch, log: fake.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG as string, registered, paths };
}

/** A shell script as the claude of a version, run once with --warm: macOS's first exec of a new script is slow. */
function stub(paths: Setup['paths'], version: string, body: string[]): void {
  const bin = claudeBinary(paths, version);
  mkdirSync(dirname(bin), { recursive: true });
  rmSync(bin, { force: true });
  writeFileSync(bin, `${['#!/bin/sh', '[ "$1" = --warm ] && exit 0', ...body].join('\n')}\n`);
  chmodSync(bin, 0o755);
  Bun.spawnSync([bin, '--warm']);
}

/** The transcript of a session that ran a turn, in the clone's project directory: what a resume resumes (8.4). */
function ranATurn(fixture: Setup, sessionRef: string): void {
  const dir = claudeProjectDir(fixture.paths.homes.claude, fixture.launch.clone);
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const prompt = { type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: 'Start with the task.' } };
  writeFileSync(join(dir, `${sessionRef}.jsonl`), `${JSON.stringify(prompt)}\n`);
}

/** A recording whose system/init frames name another CLI version. */
function initVersion(name: string, version: string): ClaudeRecording {
  const text = readFileSync(join(CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, `${name}.jsonl`), 'utf8');
  const pinned = `"claude_code_version":"${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}"`;
  return parseRecording(text.replaceAll(pinned, `"claude_code_version":"${version}"`));
}

/** The recording with its first turn held after its system/init, where stdin EOF does not end the CLI (design 3). */
function stalledAfterInit(recording: ClaudeRecording): ClaudeRecording {
  const [turn = [], ...rest] = recording.turns;
  const init = turn.findIndex(
    (step) => 'frame' in step && step.frame.type === 'system' && step.frame.subtype === 'init',
  );
  const held: RecordingStep[] = [...turn.slice(0, init + 1), { ignoreEof: true }, { sleep: 60_000 }];
  return { ...recording, turns: [held, ...rest] };
}

async function start(adapter: ClaudeAdapter, launch: AgentLaunch): Promise<AgentSession> {
  const session = await adapter.start(launch);
  sessions.push(session);
  return session;
}

/** The first n events of a session. */
async function firstEvents(session: AgentSession, n: number): Promise<AgentEvent[]> {
  const events: AgentEvent[] = [];
  for await (const event of session.events) {
    events.push(event);
    if (events.length === n) break;
  }
  return events;
}

async function argvOf(log: string): Promise<Extract<FakeClaudeLogEntry, { kind: 'argv' }>> {
  const entry = (await readFakeClaudeLog(log)).find((line) => line.kind === 'argv');
  if (entry?.kind !== 'argv') throw new Error('the fake logged no argv');
  return entry;
}

function alive(pid: number): boolean {
  try {
    process.kill(pid, 0);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

describe('ClaudeAdapter.start', () => {
  test(
    "it reads the binary of launch.cliVersion first: a missing one is 'binary missing', another version is named",
    async () => {
      const missing = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'), { binary: 'none' });
      await expect(missing.adapter.start(missing.launch)).rejects.toThrow('binary missing');

      const older = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'), { binary: 'none' });
      stub(older.paths, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, ['echo "2.1.200 (Claude Code)"']);
      await expect(older.adapter.start(older.launch)).rejects.toThrow(
        `claude 2.1.200, expected ${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}`,
      );
      expect([...missing.registered, ...older.registered]).toEqual([]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "the binary and the first-turn check follow launch.cliVersion, not the pin: a resume's older CLI",
    async () => {
      // Only the pin's binary is there.
      const missing = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
      await expect(missing.adapter.start({ ...missing.launch, cliVersion: '2.1.200' })).rejects.toThrow(
        'binary missing',
      );

      const wrong = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
      stub(wrong.paths, '2.1.200', [`echo "${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION} (Claude Code)"`]);
      await expect(wrong.adapter.start({ ...wrong.launch, cliVersion: '2.1.200' })).rejects.toThrow(
        `claude ${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}, expected 2.1.200`,
      );

      // The version check gets only PATH, so the older claude is a script that answers it and runs the fake.
      const older = [
        '[ "$1" = --version ] && { echo "2.1.200 (Claude Code)"; exit 0; }',
        `exec '${FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN}' "$@"`,
      ];
      const ok = setup(initVersion('turn-basic', '2.1.200'));
      stub(ok.paths, '2.1.200', older);
      const session = await start(ok.adapter, { ...ok.launch, cliVersion: '2.1.200' });
      const [started] = await firstEvents(session, 1);
      expect(started).toMatchObject({ type: 'started', cliVersion: '2.1.200' });

      // A first turn of the pin's version is not the attempt's.
      const pinned = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
      stub(pinned.paths, '2.1.200', older);
      await expect(pinned.adapter.start({ ...pinned.launch, cliVersion: '2.1.200' })).rejects.toThrow(
        new Error(`claude ${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}, expected 2.1.200`),
      );
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a model alias, a launch without a base checkout and a clone slug over 200 characters are refused before spawning',
    async () => {
      const { adapter, launch, log, registered, paths } = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
      await expect(adapter.start({ ...launch, model: 'sonnet' })).rejects.toThrow(/not a full model id/);
      await expect(adapter.start({ ...launch, baseCheckout: null })).rejects.toThrow(/base checkout/);
      const deep = join(paths.work, 'p-1', 'x'.repeat(200));
      mkdirSync(deep, { recursive: true });
      await expect(adapter.start({ ...launch, clone: deep })).rejects.toThrow(/refuses the clone/);
      expect(registered).toEqual([]);
      expect(existsSync(log)).toBe(false);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'it pushes the first prompt and resolves after the first system/init; started comes first, after the pid',
    async () => {
      const { adapter, launch, log, registered } = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
      const session = await start(adapter, launch);
      expect(session.sessionRef).toMatch(UUID);
      expect(registered).toEqual([session.pid]);
      const [started, turn] = await firstEvents(session, 2);
      expect(started).toEqual({
        type: 'started',

        model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',

      expect(users[0]).toMatchObject({ message: { message: { role: 'user', content: 'Start with the task.' } } });
    },

  test(
    "a first system/init that does not match closes the session and rejects start() with the problems",
    async () => {
      const { adapter, launch, registered } = setup(loadRecording('init-mismatch'));
      await expect(adapter.start(launch)).rejects.toThrow(

    async () => {

      // SIGTERM came with the refusal; the SDK's close() alone would wait 2 s, then signal the leader only.
      expect((exit?.at ?? Infinity) - (prompt?.at ?? 0)).toBeLessThan(1_500);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "a new session's CLI that ends before its first turn fails the start with how it exited and its stderr",
    async () => {
      const { adapter, launch, registered } = setup(claudeRecording({ turns: [[{ stderr: 'boom\n' }, { exit: 3 }]] }));
      await expect(adapter.start(launch)).rejects.toThrow(
        new Error('claude ended before its first turn: exit code 3: boom'),
      );
      expect(registered).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(alive(registered[0] as number)).toBe(false);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a CLI that starts no turn within the deadline fails the start; one that ignores SIGTERM is killed',
    async () => {
      const { adapter, launch, registered, paths } = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'), {
        adapter: { startTimeoutMs: 1_000 },
      });
      stub(paths, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, [
        `[ "$1" = --version ] && { echo "${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION} (Claude Code)"; exit 0; }`,
        "trap '' TERM",
        'exec /bin/sleep 600',
      ]);
      await expect(adapter.start(launch)).rejects.toThrow(
        new Error('claude started no turn within 1 s: ended by SIGKILL'),
      );
      expect(alive(registered[0] as number)).toBe(false);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'with the auto profile and a last preflight that did not offer auto, the session runs acceptEdits and says so',
    async () => {
      const { adapter, launch, log } = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
      const session = await start(adapter, { ...launch, profile: { ...standardProfile, name: 'auto' } });
      const [started] = await firstEvents(session, 1);
      expect(started).toMatchObject({ type: 'started', permissionMode: 'acceptEdits' });
      const { argv } = await argvOf(log);
      expect(argv[argv.indexOf('--permission-mode') + 1]).toBe('acceptEdits');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "the child's environment holds no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_* from the runner's own environment",
    async () => {
      const { adapter, launch, log } = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
      const saved = { key: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, bedrock: process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK };
      process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = 'sk-ant-runner-own';
      process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK = '1';
      try {
        await start(adapter, launch);
      } finally {
        if (saved.key === undefined) delete process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
        else process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = saved.key;
        if (saved.bedrock === undefined) delete process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK;
        else process.env.CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK = saved.bedrock;
      }
      const { env } = await argvOf(log);
      expect(env).not.toContain('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY');
      expect(env).not.toContain('CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK');
      expect(env).toContain('CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR');
      expect(env).toContain('CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "skipAuthChecks leaves the first turn's API key source be; without it, the key fails the start",
    async () => {
      const text = readFileSync(join(CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, 'turn-basic.jsonl'), 'utf8');
      const keyed = parseRecording(text.replaceAll('"apiKeySource":"none"', '"apiKeySource":"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"'));
      const strict = setup(keyed);
      await expect(strict.adapter.start(strict.launch)).rejects.toThrow('an API key would replace the subscription');
      const test = setup(keyed, { adapter: { skipAuthChecks: true } });
      const session = await start(test.adapter, test.launch);
      expect(await firstEvents(session, 1)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ type: 'started' })]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test('Claude raises no approvals, so the adapter has no enrichApproval (X-5)', () => {
    const { adapter } = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
    expect('enrichApproval' in adapter).toBe(false);
    expect((adapter as Partial<VendorAdapter>).enrichApproval).toBeUndefined();
  });

  test(
    'a resume passes the session id, pushes no prompt, and resolves once the CLI answers initialize',
    async () => {
      const fixture = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
      const { adapter, launch, log } = fixture;
      const sessionRef = 'aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
      ranATurn(fixture, sessionRef);
      const session = await start(adapter, { ...launch, resume: { sessionRef } });
      expect(session.sessionRef).toBe(sessionRef);
      expect((await argvOf(log)).argv).toContain(`--resume=${sessionRef}`);
      expect((await readFakeClaudeLog(log)).some((entry) => entry.kind === 'user')).toBe(false);
      await session.send({ id: 'm-1', text: 'Carry on.', authority: 'system' });
      // The message starts before system/init comes, yet started stays the first event.
      expect(await firstEvents(session, 3)).toEqual([
        expect.objectContaining({ type: 'started', sessionRef }),
        { type: 'turn_started' },
        { type: 'delivered', id: 'm-1' },
      ]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "a resumed session's first turn is checked when the runner's message starts it: a mismatch ends the session",
    async () => {
      const fixture = setup(loadRecording('init-mismatch'));
      const { adapter, launch } = fixture;
      const sessionRef = 'aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
      ranATurn(fixture, sessionRef);
      const session = await start(adapter, { ...launch, resume: { sessionRef } });
      await session.send({ id: 'm-1', text: 'Carry on.', authority: 'system' });
      const events: AgentEvent[] = [];
      for await (const event of session.events) events.push(event);
      const problems = `claude 2.1.200, expected ${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}; unexpected MCP servers: github`;
      expect(events).toEqual([{ type: 'warning', text: `the session does not match its options: ${problems}` }]);
      expect((await session.exited).signal).toBeNull();
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "a resumed CLI that ends before it answers initialize fails the start with the CLI's error, once it is gone",
    async () => {
      const recording = claudeRecording({ startup: [{ stderr: 'boom\n' }, { exit: 3 }], turns: [] });
      const fixture = setup(recording);
      const { adapter, launch, registered } = fixture;
      const sessionRef = 'aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
      ranATurn(fixture, sessionRef);
      const failure = adapter.start({ ...launch, resume: { sessionRef } });
      await expect(failure).rejects.toThrow(/exit code 3: boom$/);
      expect(registered).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(alive(registered[0] as number)).toBe(false);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

describe('the transcripts', () => {
  test("readTranscriptTail and deleteTranscript apply to the adapter's Claude home", async () => {
    const { adapter, launch } = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
    const sessionRef = 'bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
    const dir = claudeProjectDir(launch.env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR as string, launch.clone);
    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const said = (text: string) =>
      JSON.stringify({ type: 'assistant', message: { role: 'assistant', content: [{ type: 'text', text }] } });
    const prompt = JSON.stringify({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: 'go' } });
    writeFileSync(join(dir, `${sessionRef}.jsonl`), `${[prompt, said('first'), prompt, said('second')].join('\n')}\n`);
    const ref = { sessionRef, clone: launch.clone };
    expect(await adapter.readTranscriptTail({ ...ref, maxChars: 100 })).toBe('first\n\nsecond');
    await adapter.deleteTranscript(ref);
    expect(existsSync(join(dir, `${sessionRef}.jsonl`))).toBe(false);
    expect(await adapter.readTranscriptTail({ ...ref, maxChars: 100 })).toBeNull();
  });
});
```
