```ts
// The Claude adapter (design 8, 13): it starts sessions of the pinned claude and reads and deletes their transcripts
// under the runner's Claude home. A start checks the binary of the attempt's CLI version first (7.4, X-13), then
// spawns the session, pushes the first prompt and resolves once the first system/init passes the first-turn check
// (8.1). A mismatch fails the start and does nothing else (X-29), and so does a CLI that starts no turn within the
// start's deadline. The auto profile runs acceptEdits unless the last preflight saw the account offer auto mode (7.6).
import type { Vendor } from '@agflow/core';
import type { RunnerPaths } from '../../paths';
import { boundedWait } from '../../processes';
import type { AgentLaunch, AgentSession, AgflowCommand, ExitInfo } from '../types';
import { checkSystemInit, type SystemInitExpectation } from './checks';
import { CLAUDE_BRIEF_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S, claudeBinary, claudeTools, effectivePermissionMode } from './options';
import { readClaudeVersion } from './pin';
import { QuotaBook } from './quota';
import { ClaudeSession } from './session';
import { deleteClaudeTranscript, readClaudeTranscriptTail } from './transcript';

/** How long a failed start waits for the CLI it ended to exit, before it kills the CLI's group. */
const FAILED_START_EXIT_MS = 5_000;

/** How long a killed CLI gets to be reaped. */
const KILLED_EXIT_MS = 1_000;

/**
 * How long a start waits for the first turn of a new session, or for a resumed CLI's answer to initialize: a minute
 * above the brief hook's timeout. The attempt's later stop waits behind the start, so the start must end.
 */
export const CLAUDE_START_TIMEOUT_MS = (CLAUDE_BRIEF_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S + 60) * 1_000;
const DEFAULT_PATH = '/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin';

export interface ClaudeAdapterOptions {
  /** How the runner runs agflow; the brief hook runs it (X-5). */
  agflow: AgflowCommand;
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  /** vendorHomes(config, paths): the Claude home is every launch's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. */
  vendorHomes: Record<Vendor, string>;
  /** Test mode (15.1): the scripted server's API key is expected, so the first-turn check leaves apiKeySource be. */
  skipAuthChecks?: boolean;
  /** CLAUDE_START_TIMEOUT_MS by default. */
  startTimeoutMs?: number;
}

export class ClaudeAdapter {
  readonly vendor = 'claude' as const;
  /** The last quota per account, which every session reports into. */
  readonly quota = new QuotaBook();
  /** Whether the last preflight saw the account offer auto mode; before any preflight, it did not. */
  protected autoOffered = false;
  /** The account the last preflight saw; the sessions' quota events name it. */
  protected accountId: string | null = null;

  constructor(protected readonly options: ClaudeAdapterOptions) {}

  async start(launch: AgentLaunch): Promise<AgentSession> {
    // The binary that wrote the session, or the pin for a new one (X-13); --version needs no more than PATH.
    const version = await readClaudeVersion(claudeBinary(this.options.paths, launch.cliVersion), launch.cliVersion, {
      env: { PATH: launch.env.PATH ?? DEFAULT_PATH },
    });
    if (!version.ok) throw new Error(version.problem);
    // Taken once, so the options and the check agree even if a preflight runs meanwhile.
    const expected = this.firstTurnExpectation(launch);
    if (!launch.resume) return this.startNew(launch, expected);
    // A resumed session waits for the runner's message, which M2b's controller sends only once start() resolved: so
    // the start resolves once the CLI answers initialize, and the first turn is checked when that message starts it.
    // A mismatch then ends the session (a warning, then SIGTERM), which the hub sees as an exit nobody asked for, not
    // as a failed start (a refinement of 8.1 and X-29).
    const session = this.session(launch, expected);
    const answered = session.initialization().then(
      () => null,
      (error: Error) => error,
    );
    const answer = await this.withinStart(answered);
    if (!answer.done) {
      const problem = `claude did not answer initialize within ${this.startSeconds()} s`;
      throw await this.failedStart(session, problem, { exit: true });
    }
    if (answer.value !== null) throw await this.failedStart(session, answer.value.message, { exit: true });
    return session;
  }

  /** A new session: it pushes the first prompt and resolves once its first system/init passes the check. */
  private async startNew(launch: AgentLaunch, expected: SystemInitExpectation): Promise<ClaudeSession> {
    const session = this.session(launch, expected);
    const first = await this.withinStart(session.firstInit);
    if (!first.done) {
      const problem = `claude started no turn within ${this.startSeconds()} s`;
      throw await this.failedStart(session, problem, { exit: true });
    }
    if (first.value === null) {
      throw await this.failedStart(session, 'claude ended before its first turn', { exit: true });
    }
    if (first.value.problems.length > 0) {
      throw await this.failedStart(session, first.value.problems.join('; '), { exit: false });
    }
    return session;
  }

  /** A start's wait for the CLI, bounded by the start's deadline. */
  private withinStart<T>(promise: Promise<T>): Promise<{ done: true; value: T } | { done: false }> {
    return boundedWait(promise, this.options.startTimeoutMs ?? CLAUDE_START_TIMEOUT_MS);
  }

  private startSeconds(): number {
    return Math.round((this.options.startTimeoutMs ?? CLAUDE_START_TIMEOUT_MS) / 1_000);
  }

  /**
   * The session of a launch: a new one with its first prompt, or the resume of launch.resume. The options refuse a
   * model alias, a launch without a base checkout and a clone whose project name the CLI would hash, before anything
   * is spawned.
   */
  private session(launch: AgentLaunch, expected: SystemInitExpectation): ClaudeSession {
    return new ClaudeSession({
      launch,
      deps: {
        agflow: this.options.agflow,
        paths: this.options.paths,
        vendorHomes: this.options.vendorHomes,
        autoOffered: expected.permissionMode === 'auto',
      },
      firstPrompt: launch.resume ? null : launch.firstPrompt,
      accountId: this.accountId,
      quota: this.quota,
      checkInit: (init) => checkSystemInit(init, expected),
    });
  }

  /** The end of a session's transcript under the runner's Claude home (8.3). */
  readTranscriptTail(input: { sessionRef: string; clone: string; maxChars: number }): Promise<string | null> {
    return readClaudeTranscriptTail(this.options.vendorHomes.claude, input);
  }

  /** cleanup_attempt and retention (7.8). */
  deleteTranscript(input: { sessionRef: string; clone: string }): Promise<void> {
    return deleteClaudeTranscript(this.options.vendorHomes.claude, input);
  }

  /** What the first turn's system/init must say: the attempt's CLI version and the mode the session runs in. */
  private firstTurnExpectation(launch: AgentLaunch): SystemInitExpectation {
    return {
      cliVersion: launch.cliVersion,
      permissionMode: effectivePermissionMode(launch.profile, this.autoOffered),
      tools: claudeTools(launch.profile),
      skipAuthChecks: this.options.skipAuthChecks,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Ends the session's process group, and kills it when it does not exit within a bounded wait, so no work runs after
   * the start failed. The error is the problem, and for a CLI that ended by itself also how it exited and its last
   * stderr lines.
   */
  private async failedStart(session: ClaudeSession, problem: string, options: { exit: boolean }): Promise<Error> {
    session.terminate();
    let exit = await boundedWait(session.exited, FAILED_START_EXIT_MS);
    if (!exit.done) {
      session.kill();
      exit = await boundedWait(session.exited, KILLED_EXIT_MS);
    }
    if (!options.exit) return new Error(problem);
    await session.stderrRead();
    const how = exit.done ? exitText(exit.value) : null;
    const parts = [problem, how, session.stderrTail().trim()];
    return new Error(parts.filter((part) => part !== null && part !== '').join(': '));
  }
}

function exitText(exit: ExitInfo): string | null {
  if (exit.signal !== null) return `ended by ${exit.signal}`;
  return exit.code !== null && exit.code !== 0 ? `exit code ${exit.code}` : null;
}
```

Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/adapter-start.test.ts packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/options.test.ts packages/testkit/test/fake-claude.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: the task's tests pass (`0 fail`); then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

`init-mismatch.jsonl` is synthesised from `turn-basic` with `claude_code_version` 2.1.200 and an extra `github` MCP server, so the start fails with 'claude 2.1.200, expected 2.1.285; unexpected MCP servers: github'. The fake's argv log now carries the names, never the values, of its environment variables. `ClaudeAdapter` implements `VendorAdapter` from Task 21, which adds preflight. Literal bridge configurations include `tools: []`; their bridge environment has no `AGFLOW_ROLE`, matching `bridgeOf`. Preflight obtains its bridge through `bridgeOf`.

### Task 19: Resume and the never-ran-turn fallback

A session that never ran a turn cannot be resumed: 2.1.285 prints 'No conversation found' and exits before it answers initialize (design 8.4, 7.4). So before spawning a resume, `hasClaudeConversation` looks in the clone's project directory for the session's transcript with a main-thread user or assistant line; without one, the adapter starts a fresh session in the same clone with the first prompt and reports its new `sessionRef`. One launch therefore spawns and registers one process, as M2b's `ProcessRegistration` requires (X-50). A resume the CLI refuses anyway, and any other resume failure, fails the start with the CLI's error once the process is gone. The two failure recordings are captured from 2.1.285, and the recorder gains resume scenarios.

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { chmodSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { linkClaudeBinary } from '@agflow/testkit/src/anthropic';
import {
  type ClaudeRecording,
  CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR,
  FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN,
  type FakeClaudeLogEntry,
  fakeClaudeEnv,
  loadRecording,
  parseRecording,
  readFakeClaudeLog,
} from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import {
  CLAUDE_SCENARIOS,
  type ClaudeScenario,
  recordingOf,
  runScenario,
  scratchLaunch,
} from '../../../scripts/record-claude-stream';
import { ClaudeAdapter } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/adapter';
import { claudeBinary } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/options';
import { claudeProjectDir } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/paths';
import { CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/pin';
import type { AgentEvent, AgentLaunch, AgentSession } from '../../../src/adapters/types';
import { runnerPaths } from '../../../src/paths';
import { standardProfile } from '../../../src/profile';

// macOS's first exec of a new script is slow, more so under load.
const TIMEOUT = 30_000;
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const SESSION_REF = 'cccccccc-0000-4000-8000-000000000003';
/** An older CLI version an attempt may have started with (X-13). */
const OLDER = '2.1.280';
/** What 2.1.285 says when it resumes a session without a conversation (captured in resume-not-found). */
const NOT_FOUND = 'No conversation found with session ID';

const dirs: string[] = [];
const groups = new Set<number>();
const sessions: AgentSession[] = [];

afterEach(async () => {
  for (const session of sessions.splice(0)) await session.close();
  for (const pgid of groups) {
    try {
      process.kill(-pgid, 'SIGKILL');
    } catch {
      // Already gone.
    }
  }
  groups.clear();
  for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

beforeAll(() => {
  // Warm the script and Bun's transpile cache once, so the first test does not pay for it.
  Bun.spawnSync([FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, '--version'], { env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN: process.execPath } });
}, TIMEOUT);

interface Setup {
  root: string;
  adapter: ClaudeAdapter;
  launch: AgentLaunch;
  /** The fake's log. */
  log: string;
  /** The pids registerProcess got, in order, across the launches. */
  registered: number[];
  paths: ReturnType<typeof runnerPaths>;
  /** A registerProcess for another launch. */
  registration(): AgentLaunch['registerProcess'];
}

/** A runner layout, its adapter, and a launch of the recording, with the fake as the pinned claude. */
function setup(recording: ClaudeRecording): Setup {
  const root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-claude-resume-')));
  dirs.push(root);
  const paths = runnerPaths(join(root, '.agflow'));
  linkClaudeBinary(paths.home, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN);
  const clone = join(paths.work, 'p-1', 'T-1-a1');
  const tmpDir = join(root, 'tmp');
  const home = join(root, 'home');
  for (const dir of [clone, tmpDir, home, paths.homes.claude]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const fake = fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir: join(root, 'fake') });
  const registered: number[] = [];
  // As M2b's ProcessRegistration: a launch registers one process, and a second one is refused.
  const registration = (): AgentLaunch['registerProcess'] => {
    let pid: number | null = null;
    return (next) => {
      if (pid !== null) throw new Error(`the agent was already registered (pid ${pid})`);
      pid = next;
      registered.push(next);
      groups.add(next);
    };
  };
  const launch: AgentLaunch = {
    attemptId: 'T-1-a1',
    role: 'worker',
    model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
    cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
    clone,
    baseCheckout: paths.baseCheckout('p-1', '0123456789abcdef'),
    projectConfigVerified: true,
    tmpDir,
    env: {
      HOME: home,
      PATH: `${dirname(process.execPath)}:/usr/bin:/bin`,
      CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: paths.homes.claude,
      CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR: tmpDir,
      ...fake,
    },
    bridge: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: ['mcp', '--vendor', 'claude', '--runner'], env: {}, tools: [] },
    profile: standardProfile,
    brief: 'brief',
    firstPrompt: 'Start with the task.',
    resume: null,
    logFile: join(root, 'attempt.log'),
    registerProcess: registration(),
  };
  const adapter = new ClaudeAdapter({
    agflow: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: [] },
    paths,
    vendorHomes: { claude: paths.homes.claude, codex: paths.homes.codex },
  });
  return { root, adapter, launch, log: fake.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG as string, registered, paths, registration };
}

/** The transcript of a session that ran a turn, in the clone's project directory: what a resume resumes. */
function ranATurn(setup: Setup, sessionRef: string): void {
  const dir = claudeProjectDir(setup.paths.homes.claude, setup.launch.clone);
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const prompt = { type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: 'Start with the task.' } };
  writeFileSync(join(dir, `${sessionRef}.jsonl`), `${JSON.stringify(prompt)}\n`);
}

/**
 * A claude of the given version in the layout: it reports that version and runs the fake, after noting its working
 * directory in <root>/cwd. With notFound, a resume replays resume-not-found instead of the launch's recording.
 */
function wrapClaude(setup: Setup, version: string, options: { notFound?: boolean } = {}): void {
  const bin = claudeBinary(setup.paths, version);
  mkdirSync(dirname(bin), { recursive: true });
  rmSync(bin, { force: true });
  const notFound = join(CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, 'resume-not-found.jsonl');
  const lines = [
    '#!/bin/sh',
    `[ "$1" = --version ] && { echo "${version} (Claude Code)"; exit 0; }`,
    `pwd > '${join(setup.root, 'cwd')}'`,
    ...(options.notFound
      ? [`case " $* " in *" --resume"*) FAKE_CLAUDE_RECORDING='${notFound}'; export FAKE_CLAUDE_RECORDING;; esac`]
      : []),
    `exec '${FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN}' "$@"`,
  ];
  writeFileSync(bin, `${lines.join('\n')}\n`);
  chmodSync(bin, 0o755);
}

/** turn-basic as an older CLI printed it: its system/init names that version. */
function olderTurn(version: string): ClaudeRecording {
  const text = readFileSync(join(CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, 'turn-basic.jsonl'), 'utf8');
  return parseRecording(
    text.replaceAll(`"claude_code_version":"${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}"`, `"claude_code_version":"${version}"`),
  );
}

async function start(adapter: ClaudeAdapter, launch: AgentLaunch): Promise<AgentSession> {
  const session = await adapter.start(launch);
  sessions.push(session);
  return session;
}

/** The first n events of a session. */
async function firstEvents(session: AgentSession, n: number): Promise<AgentEvent[]> {
  const events: AgentEvent[] = [];
  for await (const event of session.events) {
    events.push(event);
    if (events.length === n) break;
  }
  return events;
}

async function argvs(log: string): Promise<string[][]> {
  return (await readFakeClaudeLog(log)).flatMap((entry: FakeClaudeLogEntry) =>
    entry.kind === 'argv' ? [entry.argv] : [],
  );
}

function alive(pid: number): boolean {
  try {
    process.kill(pid, 0);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

describe('ClaudeAdapter.start: resume', () => {
  test(
    "a resume passes resume: sessionRef with a new session's options, in its clone, with the attempt's CLI",
    async () => {
      const fixture = setup(olderTurn(OLDER));
      const { adapter, launch, log, root } = fixture;
      wrapClaude(fixture, OLDER);
      // A new session of the same launch on the pin, for its options.
      const fresh = await start(adapter, launch).catch((error: Error) => error);
      // The pin's fake replays the older init, which the first-turn check refuses; its argv is all this needs.
      expect(fresh).toBeInstanceOf(Error);

      ranATurn(fixture, SESSION_REF);
      const session = await start(adapter, {
        ...launch,
        cliVersion: OLDER,
        resume: { sessionRef: SESSION_REF },
        registerProcess: fixture.registration(),
      });
      expect(session.sessionRef).toBe(SESSION_REF);
      const [newArgv, resumeArgv] = await argvs(log);
      const asResume = (newArgv ?? []).map((arg) =>
        arg.startsWith('--session-id=') ? `--resume=${SESSION_REF}` : arg,
      );
      // The SDK places --resume elsewhere than --session-id; the arguments are the same.
      expect([...(resumeArgv ?? [])].sort()).toEqual(asResume.sort());
      // The binary of launch.cliVersion ran, in the clone.
      expect(readFileSync(join(root, 'cwd'), 'utf8').trim()).toBe(launch.clone);
      await session.send({ id: 'm-1', text: 'Carry on.', authority: 'system' });
      const [started] = await firstEvents(session, 1);
      expect(started).toEqual({
        type: 'started',
        sessionRef: SESSION_REF,
        model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
        cliVersion: OLDER,
        permissionMode: 'acceptEdits',
      });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a session that never ran a turn starts afresh in its clone with the first prompt; no resume is spawned',
    async () => {
      const queued = JSON.stringify({ type: 'queue-operation', operation: 'enqueue', content: 'Start with the task.' });
      // No transcript at all, and one the CLI wrote no message to.
      for (const transcript of [null, [queued]]) {
        const fixture = setup(loadRecording('turn-basic'));
        const { adapter, launch, log, registered } = fixture;
        // A resume, were one spawned, would replay resume-not-found.
        wrapClaude(fixture, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, { notFound: true });
        if (transcript !== null) {
          const dir = claudeProjectDir(fixture.paths.homes.claude, launch.clone);
          mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
          writeFileSync(join(dir, `${SESSION_REF}.jsonl`), `${transcript.join('\n')}\n`);
        }
        const session = await start(adapter, { ...launch, resume: { sessionRef: SESSION_REF } });
        expect(session.sessionRef).toMatch(UUID);
        expect(session.sessionRef).not.toBe(SESSION_REF);
        // One launch, one process: the registration M2b refuses twice took it.
        expect(registered).toEqual([session.pid]);
        expect(readFileSync(join(fixture.root, 'cwd'), 'utf8').trim()).toBe(launch.clone);
        const all = await argvs(log);
        expect(all).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(all[0]).toContain(`--session-id=${session.sessionRef}`);
        expect(all[0]?.some((arg) => arg.startsWith('--resume'))).toBe(false);
        const [started] = await firstEvents(session, 1);
        expect(started).toMatchObject({ type: 'started', sessionRef: session.sessionRef });
        const users = (await readFakeClaudeLog(log)).filter((entry) => entry.kind === 'user');
        expect(users).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(users[0]).toMatchObject({ message: { message: { role: 'user', content: 'Start with the task.' } } });
      }
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "a resume the CLI refuses with 'No conversation found' fails the start once the process is gone; no fallback",
    async () => {
      const fixture = setup(loadRecording('resume-not-found'));
      const { adapter, launch, registered } = fixture;
      ranATurn(fixture, SESSION_REF);
      const failure = adapter.start({ ...launch, resume: { sessionRef: SESSION_REF } });
      await expect(failure).rejects.toThrow(NOT_FOUND);
      await expect(failure).rejects.toThrow(/exit code 1/);
      expect(registered).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(alive(registered[0] as number)).toBe(false);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "any other resume failure rejects start() with the CLI's error once the process is gone",
    async () => {
      const fixture = setup(loadRecording('resume-failure'));
      const { adapter, launch, registered } = fixture;
      ranATurn(fixture, SESSION_REF);
      const failure = adapter.start({ ...launch, resume: { sessionRef: SESSION_REF } });
      await expect(failure).rejects.toThrow(/--resume requires a valid session ID.*: exit code 1$/);
      expect(registered).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(alive(registered[0] as number)).toBe(false);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

describe('the resume recordings', () => {
  function scenario(name: string): ClaudeScenario {
    const found = CLAUDE_SCENARIOS.find((entry) => entry.name === name);
    if (!found) throw new Error(`no scenario ${name}`);
    return found;
  }

  for (const name of ['resume-not-found', 'resume-failure']) {
    test(
      `${name} replays through the recorder as it was captured: an error result, stderr and exit 1`,
      async () => {
        const recording = loadRecording(name);
        expect(recording.header).toMatchObject({ source: 'captured', cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION });
        const launch = scratchLaunch({ bin: FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, model: recording.header.model, env: {} });
        try {
          Object.assign(launch.launch.env, fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir: join(launch.root, 'fake') }));
          const run = await runScenario(scenario(name), launch);
          expect(run.exit).toEqual({ code: 1, signal: null });
          expect(run.startError).toContain(name === 'resume-not-found' ? NOT_FOUND : '--resume');
          const again = recordingOf(run, recording.header, launch, { live: false });
          expect(again.startup).toEqual(recording.startup);
          expect(again.turns).toEqual([]);
        } finally {
          launch.cleanup();
        }
      },
      TIMEOUT,
    );
  }
});

+/**
+ * Whether the clone's project directory, where the CLI resumes from, holds the session's transcript with a message of
+ * the main thread in it. A session that never ran a turn has none, and 2.1.285 refuses to resume it ('No conversation
+ * found'); the adapter then starts a fresh session instead of spawning a resume that fails (8.4, 7.4).
+ */
+export async function hasClaudeConversation(claudeHome: string, ref: ClaudeTranscriptRef): Promise<boolean> {
+  checkSessionRef(ref.sessionRef);
+  const own = ownProjectDir(claudeHome, ref.clone);
+  if (own === null) return false;
+  const path = join(own, `${ref.sessionRef}.jsonl`);
+  if (!(await isFile(path))) return false;
+  // Line by line, up to the first message: a long transcript is not read whole.
+  const input = createReadStream(path, { encoding: 'utf8' });
+  const lines = createInterface({ input, crlfDelay: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY });
+  try {
+    for await (const line of lines) {
+      const entry = parseEntry(line);
+      if (entry !== null && entry.isSidechain !== true && (entry.type === 'user' || entry.type === 'assistant')) {
+        return true;
+      }
+    }
+    return false;
+  } finally {
+    lines.close();
+    input.destroy();
+  }

### Task 20: Vendor outcomes through a live session

Limit hits, overage, auth, context, policy and vendor errors through a live session, as design 8.3 and 6.10 say. Where the scripted server can produce them, the recordings are captured from 2.1.285: a 401 (auth), a 400 'prompt is too long' (context), a refusal (policy), a 429 with one retry allowed and a 529 after retries (vendor). The subscription-only limit hit and overage-in-use are synthesised from captures by the recorder and marked so in their headers, because with an API key 2.1.285 ignores the unified rate-limit headers. Each recording is replayed through the adapter and through the recorder (a round trip); a 429 retry re-reports the last quota as `unknown`, never a limit hit. No adapter code changes: the task is the recordings, the recorder's scenarios and the tests.

import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, realpathSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';

// macOS's first exec of a new script is slow, more so under load.
const TIMEOUT = 30_000;

const dirs: string[] = [];
const groups = new Set<number>();
const sessions: AgentSession[] = [];

afterEach(async () => {
  for (const session of sessions.splice(0)) await session.close();
  for (const pgid of groups) {
    try {
      process.kill(-pgid, 'SIGKILL');
    } catch {
      // Already gone.
    }
  }
  groups.clear();
  for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

beforeAll(() => {
  // Warm the script and Bun's transpile cache once, so the first test does not pay for it.
  Bun.spawnSync([FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, '--version'], { env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN: process.execPath } });
}, TIMEOUT);

/** An adapter whose pinned claude is the fake, and a launch that replays the recording. */
function setup(scenario: string): { adapter: ClaudeAdapter; launch: AgentLaunch } {
  const root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-claude-outcomes-')));
  dirs.push(root);
  const paths = runnerPaths(join(root, '.agflow'));
  linkClaudeBinary(paths.home, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN);
  const clone = join(paths.work, 'p-1', 'T-1-a1');
  const tmpDir = join(root, 'tmp');
  const home = join(root, 'home');
  for (const dir of [clone, tmpDir, home, paths.homes.claude]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const launch: AgentLaunch = {
    attemptId: 'T-1-a1',
    role: 'worker',
    model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
    cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
    clone,
    baseCheckout: paths.baseCheckout('p-1', '0123456789abcdef'),
    projectConfigVerified: true,
    tmpDir,
    env: {
      HOME: home,
      PATH: `${dirname(process.execPath)}:/usr/bin:/bin`,
      CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: paths.homes.claude,
      CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR: tmpDir,
      ...fakeClaudeEnv({ recording: loadRecording(scenario), dir: join(root, 'fake') }),
    },
    bridge: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: ['mcp', '--vendor', 'claude', '--runner'], env: {}, tools: [] },
    profile: standardProfile,
    brief: 'brief',
    firstPrompt: 'Say hello in one word.',
    resume: null,
    logFile: join(root, 'attempt.log'),

  const adapter = new ClaudeAdapter({
    agflow: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: [] },
    paths,
    vendorHomes: { claude: paths.homes.claude, codex: paths.homes.codex },
  });
  return { adapter, launch };
}

/** Starts the recording's session and gives its events up to the end of its first turn. */
async function firstTurn(scenario: string, before?: (adapter: ClaudeAdapter) => void): Promise<AgentEvent[]> {
  const { adapter, launch } = setup(scenario);
  before?.(adapter);
  const session = await adapter.start(launch);
  sessions.push(session);
  const events: AgentEvent[] = [];
  for await (const event of session.events) {
    events.push(event);
    if (event.type === 'turn_ended') break;
  }
  return events;
}

const of = <T extends AgentEvent['type']>(events: AgentEvent[], type: T) =>
  events.filter((event): event is Extract<AgentEvent, { type: T }> => event.type === type);

const turnEnded = (events: AgentEvent[]) => of(events, 'turn_ended').at(-1);

describe('quota through a live session', () => {
  test(
    'a limit hit gives quota exhausted, then turn_ended failed with errorKind quota',
    async () => {
      const events = await firstTurn('limit-hit');
      const [quota] = of(events, 'quota');
      expect(quota).toMatchObject({
        accountId: null,
        quota: { state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: SYNTHESISED_RESET * 1000, windows: { fiveHour: 1 } },
      });
      expect(events.indexOf(quota as AgentEvent)).toBeLessThan(events.indexOf(turnEnded(events) as AgentEvent));
      expect(turnEnded(events)).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'failed', errorKind: 'quota', error: SYNTHESISED_LIMIT_TEXT });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'overage in use gives quota with paidUsage in_use and the notice; the adapter does not fail the turn itself',
    async () => {
      const events = await firstTurn('overage-in-use');
      const quotas = of(events, 'quota');
      expect(quotas.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      for (const { quota } of quotas) expect(quota).toMatchObject({ state: 'ok', paidUsage: 'in_use' });
      // The controller decides by allowPaidUsage (X-14): a limit hit only where the owner does not allow it.
      expect(isLimitHit((quotas[0] as (typeof quotas)[number]).quota, false)).toBe(true);
      expect(isLimitHit((quotas[0] as (typeof quotas)[number]).quota, true)).toBe(false);
      expect(of(events, 'warning')).toContainEqual({ type: 'warning', text: SYNTHESISED_OVERAGE_TEXT });
      expect(turnEnded(events)).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed', errorKind: null });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

describe('other outcomes through a live session', () => {
  for (const [scenario, kind] of [
    ['auth-expired', 'auth'],
    ['context-overflow', 'context'],
    ['policy-refusal', 'policy'],
  ] as const) {
    test(
      `${scenario} ends the turn failed with errorKind ${kind}`,
      async () => {
        const events = await firstTurn(scenario);
        expect(turnEnded(events)).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'failed', errorKind: kind, error: expect.any(String) });
        expect(of(events, 'quota')).toEqual([]);
      },
      TIMEOUT,
    );
  }

  test(
    'an api_retry with 429 gives a warning and the last known quota, never exhausted; after the retries, vendor',
    async () => {
      const known: VendorQuota = {
        state: 'exhausted',
        resetsAt: Date.now() - 60_000,
        windows: { fiveHour: 1, weekly: 0.4 },
        paidUsage: 'disabled',
        updatedAt: Date.now() - 120_000,
      };
      const events = await firstTurn('api-retry-429', (adapter) => adapter.quota.update(null, known));
      expect(of(events, 'warning')).toEqual([
        { type: 'warning', text: 'The API answered 429 (rate_limit); retry 1 of 1 in 1 s.' },
      ]);
      const quotas = of(events, 'quota');
      expect(quotas).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(quotas[0]?.quota).toMatchObject({ state: 'unknown', windows: known.windows, paidUsage: 'disabled' });
      expect(isLimitHit(quotas[0]?.quota as VendorQuota, false)).toBe(false);
      expect(turnEnded(events)).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'failed', errorKind: 'vendor' });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'an overloaded error after the retries gives errorKind vendor, and no quota',
    async () => {
      const events = await firstTurn('vendor-error');
      expect(of(events, 'warning')).toEqual([
        { type: 'warning', text: expect.stringMatching(/^The API answered 529 \(overloaded\); retry 1 of 1/) },
      ]);
      expect(of(events, 'quota')).toEqual([]);
      expect(turnEnded(events)).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'failed', errorKind: 'vendor' });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

describe('the outcome recordings', () => {
  const captured = ['auth-expired', 'context-overflow', 'policy-refusal', 'api-retry-429', 'vendor-error'];
  for (const name of [...captured, 'limit-hit', 'overage-in-use']) {
    test(
      `${name} replays through the recorder as it was written`,
      async () => {
        const recording = loadRecording(name);
        expect(recording.header).toMatchObject({
          cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
          source: captured.includes(name) ? 'captured' : 'synthesised',
        });
        const scenario = CLAUDE_SCENARIOS.find((entry) => entry.name === name);
        if (!scenario) throw new Error(`no scenario ${name}`);
        const launch = scratchLaunch({ bin: FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, model: recording.header.model, env: {} });
        try {
          Object.assign(launch.launch.env, fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir: join(launch.root, 'fake') }));

(dynamic workflow)","argumentHint":"","builtin":true},{"name":"dataviz","description":"Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: \"chart\", \"graph\", \"plot\", \"data viz\", \"visualization\", \"dashboard\", \"analytics\", \"visualize data\", \"categorical colors\", \"sequential / diverging palette\", \"stat tile\", \"sparkline\", \"heatmap\", \"legend\", \"axis\", \"tooltip\", \"chart colors\", \"color by series\".","argumentHint":"","builtin":true},{"name":"update-config","description":"Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. ### Task 21: Preflight: handshake, plan usage and weakened items

`ClaudeAdapter.preflight` (design 8.1, 6.1, 6.10, 7.6, 15.1, X-5, X-29): the pin's platform and the binary's version, then a zero-model handshake whose only input is `/clear`, with the full session options in a scratch clone and base checkout and a bridge whose hub URL refuses connections. On the same query it reads the account, `getSettings().effective` and the experimental usage call (`skipBehaviors: true`); the usage answer becomes the quota, else the `QuotaBook`'s last value, else null. It fails closed and returns facts only, with the quota and the weakened items `'auto'` (only when a fully ready auto handshake ran first) and `'/tmp/claude'` (when the pin's constant says its denyWrite fails); the runtime adds models, ceilings and the rest. The handshake has its own 60 s bound, never throws, makes the empty directory before it starts and removes its scratch directories, and under `skipAuthChecks` it reports test mode's identity. `ClaudeAdapter` now implements `VendorAdapter` and takes `config`.

import { afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import {
  chmodSync,
  existsSync,
  mkdirSync,
  mkdtempSync,
  readFileSync,
  realpathSync,
  rmSync,
  statSync,
  symlinkSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { TEST_ACCOUNT_ID, type VendorQuota } from '@agflow/core';
import { linkClaudeBinary } from '@agflow/testkit/src/anthropic';
import {
  CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR,
  type ClaudeRecording,
  claudeRecording,
  FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN,
  type FakeClaudeLogEntry,
  fakeClaudeEnv,
  loadRecording,
  readFakeClaudeLog,
  SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT,
  writeRecording,
} from '@agflow/testkit/src/fake-claude';
import { CLAUDE_SCENARIOS, recordingOf, runScenario, scratchLaunch } from '../../../scripts/record-claude-stream';
import { ClaudeAdapter } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/adapter';
import { claudeAccountId } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/checks';
import { claudeBinary, claudeEmptyDir } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/options';
import { CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/pin';
import {
  CLAUDE_WEAKENED_AUTO,
  CLAUDE_WEAKENED_TMP,
  claudePreflight,
  PREFLIGHT_HUB_URL,
} from '../../../src/adapters/claude/preflight';
import { QuotaBook } from '../../../src/adapters/claude/quota';
import type { AgentEvent, AgentLaunch, AgentSession } from '../../../src/adapters/types';
import { type RunnerConfig, RunnerConfigSchema } from '../../../src/config';
import { type RunnerPaths, runnerPaths } from '../../../src/paths';
import { standardProfile } from '../../../src/profile';

// macOS's first exec of a new script is slow, more so under load.
const TIMEOUT = 30_000;
// The pin's platform: these tests run the fake CLI, so they hold on any machine, CI's ubuntu included.
const PLATFORM = 'darwin-arm64';

const dirs: string[] = [];
const sessions: AgentSession[] = [];

afterEach(async () => {
  for (const session of sessions.splice(0)) await session.close();
  for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

beforeAll(() => {
  // Warm the script and Bun's transpile cache once, so the first test does not pay for it.
  Bun.spawnSync([FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, '--version'], { env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', FAKE_CLAUDE_BUN: process.execPath } });
}, TIMEOUT);

interface Setup {
  root: string;
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  config: RunnerConfig;
  /** The fake's log. */
  log: string;
  /** A directory on the captured PATH, empty unless a test puts an owner's claude there. */
  ownerBin: string;
  adapter(options?: { skipAuthChecks?: boolean; platform?: string }): ClaudeAdapter;
}

/** The fake's log entries of a kind. */
async function logOf<K extends FakeClaudeLogEntry['kind']>(
  log: string,
  kind: K,
): Promise<Extract<FakeClaudeLogEntry, { kind: K }>[]> {
  return (await readFakeClaudeLog(log)).filter(
    (entry): entry is Extract<FakeClaudeLogEntry, { kind: K }> => entry.kind === kind,
  );
}

/**
 * A runner layout whose pinned claude is the fake, in test mode, so runner.json's test.claudeEnv carries the fake's
 * variables into the handshake's environment, as it carries the scripted server's in M2g.
 */
function setup(
  recording: ClaudeRecording,
  options: { binary?: 'fake' | 'none'; profile?: 'standard' | 'auto'; handshakeMs?: number } = {},
): Setup {
  const root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-claude-preflight-')));
  dirs.push(root);
  const paths = runnerPaths(join(root, '.agflow'));
  if (options.binary !== 'none') linkClaudeBinary(paths.home, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN);
  const home = join(root, 'home');
  const ownerBin = join(root, 'owner-bin');
  // Only bun, which the fake's launcher runs: a claude installed beside the machine's bun stays off the captured PATH.
  const bunBin = join(root, 'bun-bin');
  for (const dir of [home, ownerBin, bunBin, paths.homes.claude]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  symlinkSync(process.execPath, join(bunBin, 'bun'));
  const fake = fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir: join(root, 'fake') });
  const config = RunnerConfigSchema.parse({
    runnerKey: 'r-1',
    machineId: 'machine-1',
    name: 'laptop',
    profile: options.profile ?? 'standard',
    capturedPath: `${ownerBin}:${bunBin}:/usr/bin:/bin`,
    test: { claudeEnv: fake },
  });
  return {
    root,
    paths,
    config,
    log: fake.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG as string,
    ownerBin,
    adapter: (adapterOptions = {}) =>
      new ClaudeAdapter({
        agflow: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: [] },
        config,
        paths,
        vendorHomes: { claude: paths.homes.claude, codex: paths.homes.codex },
        skipAuthChecks: adapterOptions.skipAuthChecks,
        platform: adapterOptions.platform ?? PLATFORM,
        env: { AGFLOW_TEST: '1', HOME: home, USER: 'agent', LANG: 'en_US.UTF-8' },
        preflightTimeoutMs: options.handshakeMs,
      }),
  };
}

/** The pinned claude as a script: it reports the pin and runs the fake, the auto handshake with another recording. */
function autoRecording(fixture: Setup, auto: ClaudeRecording): void {
  const bin = claudeBinary(fixture.paths, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION);
  rmSync(bin, { force: true });
  const path = join(fixture.root, 'auto.jsonl');
  writeRecording(path, auto);
  const script = [
    '#!/bin/sh',
    `[ "$1" = --version ] && { echo "${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION} (Claude Code)"; exit 0; }`,
    'previous=',
    'for arg in "$@"; do',
    `  [ "$previous" = --permission-mode ] && [ "$arg" = auto ] && FAKE_CLAUDE_RECORDING='${path}'`,
    '  previous=$arg',
    'done',
    'export FAKE_CLAUDE_RECORDING',
    `exec '${FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN}' "$@"`,
  ];
  writeFileSync(bin, `${script.join('\n')}\n`);
  chmodSync(bin, 0o755);
}

/** Every argv the fake logged, in order. */
async function argvs(log: string): Promise<string[][]> {
  return (await readFakeClaudeLog(log)).flatMap((entry: FakeClaudeLogEntry) =>
    entry.kind === 'argv' ? [entry.argv] : [],
  );
}

function flag(argv: string[], name: string): string | undefined {
  const index = argv.indexOf(name);
  if (index >= 0) return argv[index + 1];
  return argv.find((arg) => arg.startsWith(`${name}=`))?.slice(name.length + 1);
}

/** preflight-ok with another answer to the usage call. */
function withUsage(answer: ClaudeRecording['answers'][string]): ClaudeRecording {
  const recording = loadRecording('preflight-ok');
  return { ...recording, answers: { ...recording.answers, get_usage: answer } };
}

const ACCOUNT_ID = claudeAccountId(SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT);

describe('preflight: platform and binary', () => {
  test(
    "an unsupported platform, a missing binary and another version are not ready, each with its problem",
    async () => {
      const unsupported = await setup(loadRecording('preflight-ok')).adapter({ platform: 'plan9-mips' }).preflight();
      expect(unsupported.facts).toMatchObject({ vendor: 'claude', ready: false, problem: 'unsupported platform' });

      const missing = await setup(loadRecording('preflight-ok'), { binary: 'none' }).adapter().preflight();
      expect(missing.facts).toMatchObject({ ready: false, problem: 'binary missing', cliVersion: null });

      const older = setup(loadRecording('preflight-ok'), { binary: 'none' });
      const bin = claudeBinary(older.paths, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION);
      mkdirSync(dirname(bin), { recursive: true });
      writeFileSync(bin, '#!/bin/sh\necho "2.1.200 (Claude Code)"\n');
      chmodSync(bin, 0o755);
      const result = await older.adapter().preflight();
      expect(result.facts).toMatchObject({ ready: false, problem: `claude 2.1.200, expected ${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}` });
      expect(result).toMatchObject({ quota: null, weakened: [] });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

describe('preflight: the handshake', () => {
  test(
    'it sends only /clear, with the full options, a scratch clone and base checkout, and a bridge whose hub refuses',
    async () => {
      const fixture = setup(loadRecording('preflight-ok'));
      // The pinned claude notes its working directory, then runs the fake.
      const bin = claudeBinary(fixture.paths, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION);
      rmSync(bin, { force: true });
      const cwdFile = join(fixture.root, 'cwd');
      writeFileSync(bin, `#!/bin/sh\n[ "$1" = --version ] || pwd > '${cwdFile}'\nexec '${FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN}' "$@"\n`);
      chmodSync(bin, 0o755);
      await fixture.adapter().preflight();
      const entries = await readFakeClaudeLog(fixture.log);
      const users = entries.flatMap((entry) => (entry.kind === 'user' ? [entry.message] : []));
      expect(users).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(users[0]).toMatchObject({ message: { role: 'user', content: '/clear' } });
      const [argv = []] = await argvs(fixture.log);
      expect(flag(argv, '--permission-mode')).toBe('acceptEdits');
      expect(flag(argv, '--permission-prompts')).toBe('none');
      expect(argv).toContain('--strict-mcp-config');
      expect(flag(argv, '--tools')).toBe('Bash,Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep,Task,TaskCreate,TaskGet,TaskList,TaskUpdate');
      const mcp = JSON.parse(flag(argv, '--mcp-config') ?? '{}');
      expect(Object.keys(mcp.mcpServers)).toEqual(['agflow']);
      expect(mcp.mcpServers.agflow.env.AGFLOW_HUB_URL).toBe(PREFLIGHT_HUB_URL);
      // The bridge starts in the Claude home's empty directory, which the handshake made.
      const empty = claudeEmptyDir(fixture.paths.homes.claude);
      expect(mcp.mcpServers.agflow).toMatchObject({ command: '/bin/sh', args: expect.arrayContaining([empty]) });
      expect(statSync(empty).isDirectory()).toBe(true);
      await expect(fetch(PREFLIGHT_HUB_URL)).rejects.toThrow();
      const settings = JSON.parse(flag(argv, '--settings') ?? '{}');
      expect(settings.sandbox).toMatchObject({ enabled: true, failIfUnavailable: true });
      // The scratch clone, its working directory, and base checkout lie outside the runner's work root, and are gone
      // afterwards.
      const base = flag(argv, '--project-config-root') as string;
      expect(base.startsWith(fixture.paths.work)).toBe(false);
      expect(existsSync(base)).toBe(false);
      const cwd = readFileSync(cwdFile, 'utf8').trim();
      expect(cwd).toBe(join(dirname(base), 'clone'));
      expect(cwd.startsWith(fixture.paths.work)).toBe(false);
      expect(existsSync(cwd)).toBe(false);
      // The usage call skips the behaviours, which could ask the model.
      const usage = (await logOf(fixture.log, 'control')).filter((entry) => entry.request.subtype === 'get_usage');
      expect(usage).toMatchObject([{ request: { subtype: 'get_usage', skip_behaviors: true } }]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "a good handshake gives facts only: the pin, the owner's claude, the account and the plan",
    async () => {
      const fixture = setup(loadRecording('preflight-ok'));
      const without = await fixture.adapter().preflight();
      expect(without).toEqual({
        facts: {
          vendor: 'claude',
          cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
          ownerCliVersion: null,
          ready: true,
          problem: null,
          accountId: ACCOUNT_ID,
          plan: 'Claude Max',
          managedPolicy: false,
        },
        // The recording's usage call has rate_limits null.
        quota: null,
        weakened: [],
      });
      writeFileSync(join(fixture.ownerBin, 'claude'), '#!/bin/sh\necho "2.1.290 (Claude Code)"\n');
      chmodSync(join(fixture.ownerBin, 'claude'), 0o755);
      expect((await fixture.adapter().preflight()).facts.ownerCliVersion).toBe('2.1.290');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "quota comes from the usage call; a failure, rate_limits null or another shape gives the book's last, else null",
    async () => {
      const resets = '2030-03-17T17:00:00.000Z';
      const usage = withUsage({
        response: {
          subscription_type: 'max',
          rate_limits: {
            five_hour: { utilization: 42, resets_at: resets },
            seven_day: { utilization: 10, resets_at: resets },
            extra_usage: { is_enabled: false },
          },
        },
      });
      const adapter = setup(usage).adapter();
      const { quota } = await adapter.preflight();
      expect(quota).toMatchObject({
        state: 'ok',
        resetsAt: Date.parse(resets),
        windows: { fiveHour: 0.42, weekly: 0.1 },
        paidUsage: 'disabled',
      });
      // The sessions' quota starts from it.
      expect(adapter.quota.last(ACCOUNT_ID)).toEqual(quota);

      const known: VendorQuota = {
        state: 'ok',
        resetsAt: null,
        windows: { fiveHour: 0.5, weekly: 0.2 },
        paidUsage: 'enabled',
        updatedAt: 1,
      };
      for (const answer of [
        { error: 'usage is not available' },
        { response: { rate_limits: null } },
        { response: { rate_limits: { five_hour: 'full' } } },
      ]) {
        const fallback = setup(withUsage(answer)).adapter();
        expect((await fallback.preflight()).quota).toBeNull();
        fallback.quota.update(ACCOUNT_ID, known);
        expect((await fallback.preflight()).quota).toEqual(known);
      }
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'an API key, an extra MCP server, a plugin from outside and a disabled sandbox are each not ready, with the reason',
    async () => {
      const cases: [string, string | RegExp][] = [
        ['preflight-api-key', 'an API key would replace the subscription'],
        ['preflight-extra-mcp', /unexpected MCP servers: github/],
        ['preflight-plugin', /unexpected plugins: repo-helper/],
        ['preflight-sandbox-off', 'the sandbox is not enabled'],
      ];
      for (const [scenario, reason] of cases) {
        const { facts } = await setup(loadRecording(scenario)).adapter().preflight();
        expect(facts.ready).toBe(false);
        expect(facts.problem).toMatch(reason);
      }
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a crash or a timeout is not ready, with the error',
    async () => {
      const crash = claudeRecording({
        turns: [],
        startup: [
          { stderr: 'panic: the keychain is locked\n' },
          { sleep: 50 },
          { stderr: '    at unlock (keychain.ts:1:1)\n' },
          { exit: 3 },
        ],
      });
      const crashed = await setup(crash).adapter().preflight();
      expect(crashed.facts).toMatchObject({ ready: false, cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION });
      expect(crashed.facts.problem).toStartWith('the handshake failed: ');
      // All of stderr, each of its writes.
      expect(crashed.facts.problem).toContain('panic: the keychain is locked\n    at unlock (keychain.ts:1:1)');

      const hang = claudeRecording({ turns: [], startup: [{ sleep: 60_000 }] });
      const hung = await setup(hang, { handshakeMs: 1_000 }).adapter().preflight();
      expect(hung.facts).toMatchObject({ ready: false, problem: 'the handshake failed: no answer within 1000 ms' });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "skipAuthChecks gives ready, 'test mode' and TEST_ACCOUNT_ID, whatever key the scripted server's account has",
    async () => {
      const { facts } = await setup(loadRecording('preflight-api-key')).adapter({ skipAuthChecks: true }).preflight();
      expect(facts).toMatchObject({ ready: true, problem: 'test mode', plan: 'test mode', accountId: TEST_ACCOUNT_ID });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

describe('preflight: the auto profile and weakened items', () => {
  const turnLaunch = (
    fixture: Setup,
    options: { recording?: string; profile?: AgentLaunch['profile'] } = {},
  ): AgentLaunch => {
    const clone = join(fixture.paths.work, 'p-1', 'T-1-a1');
    const tmpDir = join(fixture.root, 'tmp');
    for (const dir of [clone, tmpDir]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    return {
      attemptId: 'T-1-a1',
      role: 'worker',
      model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5',
      cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
      clone,
      baseCheckout: fixture.paths.baseCheckout('p-1', '0123456789abcdef'),
      projectConfigVerified: true,
      tmpDir,
      env: {
        HOME: join(fixture.root, 'home'),
        PATH: `${dirname(process.execPath)}:/usr/bin:/bin`,
        CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: fixture.paths.homes.claude,
        CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR: tmpDir,
        ...fakeClaudeEnv({
          recording: join(CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, `${options.recording ?? 'turn-basic'}.jsonl`),
          dir: join(fixture.root, 'turn'),
        }),
      },
      bridge: { command: '/usr/bin/false', args: ['mcp', '--vendor', 'claude', '--runner'], env: {}, tools: [] },
      profile: options.profile ?? { ...standardProfile, name: 'auto' },
      brief: 'brief',
      firstPrompt: 'Start with the task.',
      resume: null,
      logFile: join(fixture.root, 'attempt.log'),
      registerProcess: () => {},
    };
  };

  async function startedMode(adapter: ClaudeAdapter, launch: AgentLaunch): Promise<string | null> {
    const session = await adapter.start(launch);
    sessions.push(session);
    for await (const event of session.events) {
      if (event.type === 'started') return (event as Extract<AgentEvent, { type: 'started' }>).permissionMode;
    }
    return null;
  }

  test(
    "weakened holds 'auto' when the account offers auto mode, and later starts run auto",
    async () => {
      const fixture = setup(loadRecording('preflight-ok'), { profile: 'auto' });
      const adapter = fixture.adapter();
      const result = await adapter.preflight();
      expect(result.facts.ready).toBe(true);
      expect(result.weakened).toEqual([CLAUDE_WEAKENED_AUTO]);
      expect((await argvs(fixture.log)).map((argv) => flag(argv, '--permission-mode'))).toEqual(['auto']);
      expect(await startedMode(adapter, turnLaunch(fixture))).toBe('auto');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "without auto offered, or when the auto handshake fails, the standard one decides and 'auto' is left out",
    async () => {
      const crash = claudeRecording({
        turns: [],
        startup: [{ stderr: 'auto mode is unavailable right now\n' }, { exit: 1 }],
      });
      for (const auto of [loadRecording('preflight-auto-off'), crash]) {
        const fixture = setup(loadRecording('preflight-ok'), { profile: 'auto' });
        autoRecording(fixture, auto);
        const adapter = fixture.adapter();
        const result = await adapter.preflight();
        expect(result.facts).toMatchObject({ ready: true, problem: null });
        expect(result.weakened).toEqual([]);
        const modes = (await argvs(fixture.log)).map((argv) => flag(argv, '--permission-mode'));
        expect(modes).toEqual(['auto', 'acceptEdits']);
        expect(await startedMode(adapter, turnLaunch(fixture))).toBe('acceptEdits');
      }
    },

  );

    "later sessions name preflight's account in their quota, and start from preflight's quota",
    async () => {

      const usage = withUsage({
        response: {
          subscription_type: 'max',
          rate_limits: {
            five_hour: { utilization: 42, resets_at: resets },
            seven_day: { utilization: 10, resets_at: resets },
            extra_usage: { is_enabled: false },
          },
        },
      });
      for (const [skipAuthChecks, accountId] of [
        [false, ACCOUNT_ID],
        [true, TEST_ACCOUNT_ID],
      ] as const) {
        const fixture = setup(usage);
        const adapter = fixture.adapter({ skipAuthChecks });
        const { quota } = await adapter.preflight();
        if (quota === null) throw new Error('preflight gave no quota');
        // A 429 the CLI retries repeats the account's last known quota.
        const launch = turnLaunch(fixture, { recording: 'api-retry-429', profile: standardProfile });
        const session = await adapter.start(launch);
        sessions.push(session);
        let found: AgentEvent | null = null;
        for await (const event of session.events) {
          if (event.type === 'quota') found = event;
          if (event.type === 'turn_ended') break;

      }
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

    async () => {
      const fixture = setup(loadRecording('preflight-ok'));

        config: fixture.config,
        paths: fixture.paths,
        vendorHomes: { claude: fixture.paths.homes.claude, codex: fixture.paths.homes.codex },
        platform: PLATFORM,
        quota: new QuotaBook(),
        skipAuthChecks: false,
        env: { AGFLOW_TEST: '1', HOME: join(fixture.root, 'home') },

      expect((await claudePreflight(input)).weakened).toEqual([]);
      const weakened = await claudePreflight({ ...input, tmpClaudeDenyWriteEnforced: false });
      expect(weakened).toMatchObject({ facts: { ready: true }, weakened: [CLAUDE_WEAKENED_TMP] });
      // Even a vendor that is not ready names it.
      const missing = await claudePreflight({ ...input, platform: 'plan9-mips', tmpClaudeDenyWriteEnforced: false });
      expect(missing.weakened).toEqual([CLAUDE_WEAKENED_TMP]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

          source: captured.includes(name) ? 'captured' : 'synthesised',
          account: name === 'preflight-api-key' ? 'api-key' : 'synthetic-subscription',
        });
        const scenario = CLAUDE_SCENARIOS.find((entry) => entry.name === name);
        if (!scenario) throw new Error(`no scenario ${name}`);
        const launch = scratchLaunch({ bin: FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN, model: recording.header.model, env: {} });
        try {
          Object.assign(launch.launch.env, fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir: join(launch.root, 'fake') }));
          const run = await runScenario(scenario, launch);
          const again = recordingOf(run, recording.header, launch, {
            live: false,
            apiKeyAccount: scenario.apiKeyAccount,
          });
          expect(again.answers).toEqual(recording.answers);
          expect(again.startup).toEqual(recording.startup);
          expect(again.turns).toEqual(recording.turns);
        } finally {
          launch.cleanup();
        }
      },
      TIMEOUT,
    );
  }
});

**File:** `packages/runner/src/adapters/claude/preflight.ts` (new)

```ts
// Claude's preflight (design 8.1, 6.1, 6.10, 7.6, 15.1, X-5, X-29): the pin's platform and binary, then a zero-model
// handshake whose only input is the local /clear command, run with the full session options in a scratch clone and
// base checkout, with a bridge whose hub URL refuses connections. On the same query it reads the account, the
// untyped getSettings() and the experimental usage call. It fails closed and gives facts only, with the quota and the
// weakened items; the runtime adds models, ceilings, allowPaidUsage, preflightAt and degraded.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, realpathSync, rmSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { Vendor, VendorQuota } from '@agflow/core';
import {
  type AccountInfo,
  type HookCallback,
  query,
  type SDKSystemMessage,
  type SDKUserMessage,
} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { bridgeOf } from '../../attempt/launch';
import type { RunnerConfig } from '../../config';
import { buildAgentEnv } from '../../env';
import { makeAttemptTmpDir, type RunnerPaths } from '../../paths';
import { boundedWait } from '../../processes';
import { profileOf } from '../../profile';
import { runDirOf } from '../../run-dir';
import type { AgentLaunch, AgflowCommand, PreflightResult } from '../types';
import { checkAccount, checkEffectiveSettings, checkSystemInit } from './checks';
import { ClaudeInbox } from './inbox';
import { isRecord } from './json';
import { buildQueryOptions, claudeBinary, claudeTools, ensureClaudeEmptyDir } from './options';
import { claudeProjectDir } from './paths';
import { claudePin, readClaudeVersion, TMP_CLAUDE_DENYWRITE_ENFORCED } from './pin';
import { type QuotaBook, quotaFromUsage } from './quota';
import { createDetachedSpawn, type SpawnedClaude } from './spawn';

/** The weakened item of the auto profile: agents run in auto mode, which the account offers (7.6, X-29). */
export const CLAUDE_WEAKENED_AUTO = 'auto';

/** The weakened item of a pin whose sandbox does not enforce the denyWrite of the shared /tmp/claude (8.1, X-29). */
export const CLAUDE_WEAKENED_TMP = '/tmp/claude';

/**
 * The hub URL of the handshake's bridge: nothing listens on the discard port, so the connection is refused at once
 * and no hub ever sees the handshake.
 */
export const PREFLIGHT_HUB_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:9';

/**
 * How long the handshake gets: a cold exec of the CLI, its sandbox and the bridge starting, and the usage call's round
 * trip. Its own bound, not runner.json's link handshake timing, which bounds the hub's hello and welcome (6.3).
 */
export const CLAUDE_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;

/** How long the handshake waits for the CLI to exit once it is closed. */
const EXIT_WAIT_MS = 5_000;

/** How long a failed handshake waits for the rest of the CLI's stderr: an escaped child may hold it open. */
const STDERR_WAIT_MS = 1_000;

export interface ClaudePreflightInput {
  agflow: AgflowCommand;
  config: RunnerConfig;
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  /** vendorHomes(config, paths): the Claude home is the handshake's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. */
  vendorHomes: Record<Vendor, string>;
  /** `<os>-<arch>`; the pin decides whether the platform is supported. */
  platform: string;
  /** The adapter's last quota per account: preflight's quota falls back to it, and updates it. */
  quota: QuotaBook;
  /** Test mode (15.1): ready with test mode's identity, the scripted server's API key accepted. */
  skipAuthChecks: boolean;
  /** CLAUDE_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS by default. */
  timeoutMs?: number;
  /** TMP_CLAUDE_DENYWRITE_ENFORCED by default. */
  tmpClaudeDenyWriteEnforced?: boolean;
  /** The runner's environment, for buildAgentEnv's user variables and test mode; process.env by default. */
  env?: Record<string, string | undefined>;
  now?: () => number;
}

export interface ClaudePreflightOutcome extends PreflightResult {
  /** Whether the account offered auto mode to an auto-profile handshake; later starts run auto only then. */
  autoOffered: boolean;
}

type Facts = PreflightResult['facts'];

/** Preflight; it never throws: anything that goes wrong is a vendor that is not ready, with the reason. */
export async function claudePreflight(input: ClaudePreflightInput): Promise<ClaudePreflightOutcome> {
  const weakened = (input.tmpClaudeDenyWriteEnforced ?? TMP_CLAUDE_DENYWRITE_ENFORCED) ? [] : [CLAUDE_WEAKENED_TMP];
  const ownerCliVersion = await ownerClaudeVersion(input.config.capturedPath);
  const base: Facts = {
    vendor: 'claude',
    cliVersion: null,
    ownerCliVersion,
    ready: false,
    problem: null,
    accountId: null,
    plan: null,
    managedPolicy: false,
  };
  const notReady = (problem: string, cliVersion: string | null = null): ClaudePreflightOutcome => ({
    facts: { ...base, cliVersion, problem },
    quota: null,
    weakened,
    autoOffered: false,
  });

  const pin = claudePin(input.platform);
  if (pin === null) return notReady('unsupported platform');
  const version = await readClaudeVersion(claudeBinary(input.paths, pin.version), pin.version, {
    env: { PATH: input.config.capturedPath },
  });
  if (!version.ok) return notReady(version.problem, version.version);

  const facts = { ...base, cliVersion: pin.version };
  if (profileOf(input.config).name === 'auto') {
    // Auto first; when the account does not offer it, or that handshake fails, the standard one decides.
    const auto = await handshake(input, pin.version, true);
    if (auto.facts.ready) return outcome(input, facts, auto, [...weakened, CLAUDE_WEAKENED_AUTO]);
  }
  return outcome(input, facts, await handshake(input, pin.version, false), weakened);
}

interface HandshakeResult {
  facts: Pick<Facts, 'ready' | 'problem' | 'accountId' | 'plan'>;
  usage: unknown;
  autoOffered: boolean;
}

function outcome(
  input: ClaudePreflightInput,
  facts: Facts,
  result: HandshakeResult,
  weakened: string[],
): ClaudePreflightOutcome {
  const accountId = result.facts.accountId;
  // The usage call's quota; a failure or another shape leaves the last one the adapter knows for the account.
  const fresh = quotaFromUsage(result.usage, (input.now ?? Date.now)());
  const quota: VendorQuota | null = fresh !== null ? input.quota.update(accountId, fresh) : input.quota.last(accountId);
  return { facts: { ...facts, ...result.facts }, quota, weakened, autoOffered: result.autoOffered };
}

/**
 * One handshake in a scratch clone; a crash, a timeout or a scratch directory that cannot be made is a problem, never
 * an exception. A scratch directory that cannot be removed is left behind: it holds no secret.
 */
async function handshake(input: ClaudePreflightInput, cliVersion: string, auto: boolean): Promise<HandshakeResult> {
  let root: string | null = null;
  let tmpDir: string | null = null;
  try {
    root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-preflight-')));
    const clone = join(root, 'clone');
    const baseCheckout = join(root, 'base');
    const tools = join(root, 'tools');
    tmpDir = makeAttemptTmpDir();
    for (const dir of [clone, baseCheckout, tools, runDirOf(clone, tools).config]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    ensureClaudeEmptyDir(input.vendorHomes.claude);
    const launch = handshakeLaunch(input, { clone, baseCheckout, tools, tmpDir, cliVersion, logDir: root });
    return await runHandshake(input, launch, auto);
  } catch (error) {
    return failed(`the handshake failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);
  } finally {
    const scratch = root;
    const tmp = tmpDir;
    // /clear leaves a transcript in the scratch clone's project directory; nothing else of it is kept.
    if (scratch !== null) removeQuietly(() => claudeProjectDir(input.vendorHomes.claude, join(scratch, 'clone')));
    if (tmp !== null) removeQuietly(() => tmp);
    if (scratch !== null) removeQuietly(() => scratch);
  }
}

/** Removes a directory, retrying while a CLI that outlived the handshake still writes in it; a failure is left be. */
function removeQuietly(path: () => string): void {
  try {
    rmSync(path(), { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 3 });
  } catch {
    // A slug the CLI would hash has no project directory; anything else stays behind in the temporary directory.
  }
}

function handshakeLaunch(
  input: ClaudePreflightInput,
  scratch: { clone: string; baseCheckout: string; tools: string; tmpDir: string; cliVersion: string; logDir: string },
): AgentLaunch {
  const spec = { attemptId: 'preflight', role: 'worker' as const, agentToken: 'preflight', hubUrl: PREFLIGHT_HUB_URL };
  const env = buildAgentEnv({
    vendor: 'claude',
    spec,
    clone: scratch.clone,
    tools: scratch.tools,
    tmpDir: scratch.tmpDir,
    config: input.config,
    paths: input.paths,
    base: input.env,
    env: input.env,
  });
  return {
    attemptId: spec.attemptId,
    role: spec.role,
    model: input.config.models.claude.worker,
    cliVersion: scratch.cliVersion,
    clone: scratch.clone,
    baseCheckout: scratch.baseCheckout,
    projectConfigVerified: true,
    tmpDir: scratch.tmpDir,
    env,
    bridge: bridgeOf(input.agflow, 'claude', env),
    profile: profileOf(input.config),
    brief: '',
    firstPrompt: '/clear',
    resume: null,
    logFile: join(scratch.logDir, 'handshake.log'),
    registerProcess: () => {},
  };
}

const noHook: HookCallback = async () => ({});

async function runHandshake(input: ClaudePreflightInput, launch: AgentLaunch, auto: boolean): Promise<HandshakeResult> {
  const inbox = new ClaudeInbox<SDKUserMessage>();
  let proc: SpawnedClaude | null = null;
  const spawn = createDetachedSpawn({
    registerProcess: launch.registerProcess,
    logFile: launch.logFile,
    onSpawn: (spawned) => {
      proc = spawned;
    },
  });
  const options = buildQueryOptions(launch, {
    agflow: input.agflow,
    paths: input.paths,
    vendorHomes: input.vendorHomes,
    autoOffered: auto,
    spawnClaudeCodeProcess: spawn,
    compaction: { preCompact: noHook, postCompact: noHook },
  });
  const abortController = new AbortController();
  const clear: SDKUserMessage = {
    type: 'user',
    message: { role: 'user', content: '/clear' },
    parent_tool_use_id: null,
    uuid: randomUUID(),
  };
  inbox.push(clear);
  const q = query({ prompt: inbox, options: { ...options, abortController } });
  const timeoutMs = input.timeoutMs ?? CLAUDE_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const timeout = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
    timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`no answer within ${timeoutMs} ms`)), timeoutMs);
  });
  const answers = (async () => {
    const initialization = await q.initializationResult();
    // Untyped in sdk.d.ts 0.3.285, like cancelQueued (8.1).
    const settings = await (q as unknown as { getSettings(): Promise<unknown> }).getSettings();
    const usage = await q
      .usage_EXPERIMENTAL_MAY_CHANGE_DO_NOT_RELY_ON_THIS_API_YET({ skipBehaviors: true })
      .catch(() => null);
    let init: SDKSystemMessage | null = null;
    for await (const frame of q) {
      if (frame.type === 'system' && frame.subtype === 'init') init = frame;
      if (frame.type === 'result') break;
    }
    return { account: initialization.account, settings, usage, init };
  })();
  // After a timeout nobody waits for the answers any more.
  answers.catch(() => {});
  try {
    return judge(input, launch, auto, await Promise.race([answers, timeout]));
  } catch (error) {
    // A CLI that hangs or ends early: its group ends now, without close()'s grace.
    abortController.abort();
    // Read to its end first, so the reason holds the CLI's last lines.
    const spawned = proc as SpawnedClaude | null;
    if (spawned !== null) await boundedWait(spawned.stderrRead, STDERR_WAIT_MS);
    const stderr = spawned?.stderrTail().trim() ?? '';
    const reason = [(error as Error).message, stderr].filter((part) => part !== '').join(': ');
    return failed(`the handshake failed: ${reason}`);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    // Stdin EOF ends the CLI once /clear is done.
    inbox.end();
    q.close();
    const exited = (proc as SpawnedClaude | null)?.exited;
    if (exited) await boundedWait(exited, EXIT_WAIT_MS);
  }
}

/** What the handshake found: the account, then system/init and the sandbox settings, as one list of problems. */
function judge(
  input: ClaudePreflightInput,
  launch: AgentLaunch,
  auto: boolean,
  found: { account: AccountInfo | undefined; settings: unknown; usage: unknown; init: SDKSystemMessage | null },
): HandshakeResult {
  const account = checkAccount(found.account, { skipAuthChecks: input.skipAuthChecks });
  const problems: string[] = [];
  if (!account.ready && account.problem !== null) problems.push(account.problem);
  if (found.init === null) {
    problems.push('the handshake gave no system/init');
  } else {
    problems.push(
      ...checkSystemInit(found.init, {
        cliVersion: launch.cliVersion,
        permissionMode: auto ? 'auto' : 'acceptEdits',
        tools: claudeTools(launch.profile),
        skipAuthChecks: input.skipAuthChecks,
      }),
    );
  }
  problems.push(...checkEffectiveSettings(isRecord(found.settings) ? found.settings.effective : undefined));
  const ready = problems.length === 0;
  return {
    facts: {
      ready,
      problem: ready ? account.problem : problems.join('; '),
      accountId: account.accountId,
      plan: account.plan,
    },
    usage: found.usage,
    autoOffered: auto && ready,
  };
}

function failed(problem: string): HandshakeResult {
  return { facts: { ready: false, problem, accountId: null, plan: null }, usage: null, autoOffered: false };
}

/** The version of the owner's own claude, the first on the captured login PATH; null without one. */
async function ownerClaudeVersion(capturedPath: string): Promise<string | null> {
  for (const dir of capturedPath.split(':')) {
    if (dir === '') continue;
    const bin = join(dir, 'claude');
    try {
      if (!existsSync(bin) || !statSync(bin).isFile()) continue;
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const found = await readClaudeVersion(bin, null, { env: { PATH: capturedPath } });
    return found.version;
  }
  return null;
}

  home: string;

function setup(): Setup {

  dirs.push(root);
  const paths = runnerPaths(join(root, '.agflow'));
  const home = join(root, 'home');
  mkdirSync(home, { recursive: true });
  return {

    home,
    config: (input = {}) =>
      RunnerConfigSchema.parse({ runnerKey: 'r-1', machineId: 'machine-1', name: 'laptop', ...input }),
  };

/**
 * The claude of a version in the layout: a script that hands the fake its variables itself, so the fake replays the
 * recording whether or not test mode carries test.claudeEnv into the agent's environment. Warmed once with --warm.
 * Gives the fake's log.
 */
function fakeClaudeAt(fixture: Setup, version: string, recording: ClaudeRecording): string {
  const fake = fakeClaudeEnv({ recording, dir: join(fixture.root, `fake-${version}`), version });
  const bin = claudeBinary(fixture.paths, version);
  mkdirSync(dirname(bin), { recursive: true });
  const exports = Object.entries(fake).map(([name, value]) => `export ${name}='${value}'`);
  const script = ['#!/bin/sh', '[ "$1" = --warm ] && exit 0', ...exports, `exec '${FAKE_CLAUDE_BIN}' "$@"`];
  writeFileSync(bin, `${script.join('\n')}\n`);
  chmodSync(bin, 0o755);
  Bun.spawnSync([bin, '--warm']);
  return fake.FAKE_CLAUDE_LOG as string;
}

/** turn-basic as a CLI of another version printed it: its system/init names that version. */
function turnOf(version: string): ClaudeRecording {
  const text = readFileSync(join(CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, 'turn-basic.jsonl'), 'utf8');
  return parseRecording(
    text.replaceAll(`"claude_code_version":"${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}"`, `"claude_code_version":"${version}"`),
  );
}

async function argvs(log: string): Promise<string[][]> {
  return (await readFakeClaudeLog(log)).flatMap((entry: FakeClaudeLogEntry) =>
    entry.kind === 'argv' ? [entry.argv] : [],
  );
}

function flag(argv: string[], name: string): string | undefined {
  const index = argv.indexOf(name);
  if (index >= 0) return argv[index + 1];
  return argv.find((arg) => arg.startsWith(`${name}=`))?.slice(name.length + 1);
}

/** The SessionStart command the CLI was given in --settings. */
function sessionStartCommand(argv: string[]): unknown {
  return JSON.parse(flag(argv, '--settings') ?? '{}').hooks?.SessionStart?.[0]?.hooks?.[0]?.command;
}

async function firstEvent(session: AgentSession): Promise<AgentEvent | undefined> {
  for await (const event of session.events) return event;
  return undefined;
}

// The Claude adapter from the registry's input (design 13, X-6): runner.json, the layout and how the runner runs
// agflow. The Claude home is vendorHomes' canonical string, the one buildAgentEnv puts in every launch's
// CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, so the adapter's transcripts and guard name the directory the CLI writes in. The binary is
// resolved per launch from its CLI version, so a runner home without it still gets an adapter: its preflight reports
// 'binary missing'. test.skipAuthChecks counts only in test mode (15.1).
import { isTestMode, vendorHomes } from '../../config';
import type { AdapterFactory } from '../types';
import { ClaudeAdapter } from './adapter';

export interface CreateClaudeAdapterOptions {
  /** The runner's environment: AGFLOW_TEST, and preflight's agent environment; process.env by default. */
  env?: Record<string, string | undefined>;
  /** `<os>-<arch>`, vendorPlatform() by default. */
  platform?: string;
}

export function createClaudeAdapter(
  input: Parameters<AdapterFactory>[0],
  options: CreateClaudeAdapterOptions = {},
): ClaudeAdapter {
  const { config, paths, agflow } = input;
  const env = options.env ?? process.env;
  return new ClaudeAdapter({
    agflow,
    config,
    paths,
    vendorHomes: vendorHomes(config, paths),
    skipAuthChecks: isTestMode(config, env) && config.test?.skipAuthChecks === true,
    platform: options.platform,
    env,
  });
}
