```ts
async function claudeFixture(recording: ClaudeRecording, options: RunnerFixtureOptions = {}): Promise<ClaudeFixture> {
  const f = await createRunnerFixture(options);
  const log = fakeClaudeAt(f, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, recording);
  const adapter = claudeAdapterFactory({ config: f.config, paths: f.paths, agflow: FIXTURE_AGFLOW });
  if (adapter === null) throw new Error('the claude entry gave no adapter');
  f.adapters.set('claude', adapter);
  return { f, log };
}

/**
 * turn-basic with only the tool calls given: toolu_basic_1 echo hi, 2 a push the guard refuses, 3 a bridge answer that
 * the hub is unreachable, 4 a submit the bridge accepts. The others' frames, hooks and denials are left out. The
 * recording has no second turn: a continuation or nudge sent to it fails that turn, which no check here minds.
 */
function basicWith(keep: number[], version = CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION): ClaudeRecording {
  const text = readFileSync(join(CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, 'turn-basic.jsonl'), 'utf8');
  // As a CLI of that version printed it: its system/init names the version.
  const recording = parseRecording(
    text.replaceAll(`"claude_code_version":"${CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION}"`, `"claude_code_version":"${version}"`),
  );
  const dropped = (value: unknown) =>
    [1, 2, 3, 4].some((n) => !keep.includes(n) && JSON.stringify(value).includes(`"toolu_basic_${n}"`));
  const turns = recording.turns.map((turn) =>
    turn.flatMap((step): RecordingStep[] => {
      if (!('frame' in step) || step.frame.type !== 'result') return dropped(step) ? [] : [step];
      const denials = Array.isArray(step.frame.permission_denials) ? step.frame.permission_denials : [];
      return [{ frame: { ...step.frame, permission_denials: denials.filter((denial) => !dropped(denial)) } }];
    }),
  );
  return { ...recording, turns };
}

/** A recording with a pause after the first tool's PreToolUse hook: the tool is in flight meanwhile. */
function slowFirstTool(recording: ClaudeRecording, ms: number): ClaudeRecording {
  const [turn = []] = recording.turns;
  const hook = turn.findIndex((step) => 'hook' in step);
  return { ...recording, turns: [[...turn.slice(0, hook + 1), { sleep: ms }, ...turn.slice(hook + 1)]] };
}

/**
 * A synthesised quota recording whose limit resets in ten minutes instead of at its fixed 2030 (SYNTHESISED_RESET): a
 * reset one timer of M2b's TurnPolicy reaches, for the checks of a wait and the reset it reports. Bun clamps a delay
 * past 2^31 - 1 ms to 1 ms; M2b bounds the timer there and arms it again while the reset is ahead, so testkit's
 * unmodified 2030 recording keeps the attempt waiting, which a case of its own checks.
 */
function resettingSoon(name: 'limit-hit' | 'overage-in-use'): { recording: ClaudeRecording; resetsAt: number } {
  const resetsAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1_000) + 600;
  const text = readFileSync(join(CLAUDE_FIXTURES_DIR, `${name}.jsonl`), 'utf8');
  return {
    recording: parseRecording(text.replaceAll(`"resetsAt":${SYNTHESISED_RESET}`, `"resetsAt":${resetsAt}`)),
    resetsAt: resetsAt * 1_000,
  };
}

/** The user messages the fake took, by text, in order; after the n-th process start when given. */
async function userTexts(log: string, fromStart = 0): Promise<string[]> {
  const entries = await readFakeClaudeLog(log);
  let starts = 0;
  const texts: string[] = [];
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (entry.kind === 'argv') starts += 1;
    if (entry.kind !== 'user' || starts <= fromStart) continue;
    const content = (entry.message as { message?: { content?: unknown } }).message?.content;
    texts.push(typeof content === 'string' ? content : JSON.stringify(content));
  }
  return texts;
}

async function logOf<K extends FakeClaudeLogEntry['kind']>(
  log: string,
  kind: K,
): Promise<Extract<FakeClaudeLogEntry, { kind: K }>[]> {
  return (await readFakeClaudeLog(log)).filter(
    (entry): entry is Extract<FakeClaudeLogEntry, { kind: K }> => entry.kind === kind,
  );
}

const activities = (f: RunnerFixture) => f.events('attempt.activity').map((event) => event.data);
const turnsEnded = (f: RunnerFixture) => activities(f).filter((data) => data.kind === 'turn').length;
const spawnedOf = (f: RunnerFixture) => f.events('attempt.spawned');

/** Starts T-4-a1 and waits until its first turn has ended. */
async function startedTurn(f: RunnerFixture) {
  const controller = f.controller();
  expect(await controller.start(f.spec())).toEqual({ started: true });
  await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) >= 1, 15_000);
  return controller;
}

/** Starts T-4-a1, waits for its first turn and stops it, keeping the clone and the session. */
async function startedAndStopped(f: RunnerFixture) {
  const controller = await startedTurn(f);
  const stop = { fence: FENCE, reason: 'paused', handoff: false, interruptFirst: false, keepClone: true };
  expect(await controller.stop(stop)).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  return controller;
}

const RESUME_PROMPT = 'Review feedback: rename the helper.';

/** A resume_attempt for T-4-a1 with the next fence and a new token. */
function resumeCommand(f: RunnerFixture) {
  return {
    fence: RESUMED,
    agentToken: fixtureAgentToken('T-4-a1 resumed'),
    prompt: RESUME_PROMPT,
    messages: [] as InjectedMessage[],
    taskPack: '# T-4 Tidy the app, round 2\n',
    restore: f.spec().restore,
    acceptanceIds: ['A1'],
  };
}

/** Polls an asynchronous check until it holds, or fails after timeoutMs. */
async function eventually(check: () => Promise<boolean>, timeoutMs = 15_000): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (!(await check())) {
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error(`waited ${timeoutMs} ms in vain`);
    await Bun.sleep(20);
  }
}

/** A main-thread line in the clone's project directory: the session ran a turn, so a resume resumes it (8.4). */
function ranATurn(f: RunnerFixture, sessionRef: string): void {
  const clone = f.paths.clone(FIXTURE_PROJECT, 'T-4-a1');
  const dir = claudeProjectDir(vendorHomes(f.config, f.paths).claude, clone);
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const prompt = { type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: PROMPT } };
  writeFileSync(join(dir, `${sessionRef}.jsonl`), `${JSON.stringify(prompt)}\n`);
}

describe('the AttemptController drives the Claude adapter: start and turns', () => {
  test(
    'start_attempt reports attempt.spawned with the sessionRef, pid, model, cliVersion and permissionMode',
    async () => {
      const { f, log } = await claudeFixture(basicWith([1]));
      const controller = f.controller();
      expect(await controller.start(f.spec())).toEqual({ started: true });
      const [spawned] = await waitFor(() => spawnedOf(f).length > 0 && spawnedOf(f));
      const session = controller.session;
      expect(spawned?.data).toEqual({
        sessionRef: session?.sessionRef as string,
        pid: session?.pid as number,
        model: f.config.models.claude.worker,
        cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
        permissionMode: 'acceptEdits',
        startSha: f.origin.mainSha,
      });
      const [argv] = await logOf(log, 'argv');
      expect(argv?.argv).toContain(`--session-id=${spawned?.data.sessionRef}`);
      // The adapter registered exactly the process it spawned.
      expect(f.store.processes('T-4-a1').map((record) => record.pid)).toEqual([session?.pid as number]);
      expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')).toMatchObject({ state: 'running', sessionRef: spawned?.data.sessionRef });
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a recorded turn becomes attempt.activity for its tools, text and turn; the facts show a tool while it runs',
    async () => {
      // Without the hub-unreachable answer, whose nudge would start a second turn.
      const { f } = await claudeFixture(slowFirstTool(basicWith([1, 2, 4]), 1_500));
      const controller = f.controller();
      await controller.start(f.spec());
      const tool = await waitFor(() => controller.facts()?.tool, 15_000);
      expect(tool).toMatchObject({ name: 'Bash', command: 'echo hi', long: false });
      await waitFor(() => turnsEnded(f) === 1, 15_000);
      expect(controller.facts()?.tool).toBeNull();
      expect(activities(f).map((data) => [data.kind, data.summary])).toEqual([
        ['text', 'Running the check.'],
        ['tool', 'Bash: echo hi'],
        ['tool', 'Bash: git push origin HEAD'],
        ['tool', 'mcp__agflow__submit: {"summary":"Checked."}'],
        ['text', 'The check printed hi, and the work is submitted.'],
        ['turn', 'turn completed with 3 tool calls'],
      ]);
      expect(f.events('attempt.activity')[0]?.fence).toEqual(FENCE);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a submit the bridge accepted suppresses the continuation, which a turn without one gets',
    async () => {
      const submitted = await claudeFixture(basicWith([1, 4]), CONTINUING);
      await startedTurn(submitted.f);
      const plain = await claudeFixture(basicWith([1]), CONTINUING);
      await startedTurn(plain.f);
      await eventually(async () => (await userTexts(plain.log)).length === 2);
      await Bun.sleep(400);
      expect(await userTexts(submitted.log)).toEqual([PROMPT]);
      expect(await userTexts(plain.log)).toEqual([PROMPT, continuationPrompt(['A1'])]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "the bridge's hub-unreachable answer blocks the continuation: one nudge instead, nothing while the link is down",
    async () => {
      const up = await claudeFixture(basicWith([1, 3]), CONTINUING);
      await startedTurn(up.f);
      const down = await claudeFixture(basicWith([1, 3]), CONTINUING);
      down.f.link.up = false;
      await startedTurn(down.f);
      await eventually(async () => (await userTexts(up.log)).length === 2);
      await Bun.sleep(400);
      expect(await userTexts(up.log)).toEqual([PROMPT, OUTAGE_NUDGE]);
      expect(await userTexts(down.log)).toEqual([PROMPT]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a deliver command reports attempt.delivered and attempt.acknowledged with the hub message ids',
    async () => {
      const { f, log } = await claudeFixture(loadRecording('turn-delivery'));
      const controller = f.controller();
      await controller.start(f.spec());
      // The recording takes the message while its tool runs.
      await waitFor(() => controller.facts()?.tool, 15_000);
      const message = { messageId: 31, authority: 'person' as const, text: 'also check the logs' };
      expect(await controller.deliver({ fence: FENCE, messages: [message], more: 0 })).toEqual({ ok: true });
      await waitFor(() => f.events('attempt.acknowledged').length > 0, 15_000);
      expect(f.events('attempt.delivered').map((event) => [event.fence, event.data.messageIds])).toEqual([
        [FENCE, [31]],
      ]);
      expect(f.events('attempt.acknowledged').map((event) => event.data.messageIds)).toEqual([[31]]);
      expect(await userTexts(log)).toEqual([PROMPT, message.text]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

describe('the AttemptController drives the Claude adapter: stops and quota', () => {
  test(
    'stop_attempt runs the stop ladder: an interrupt that cancels queued input, then the close; exited has stoppedBy',
    async () => {
      const { f, log } = await claudeFixture(loadRecording('interrupt'));
      const controller = f.controller();
      await controller.start(f.spec());
      await waitFor(() => controller.facts()?.tool, 15_000);
      const stop = { fence: FENCE, reason: 'stopped', handoff: false, interruptFirst: false, keepClone: false };
      expect(await controller.stop(stop)).toMatchObject({ ok: true, stoppedBy: 'close' });
      const [exited] = f.events('attempt.exited');
      expect(exited?.data).toMatchObject({ stoppedBy: 'close', handoffWritten: false });
      const interrupts = (await logOf(log, 'control')).filter((entry) => entry.request.subtype === 'interrupt');
      expect(interrupts.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(interrupts.every((entry) => entry.request.cancel_queued === true)).toBe(true);
      const [eof] = await logOf(log, 'eof');
      expect(eof?.at).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(interrupts[0]?.at as number);
      expect(activities(f).map((data) => data.summary)).toContain('turn interrupted');
      expect(controller.session).toBeNull();
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a limit hit moves the attempt to quota_wait and reports attempt.quota',
    async () => {
      const { recording, resetsAt } = resettingSoon('limit-hit');
      const { f } = await claudeFixture(recording);
      const controller = f.controller();
      await controller.start(f.spec());
      await waitFor(() => controller.phase === 'quota_wait' && f.events('attempt.quota').length > 0, 15_000);
      const [quota] = f.events('attempt.quota');
      expect(quota?.data).toMatchObject({
        vendor: 'claude',
        quota: { state: 'exhausted', resetsAt, windows: { fiveHour: 1 } },
      });
      expect(controller.facts()?.phase).toBe('quota_wait');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "a limit hit resetting in 2030, beyond one timer's reach, keeps the attempt in quota_wait without a resume prompt",
    async () => {
      const { f, log } = await claudeFixture(loadRecording('limit-hit'));
      const controller = f.controller();
      await controller.start(f.spec());
      await waitFor(() => controller.phase === 'quota_wait' && f.events('attempt.quota').length > 0, 15_000);
      // A timer armed for the whole wait would fire within a millisecond, end the wait and send the resume prompt.
      await Bun.sleep(500);
      const quotas = f.events('attempt.quota').map((event) => event.data.quota);
      expect(quotas).toMatchObject([{ state: 'exhausted', resetsAt: SYNTHESISED_RESET * 1_000 }]);
      expect(controller.phase).toBe('quota_wait');
      expect(await userTexts(log)).toEqual([PROMPT]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'overage in use is a limit hit while allowPaidUsage is false, and an allowed turn while it is true',
    async () => {
      const refused = await claudeFixture(resettingSoon('overage-in-use').recording);
      const refusing = refused.f.controller();
      await refusing.start(refused.f.spec());
      await waitFor(() => refusing.phase === 'quota_wait' && refused.f.events('attempt.quota').length > 0, 15_000);
      expect(refused.f.events('attempt.quota').map((event) => event.data.quota.state)).toEqual(['exhausted']);
      const allowed = await claudeFixture(resettingSoon('overage-in-use').recording, {
        config: { allowPaidUsage: { claude: true, codex: false } },
      });
      const allowing = await startedTurn(allowed.f);
      expect(allowing.phase).not.toBe('quota_wait');
      expect(allowed.f.events('attempt.quota')).toEqual([]);
      expect(activities(allowed.f).map((data) => data.summary)).toContain('turn completed with 0 tool calls');
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});

describe('the AttemptController drives the Claude adapter: resume', () => {
  test(
    "resume_attempt starts the binary of the attempt's recorded cliVersion and resumes the session",
    async () => {
      const { f, log } = await claudeFixture(basicWith([1]));
      await startedAndStopped(f);
      const sessionRef = spawnedOf(f)[0]?.data.sessionRef as string;
      ranATurn(f, sessionRef);
      // The record says what the attempt started with, whatever the pin is now.
      f.store.update('T-4-a1', { cliVersion: OLDER });
      const olderLog = fakeClaudeAt(f, OLDER, basicWith([1], OLDER));
      const controller = f.controller();
      expect(await controller.resume(resumeCommand(f))).toEqual({ resumed: true });
      const spawned = await waitFor(() => spawnedOf(f)[1], 15_000);
      expect(spawned.fence).toEqual(RESUMED);
      expect(spawned.data).toMatchObject({ sessionRef, cliVersion: OLDER, startSha: null });
      const [argv] = await logOf(olderLog, 'argv');
      expect(argv?.argv).toContain(`--resume=${sessionRef}`);
      expect(await userTexts(olderLog)).toEqual([RESUME_PROMPT]);
      // The pinned claude ran only the first start.
      expect(await logOf(log, 'argv')).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(f.store.processes('T-4-a1').map((record) => record.pid)).toContain(controller.session?.pid as number);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    "a resumed session whose first turn does not match ends as an exit nobody asked for, not a failed start (X-50)",
    async () => {
      const { f } = await claudeFixture(basicWith([1]));
      await startedAndStopped(f);
      ranATurn(f, spawnedOf(f)[0]?.data.sessionRef as string);
      f.store.update('T-4-a1', { cliVersion: OLDER });
      // The older binary's system/init names the pin: the first turn's check fails once the resume prompt starts it.
      fakeClaudeAt(f, OLDER, basicWith([1]));
      expect(await f.controller().resume(resumeCommand(f))).toEqual({ resumed: true });
      const exits = await waitFor(() => f.events('attempt.exited').length === 2 && f.events('attempt.exited'), 15_000);
      expect(exits[1]?.fence).toEqual(RESUMED);
      expect(exits[1]?.data).toMatchObject({ stoppedBy: 'none', cause: null });
      const notes = activities(f).filter((data) => data.kind === 'note').map((data) => data.summary);
      expect(notes).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('the session does not match its options')]);
      expect(notes[0]).toContain(OLDER);
      expect(f.events('attempt.failed_to_start')).toEqual([]);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );

  test(
    'a resume of a session that never ran a turn starts one fresh process with the first prompt (X-50)',
    async () => {
      const { f, log } = await claudeFixture(basicWith([1]));
      await startedAndStopped(f);
      const first = spawnedOf(f)[0]?.data.sessionRef as string;
      // No transcript holds a turn of the session: the fake writes none.
      const controller = f.controller();
      expect(await controller.resume(resumeCommand(f))).toEqual({ resumed: true });
      const spawned = await waitFor(() => spawnedOf(f)[1], 15_000);
      expect(spawned.data.sessionRef).not.toBe(first);
      expect(spawned.data.startSha).toBeNull();
      // The fresh process is registered, once: the stop ladder and recovery can reach it. Registration is asynchronous.
      const recorded = await waitFor(
        () => f.store.processes('T-4-a1').length > 0 && f.store.processes('T-4-a1'),
        15_000,
      );
      expect(recorded.map((record) => record.pid)).toEqual([spawned.data.pid]);
      expect(f.store.get('T-4-a1')?.sessionRef).toBe(spawned.data.sessionRef);
      const argvs = await logOf(log, 'argv');
      expect(argvs).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(argvs[1]?.argv).toContain(`--session-id=${spawned.data.sessionRef}`);
      expect(argvs[1]?.argv.some((arg) => arg.startsWith('--resume'))).toBe(false);
      await eventually(async () => (await userTexts(log, 1)).length === 2);
      expect(await userTexts(log, 1)).toEqual([PROMPT, RESUME_PROMPT]);
      expect(controller.session?.pid).toBe(spawned.data.pid);
    },
    TIMEOUT,
  );
});
```

Run: `bun test packages/runner/test/adapters/claude/controller-contract.test.ts && bun test && bun run typecheck`
Expected: the task's tests pass (12 pass); then the whole suite passes (`0 fail`) and `tsc` exits 0.

This test passes at once: it checks what Tasks 1-22 built, and it needs the bounded quota timer supplied by M2b and included in the M2c `m2c-ops` base `a0202a2f06b26bde6947efcb936ef6aff344a782`. Against an M2b whose `TurnPolicy.limitHit` arms an unbounded `setTimeout`, the 2030 case fails: Bun clamps a delay over 2^31-1 ms to 1 ms, so the wait ends at once and the resume prompt goes out. `resettingSoon()` moves the synthesised reset ten minutes ahead for the cases that need the wait to end.

### Task 24: Real-CLI smoke harness and start checks

The local Claude smoke suite of design 15, gated by `AGFLOW_SMOKE=1` and a located pin (X-20). `startClaudeSmoke` runs the pinned claude against the scripted server with the fake key, behind the refusing proxy, with a scratch `AGFLOW_HOME` (the binary linked into its `vendor/`), Claude home and `HOME`, in a real clone and base checkout made from a local origin; M2b's in-process hub holds the runner agent and its `agt_` token, and the real bridge and brief hook run by path as `bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null <repo>/packages/cli/src/main.ts` behind a tap that records their requests (X-26). Every test asserts that `isolationProblems()` is empty: the model only on 127.0.0.1 with the test key, scratch homes, and a proxy that refused nothing. The start checks are `started` and the first-turn checks, the hub's brief and working-directory line through the hook, a bridge call as the runner agent, preflight in test mode with no model, and a committed `bunfig.toml` preload and `.env` that reach neither the bridge nor the hook, on a start and on a resume.

```ts
  /** process.env by default. */
  env?: Record<string, string | undefined>;
  /** The home findClaudeBinary searches; the real home by default. */
  home?: string;
  /** The variables that must be 1 for the suite to run (X-20). */
  switches?: string[];
}

/**
 * Whether the real-CLI suites run (X-20): only with AGFLOW_SMOKE=1 (and whatever other switches a suite needs), on a
 * platform the pin supports, with the pinned claude found. Otherwise the reason says what is missing.
 */
export function claudeSmokeGate(options: ClaudeSmokeGateOptions = {}): ClaudeSmokeGate {
  const env = options.env ?? process.env;
  const missing = (options.switches ?? ['AGFLOW_SMOKE']).filter((name) => env[name] !== '1');
  if (missing.length > 0) return { run: false, bin: null, reason: `${missing.join(' and ')}=1 not set` };
  if (claudePin(vendorPlatform()) === null) {
    return { run: false, bin: null, reason: `agflow pins no claude for ${vendorPlatform()}` };
  }
  const found = findClaudeBinary(CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, { env, home: options.home });
  if (found.path === null) return { run: false, bin: null, reason: found.reason };
  return { run: true, bin: found.path, reason: null };
}

/** describe, or describe.skip with the gate's reason in its title, so a skipped run says why. */
export function smokeDescribe(gate: ClaudeSmokeGate, title: string, fn: () => void): void {
  if (gate.run) describe(title, fn);
  else describe.skip(`${title} (skipped: ${gate.reason})`, fn);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The hub tap

/** One request the bridge or the brief hook sent the hub, as the hub received it. */
export interface HubTapRequest {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  /** The bearer token, or null. */
  bearer: string | null;
  /** X-Agflow-Agent, which an agent-token request must not carry. */
  agentHeader: string | null;
  status: number;
}

/** A hub path the tap holds: requests for it wait until release(). */
export interface HubHold {
  /** Resolves once a request for the path reached the tap. */
  reached: Promise<void>;
  /** Lets the held requests, and later ones, through. */
  release(): void;
}

interface HubTap {
  url: string;
  requests: HubTapRequest[];
  hold(path: string): HubHold;
  stop(): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Forwards every request to the hub as it came and records it; the hub answers only at 127.0.0.1 anyway. A held path
 * waits before it is forwarded, so a test can act while the CLI waits on the hub (in its brief hook, say).
 */
function startHubTap(hubUrl: string): HubTap {
  const requests: HubTapRequest[] = [];
  const holds = new Map<string, { arrived(): void; opened: Promise<void> }>();
  const server = Bun.serve({
    hostname: '127.0.0.1',
    port: 0,
    idleTimeout: 0,
    async fetch(incoming) {
      const url = new URL(incoming.url);
      const held = holds.get(url.pathname);
      if (held) {
        held.arrived();
        await held.opened;
      }
      const body = incoming.method === 'GET' || incoming.method === 'HEAD' ? undefined : await incoming.arrayBuffer();
      const answer = await fetch(`${hubUrl}${url.pathname}${url.search}`, {
        method: incoming.method,
        headers: incoming.headers,
        body,
      });
      const authorization = incoming.headers.get('authorization');
      requests.push({
        method: incoming.method,
        path: url.pathname,
        bearer: authorization?.match(/^Bearer (.+)$/)?.[1] ?? null,
        agentHeader: incoming.headers.get('x-agflow-agent'),
        status: answer.status,
      });
      // fetch has decoded the body already.
      const headers = new Headers(answer.headers);
      headers.delete('content-encoding');
      headers.delete('content-length');
      return new Response(await answer.arrayBuffer(), { status: answer.status, headers });
    },
  });
  const opens: (() => void)[] = [];
  return {
    url: `http://127.0.0.1:${server.port}`,
    requests,
    hold(path) {
      const reached = Promise.withResolvers<void>();
      const opened = Promise.withResolvers<void>();
      holds.set(path, { arrived: reached.resolve, opened: opened.promise });
      opens.push(opened.resolve);
      return { reached: reached.promise, release: opened.resolve };
    },
    stop: () => {
      // A held request ends with the tap.
      for (const open of opens) open();
      return server.stop(true);
    },
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sessions

/** A started session and every event it emitted so far. */
export interface SmokeSession {
  session: ClaudeSession;
  events: AgentEvent[];
  /** The first event, from the given index on, that matches; it fails after timeoutMs. */
  next<T extends AgentEvent['type']>(
    type: T,
    match?: (event: Extract<AgentEvent, { type: T }>) => boolean,
    options?: { from?: number; timeoutMs?: number },
  ): Promise<Extract<AgentEvent, { type: T }>>;
  /** Resolves once the events end, after the CLI exited. */
  ended: Promise<void>;
}

function collect(session: ClaudeSession): SmokeSession {
  const events: AgentEvent[] = [];
  const waiters = new Set<() => void>();
  let done = false;
  const ended = (async () => {
    for await (const event of session.events) {
      events.push(event);
      for (const wake of [...waiters]) wake();
    }
    done = true;
    for (const wake of [...waiters]) wake();
  })();
  return {
    session,
    events,
    ended,
    async next(type, match = () => true, options = {}) {
      const deadline = Date.now() + (options.timeoutMs ?? ATTEMPT_WAIT_MS);
      for (;;) {
        const found = events
          .slice(options.from ?? 0)
          .find((event) => event.type === type && match(event as Extract<AgentEvent, { type: typeof type }>));
        if (found) return found as Extract<AgentEvent, { type: typeof type }>;
        if (done) throw new Error(`the session ended without a matching ${type} event: ${JSON.stringify(events)}`);
        if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error(`no matching ${type} event: ${JSON.stringify(events)}`);
        await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
          const wake = () => {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            waiters.delete(wake);
            resolve();
          };
          const timer = setTimeout(wake, 200);
          waiters.add(wake);
        });
      }
    },
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The harness

export interface ClaudeSmokeOptions {
  /** The pinned claude; the gate's by default. */
  bin?: string;
  /** The scripted server's first handler; setHandler replaces it. */
  handler?: AnthropicHandler;
  /** CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES; 0 by default. */
  maxRetries?: number;
  /** runner.json's profile; standard by default. */
  profile?: RunnerConfig['profile'];
  /**
   * The host:port targets the CLI's proxy tunnels to the real host, for the sandbox's network checks: Claude's sandbox
   * proxy chains through HTTPS_PROXY, so behind a proxy that refuses everything no sandboxed command could reach an
   * allowed registry. Every other target is still refused and recorded, and the model still comes only from the
   * scripted server on 127.0.0.1.
   */
  egress?: string[];
  /**
   * The owner's SHELL, as the agent environment and preflight carry it (7.6); the test process's by default. The
   * adapter runs the CLI's shells as zsh whatever it is (8.2).
   */
  shell?: string;
  /** More files of the origin's main, so of the clone and the base checkout, besides README.md and src/app.ts. */
  files?: Record<string, string>;
  /** How the bridge and the brief hook run agflow: SMOKE_AGFLOW by default. */
  agflow?: AgflowCommand;
}

export interface StartSmokeOptions {
  /** A new session's first prompt. */
  prompt?: string;
  /** The session to resume instead. */
  resume?: string;
}

export interface ClaudeSmoke {
  /** The scratch directory everything but the clone's temporary directory lies in. */
  root: string;
  /** The agent's scratch HOME. */
  home: string;
  paths: RunnerPaths;
  config: RunnerConfig;
  /** The runner's Claude home, every launch's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. */
  claudeHome: string;
  server: ScriptedAnthropic;
  proxy: RefusingProxy;
  hub: TestHub;
  /** Every request the bridge and the brief hook sent the hub. */
  hubRequests: HubTapRequest[];
  origin: OriginRepo;
  /** The runner agent the hub knows, its attempt, task and agt_ token. */
  agent: Agent;
  attempt: Attempt;
  task: Task;
  token: string;
  /** A marker in the task's title: it reaches the model only through the hub's brief. */
  briefMarker: string;
  clone: string;
  baseCheckout: string;
  tmpDir: string;
  adapter: ClaudeAdapter;
  /** The launch a start uses: the agent environment, the bridge and the profile as the runner builds them. */
  launch(options?: StartSmokeOptions): AgentLaunch;
  /** Starts (or resumes) a session through the adapter, collecting its events. */
  start(options?: StartSmokeOptions): Promise<SmokeSession>;
  /** The pids the launches registered. */
  pids: number[];
  /** Holds the bridge's and the brief hook's requests for a hub path until release(). */
  holdHub(path: string): HubHold;
  /**
   * Why this harness may have let a request reach a real model, the owner's home or a host other than the scripted
   * server and the hub; empty when it did not.
   */
  isolationProblems(): string[];
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

const smokes = new Set<ClaudeSmoke>();

/** For afterEach: closes every harness a test started, even when it failed. */
export async function cleanupClaudeSmokes(): Promise<void> {
  for (const smoke of [...smokes]) await smoke.close();
}

/**
 * The user variables an agent environment carries over (design 7.6), with the scratch HOME in place of the owner's
 * and the given SHELL, if any.
 */
function runnerEnv(home: string, shell: string | undefined): Record<string, string> {
  const env: Record<string, string> = { HOME: home, AGFLOW_TEST: '1' };
  for (const name of ['USER', 'LOGNAME', 'LANG', 'SHELL']) {
    const value = process.env[name];
    if (value !== undefined) env[name] = value;
  }
  if (shell !== undefined) env.SHELL = shell;
  return env;
}

export async function startClaudeSmoke(options: ClaudeSmokeOptions = {}): Promise<ClaudeSmoke> {
  const bin = options.bin ?? claudeSmokeGate().bin;
  if (!bin) throw new Error('no pinned claude: check claudeSmokeGate() before starting the harness');
  const agflow = options.agflow ?? SMOKE_AGFLOW;
  const cleanups: (() => void | Promise<void>)[] = [];
  const later = (cleanup: () => void | Promise<void>) => cleanups.push(cleanup);
  const closeAll = async () => {
    for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) {
      try {
        await cleanup();
      } catch {
        // The rest is cleaned up regardless.
      }
    }
  };
  try {
    const root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'agflow-claude-smoke-')));
    later(() => rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
    const home = join(root, 'home');
    mkdirSync(home);
    const paths = runnerPaths(join(root, 'agflow'));
    ensureRunnerGitFiles(paths);
    linkClaudeBinary(paths.home, CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION, bin);

    const server = await startScriptedAnthropic({ handler: options.handler });
    later(() => server.close());
    const proxy = options.egress === undefined ? await startRefusingProxy() : await startEgressProxy(options.egress);
    later(() => proxy.close());
    const origin = await originRepo({
      'README.md': '# Smoke project\n',
      'src/app.ts': 'export const app = 1;\n',
      ...options.files,
    });
    later(() => origin.remove());
    const hub = startTestHub({ config: { projectName: PROJECT, projectRepo: origin.path } });
    later(() => hub.stop());
    const tap = startHubTap(hub.url);
    later(() => tap.stop());

    const briefMarker = `smoke-brief-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const [created] = createTasks(hub.ctx, [newTask({ title: `Tidy the app ${briefMarker}` })], 'user:alice');
    if (!created) throw new Error('the hub created no task');
    const { agent, attempt, task } = addRunnerAttempt(hub.ctx, { taskId: created.id });
    const token = mintAgentToken(hub.ctx, attempt);
    if (!task.branch) throw new Error(`${task.id} has no branch`);

    const claudeEnv = claudeTestEnv({ baseUrl: server.url, proxyUrl: proxy.url, maxRetries: options.maxRetries });
    const config = RunnerConfigSchema.parse({
      runnerKey: 'rk_claude_smoke',
      machineId: 'MACHINE-SMOKE',
      name: 'smoke-laptop',
      profile: options.profile ?? 'standard',
      test: {
        claudeEnv,
        skipAuthChecks: true,
      },
    });
    const claudeHome = vendorHomes(config, paths).claude;
    mkdirSync(claudeHome, { recursive: true });

    // The vault, the task clone and the base checkout as the runner makes them, with no owner git configuration.
    const project = projectKey(hub.url, PROJECT);
    const vault = new Vault({
      paths,
      project,
      repo: { url: origin.path, mainBranch: 'main' },
      remote: () => remoteGitEnv({ base: { PATH: process.env.PATH, HOME: home }, gitDir: paths.vault(project) }),
    });
    await vault.ensure();
    const fromMain = { ref: 'refs/heads/main', sha: null };
    await vault.fetchForAttempt({ taskId: task.id, start: fromMain }, hub.ctx.config.wipRefPrefix);
    const clonePath = paths.clone(project, attempt.id);
    await createTaskClone({
      vault,
      local: vault.local,
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      clone: clonePath,
      branch: task.branch,
      startSha: origin.mainSha,
    });
    const clone = realpathSync(clonePath);
    const base: BaseCheckout = await vault.acquireBaseCheckout(attempt.id);
    later(() => base.release());
    const tools = paths.agentTools(project, attempt.id);
    later(() => removeAgentTools(tools));
    writeRunDir({
      clone,
      tools,
      taskPack: `# ${task.id} ${task.title}\n`,
      brief: withWorkingDirectory(`Work on ${task.id}.`, clone),
      identity: config.commitIdentity,
    });
    const tmpDir = makeAttemptTmpDir();
    later(() => rmSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true }));

    const env = buildAgentEnv({
      vendor: 'claude',
      spec: { attemptId: attempt.id, role: 'worker', agentToken: token, hubUrl: tap.url },
      clone,
      tools,
      tmpDir,
      config,
      paths,
      base: runnerEnv(home, options.shell),
      env: { AGFLOW_TEST: '1' },
    });
    const adapter = createClaudeAdapter(
      { config, paths, agflow },
      { env: runnerEnv(home, options.shell) },
    );
    const pids: number[] = [];
    const identities: Promise<ProcessIdentity | null>[] = [];
    later(async () => {
      // Whatever CLI a test left running goes before its files do; the start time guards against a reused pid.
      for (const identity of await Promise.all(identities)) if (identity) await killGroup(identity, 'SIGKILL');
    });

    const launch = (start: StartSmokeOptions = {}): AgentLaunch => ({
      attemptId: attempt.id,
      role: 'worker',
      model: SMOKE_MODEL,
      cliVersion: CLAUDE_CLI_VERSION,
      clone,
      baseCheckout: base.path,
      projectConfigVerified: false,
      tmpDir,
      env,
      bridge: bridgeOf(agflow, 'claude', env),
      profile: profileOf(config),
      brief: withWorkingDirectory(`Work on ${task.id}.`, clone),
      firstPrompt: start.prompt ?? '',
      resume: start.resume === undefined ? null : { sessionRef: start.resume },
      logFile: join(root, 'attempt.log'),
      registerProcess: (pid) => {
        pids.push(pid);
        identities.push(processIdentity(pid));
      },
    });

    const smoke: ClaudeSmoke = {
      root,
      home,
      paths,
      config,
      claudeHome,
      server,
      proxy,
      hub,
      hubRequests: tap.requests,
      origin,
      agent,
      attempt,
      task,
      token,
      briefMarker,
      clone,
      baseCheckout: base.path,
      tmpDir,
      adapter,
      launch,
      pids,
      holdHub: (path) => tap.hold(path),
      async start(start = {}) {
        const session = (await adapter.start(launch(start))) as ClaudeSession;
        const collected = collect(session);
        later(async () => {
          session.terminate();
          await Promise.race([session.exited, Bun.sleep(5_000)]);
        });
        return collected;
      },
      isolationProblems() {
        return isolationProblems({
          env,
          root,
          home,
          claudeHome,
          server,
          proxy,
          hubUrl: tap.url,
        });
      },
      async close() {
        smokes.delete(smoke);
        await closeAll();
      },
    };
    smokes.add(smoke);
    return smoke;
  } catch (error) {
    await closeAll();
    throw error;
  }
}

function isolationProblems(input: {
  env: Record<string, string>;
  root: string;
  home: string;
  claudeHome: string;
  server: ScriptedAnthropic;
  proxy: RefusingProxy;
  hubUrl: string;
}): string[] {
  const { env, root, server } = input;
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const inside = (path: string | undefined) => path !== undefined && path.startsWith(`${root}/`);
  if (env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL !== server.url || !server.url.startsWith('http://127.0.0.1:')) {
    problems.push(`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is ${env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL}, not the scripted server on 127.0.0.1`);
  }
  if (env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY !== CLAUDE_TEST_API_KEY) problems.push('the agent environment holds another API key');
  if (env.HOME !== input.home || !inside(env.HOME)) problems.push(`HOME is ${env.HOME}, not the scratch home`);
  if (env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR !== input.claudeHome || !inside(env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR)) {
    problems.push(`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is ${env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}, not the scratch Claude home`);
  }
  if (env.HTTPS_PROXY !== input.proxy.url || env.HTTP_PROXY !== input.proxy.url) {
    problems.push(`HTTPS_PROXY is ${env.HTTPS_PROXY}, not the test proxy`);
  }
  if (!input.hubUrl.startsWith('http://127.0.0.1:') || env.AGFLOW_HUB_URL !== input.hubUrl) {
    problems.push(`AGFLOW_HUB_URL is ${env.AGFLOW_HUB_URL}, not the in-process hub`);
  }
  for (const request of server.requests) {
    if (request.headers['x-api-key'] !== CLAUDE_TEST_API_KEY || request.headers.authorization !== undefined) {
      problems.push(`a request to ${request.path} carried other credentials`);
    }
  }
  // Every other host goes through the test proxy, which records what it refused; none was even tried.
  for (const refused of input.proxy.refused) problems.push(`the CLI tried ${refused.method} ${refused.target}`);
  // The Claude home is the scratch one: no transcript was written anywhere else.
  if (existsSync(join(input.claudeHome, 'projects'))) {
    for (const dir of readdirSync(join(input.claudeHome, 'projects'))) {
      if (!dir.startsWith(root.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '-'))) problems.push(`a project directory ${dir} is outside`);
    }
  }
  return problems;
}

/**
 * The test proxy of the sandbox's network checks: like the refusing proxy, except that it tunnels a CONNECT to one of
 * the allowed host:port targets to the real host. Plain requests and every other target are refused and recorded.
 */
async function startEgressProxy(allowed: string[]): Promise<RefusingProxy> {
  const refused: RefusedRequest[] = [];
  const tunnels = new Set<Socket>();
  const server = createServer((request, response) => {
    refused.push({ kind: 'http', method: request.method ?? 'GET', target: request.url ?? '', at: Date.now() });
    response.writeHead(403, { 'content-type': 'text/plain' }).end('refused by the agflow test proxy\n');
  });
  server.on('connect', (request, client: Socket, head: Buffer) => {
    const target = request.url ?? '';
    client.on('error', () => {});
    if (!allowed.includes(target)) {
      refused.push({ kind: 'connect', method: 'CONNECT', target, at: Date.now() });
      client.end('HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n');
      return;
    }
    const colon = target.lastIndexOf(':');
    const upstream = connect(Number(target.slice(colon + 1)), target.slice(0, colon), () => {
      client.write('HTTP/1.1 200 Connection Established\r\n\r\n');
      upstream.write(head);
      upstream.pipe(client);
      client.pipe(upstream);
    });
    for (const socket of [client, upstream]) {
      tunnels.add(socket);
      socket.on('close', () => tunnels.delete(socket));
    }
    upstream.on('error', () => client.destroy());
    client.on('close', () => upstream.destroy());
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    server.once('error', reject);
    server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => resolve());
  });
  const { port } = server.address() as AddressInfo;
  return {
    url: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
    port,
    refused,
    close: () =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        server.close(() => resolve());
        server.closeAllConnections();
        // A tunnel is no longer the server's connection.
        for (const socket of tunnels) socket.destroy();
      }),
  };
}
```

```ts
    expect(first?.problems).toEqual([]);
    const init = first?.init;
    if (!init) throw new Error('no system/init');
    // Only the built-ins asked for, plus the bridge's tools.

    expect(builtins.sort()).toEqual([...CLAUDE_BUILTIN_TOOLS].sort());
    const bridged = init.tools.filter((tool) => tool.startsWith('mcp__'));
    expect(bridged).toContain('mcp__agflow__get_goal');
    expect(bridged.every((tool) => tool.startsWith('mcp__agflow__'))).toBe(true);
    const servers = init.mcp_servers.map(({ name, status }) => ({ name, status }));
    expect(servers).toEqual([{ name: 'agflow', status: 'connected' }]);
    for (const plugin of init.plugins) {

    }
    expect(await session.next('turn_ended')).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed', error: null });
    // What the model is offered is the same set; 2.1.285 offers its Task tool to the model as Agent.
    const request = smoke.server.requests.find((candidate) => candidate.mainLoop);
```

### Task 25: Real-CLI smoke: delivery, interrupts and stop

Delivery into a running turn, both interrupts and the stop, on the real CLI (design 15, 8.3, 7.4). The Bash tool waits for a file the test creates, a held scripted reply keeps a model call open until the interrupt, and a sent message counts as queued only once the CLI's transcript records its enqueue, so the test decides the order of events, never a sleep. A note sent while Bash runs folds into the same turn after the tool result and is delivered before it is acknowledged; a plain interrupt ends the turn `interrupted` and the queued message runs next; `cancelQueued` ends it and the dropped message never reaches the model; and `close()` ends the CLI with code 0 within the 2 s close step and leaves its process group empty.

**Files:**
- Test: `packages/runner/test/claude-real/session.test.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Make the change**

**File:** `packages/runner/test/claude-real/session.test.ts` (new)

```ts
// Delivery, interrupts and the stop with the real claude (design 15, 8.3, 7.4), gated by AGFLOW_SMOKE=1 (X-20). The
// Bash commands wait for a file the test creates, a held scripted reply keeps a model call open until the interrupt,
// and a sent message counts as queued only once the CLI's transcript records it, so the test decides the order of
// events, never a sleep.
import { afterEach, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { afterToolResult, bashTool, hold, reply, rules, userSays } from '@agflow/testkit/src/anthropic';
import { claudeProjectDir } from '../../src/adapters/claude/paths';
import { boundedWait, listProcesses } from '../../src/processes';
import { waitFor } from '../fixture';
import {
  type ClaudeSmoke,
  cleanupClaudeSmokes,
  claudeSmokeGate,
  type SmokeSession,
  smokeDescribe,
  startClaudeSmoke,
} from './harness';

// A cold start of the CLI, its sandbox, the bridge and the brief hook, on a machine other suites may load.
setDefaultTimeout(180_000);

afterEach(cleanupClaudeSmokes);

const gate = claudeSmokeGate();

/** The stop ladder's close step (7.4): stdin EOF, then 2 s before the group gets SIGTERM. */
const CLOSE_BUDGET_MS = 2_000;

/** A Bash command that runs until the test creates the file. */
function waitingCommand(file: string): string {
  return `until [ -e '${file}' ]; do sleep 0.1; done; echo released`;
}

/** Polls an asynchronous check until it holds, or fails after timeoutMs. */
async function until(check: () => Promise<boolean>, timeoutMs: number): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (!(await check())) {
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error(`waited ${timeoutMs} ms in vain`);
    await Bun.sleep(50);
  }
}

/** Resolves once the model's call of the tool reached the CLI: the turn is in that tool's step. */
async function inTool(session: SmokeSession, toolId: string): Promise<void> {
  await session.next('tool_started', (event) => event.toolId === toolId);
}

/**
 * Resolves once the CLI read the message from its input and queued it: 2.1.285 then writes a queue-operation enqueue
 * line holding the text into the session's transcript. Before that, the message could still arrive after the tool's
 * step or the interrupt it is meant to precede.
 */
async function queued(smoke: ClaudeSmoke, session: SmokeSession, text: string): Promise<void> {
  const transcript = join(claudeProjectDir(smoke.claudeHome, smoke.clone), `${session.session.sessionRef}.jsonl`);
  const enqueued = (line: string) => {
    try {
      const entry = JSON.parse(line) as { type?: unknown; operation?: unknown; content?: unknown };
      return entry.type === 'queue-operation' && entry.operation === 'enqueue' && entry.content === text;
    } catch {
      // The line the CLI is still writing.
      return false;
    }
  };
  await waitFor(() => existsSync(transcript) && readFileSync(transcript, 'utf8').split('\n').some(enqueued), 30_000);
}

smokeDescribe(gate, 'the real claude: delivery, interrupts and stop', () => {
  test('a message sent while Bash runs is folded in after its result, then delivered and acknowledged', async () => {
    const PROMPT = 'Run the slow check.';
    const NOTE = 'A note for you while that runs: keep going.';
    const smoke = await startClaudeSmoke();
    const release = join(smoke.tmpDir, 'release-fold');
    smoke.server.setHandler(
      rules(
        { when: afterToolResult('toolu_fold_1'), reply: reply('Done, and I saw your note.') },
        { when: userSays(PROMPT), reply: reply(bashTool({ command: waitingCommand(release), id: 'toolu_fold_1' })) },
      ),
    );
    const session = await smoke.start({ prompt: PROMPT });
    await inTool(session, 'toolu_fold_1');
    await session.session.send({ id: 'msg-note', text: NOTE, authority: 'person' });
    await queued(smoke, session, NOTE);
    writeFileSync(release, '');
    const ended = await session.next('turn_ended');
    expect(ended).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed', error: null, toolCalls: 1 });
    // The model saw the note with the tool's result, in the same turn.
    const folded = smoke.server.requests.find((request) => afterToolResult('toolu_fold_1')(request));
    expect(folded?.lastToolResult?.text).toContain('released');
    expect(folded?.userTexts.some((text) => text.includes(NOTE))).toBe(true);
    expect(session.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'turn_started')).toHaveLength(1);
    const delivered = session.events.findIndex((event) => event.type === 'delivered' && event.id === 'msg-note');
    const acknowledged = session.events.findIndex((event) => event.type === 'acknowledged' && event.id === 'msg-note');
    expect(delivered).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(acknowledged).toBeGreaterThan(delivered);
    expect(smoke.isolationProblems()).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a plain interrupt ends the turn interrupted and leaves a queued message to run next', async () => {
    const PROMPT = 'Think about the task.';
    const NOTE = 'When you can: look at the README.';
    const smoke = await startClaudeSmoke({
      handler: rules(
        { when: userSays(NOTE), reply: reply('Picked up the note.') },
        // Never released: the model call is still streaming when the interrupt comes.
        { when: userSays(PROMPT), reply: hold('never', reply('Thinking done.')) },
      ),
    });
    const session = await smoke.start({ prompt: PROMPT });
    await waitFor(() => smoke.server.requests.some((request) => request.mainLoop && userSays(PROMPT)(request)));
    await session.session.send({ id: 'msg-queued', text: NOTE, authority: 'person' });
    await queued(smoke, session, NOTE);
    await session.session.interrupt();
    expect(await session.next('turn_ended')).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'interrupted', errorKind: null });
    const interrupted = session.events.findIndex((event) => event.type === 'turn_ended');
    // The queued message starts the next turn, which the model answers.
    expect(await session.next('turn_ended', () => true, { from: interrupted + 1 })).toMatchObject({
      outcome: 'completed',
      error: null,
    });
    expect(smoke.server.requests.some((request) => request.mainLoop && userSays(NOTE)(request))).toBe(true);
    expect(await session.next('acknowledged', (event) => event.id === 'msg-queued')).toBeDefined();
    expect(smoke.isolationProblems()).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('an interrupt with cancelQueued ends the turn interrupted, and nothing queued runs', async () => {
    const PROMPT = 'Run the long check.';
    const DROPPED = 'This note is dropped by the stop.';
    const LATER = 'Say hello.';
    const smoke = await startClaudeSmoke();
    const release = join(smoke.tmpDir, 'release-never');
    smoke.server.setHandler(
      rules(
        { when: userSays(LATER), reply: reply('Hello.') },
        { when: userSays(DROPPED), reply: reply('I should never see this.') },
        { when: userSays(PROMPT), reply: reply(bashTool({ command: waitingCommand(release), id: 'toolu_stop_1' })) },
      ),
    );
    const session = await smoke.start({ prompt: PROMPT });
    await inTool(session, 'toolu_stop_1');
    await session.session.send({ id: 'msg-dropped', text: DROPPED, authority: 'person' });
    await queued(smoke, session, DROPPED);
    await session.session.interrupt({ cancelQueued: true });
    expect(await session.next('turn_ended')).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'interrupted', errorKind: null });
    // The next message runs alone: the dropped one reached no request, not even as history.
    const interrupted = session.events.findIndex((event) => event.type === 'turn_ended');
    await session.session.send({ id: 'msg-later', text: LATER, authority: 'person' });
    expect(await session.next('turn_ended', () => true, { from: interrupted + 1 })).toMatchObject({
      outcome: 'completed',
    });
    const mentions = smoke.server.requests.filter((request) => JSON.stringify(request.body).includes(DROPPED));
    expect(mentions).toEqual([]);
    expect(session.events.filter((event) => 'id' in event && event.id === 'msg-dropped')).toEqual([]);
    expect(smoke.isolationProblems()).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('close() ends the CLI within the stop budget and leaves no process in its group', async () => {
    const PROMPT = 'Say hello.';
    const smoke = await startClaudeSmoke({ handler: rules({ when: userSays(PROMPT), reply: reply('Hello.') }) });
    const session = await smoke.start({ prompt: PROMPT });
    expect(await session.next('turn_ended')).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed' });
    const group = session.session.pid;
    expect(group).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    // The bridge runs in the CLI's group.
    expect((await listProcesses()).filter((row) => row.pgid === group).length).toBeGreaterThan(1);
    const closed = Date.now();
    await session.session.close();
    const exit = await boundedWait(session.session.exited, CLOSE_BUDGET_MS);
    expect(exit).toEqual({ done: true, value: { code: 0, signal: null } });
    await until(async () => (await listProcesses()).every((row) => row.pgid !== group), CLOSE_BUDGET_MS);
    expect(Date.now() - closed).toBeLessThan(CLOSE_BUDGET_MS);
    await session.ended;
    expect(smoke.isolationProblems()).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

### Task 26: Real-CLI smoke: resume, vendor errors, compaction and transcript

The rest of what design 15 asks of the Claude adapter, on the real CLI (8.3, 8.4, 7.8). A resume continues the conversation with the same session id, and the brief hook fires again. A session the real CLI left before its first turn (killed inside its SessionStart hook while the brief is held) resumes as a fresh session with a new `sessionRef` and exactly one more process (X-50). With retries off, a 529, a 500 and a 429 each end the turn `failed` with `errorKind` `vendor` and no quota event. `/compact` gives `compacted` with the scripted summary, and after the exit the transcript tail holds the last assistant text and `deleteTranscript` removes the transcript and its saved tool output.

**Files:**
- Test: `packages/runner/test/claude-real/resume.test.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Make the change**

**File:** `packages/runner/test/claude-real/resume.test.ts` (new)

```ts
// Resume, vendor errors, compaction and the transcript with the real claude (design 15, 8.3, 8.4, 7.8), gated by
// AGFLOW_SMOKE=1 (X-20). Retries are off (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES=0), so an API error reaches the adapter at once.
import { afterEach, expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from 'bun:test';
import { existsSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import {
  type AnthropicHandler,
  afterToolResult,
  bashTool,
  fail,
  reply,
  rules,
  userSays,
} from '@agflow/testkit/src/anthropic';
import { claudeProjectDir } from '../../src/adapters/claude/paths';
import { cleanupClaudeSmokes, claudeSmokeGate, type SmokeSession, smokeDescribe, startClaudeSmoke } from './harness';

// A cold start of the CLI, its sandbox, the bridge and the brief hook, on a machine other suites may load.
setDefaultTimeout(180_000);

afterEach(cleanupClaudeSmokes);

const gate = claudeSmokeGate();

/** Ends the input and waits for the CLI to exit and the events to end. */
async function closed(session: SmokeSession): Promise<void> {
  await session.session.close();
  await session.ended;
}

smokeDescribe(gate, 'the real claude: resume, vendor errors, compaction and the transcript', () => {
  test('a resume continues the conversation, and the brief hook fires again', async () => {
    const FIRST = 'Remember the word heliotrope.';
    const SECOND = 'Which word did I ask you to remember?';
    const smoke = await startClaudeSmoke({
      handler: rules(
        { when: userSays(SECOND), reply: reply('You asked me to remember heliotrope.') },
        { when: userSays(FIRST), reply: reply('I will remember heliotrope.') },
      ),
    });
    const first = await smoke.start({ prompt: FIRST });
    expect(await first.next('turn_ended')).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed' });
    await closed(first);
    const sessionRef = first.session.sessionRef;

    const resumed = await smoke.start({ resume: sessionRef });
    expect(resumed.session.sessionRef).toBe(sessionRef);
    // As the controller does once the start resolved: the resume's message starts its first turn.
    await resumed.session.send({ id: 'msg-resume', text: SECOND, authority: 'system' });
    expect(await resumed.next('turn_ended')).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed', error: null });
    expect(await resumed.next('started')).toMatchObject({ sessionRef });
    // The model sees the earlier turn, in the same session.
    const request = smoke.server.requests.find((candidate) => candidate.mainLoop && userSays(SECOND)(candidate));
    expect(request?.sessionId).toBe(sessionRef);
    const history = JSON.stringify(request?.messages);
    expect(history).toContain(FIRST);
    expect(history).toContain('I will remember heliotrope.');
    // The brief hook ran for the start and again for the resume.
    expect(smoke.hubRequests.filter((hub) => hub.path === '/api/brief' && hub.status === 200)).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(smoke.isolationProblems()).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('resuming a session that never ran a turn starts a fresh session with a new sessionRef', async () => {
    const PROMPT = 'Start working on the task.';
    const smoke = await startClaudeSmoke({ handler: rules({ when: userSays(PROMPT), reply: reply('Starting.') }) });
    // The real CLI leaves the session that never ran a turn: it dies in its SessionStart hook, while the hub holds the
    // brief. 2.1.285 writes a session's transcript only once that hook ended, together with the first user line, so
    // the session it leaves has its session-env directory and no transcript.
    const brief = smoke.holdHub('/api/brief');
    const dying = smoke.start({ prompt: 'This prompt never reaches the model.' });
    await brief.reached;
    const [first] = smoke.pids;
    if (first === undefined) throw new Error('the first launch registered no process');
    process.kill(-first, 'SIGTERM');
    const [settled] = await Promise.allSettled([dying]);
    if (settled.status === 'fulfilled') await settled.value.ended;
    const sessions = readdirSync(join(smoke.claudeHome, 'session-env'));
    expect(sessions).toHaveLength(1);
    const never = sessions[0] ?? '';
    expect(existsSync(join(claudeProjectDir(smoke.claudeHome, smoke.clone), `${never}.jsonl`))).toBe(false);
    brief.release();

    const before = smoke.server.requests.length;
    const session = await smoke.start({ resume: never, prompt: PROMPT });
    expect(session.session.sessionRef).not.toBe(never);
    expect(await session.next('started')).toMatchObject({ sessionRef: session.session.sessionRef });
    expect(await session.next('turn_ended')).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed' });
    const request = smoke.server.requests.find((candidate) => candidate.mainLoop && userSays(PROMPT)(candidate));
    expect(request?.sessionId).toBe(session.session.sessionRef);
    expect(smoke.server.requests.slice(before).filter((candidate) => candidate.sessionId === never)).toEqual([]);
    // One launch, one process (X-50): no resume was spawned first.
    expect(smoke.pids).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(smoke.isolationProblems()).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a 529 or 500 gives a failed turn with errorKind vendor, and a 429 a vendor error, not quota', async () => {
    const sent: [prompt: string, status: number][] = [
      ['Overloaded call.', 529],
      ['Broken call.', 500],
      ['Limited call.', 429],
    ];
    // A failed turn adds no assistant message, so a later request's newest user entry still holds the earlier
    // prompts: the rules check the newest prompt first.
    const smoke = await startClaudeSmoke({
      maxRetries: 0,
      handler: rules(
        ...[...sent].reverse().map(([prompt, status]) => ({ when: userSays(prompt), reply: fail(status) })),
      ),
    });
    const session = await smoke.start({ prompt: sent[0]?.[0] });
    for (const [index, [prompt, status]] of sent.entries()) {
      const from = session.events.length;
      if (index > 0) await session.session.send({ id: `msg-${index}`, text: prompt, authority: 'system' });
      const ended = await session.next('turn_ended', () => true, { from });
      expect(ended).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'failed', errorKind: 'vendor' });
      // The turn failed with its own prompt's status, not an earlier one's.
      expect(ended.error).toContain(String(status));
      // Retries are off: one request per prompt.
      expect(smoke.server.requests.filter((request) => request.mainLoop && userSays(prompt)(request))).toHaveLength(1);
    }
    expect(session.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'quota')).toEqual([]);
    expect(smoke.isolationProblems()).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('/compact gives compacted with the scripted summary', async () => {
    const PROMPT = 'Say hello in one word.';
    const SUMMARY = 'Summary: the agent said hello; nothing else happened.';
    const main = rules({ when: userSays(PROMPT), reply: reply('Hello.') });
    const handler: AnthropicHandler = (request) => (request.compaction ? reply(SUMMARY) : main(request));
    const smoke = await startClaudeSmoke({ handler });
    const session = await smoke.start({ prompt: PROMPT });
    expect(await session.next('turn_ended')).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed' });
    await session.session.send({ id: 'msg-compact', text: '/compact', authority: 'system' });
    const compacted = await session.next('compacted');
    expect(compacted.summary).toContain(SUMMARY);
    expect(smoke.server.requests.some((request) => request.compaction)).toBe(true);
    expect(smoke.isolationProblems()).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('after the exit, the transcript tail holds the last assistant text; deleteTranscript removes it', async () => {
    const PROMPT = 'Print a long listing.';
    const LAST = 'The listing is long; I am done.';
    // Output this long is persisted beside the transcript instead of kept in it.
    const LONG = 'yes a | head -c 120000';
    const smoke = await startClaudeSmoke({
      handler: rules(
        { when: afterToolResult('toolu_long_1'), reply: reply(LAST) },
        { when: userSays(PROMPT), reply: reply(bashTool({ command: LONG, id: 'toolu_long_1' })) },
      ),
    });
    const session = await smoke.start({ prompt: PROMPT });
    expect(await session.next('turn_ended')).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'completed' });
    await closed(session);
    const ref = { sessionRef: session.session.sessionRef, clone: smoke.clone };
    expect(await smoke.adapter.readTranscriptTail({ ...ref, maxChars: 2_000 })).toEndWith(LAST);
    const project = claudeProjectDir(smoke.claudeHome, smoke.clone);
    const transcript = join(project, `${ref.sessionRef}.jsonl`);
    const toolResults = join(project, ref.sessionRef, 'tool-results');
    expect(existsSync(transcript)).toBe(true);
    expect(readdirSync(toolResults).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await smoke.adapter.deleteTranscript(ref);
    expect(existsSync(transcript)).toBe(false);
    expect(existsSync(join(project, ref.sessionRef))).toBe(false);
    expect(await smoke.adapter.readTranscriptTail({ ...ref, maxChars: 2_000 })).toBeNull();
    expect(smoke.isolationProblems()).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

### Task 27: Sandbox checks: network and keychain

Local checks of boundary 1 and the keychain (design 5, 15, 7.6), gated also by `AGFLOW_SANDBOX_CHECKS=1`, macOS only (X-20). The model runs POSIX probe scripts from the clone as one `sh agflow-probes/<script>` Bash call each, so the guard never pre-empts the sandbox and 2.1.285 asks no approval, and the same scripts run outside for comparison. From inside, neither the hub nor github.com is reachable over HTTPS or SSH, through the sandbox proxy or directly, while registry.npmjs.org is reachable through the HTTP and the SOCKS proxy. Claude's sandbox proxy chains through the CLI's `HTTPS_PROXY`, so these runs use the harness's `egress` proxy, which tunnels only `registry.npmjs.org:443` and refuses and records every other target. A throwaway keychain file in the scratch `HOME`'s `Library/Keychains`, set never to lock, is readable outside before and after and refused inside; the owner's login keychain and search list are never touched. `checks.ts` holds the shared pieces: the gate, the probe runner and parser, outside runs, the keychain and the check table.

- Test: `packages/runner/test/claude-sandbox/checks.ts`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/claude-sandbox/network-keychain.test.ts`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/claude-sandbox/probes/keychain.sh`
- Test: `packages/runner/test/claude-sandbox/probes/net.sh`

```ts
// Shared pieces of the local sandbox checks (design 5, 15, 7.6; X-20): their gate, the probe scripts the model runs
// through real sandboxed Bash calls, the same scripts run outside for comparison, a throwaway keychain, and the table
// of what each check expected and observed, which the suites print.
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { homedir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { afterToolResult, bashTool, reply, rules, type ScriptRule, userSays } from '@agflow/testkit/src/anthropic';
import {
  type ClaudeSmoke,
  type ClaudeSmokeGate,
  type ClaudeSmokeGateOptions,
  claudeSmokeGate,
} from '../claude-real/harness';

/** check:claude-sandbox sets both: the checks are real-CLI suites too. */
const SANDBOX_SWITCHES = ['AGFLOW_SMOKE', 'AGFLOW_SANDBOX_CHECKS'];

/** The git host the network checks try, over HTTPS and SSH. */
export const SANDBOX_GIT_HOST = 'github.com';

/** An allowed registry of the standard profile (7.6). */
export const SANDBOX_REGISTRY = 'registry.npmjs.org';

const PROBES = join(import.meta.dir, 'probes');

const SYSTEM_PATH = '/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin';

/** Where the probe scripts lie in the clone, relative to it: the agent's commands run there. */
const CLONE_PROBES = 'agflow-probes';

/** A probe of slow hosts waits out several timeouts; the Bash tool's default of 2 minutes is too short. */
const PROBE_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS = 300_000;

/**
 * Whether the sandbox checks run: only on macOS, whose Seatbelt sandbox they check, with AGFLOW_SMOKE=1 and
 * AGFLOW_SANDBOX_CHECKS=1 and the pinned claude. Otherwise the reason says what is missing.
 */
export function sandboxGate(options: ClaudeSmokeGateOptions & { platform?: string } = {}): ClaudeSmokeGate {
  const platform = options.platform ?? process.platform;
  if (platform !== 'darwin') return { run: false, bin: null, reason: `the sandbox checks need macOS, not ${platform}` };
  return claudeSmokeGate({ ...options, switches: SANDBOX_SWITCHES });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Probes

/** What a probe script printed for one label: `PROBE <label words>: <result> <detail>`. */
export interface ProbeResult {
  result: string;
  detail: string;
}

export type ProbeResults = Map<string, ProbeResult>;

const PROBE_LINE = /^PROBE (.+?): (\S+) ?(.*)$/;

/** The PROBE lines of a script's output, by label; the last line of a label wins. */
export function parseProbes(output: string): ProbeResults {
  const results: ProbeResults = new Map();
  // ssh's log lines end in \r\n.
  for (const line of output.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const found = line.match(PROBE_LINE);
    if (found?.[1] && found[2]) results.set(found[1], { result: found[2], detail: found[3] ?? '' });
  }
  return results;
}

/** The environment of an outside run: no proxy, no SSH agent, and the scratch HOME. */
export function outsideEnv(smoke: Pick<ClaudeSmoke, 'home'>): Record<string, string> {
  return { PATH: SYSTEM_PATH, HOME: smoke.home, LANG: 'C.UTF-8' };
}

/**
 * Runs a probe script outside the sandbox, as the test process. Asynchronously: the hub it may probe answers from
 * this process.
 */
export async function runOutside(script: string, args: string[], env: Record<string, string>): Promise<ProbeResults> {
  const proc = Bun.spawn(['/bin/sh', join(PROBES, script), ...args], {
    env,
    stdin: 'ignore',
    stdout: 'pipe',
    // Piped, not ignored: ssh does not run its key exchange with a closed standard error.
    stderr: 'pipe',
  });
  const [output] = await Promise.all([new Response(proc.stdout).text(), new Response(proc.stderr).text(), proc.exited]);
  return parseProbes(output);
}

/** The Bash command that runs a probe script from the clone, its arguments quoted for the shell. */
export function probeCommand(script: string, args: string[]): string {
  return ['sh', `${CLONE_PROBES}/${script}`, ...args].map(shellQuote).join(' ');
}

function shellQuote(word: string): string {
  return /^[\w./:@-]+$/.test(word) ? word : `'${word.replaceAll("'", `'\\''`)}'`;
}

/**
 * Has the model run the commands through the Bash tool, one call after another in one turn, from the clone with the
 * probe scripts copied in, and returns every PROBE line the results carried. A result without one (a permission
 * denial, say) fails with what the model saw.
 */
export async function runAsAgent(smoke: ClaudeSmoke, commands: string[]): Promise<ProbeResults> {
  const directory = join(smoke.clone, CLONE_PROBES);
  mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true });
  for (const script of readdirSync(PROBES)) copyFileSync(join(PROBES, script), join(directory, script));
  const prompt = `Run the sandbox probes ${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}.`;
  const ids = commands.map((_, index) => `toolu_probe_${index + 1}`);
  const call = (index: number) =>
    reply(bashTool({ command: commands[index] ?? '', id: ids[index], timeoutMs: PROBE_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS }));
  // Each result asks for the next command; the last one ends the turn.
  const script: ScriptRule[] = ids.map((id, index) => ({
    when: afterToolResult(id),
    reply: index + 1 < ids.length ? call(index + 1) : reply('The probes ran.'),
  }));
  smoke.server.setHandler(rules(...script, { when: userSays(prompt), reply: call(0) }));
  const session = await smoke.start({ prompt });
  const ended = await session.next('turn_ended', () => true, { timeoutMs: PROBE_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS * commands.length });
  await session.session.close();
  await session.ended;
  if (ended.outcome !== 'completed') throw new Error(`the probe turn ended ${ended.outcome}: ${ended.error}`);
  const results: ProbeResults = new Map();
  for (const [index, id] of ids.entries()) {
    const answered = smoke.server.requests.find((request) => afterToolResult(id)(request));
    const text = answered?.toolResults.find((result) => result.toolUseId === id)?.text;
    const parsed = parseProbes(text ?? '');
    if (parsed.size === 0) throw new Error(`\`${commands[index]}\` printed no probe line: ${text ?? 'no result'}`);
    for (const [label, result] of parsed) results.set(label, result);
  }
  return results;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The throwaway keychain

export interface ThrowawayKeychain {
  path: string;
  service: string;
  account: string;
  secret: string;
  /** Deletes the keychain; safe to call more than once. */
  remove(): void;
}

/**
 * A new keychain file holding one generic-password item, made with `security` under the given (scratch) HOME. The
 * owner's login keychain and search list are left alone, which is checked.
 */
export function throwawayKeychain(path: string, home: string): ThrowawayKeychain {
  const security = (args: string[], env: Record<string, string> = { PATH: SYSTEM_PATH, HOME: home }) =>
    Bun.spawnSync(['/usr/bin/security', ...args], { env, stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' });
  const run = (...args: string[]) => {
    const result = security(args);
    if (result.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`security ${args[0]} failed: ${result.stderr.toString().trim()}`);
  };
  const tag = crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
  const keychain: ThrowawayKeychain = {
    path,
    service: `agflow-sandbox-probe-${tag}`,
    account: 'agflow-probe',
    secret: `agflow-probe-secret-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    remove() {
      if (!existsSync(path)) return;
      security(['delete-keychain', path]);
      rmSync(path, { force: true });
    },
  };
  try {
    run('create-keychain', '-p', crypto.randomUUID(), path);
    run('add-generic-password', '-s', keychain.service, '-a', keychain.account, '-w', keychain.secret, path);
    // A new keychain locks after 5 minutes and on sleep, and a locked one refuses the lookup inside for that reason
    // alone; with no options it never locks.
    run('set-keychain-settings', path);
    // show-keychain-info writes to standard error.
    const settings = security(['show-keychain-info', path]).stderr.toString().trim();
    if (!settings.includes('no-timeout') || settings.includes('lock-on-sleep')) {
      throw new Error(`${path} still locks itself: ${settings}`);
    }
    // The user's search list, as the owner's own processes see it.
    const owner = security(['list-keychains', '-d', 'user'], { PATH: SYSTEM_PATH, HOME: homedir() });
    if (owner.stdout.toString().includes(path)) throw new Error(`${path} joined the owner's keychain search list`);
  } catch (error) {
    keychain.remove();
    throw error;
  }
  return keychain;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The table

export interface CheckRow {
  check: string;
  expected: string;
  observed: string;
  /** Why the check did not run (an unreachable host, say); a skipped row never mismatches. */
  skipped?: string | null;
}

/** The rows under a title, in aligned columns; a mismatching row is marked. */
export function formatChecks(title: string, rows: CheckRow[]): string {
  const header: CheckRow = { check: 'check', expected: 'expected', observed: 'observed' };
  const all = [header, ...rows];
  const checkWidth = Math.max(...all.map((row) => row.check.length));
  const expectedWidth = Math.max(...all.map((row) => row.expected.length));
  const lines = all.map((row) => {
    const observed = row.skipped ? `skipped: ${row.skipped}` : row.observed;
    const mark = row !== header && isMismatch(row) ? '  MISMATCH' : '';
    return `  ${row.check.padEnd(checkWidth)}  ${row.expected.padEnd(expectedWidth)}  ${observed}${mark}`.trimEnd();
  });
  return [title, ...lines].join('\n');
}

function isMismatch(row: CheckRow): boolean {
  return !row.skipped && row.expected !== row.observed;
}

/** The rows whose observed result is not the expected one. */
export function mismatches(rows: CheckRow[]): CheckRow[] {
  return rows.filter(isMismatch);
}

/** The checks one suite made, printed once it ends, so a run shows what held and what did not. */
export class CheckTable {
  readonly rows: CheckRow[] = [];

  constructor(readonly title: string) {}

  /** Adds the rows and returns them, for the test's own assertions. */
  add(...rows: CheckRow[]): CheckRow[] {
    this.rows.push(...rows);
    return rows;
  }

  print(): void {
    if (this.rows.length > 0) console.log(formatChecks(this.title, this.rows));
  }
}
```
